स: स 1. स, the thirty-second consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and last of the three sibilants; it belongs to the dental class and in sound corres-ponds to स् in सिन्. —स-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound स्।
स 2. स, (in prosody) an anapest or foot consisting of two short syllables followed by a long one.
स 3. स, अस्, m. a snake; air, wind; a bird; an abbreviated term for the musical note षड्-ज; Śiva; Viṣṇu; (आ), f. the goddess Lak-ṣmī; (अम्), n. knowledge; meditation; a carriage road; a fence.
स 4. स, the actual base for the nom. case masc. of the third personal pronoun तद्, q. v., (Ved. loc. सस्मिन्।)

स 5. स, ind. a prefix substituted for सह or सम् or सम, and when combined with nouns to form compound adjectives and adverbs yielding the senses ‘with,’ ‘together with,’ ‘along with,’ ‘having,’ ‘accompanied by,’ ‘possessing,’ ‘same,’ ‘similar,’ or translateable by the English adverbial affix ‘ly’ (e. g. स-कोप, having anger, angry; स-कोपम्, with anger, angrily; स-भार्य, accompanied by a wife; साग्नि, along with fire; सोपधि, fraudu-lently; स-धर्मन्, having similar duties); [cf. Lith. sa in sa-darbininkas, ‘a fellow-worker;’ sa-karawis, ‘a fellow-soldier:’ Gr. σα in σαφής (cf. φάος, φῶς); ἀ in some compounds, as in ἄλοχος, ἄκοιτις, ἀκοίτης, ἀδελφός (= सोदर).]
5. स, अस्, आ, अम्, giving, bestowing, &c. (at the end of comps., cf. सदा-स).
संय: संय सं-य। See under सं-यम् below.
संयज्: संयज् सं-यज्, cl. 1. P. A. -यजति, -ते, -यष्टुम्, to worship together, offer sacrifices at the same time; to sacrifice, worship, adore, honour; to consecrate, dedicate: Caus. -याजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sacrifice together; (in Vedic ritual) to perform the Patnī-saṃyājas, repeat the Saṃ-yāja Mantras; to perform a sacrifice for another, act as sacrificing priest for any one (acc.).
संयाज: सं-याज, अस्, m. a sacrifice, (see पत्नी-स्°।)
संयाज्य: सं-याज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made or allowed to sacrifice, &c., (अ-संयाज्य, one with whom nobody is allowed to sacrifice); (अम्), n. sacrificing [cf. अयाज्य-स्°]; (आ), f., N. of the Yājyā and Anu-vākyā Mantras (as required in the Sviṣṭa-kṛt ceremony).
समिष्ट: समिष्ट सम्-इष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सं-यज्), sacrificed together, sacrificed.
संयत्: संयत् 1. सं-यत्, cl. 1. A. (Ved. also P.) -यतते (-ति), to unite, join (P. Ved., but according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VI. 67, 3. संयतथस् = संयच्छथस्); to form or be formed in rows; to unite, meet together, agree, coincide, coalesce, join with; to encounter, quarrel, dispute, contend (e. g. देवासुराः समयतन्त, the gods and Asuras con-tended).

2. सं-यत्, त्, त्, त् (also to be connected with rt. 2. यत्), Ved. making efforts, zealous, eager; strong, plentiful, abundant; (त्), m. f. contest, conflict, war, battle (= सङ्ग्राम, Naigh. II. 17). —संयद्-वर, अस्, m. ‘chief in battle,’ a king, prince, chief; [cf. सम्पद्वर।] —संयद्-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, ex-plained by Sāy. on Ṛg-veda II. 4, 8. संयतो वीरा यस्मिन् तादृश, perhaps an epithet of ‘food’ as ‘supporting strong heroes.’
संयत्त: सं-यत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared, ready, entirely devoted to, taking great care, being on guard.
संयन्त्रित: संयन्त्रित सं-यन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened with bands, held in, stopped.
संयम्: संयम् सं-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति (some-times also A. -ते), &c., -यन्तुम्, to hold together, hold in, hold fast; to restrain thoroughly or com-pletely, check, guide, control, govern, have power over; to guide or drive horses; to keep down, suppress (passions, feelings, &c.), subdue; to bind or fasten together, tie up; to put together, heap up; to shut up, close; to keep or maintain in order; to constrain; to make a present, present with, give to (A. with inst. of person when the action is illicit; P. with dat. when the action is usual, see Pāṇ. I. 3, 55): Pass. -यम्यते, to be restrained or kept in check, &c.: Caus. -यमयति, &c., to cause to restrain, &c.; to subdue, overcome; to fasten to-gether, bind up.
संयत: सं-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, held together, held in; well or completely restrained, checked, controlled, fettered, confined, governed, guided, driven; kept down, suppressed, subdued; bound together, bound; fastened up, tied up; imprisoned; restricted, limited, kept in order, arranged; = उद्यत, prepared, ready (with inf.); (अस्), m. one who restrains or controls himself, an ascetic; epithet of Śiva. —संयत-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one whose mind is restrained, controlled in mind. —संयत-प्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose breath is suppressed or whose organs are restrained. —शंयत-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, having the mind completely controlled. —संयत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has restrained or controlled (his passions, feelings, &c.). —संयत-वस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose dress is fastened. —संयत-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, restrained in speech, taciturn, silent. —सं-यताक्ष (°त-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, one whose eyes are restrained or closed. —संयताञ्जलि (°त-अञ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, one whose hands are joined together (for en-treaty or salutation, = बद्धाञ्जलि). —संयतात्-मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, one whose mind is restrained or subdued, having a well regulated spirit, self-con-trolled. —संयताहार (°त-आह्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose food is restrained, temperate in eating. —सं-यतेन्द्रिय (°त-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose senses or passions are restrained, controlled in feelings. —संयतोपस्कर (°त-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose house-furniture is kept in order, having a well regulated house.
संयत्वर: संयत्वर, अस्, m. (according to Śabda-k.) = वाग्-यत; = जन्तु-समूह।
संयन्तृ: सं-यन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who restrains or keeps in check, restraining, controlling, &c., a restrainer.
संयम: सं-यम, अस्, m. restraint, check, control, for-bearance, abstinence; N. of the last three stages of the Yoga system; a religious vow; any religious act on the day preceding a vow or course of penance; avoiding infliction of pain on others, humanity, com-passionateness. —संयम-पुण्य-तीर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, having restraint for a holy place of pilgrimage.
संयमक: सं-यमक, अस्, आ or इका, अम्, restraining, checking, curbing; who or what restrains, &c.
संयमत्: सं-यमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, restraining, subduing, curbing, who or what restrains, &c.
संयमन: सं-यमन, अस्, m. one who restrains, a ruler; (अम्), n. the act of restraining, checking; binding, confinement; drawing in; holding, detaining; for-bearance, self-denial, control; a religious vow or obligation; a cluster or square of four houses; (ई), f., N. of the city or residence of Yama.
संयमित: सं-यमित, अस्, आ, अम्, restrained, checked, controlled, regulated; bound, confined, fettered, held, detained; assembled, collected.
संयमिन्: सं-यमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, who or what restrains or subdues, restraining, checking, curbing, abstaining; (ई), m. one who subdues or controls his passions, an ascetic, saint, sage, hermit.
संयम्य: सं-यम्य, ind. having restrained or controlled; having bound together or fastened up; having fastened or closed.
संयम्यमान: सं-यम्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being held to-gether or restrained.
संयाम: सं-याम, अस्, m. restraint, check, control, for-bearance; abstaining from giving pain to others, humanity. —संयाम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of restraint, forbearing.
संयस्: संयस् सं-यस्, cl. 4. 1. P. -यस्यति, -य-सति, &c., to make effort, &c., (see rt. यस्।)
संयास: सं-यास, अस्, m. making effort, exertion, &c.
संया: संया सं-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go or proceed together, go, wander, travel; to come together, assemble, meet; to meet together (hos-tilely), come to blows, fight; to go to, enter, pene-trate; to go to any state or condition (e. g. एकतां संया, ‘to go to oneness, become one’); to go towards, be directed towards, aim at; to come.
संयात: सं-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone or proceeded to-gether, travelled.
संयात्रा: सं-यात्रा, f. travelling, voyaging by sea (to another country).
संयान: सं-यान, अस्, m. a mould; (अम्), n. going toge-ther, going along with, accompanying; proceeding, tra-velling, departure; the carrying out of a dead body.
संयाच्: संयाच् सं-याच्, cl. 1. A. -याचते, -याचितुम्, to ask, beg, request, implore, solicit.
संयु: संयु सं-यु, cl. 2. P., 9. P. A. -यौति, -यु-नाति, -युनीते, (for Ved. forms see under rt. 2. यु), -यवितुम्, to attach to one's self, lay hold of, attack, consume (Ved.); to attach to, share with, bestow on (Ved.); to join or connect together, mix, mingle, combine, unite.
संयवन: सं-यवन, अम्, n. = सञ्-जवन, a square of four houses.
संयाव: सं-याव, अस्, m. a sort of cake (of wheaten flour fried with ghee and milk and made up into an oblong form with sugar and spices).
संयुत: सं-युत, अस्, आ, अम्, joined together, connected, joined, attached, mixed with, blended, heaped to-gether; endowed or furnished with; consisting of (with inst.); relating to, implying, (प्रैष्य-स्°, [a name] implying service.)
संयुयूषु: सं-युयूषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to join together, wishing to unite, &c.
संयुज्: संयुज् 1. सं-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, &c., -योक्तुम्, to join or attach together, connect, combine, unite; to endow with; to form an alliance, league together; to place in, fix in or on, set in (with loc.), direct towards: Pass. -युज्-यते, to be joined together, be united, &c.: Caus. -योजयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to join together; to bring together, unite, connect, mix together; to yoke, harness; to prepare, equip (an army); to fasten or fix on, put on (with loc.), direct towards; to shoot, discharge (a missile &c.); to use, employ; to place in, appoint to (an office); to prepare, equip (an army &c.); to furnish or supply with, endow with, provide with, present with; to give over to, entrust with (with acc. and gen.); to bring about, per-form, accomplish; to be absorbed, meditate (A.).
2. सं-युज्, क्, क्, क्, joined together, united, con-nected, associated with; possessed of or endowed with good qualities.
संयुक्त: सं-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, conjoined, joined with, connected, attached; mixed, blended; accompanied or attended by; endowed or furnished with, pos-sessed of.
संयुग: सं-युग, अस्, m. conjunction, union, mixture; conflict, contest, war, battle, (in Naigh. II. 17. सं-युगे [loc. c.] is enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि।) —संयुग-गोष्पद, अम्, n. a contest in a cow's footstep, i. e. an insignificant struggle.
संयुज्य: सं-युज्य, ind. having joined together, becom-ing united.
संयोग: सं-योग, अस्, m. conjunction, connection, junc-tion, adherence, intimate union, close connection, association, living together; a kind of alliance or peace made between two kings for a common object; (in phil.) simple conjunction or connection; conjunc-tion (as one of the twenty-four Guṇas of the Nyāya); a particular relation, (see under सम्-बन्ध); ad-herence, possession; (in gram.) a conjunct conso-nant; (in astron.) conjunction of two heavenly bodies; endowment with; annexation, addition, ac-cession; epithet of Śiva. —संयोग-पृथक्त्व, अम्, n. (in phil.) separateness or severalty of con-junction, (a term applied to express the distinction between what is optional and non-optional in an action.) —संयोग-विरुद्ध, अम्, n. any eatables which cause disease by being mixed.
संयोगित: सं-योगित, अस्, आ, अम्, joined together, con-nected, annexed.
संयोगिन्: सं-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having union or connection, conjoined, associated; joining, connecting.
संयोजक: सं-योजक, अस्, इका, अम्, joining together, con-necting, uniting.
संयोजन: सं-योजन, अम्, n. the act of joining or uniting together, conjunction; copulation, coition; (प्रहि-तोः? संयोजनम्, N. of a Sāman.)
संयोजित: सं-योजित, अस्, आ, अम्, conjoined, attached, an-nexed.
संयोज्य: सं-योज्य, ind. having joined together or united; having enjoined or directed.
संयुध्: संयुध् सं-युध्, cl. 4. A. -युध्यते, -योद्-धुम्, to fight together, fight with, combat, oppose: Caus. -योधयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fight together, bring into conflict or collision; to fight together, encounter: Desid. -युयुत्सति, to desire to fight, be eager for battle.
संयुप्: संयुप् सं-युप्, cl. 4. P. -युप्यति, &c., Ved. to efface: Caus. -योपयति, -यितुम्, to efface, obliterate.
संयोपयत्: सं-योपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. obliterating, effacing; smoothing.
संरक्ष्: संरक्ष् सं-रक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -रक्षति, -रक्-षितुम्, to guard, watch, take care of, protect, de-fend, preserve, save; to keep off, ward off.
संरक्ष: सं-रक्ष, अस्, m. protection, care, preservation, ward.
संरक्षण: सं-रक्षण, अम्, n. the act of protecting, guarding, preserving, taking care of, charge, custody, protection; saving.
संरक्षित: सं-रक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, protected, preserved, taken care of.
संरक्षितव्य: सं-रक्षितव्य or सं-रक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be preserved or guarded or taken care of.
संरक्ष्य: 1. सं-रक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = सं-रक्षितव्य above.
2. सं-रक्ष्य, ind. having guarded or protected, &c.
संरक्ष्यमाण: सं-रक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being protected or preserved.
संरञ्ज्: संरञ्ज् सं-रञ्ज्, cl. 1. 4. P. A. -रजति, -ते, -रज्यति, -ते, -रङ्क्तुम्, to be dyed or coloured, become red; to be affected with any passion: Caus. -रञ्जयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to colour, dye, redden; to please, gratify, charm.
संरक्त: सं-रक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, coloured, red; impas-sioned; inflamed, angry, enamoured, charmed; charming, beautiful. —संरक्त-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, red-eyed, having the eyes reddened (with fury).
संरञ्जयत्: सं-रञ्जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, colouring, dyeing; pleasing, gratifying.
संरञ्जित: सं-रञ्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, coloured, dyed, reddened.
संराग: सं-राग, अस्, m. colouring; affection, passion; anger.
संरभ्: संरभ् सं-रभ्, cl. 1. A. -रभते, -रब्-धुम्, to seize or take hold of together (Ved.), take hold of mutually; to become possessed of, (Sāy. संरभेमहि = सङ्गच्छेमहि, Ṛg-veda I. 53, 4, 5); to become roused or incensed or angry.
संरब्ध: सं-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, seized, held, taken hold of (Ved.); closely joined or connected, hand in hand; excited, aroused, exasperated, inflamed, agitated; incensed, enraged, furious, angry; increased, aug-mented; swelled, swelling; overwhelmed. —सं-रब्ध-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having inflamed or angry eyes.
संरम्भ: सं-रम्भ, अस्, m. taking hold of, beginning [cf. आ-रम्भ]; energy, zeal, impetuosity, impetu-ous onset, turbulence; agitation, flurry, rage, wrath, fury, anger; pride, arrogance; swelling with heat and inflammation. —संरम्भ-ताम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, red with fury. —संरम्भ-परुष, अस्, आ, अम्, harsh from rage, impetuously harsh or rough. —सं-रम्भ-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, feeling great wrath or resentment. —संरम्भ-वेग, अस्, m. the violence or impetuosity of wrath.
संरम्भमाण: सं-रम्भमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being aroused or excited, being incensed.
संरम्भिन्: संरम्भिन्, ई, इणी, इ, agitated, exasperated, flur-ried; wrathful, furious, angry; proud. —संरम्-भि-ता, f. or संरम्भि-त्व, अम्, n. agitation; wrath, fury; pride.
संरम्: संरम् सं-रम्, cl. 1. A. -रमते, -रन्तुम्, to be delighted, find pleasure in (with loc.), rejoice greatly; to have carnal pleasure or sexual intercourse with, dally with.
संरा: संरा सं-रा, cl. 2. P. -राति, &c., Ved. to give liberally, bestow, grant, confer.
संरराण: सं-रराण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bestowing, grant-ing, liberal, (Sāy. = सं-रममाण); sharing, di-viding.
संराज्: संराज् 1. सं-राज्, cl. 1. P. A. -राजति, -ते, राजितुम्, to reign universally, reign as a paramount sovereign, reign over.
संराजत्: सं-राजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, reigning universally; (अन्), m. a sovereign lord (= सम्-राज्, and written with म् in Ṛg-veda I. 27, 1).
संराध्: संराध् सं-राध्, cl. 4. P. A. -राध्यति, -ते, &c. (see rt. राध्, p. 842), to be accomplished or perfected; to be acquired or brought into possession: Caus. -राधयति, -यितुम्, to bring into harmony; to agree together, agree about or upon (with loc.); to conciliate, propitiate, appease, satisfy.
संराद्ध: सं-राद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, accomplished, acquired, participated in.
संराधन: सं-राधन, अम्, n. the act of propitiating or appeasing, conciliation, propitiation, pleasing by wor-ship; the act of accomplishing or perfecting; perfect meditation.
संराधयत्: सं-राधयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing into har-mony; agreeing with, being in unison with; con-ciliating.
संराधित: सं-राधित, अस्, आ, अम्, propitiated, appeased, pleased.
संराध्य: सं-राध्य, ind. having propitiated, having gratified.
संराव: सं-राव, अस्, m. clamour, uproar, tumult, sound, noise.
संरिह्: संरिह् सं-रिह्, a Vedic form of सं-लिह्, q. v., (see also rt. रिह्, p. 847.)
संरिहाण: सं-रिहाण, अस्, आ, अम्, affectionately licking, caressing (said of a cow licking its calf).
संरी: संरी सं-री, cl. 9. P. A. -रिणाति, -रिणीते, &c. (see rts. 1. रि, 1. री), Ved. to bring together, restore, set free, liberate; to wash, purify.
संरु: संरु सं-रु, cl. 2. P. -रौति, -रवीति, &c., to cry or clamour together, shout, roar.
संराविन्: सं-राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, shouting together, making an uproar, clamouring, roaring.
संरुच्: संरुच् सं-रुच्, cl. 1. A. -रोचते, -रोचितुम्, to shine together or at the same time, shine along with, shine in rivalry; to shine, beam, glitter: Caus. -रोचयति, -यितुम्, to find or take pleasure in (with acc.); to like, love, approve, choose, select.
संरुज्: संरुज् सं-रुज्, cl. 6. P. -रुजति, &c., to break entirely, break to pieces, shatter.
संरुग्ण: सं-रुग्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces, shattered.
संरुध्: संरुध् सं-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, -रोद्धुम्, to stop completely, check, obstruct, hinder, keep back, restrain; to hold fast, fetter; to stop up, block up, stuff up, stuff, fill; to close up, shut up, besiege, invest, confine; to cover over, cover up, conceal; to keep from, withhold, re-frain, refuse: Caus. -रोधयति, -यितुम्, to cause to stop, obstruct.
संरुद्ध: सं-रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, completely stopped, checked, impeded, opposed, attacked; stopped up, blocked up, stuffed, filled; shut up, confined, be-sieged, invested; covered over, concealed, obscured; stopped or blocked up, filled; withheld, refused.
संरुध्य: सं-रुध्य, ind. having completely obstructed, having blocked up.
संरोध: सं-रोध, अस्, m. complete obstruction or op-position, impediment, hindrance, stop, prevention, check, curb; bond, fetter; throwing, sending.
संरोध्य: सं-रोध्य, ind. having completely obstructed or stopped.
संरुष्: संरुष् सं-रुष्, cl. 1. P. -रोषति, &c., to annoy, displease, make angry: Caus. -रोषयति, &c., to enrage, irritate.
संरुषित: सं-रुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, angry, irritated.
संरोष्यमाण: सं-रोष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being enraged, being irritated.
संरुह्: संरुह् सं-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्, to grow together; to grow over, be cicatrized, heal; to grow up, grow, increase, break forth, appear: Caus. -रोपयति, -यितुम्, to cause to grow together or grow over or cicatrize; to heal; to cause to grow, plant, set, sow.
संरूढ: सं-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, grown together, grown over, cicatrized, healed; grown, sprouted, budded, blossomed; burst forth, appeared; growing fast or firmly, taking firm root; confident, bold (= प्रौ-ढ). —संरूढ-व्रण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a healed or cicatrized wound.
संरोपित: सं-रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to grow, planted, sown, impregnated.
संरोहत्: सं-रोहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, growing up, breaking or bursting forth, appearing.
संरूष्: संरूष् सं-रूष्, cl. 10. or Caus. -रूषयति, -रोषयति (?), &c., to spread over, smear, cover.
संरूषित: सं-रूषित or सं-रोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, spread over, covered, besmeared.
संरेज्: संरेज् सं-रेज्, cl. 1. A. -रेजते, &c., Ved. to shake, quake, tremble.
संलक्ष्: संलक्ष् सं-लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. A. -लक्षयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to mark distinctly, distinguish, charac-terize; to observe, see, perceive, feel; to hear, learn, understand; to test, prove, try: Pass. -लक्ष्यते, to be distinguished; to be observed, &c.; to appear, seem; to be tested or proved.
संलक्षण: सं-लक्षण, अम्, n. the act of marking, dis-tinguishing, characterizing.
संलक्षित: सं-लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, distinctly marked, distinguished, characterized; observed, recognised, known.
संलक्ष्य: 1. सं-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be marked, dis-tinguishable, to be observed.
2. सं-लक्ष्य, ind. having observed or per-ceived, having heard.
संलग्: संलग् सं-लग्, cl. 1. P. -लगति, &c., to adhere or stick together: Caus. -लागयति, &c., to put or place firmly upon.
संलग्न: सं-लग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, closely attached, stuck together, joined together, united with, adhering, adherent, sticking in, fallen into; come to close contact, come to blows.
संलङ्घ्: संलङ्घ् सं-लङ्घ्, cl. 1. P. A. -लङ्घति, -ते, &c., to leap over or beyond, pass by.
संलङ्घित: सं-लङ्घित, अस्, आ, अम्, passed by, gone by.
संलज्ज्: संलज्ज् सं-लज्ज्, cl. 6. A. -लज्जते, &c., to be ashamed, become embarrassed, blush.
संलज्जमान: सं-लज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being ashamed or embarrassed, blushing.
संलप्: संलप् सं-लप्, cl. 1. P. -लपति, &c., to talk together, chat, converse; to address, call, name: Pass. -लप्यते, to be spoken of, be called or named: Caus. -लापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to converse, ad-dress.
संलाप: सं-लाप, अस्, m. talking together, familiar or friendly conversation, confabulation, chat, discourse; (in the drama) a kind of dialogue (having an occult meaning).
संलापक: सं-लापक, अम्, n. a species of minor drama (said to be of a controversial kind).
संलापित: सं-लापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to converse, ad-dressed, spoken with, conversed; discoursing, con-versing.
संलापिन्: सं-लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, conversing together in a friendly way, chatting; discoursing; one who con-verses or discourses.
संलभ्: संलभ् सं-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते, &c., -लब्धुम्, to seize one another, lay hold of mutu-ally; to take, obtain, receive.
संलब्ध: सं-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, taken hold of; obtained, received.
संलिप्सु: सं-लिप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of seizing or taking hold of.
संलय: सं-लय, अस्, m. lying down, sleep, sleepiness; melting away, dissolution (= प्र-लय).
संलल्: संलल् सं-लल्, Caus. -लालयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sport or dally together; to caress, fondle.
संलालित: सं-लालित, अस्, आ, अम्, caressed, fondled.
संलिख्: संलिख् सं-लिख्, cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लिखि-तुम् or -लेखितुम्, to scratch, scarify, lance, make an incision; to write, engrave, inscribe; to touch, strike, play upon (a musical instrument).
संलिखित: सं-लिखित, अस्, आ, अम्, scratched, &c., (used in Atharva-veda VII. 50, 5. to express some action practised in gambling.)
संलिह्: संलिह् सं-लिह्, cl. 2. P. A. -लेढि, -लीढे, -लेढुम्, to lick up, lick; to devour, enjoy.
संलिहत्: सं-लिहत्, अन्, अती, अत्, licking up, licking, de-vouring.
संलिहान: सं-लिहान, अस्, आ, अम्, licking up, &c.
संलीढ: सं-लीढ, अस्, आ, अम्, licked up, licked, enjoyed.
संली: संली सं-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लेतुम् or -लातुम्, to cling to, stick close to, cleave to; to enter, go into; to lie down, cower, hide, be con-cealed; to melt away.
संलयन: सं-लयन, अम्, n. the act of clinging or adher-ing to; lying down, &c.; dissolution.
संलीन: सं-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, stuck close to, clung to, clinging to, staying in; joined together; hidden, concealed, cowered, cowering down; contracted. —संलीन-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having ears inclined or hanging down. —संलीन-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, drooping or depressed in mind.
संलीय: सं-लीय, ind. having clung or stuck to.
संलीयमान: सं-लीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, lying or cowering down.
संलुड्: संलुड् सं-लुड्, cl. 1. P. -लोडति, &c., to agitate, stir about, disturb: Caus. -लोडयति, -यितुम्, to stir about, move to and fro; to disarrange, con-found, disturb, throw into disorder or confusion: Pass. of Caus. -लोड्यते, to be agitated, be thrown into disorder; to be ruined.
संलोडन: सं-लोडन, अम्, n. the act of agitating, disturb-ing, confusing; (अस्, ई, अम्), one who disturbs, &c., a disturber.
संलोडित: सं-लोडित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, confounded, dis-ordered, perplexed.
संलोड्यमान: सं-लोड्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being thrown into disorder or confusion.
संलुप्: संलुप् सं-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A., 4. P. -लुम्पति, -ते, -लुप्यति, &c., -लोप्तुम्, to break in pieces, destroy; to drag, tear, tear away: Caus. -लोपयति, -यितुम्, to cause to perish, destroy.
संलुभ्: संलुभ् सं-लुभ् (in some senses apparently connected with सं-लुप्), cl. 4. P. -लुभ्यति, &c., to be perplexed or disturbed, fall into confusion: Caus. -लोभयति, &c., to allure, entice, seduce; to disturb, disarrange, put in confusion (Ved.); to cause to disappear, efface, obliterate (Ved.).
संलुल्: संलुल् सं-लुल्, cl. 1. P. -लोलति, &c., to roll or stir about; to agitate, disturb.
संलुलित: सं-लुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, disordered, dis-arranged; mixed up with; besmeared.
संलोक्: संलोक् सं-लोक्, cl. 1. A. -लोकते, &c., to look together, look at one another.
संवच्: संवच् सं-वच्, cl. 2. P. (in the non-con-jugational tenses also A., see rt. वच्), -वक्ति, &c., to proclaim, announce, publish, communicate; to speak, say; to speak to, address; to remonstrate or expostu-late with; to converse, talk with (A.).
संवाच्य: सं-वाच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be conversed with, &c.
समुक्त: सम्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken to, addressed.
संवत्: संवत् सं-वत्, f. (probably connected with 2. सं-वस्), Ved. a region, (Sāy. = संविभाग-वत्, i. e. दिश्, Ṛg-veda I. 191, 15); an assemblage or host of people (come together for battle, &c., Sāy. संवतः = सङ्गताञ् शत्रून्, Ṛg-veda V. 15, 3; in Naigh. II. 17. संवतः is enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि); (त्), ind. (probably a contraction of सं-वत्सर below), a year; a year of Vikramāditya's era (commencing B. C. 57, as opposed to a year of the era of Śāli-vāhana, com-monly called Śaka or Śāka, q. v.); [cf. Gr. ἔτος, ἐνιαυτός.]
संवत्सर: सं-वत्सर, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. III. 72. fr. 2. सं-वस्, ‘to dwell with,’ because the seasons are supposed to abide in the year; वस् becomes वत् before affix सर, cf. rt. 6. वस्), a full year, year, (in the Purāṇas Saṃvatsara is personified as presiding over the seasons); a year of Vikramāditya's era, (see सं-वत् above); the first year in a cycle of five years; epithet of Śiva. —संवत्सर-कर, अस्, m. ‘year-causer,’ epithet of Śiva. —संवत्सर-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, completing a full year, yearly; [cf. मास-तम।] —संवत्सर-निरोध, अस्, m. im-prisonment for a year. —संवत्सर-प्रदीप, अस्, m., N. of a work. —संवत्सर-भ्रमि, इस्, इस्, इ, year-revolving, completing a revolution in a year (said of the sun). —संवत्सर-रय, अस्, m. a year's course.
संवद्: संवद् सं-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, -वदितुम्, to speak together, speak with, converse with (with inst.); to speak about, discourse upon (with loc.); to speak, speak to, address; to speak of as, designate, call, name; to sound together (said of musical instruments; P., Ved.); to agree, accord, consent: Caus. -वादयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to converse with, cause a conversation about (with loc.); to cause to speak together, cause to agree; to agree upon, accord; to state accurately, give a true account of, declare; to invite or call upon to speak; to cause to sound, play (a musical instrument).
संवदन: सं-वदन, अम्, n. the act of speaking together, conversing; communication of intelligence; con-sideration, examination, = आलोचन; (अम्, आ), n. f. subduing by charms (such as mystical gems, drugs, &c.), overpowering by magic, (probably for सं-वनन, q. v.); a charm, amulet.
संवदितव्य: सं-वदितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken with, to be addressed, &c.
संवाद: सं-वाद, अस्, m. speaking together, conversation, colloquy, dialogue; discussing, discussion; commu-nication of intelligence, report, information, news; assent, concurrence; agreement, conformity, corres-pondence, sameness.
संवादन: सं-वादन, अम्, n. the act of causing to con-verse, &c.
संवादयत्: सं-वादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to converse or agree; agreeing.
संवादित: सं-वादित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to speak with, made to converse; agreed with or upon.
संवाद्य: सं-वाद्य, ind. having declared truly, having stated accurately.
समुदित: 1. सम्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see under सम्-उद्-इ), spoken with, conversed; spoken to, addressed, accosted; agreed upon, (यथा-समुदितम्, accord-ing to agreement); consented, settled, customary.

2. सम्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see under सं-वद्), gone up, risen, ascended, rising upwards, lofty, elevated; arisen, produced, occasioned, excited; come together, collected, gathered together, aggregated, united, assembled; possessed of, furnished with, en-dowed.
समुद्य: सम्-उद्य, ind. having spoken together; having concluded or agreed upon.
2. सम्-उद्य, ind. (for 1. see p. 1037, col. 1), having sprinkled all over, having moistened.
समुद्य सम्-उद्य। See under सं-वद्, p. 1037, and under सम्-उद्, p. 1079.
संवन्: संवन् सं-वन्, Caus. -वनयति, &c., (in Atharva-veda VI. 9, 3. सं-वानयन्तु occurs), Ved. to cause to like or love, make well-disposed.
संवनन: सं-वनन, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, subduing by charms, adorable, (Sāy. = स्तोतृभिः सम्यक् सम्भज-नीय); (अम्, आ), n. f. causing mutual fondness; sub-duing by magical drugs or charms [cf. सं-वदन]; charming, fascination; means of securing love, a charm; fondness, love; (अस्), m., N. of an Āṅgirasa (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 191).
संवन्द्: संवन्द् सं-वन्द्, cl. 1. A. -वन्दते, -वन्-दितुम्, to salute respectfully.
संवप्: संवप् सं-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्तुम्, to throw together, mix, pour in, put in; to scatter, sow.
संवर: सं-वर, अस्, m. (sometimes written and con-founded with सम्बर), covering; comprehending, comprehension, collection; closing, contraction, com-pression; a causeway, dam, mound, bridge; a kind of deer (= शम्बर); a sort of fish (= शम्बर); N. of a demon, = शम्बर; (अम्), n. covering, con-cealment; restraint, self-control, forbearance; a parti-cular religious observance (with Buddhists); water.
संवर्ग: सं-वर्ग, अस्, m., Ved. plunder, spoils, (Sāy. = सम्यग् वृष्टेर् वर्जयिता, discharger of rain, Ṛg-veda X. 43, 5); (perhaps) food, (Sāy. संवर्-गम् = शत्रुभ्यः सहाच्छिद्यमानम्, Ṛg-veda VIII. 75, 12); epithet of Agni (‘the consumer’). —संवर्ग-जित्, त्, m., N. of a preceptor.
संवर्ण्: संवर्ण् सं-वर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -वर्णयति, -यि-तुम्, to communicate, relate, narrate, tell; to praise.
संवर्त: सं-वर्त, अस्, m. turning towards; coming to pass, being, becoming; rolling up, crumpling up, destruction; the periodical destruction or dissolution of the universe; a cloud; a particular kind of cloud (abounding in water and so distinct from the Ā-varta which has no water, cf. द्रोण, पुष्कलावर्तक); N. of one of the seven clouds at the dissolution of the universe [cf. भीम-नाद]; a collection, multitude; a year; the tree Terminalia Bellerica; N. of a Muni and legislator [cf. वृहत्-स्°]; of an Āṅgirasa (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 172); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a family.
संवर्धक: सं-वर्धक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing complete growth or increase, augmenting, prospering; an in-creaser.
संवर्मय: संवर्मय संवर्मय (fr. वर्मन् with सम्), Nom. P. A. संवर्मयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to put on armour, arm one's self fully.
संवर्मित: संवर्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, fully armed, completely mailed.
संवर्षण: सं-वर्षण, अम्, n. raining, showering down.
संवलित: संवलित सं-वलित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वल् with सम्), met together, mixed, mingled; con-nected or associated with; united; encompassed, surrounded; possessed of; broken, diversified (= चूर्णित, Kirāt. VI. 4, Schol.).
संवल्गित: संवल्गित सं-वल्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, overrun.
संववृत्वस्: संववृत्वस् सं-ववृत्वस्, आन्, उषी, अत् (fr. rt. 1. वृत् with सम्, but apparently connected with rt. वृ), one who has enveloped, enveloping, (ac-cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 31, 3. सं-ववृत्वत् = संवरण-शीलम्।)
संवस्: संवस् 1. सं-वस् (see rt. 5. वस्), cl. 2. A. -वस्ते, -वसितुम्, to wear (clothes), be clad in, be dressed with.

संवस् 2. सं-वस् (see rt. 6. वस्), cl. 1. P. A. -वसति, -ते, -वस्तुम्, to dwell together, live with, to have intercourse or dealings with (some-times with acc. of person); to cohabit with (with acc.); to stay, abide, dwell; to spend, pass (time): Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dwell together, bring together; to furnish with lodging, lodge.
संवस्त्रय: सं-वस्त्रय (fr. सम् + वस्त्र), Nom. P. -वस्-त्रयति, -यितुम्, to put on clothes, dress.
संवस्त्र्य: सं-वस्त्र्य, ind. having put on clothes, having dressed in.
संवसत्: सं-वसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dwelling together, &c.
संवसथ: सं-वसथ, अस्, m. a place where people live together, village, inhabited place.
संवसन: सं-वसन, अम्, n. residing together, dwelling.
संवसान: सं-वसान, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling with, residing amongst.
संवसु: सं-वसु, उस्, m., Ved. one who dwells along with, living with, (Sāy. सं-वसुः = संवसति, Ṛg-veda VIII. 39, 7.)
संवास: सं-वास, अस्, m. dwelling along with, cohabita-tion, domestic intercourse; a dwelling, residence, house; an open space for meeting or recreation (either within or without a town, = सन्-निवेश); association, company, society.
समुषित: सम्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelt or lived together, stayed with; passed, spent (as time).
संवह्: संवह् सं-वह् [cf. सम्-ऊह्], cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वोढुम्, to bear or carry together, convey together; to carry or bear along, take along, draw, drag, bear away; to convey; to bring near; to take a wife, marry; to carry the hand along the body, rub down, press together, shampoo, stroke, soothe; to manifest, display, express: Pass. -उह्यते, to be carried by, ride on (with inst.): Caus. -वाह-यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to be carried together; to bring together, assemble, collect; to drive (a car-riage &c.), guide, conduct, lead, lead or conduct to (one's home), take a wife, marry; to carry the hand along the body, stroke, shampoo: Pass. of Caus. -वाह्यते, to be carried away, be driven along, &c.
संवह: सं-वह, अस्, m. bearing or carrying along; N. of the wind of the third of the seven Mārgas or paths of the sky, (viz. that which impels the moon; the other six are called आ-वह, प्र-व्°, उद्-व्°, वि-व्°, परि-व्°, नि-व्°, the Saṃ-vaha coming above the Ud-vaha wind.)
संवाह: सं-वाह, अस्, m. bearing or carrying along, pressing together; rubbing the body, shampooing; an attendant employed to rub and shampoo the body; N. of one of the winds, (see सं-वह above.)
संवाहक: सं-वाहक, अस्, m. an attendant who rubs and shampooes the limbs, a shampooer.
संवाहन: सं-वाहन, अम्, n. rubbing the person, sham-pooing; bearing (a burden), carrying.
संवाह्य: सं-वाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought together; to be borne or carried along; to be rubbed, to be shampooed; (अस्), m., scil. अग्नि, a kind of sacrificial fire; [cf. 1. सम्-ऊह्य।]
समुह्य: सम्-उह्य, ind. having brought together, having arranged or put in order; [cf. 2. सम्-ऊह्य।]
समुह्य सम्-उह्य, सम्-उह्यमान। See under सं-वह्।
समुह्यमान: सम्-उह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being borne or carried along; being carried by, riding on (with inst.).
समूढ: 1. सम्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see under सम्-ऊह्), borne or conveyed together, carried or borne along, borne away; led, conducted; married.

संवाश्: संवाश् सं-वाश्, cl. 4. A. -वाश्यते (Ved. and ep. also P. -वाश्यति, and cl. 1. P. A. -वाशति, -ते), -वाशितुम्, to roar or cry at the same time, bellow or low together, bleat: Caus. -वाशयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to cry or low together.
संवावशान: सं-वावशान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. roaring at the same time, bellowing together.
संवासित: संवासित सं-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, made fra-grant, perfumed; made fetid, having an offensive smell (said of the breath).
संवाह्: संवाह् सं-वाह् [cf. सं-वह्, to which the forms and senses given to this verb are perhaps more properly referred], cl. 1. A. -वाहते, &c. (see rt. 1. वाह्), to rub together, shampoo, knead (the limbs), stroke: Caus. -वाहयति, &c., to rub to-gether, shampoo.
संविच्: संविच् सं-विच्, cl. 3. P. -वेवेक्ति, &c., Ved. to keep entirely separate or distinct.
संविक्त: सं-विक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely separated or dis-tinct; (अम्), n. that which is separated or individual-ized.
संविचि: संविचि सं-वि-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to separate entirely, keep quite apart.

संविज्: संविज् सं-विज्, cl. 7. P., 6. A. -विनक्ति, -विजते, &c., -विजितुम्, to tremble violently, shake, be agitated; to start with fear, start up, run away: Caus. -वेजयति, -यितुम्, to startle, frighten, terrify.
संविग्न: सं-विग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, flurried, startled, alarmed, frightened, terrified, distracted. —सं-विग्न-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated or distracted in mind.
संवेग: सं-वेग, अस्, m. agitation, flurry; excessive im-petus or impetuosity, vehemence, haste proceeding from terror; hurry, haste, speed.
संविज्ञा: संविज्ञा सं-वि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to recommend, advise (with gen. of person): Caus. -ज्ञापयति, -ज्ञपयति, -यितुम्, to make known; to recite, repeat.

संवितर्क्: संवितर्क् सं-वि-तर्क्, cl. 10. P. -तर्कयति, -यितुम्, to deliberate about, reflect upon.
संविद्: संविद् 1. सं-विद्, cl. 2. P. A. (see Vārtt. to Pāṇ. I. 3, 29), -वेत्ति, -वित्ते (3rd pl. -विदते or -विद्रते), &c., to know together, know thoroughly, know, recognise; to investigate, explore, examine; to perceive, feel, taste; to come to an understanding, agree together; to admonish, advise, teach; to meditate; cl. 6. 2. सं-विद्, त्, f. knowledge, intellect, understand-ing; = महत् (in philosophy); a mutual understand-ing, agreement, contract, covenant, engagement; consent, assent, promise; prescribed custom, esta-blished usage; an alliance, marriage (Ved.); a watch-word, war-cry; war, battle; a name, appellation; a sign, signal; participation, sympathy; pleasing, delighting (= तोषण); meditation (= समाधि); hemp. —संविद्-व्यतिक्रम, अस्, m. breach of promise, violation of contract.
संवित्ति: सं-वित्ति, इस्, f. perception, ascertainment, know-ledge, consciousness, feeling; intellect, understanding; recognition, recollection; mutual reconciliation, ac-commodation of disputes, harmony.
संविदान: सं-विदान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being found with or together with; connected, united; agreeing with, harmonious.
संविदित: सं-विदित, अस्, आ, अम्, known, recognised, under-stood; well-known; explored; agreed upon, assented to; admonished, advised; (अम्), n. agreement.
संविद्वस्: सं-विद्वस्, आन्, m. one who has known or knows.
संवेद: सं-वेद, अस्, m. perception, consciousness, know-ledge, understanding.
संवेदन: सं-वेदन, अम्, n. the act of perceiving; per-ception, sensation, feeling, suffering.
संवेदित: सं-वेदित, अस्, आ, अम्, made known, informed, instructed, &c.
संवेद्य: सं-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be known or under-stood; to be made known; (अस्), m. the junction of two rivers.
संवेविदान: सं-वेविदान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.), Ved. = सं-विदान above.
संविधा: संविधा 1. सं-वि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to dispose, arrange, fix, settle; to direct, order; to carry on, perform, accomplish, conduct, manage, do, act, render, make, attend to, mind; to use, employ; to set, lay, place, put, (मा-नसं सं-विधा, to keep the mind fixed or composed): Pass. -धीयते, to be arranged or fixed; to be performed, &c.
2. सं-विधा, f. arrangement, plan, preparation; mode of life.
संविधातव्य: सं-विधातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be disposed or arranged, &c.
संविधान: सं-विधान, अम्, n. disposition, arrangement; performance; plan, mode, rite.
संविधानक: संविधानक, अम्, n. a strange act, unusual occurrence.
संविधाय: सं-विधाय, ind. having disposed or arranged, hav-ing appointed or fixed; having directed or ordered; having performed; having used or employed, &c.
संविनी: संविनी सं-वि-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to take entirely away, remove, suppress.
संविनीय: सं-विनीय, ind. having removed entirely, having suppressed.
संविभज्: संविभज् सं-वि-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते, -भक्तुम्, to divide, separate; to share with; to give a share to, distribute, apportion (with dat. or gen.); to furnish or provide any one (acc.) with anything (inst.), bestow upon, give to: Caus. -भा-जयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be divided.
संविभक्त: सं-विभक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, divided, parted, sepa-rated, shared with, conferred upon, bestowed, given.
संविभज्य: सं-विभज्य, ind. having divided or distributed.
संविभाग: सं-विभाग, अस्, m. a dividing together, distribut-ing, apportioning, partition; part, portion, share.
संविभागिन्: सं-विभागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sharing in; (ई), m. a sharer, co-partner. —संविभागि-ता, f. or संवि-भागि-त्व, अम्, n. participation, co-partnership.
संविभा: संविभा सं-वि-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भा-तुम्, to long for, be desirous of; to meditate on (= सङ्कल्पयति).
संविभाष्: संविभाष् सं-वि-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, -भाषितुम्, to speak to, address.
संविमृश्: संविमृश् सं-वि-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति, &c., to reflect upon, consider.
संविमृश्य: सं-विमृश्य, ind. having reflected or considered.
संविराज्: संविराज् सं-वि-राज्, cl. 1. P. A. -राजति, -ते, &c., to shine forth, be very illustrious.
संविलङ्घ्: संविलङ्घ् सं-वि-लङ्घ्, cl. 10. P. or Caus. -लङ्घयति, -यितुम्, to leap over, pass by, trans-gress, neglect.
संविवृध्: संविवृध् सं-वि-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते, -वर्धितुम्, to grow, increase, prosper.
संविव्यान: सं-विव्यान, अस्, आ, अम् (perf. part. A.), Ved. fully surrounded or invested with, endowed with.
संविश्: संविश् सं-विश्, cl. 6. P. -विशति (ep. also A. -ते), -वेष्टुम्, to enter together; to lie together; to enter; to lie down, rest, repose; to lie or cohabit with (with acc.); to sit down with; to engage in: Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to enter, cause to lie down, cause to rest on, place, lay.
संविष्ट: 1. सं-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, entered together; entered; lying down, resting on, reposing; seated together.
2. सं-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, clothed, dressed.
संवेश: सं-वेश, अस्, m. sleep, sleeping; lying together, cohabitation, copulation; dreaming, a dream; a seat, chair, stool.
संवेशन: सं-वेशन, अस्, m., Ved. one who enters; one who introduces; (अम्), n. the act of causing to enter or causing to lie down; sexual union, coition.
संवेशयत्: सं-वेशयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making to lie down.
संविष्: संविष् सं-विष्, cl. 3. P. A. -वेवेष्टि, -वे-विष्टे, &c., to procure; to clothe, dress.
संविषा: संविषा सं-विषा, f. the plant Aconitum Ferox (= अति-विषा).
संविहस्: संविहस् सं-वि-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, &c., to laugh at, laugh.
संवीक्ष्: संवीक्ष् सं-वीक्ष् (-वि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -वीक्-षते, -वीक्षितुम्, to look about; to look at atten-tively, look into thoroughly; to perceive.
संवीक्षण: सं-वीक्षण, अम्, n. looking about in all direc-tions, looking for (anything lost), search, inquiry; looking or gazing attentively.
संवीक्ष्य: सं-वीक्ष्य, ind. having looked at or into, hav-ing searched for; having perceived.
संवीत: सं-वीत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered over, coated over, overlaid; clothed; adorned; invested, surrounded, enclosed, encompassed, shut in; overwhelmed. —सं-वीताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having the body covered, properly clothed, (according to Kullūka = आच्छादित-देह।)
संवृ: संवृ सं-वृ or सं-वॄ, cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते, -वृणाति, -वृणीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -वरीतुम् (ep. also -वर्तुम्), to cover over, cover, enclose, hide, conceal; to secure; to keep together, close, shut up, compress, contract; to put or place together, arrange, put in order; to keep or ward off, avert, restrain, keep back, stop; to refuse, reject; to select, choose: Caus. -वारयति, -यितुम्, to cover; to restrain; to keep back, ward off, avert.
संवरण: सं-वरण, अम्, n. the act of covering or screening, concealing, enclosing, concealment; a secret; a disguise, pretext; the act of closing, shut-ting; an enclosure; a sanctuary, house, (in Ṛg-veda IX. 107, 9. according to Sāy. संवरणानि = सम्-भजनीयानि रस-रूपाण्य् अन्नानि; according to some, used as an epithet of rivers enclosed in beds); (अस्), m., N. of the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda V. 33, 34 (having the patronymic Prājāpatya); N. of a king mentioned in the Mahā-bhārata, (the father of Kuru.)
संवार्य: 1. सं-वार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be covered or con-cealed; to be secured, &c.
2. सं-वार्य, ind. having kept off, having warded off or averted, having repelled.
संवुवूर्षु: सं-वुवूर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to cover or conceal or disguise, &c.
संवृण्वत्: सं-वृण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, hiding, concealing; compressing.
संवृण्वान: सं-वृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing, hiding, &c.
संवृत: सं-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered up, covered, en-closed, enveloped, surrounded; concealed, hidden, kept secret, secured; retired, secluded; closed, shut, shut up, secured, put away, kept in safety; contracted, compressed (as the throat &c.); restrained, sup-pressed; sequestered, confiscated; filled with, full of; furnished or attended with, accompanied by; (अम्), n. a secret place; (in grammar) a particular mode of pronunciation, (one of the Ābhyantara-prayatnas.) —संवृत-संवार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who con-ceals what ought to be concealed, securing what ought to be secured. —संवृताकार (°त-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who conceals all signs of feeling.
संवृति: सं-वृति, इस्, f. covering up, concealment, com-pression, suppression; secret purpose.
संवृत्य: सं-वृत्य, ind. having concealed; having closed or compressed.
संवृंह्: संवृंह् सं-वृंह् (see rt. वृंह्, also written बृंह्), cl. 1. P. -वृंहति, -वृंहितुम्, to join firmly together (Ved.): Caus. -वृंहयति (Ved. -वर्हयति), &c., to cause to be joined together, to unite (Ved.); to make strong, strengthen, invigorate; to incite, stimulate, encourage, animate, urge, (Sāy. सं-वर्हय = उत्साहय, Ṛg-veda VII. 31, 12.)
संवृज्: संवृज् 1. सं-वृज्, cl. 7. P. A. -वृणक्ति, वृङ्क्ते, -वर्जितुम्, Ved. to bend or attract or appropriate to one's self, carry off, despoil; to devour, consume, (Sāy. = खादति): Desid. -विवृक्षते, to wish to appropriate.
2. सं-वृज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. one who carries off, a spoiler; one who consumes or destroys.
संवर्ग्य: सं-वर्ग्य, अस्, m., N. of a sage.
संवर्जन: सं-वर्जन, अम्, n. the act of bending or appro-priating to one's self; devouring, consuming.
संवृक्त: सं-वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, consumed, devoured, de-stroyed. —संवृक्त-धृष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who has cut off or destroyed valiant (enemies; Sāy. सञ्छिन्ना धर्षण-शीला शत्रवो येन).
संवृज्य: सं-वृज्य, ind. = सं-हृत्य, having carried off, &c.
संवृत्: संवृत् सं-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, &c., -वर्तितुम्, to turn towards, go towards, approach; to go against, attack, assault (with acc.); to come together, meet together, be united, meet in sexual embrace; to come round, come to pass, happen, take place, be produced, be fulfilled, be accomplished; to fall to the lot (of any one); to be, become, exist: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to turn or re-volve, cause to proceed or go on; to cast, throw; to carry on, accomplish, fulfil, roll together, roll up, fold up, wrap up, envelop; to crumple up; to crush, destroy, dash to pieces: Desid. P. -विवृत्सति, to wish to be sexually united.
संवर्तक: सं-वर्तक, अस्, m. the fire that is to roll every-thing together and destroy the world at the period of universal dissolution; submarine fire; a kind of cloud, (see above, cf. मातङ्ग); N. of Bala-rāma, (other-wise called Bala-deva, elder brother of Kṛṣṇa); the plough of Bala-rāma. —संवर्तकाग्नि (°क-अग्°), इस्, m. the world-destroying fire.
संवर्तकिन्: संवर्तकिन्, ई, m., N. of Bala-rāma, (see above.)
संवर्तमान: सं-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, turning towards, going towards, approaching; coming or meeting to-gether, having sexual intercourse.
संवर्तयत्: सं-वर्तयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, crushing, destroying, dashing to pieces.
संवर्तयित्वा: सं-वर्तयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having per-formed, having fulfilled, &c.
संवर्तिका: संवर्तिका, f. the new leaf of a water-lily, the petal or leaf near the filament (= केशर-समी-पस्थ-दल).
संवर्तित: सं-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolled up, wrapped up, enveloped.
संवृत्त: सं-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, become, arisen, happened, taken place, fulfilled, accomplished, past, gone; fur-nished with (for सं-वृत); covered (for सं-वृत); (अस्), m., N. of Varuṇa.
संवृत्ति: सं-वृत्ति, इस्, f. being, existing, becoming, hap-pening, fulfilment, accomplishment; covering, con-cealing (for सं-वृति).
संवृध्: संवृध् सं-वृध्, cl. 1. P. A. -वर्धति, -ते (see rt. 1. वृध्), -वर्धितुम्, to grow to perfection or completion, grow up, increase; to fulfil, satisfy, grant (P.): Caus. -वर्धयति, -यितुम्, to cause to grow or increase, augment, enlarge; to plant; to bring up, rear, raise, cherish, foster, nourish, fatten, feed, nurse; to cause to prosper, make prosperous or happy; to present with (with inst.); to fulfil, satisfy, grant.
संवर्धन: सं-वर्धन, अम्, n. the act of augmenting or increasing, prospering, cherishing, encouraging; com-plete growth, prospering, thriving.
संवर्धनीय: सं-वर्धनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be increased or augmented, to be fostered or encouraged.
संवर्धयत्: सं-वर्धयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to grow up or increase, enlarging, increasing, much increased, magnifying.
संवर्धित: सं-वर्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought to complete growth, brought up, reared, raised, cherished, pro-tected, encouraged.
संवृद्ध: सं-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, full grown, completely grown, grown up, grown tall or high, increased, augmented, enlarged, large, big; flourishing, bloom-ing.
संवृष्: संवृष् सं-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, &c., Ved. to rain upon, shower down.
संवृह्: संवृह् सं-वृह्, cl. 6. P. -वृहति, &c. (see rt. 1. वृह्), -वर्हितुम्, -वर्ढुम्, Ved. to draw out or extract together.
संवे: संवे सं-वे, cl. 1. P. A. -वयति, -ते, -वातुम्, Ved. to weave together, interweave.

संवेप्: संवेप् सं-वेप्, cl. 1. A. -वेपते, &c., to tremble, shake.
संवेपमान: सं-वेपमान, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, shaking (from cold &c.).
संवेष्ट्: संवेष्ट् सं-वेष्ट्, cl. 1. A. -वेष्टते, &c., to be surrounded: Caus. -वेष्टयति, -यितुम्, to sur-round, envelop, encompass.
संवेष्टमान: सं-वेष्टमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being surrounded or enveloped.
संव्यच्: संव्यच् सं-व्यच्, cl. 6. P. -विचति, -व्यचि-तुम्, Ved. to surround, encompass, envelop; to roll together, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VII. 63, 1. सम्-अविव्यक् = सह विचति, सं-वेष्टयति); to pervade.
संव्यवसो: संव्यवसो सं-व्य्-अव-सो (-वि-अव-), cl. 4. P. -स्यति, -सातुम्, to decide upon, decree.
संव्यवहार: संव्यवहार सं-व्यवहार, अस्, m. dealing together, mutual traffic or business, intercourse.
संव्यूढ: संव्यूढ सं-व्यूढ, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. व्य्-ऊढ), combined together, mixed, united.
संव्यूह: सं-व्यूह, अस्, m. combination, mixture, union.
संव्ये: संव्ये सं-व्ये, cl. 1. P. A. -व्ययति, -ते, -व्यातुम्, to cover over, overlay, clothe, put on clothes; to invest, surround, enclose.
संव्यान: सं-व्यान, अम्, n. the act of covering over, a covering; cloth, clothes, garment, vestment, vesture; an upper garment.
संशङ्क्: संशङ्क् सं-शङ्क्, cl. 1. A. -शङ्कते, -शङ्कि-तुम्, to be very suspicious of, suspect.
संशद्: संशद् सं-शद्, Caus. -शातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall down, throw down, break to pieces.
संशप्तक: संशप्तक सं-शप्तक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 3. शप् with सम्), a soldier sworn never to recede from a fight and stationed to prevent the flight of others; a picked warrior, a brother in arms; a conspirator bound by an oath to kill another; N. of a kind of soldier or guard belonging to Nārāyaṇī (mentioned in the Mahā-bhārata).
संशब्द: संशब्द सं-शब्द, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शब्द् with सम्), mention.
संशब्दन: सं-शब्दन, अम्, n. making a sound, calling out; praising, eulogizing.
संशब्द्य: सं-शब्द्य, ind. (see rt. शब्द्), having called out, having said or spoken.
संशम्: संशम् सं-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति, -शमि-तुम्, to become calm or pacified, be allayed, be extinguished: Caus. -शमयति, -यितुम्, to miti-gate, calm, allay; to settle.
संशय: सं-शय, अस्, m. uncertainty, irresolution, doubt, scruple, misgiving, suspicion, (frequently in the phrase न संशयः, there is no doubt, to be sure); diffi-culty, danger, risk, peril; dispute, question; possibility. —संशय-च्छेद, अस्, m. the solution of doubt. —संशय-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in uncertainty, uncertain, doubtful, —संशयात्मक (°य-आत्°), अस्, इका, अम्, consisting of doubt, made up of uncertainties. —संशयात्मन् (°य-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, having a doubt-ful or irresolute mind; (आ), m. a sceptic. —संशया-पन्न (°य-आप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, beset with doubt, hesi-tating, irresolute; doubtful, uncertain, dubious. —सं-शयापन्न-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, having the mind beset with doubts, of an irresolute or hesitating dis-position. —संशयोपेत (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of uncertainty, subject to doubt, doubtful, dubious, uncertain.
संशरण: संशरण सं-शरण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. शॄ with सम्), commencement of a combat, charge, attack.
संशास्: संशास् सं-शास्, cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्, Ved. to sanctify, purify, make perfect, (Sāy. सं-शिशाधि = संस्कुरु, Ṛg-veda VII. 104, 19.)
संशि: संशि सं-शि (closely connected with सं-शो), cl. 5. P. A. -शिनोति, -शिनुते, (Ved. also cl. 3. A.) -शिशीते, -शेतुम्, to sharpen up or well, excite, incite.
संशित: 1. सं-शित, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see under सं-शो), sharpened up, aroused, excited; [cf. यज्ञ-स्°।]

2. सं-शित, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly finished or completed, finished off, effected, accomplished; established, decided, determined, certified, certain, well-ascertained; completing, effecting, diligent in accomplishing. —संशित-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has finished or accomplished a vow, faithful to a vow or obligation. —संशितात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, one whose mind or spirit is thoroughly matured or disciplined.
संशिशान: सं-शिशान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sharpening well or thoroughly.
संशिश्रीषु: सं-शिश्रीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to have recourse to, desiring to adhere to or depend upon; wishing to serve, &c.
संशिश्वन्: संशिश्वन् सं-शिश्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. having young ones, (Sāy. सं-शिश्वरीः = सं-शिश्वर्यः सङ्गच्छमाना गावः, Ṛg-veda VIII. 69, 11.)
संशी: संशी सं-शी, cl. 2. A. -शेते, -शयितुम्, to lie down for rest or repose, sleep, grow languid, be-come feeble; to waver, be uncertain or irresolute or doubtful.
संशयान: सं-शयान, अस्, आ, अम्, feeling uncertain or irresolute, wavering, doubting, dubious, sceptical.
संशयालु: सं-शयालु, उस्, उस्, उ, disposed to doubt, irreso-lute, doubting, dubious.
संशयित: सं-शयित, अस्, आ, अम्, uncertain, dubious, doubtful.
संशयितृ: सं-शयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who hesitates or wavers, a doubter, sceptic; dubious, doubtful.
संशयिन्: सं-शयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, doubtful, dubious, uncertain, questionable.
संशय्य: सं-शय्य, ind. having doubted or wavered, being in doubt, deliberating.
संशुध्: संशुध् सं-शुध्, cl. 4. P. -शुध्यति, -शोद्-धुम्, to become completely pure or purified: Caus. -शोधयति, -यितुम्, to purify or cleanse thoroughly, clear; to clear (expenses), pay off; to correct, rectify; to examine.
संशुद्ध: सं-शुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, completely purified or cleansed, pure, clean; refined, polished; expiated; acquitted (of crime or debt). —संशुद्ध-किल्वि-ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose offences are expiated, purified from sin.
संशुद्धि: सं-शुद्धि, इस्, f. thorough purification; cleansing or cleaning (the body); purity, cleanness; clearance; acquittal, acquittance; correction, rectification.
संशोधन: सं-शोधन, अम्, n. the act of purifying thoroughly, purification, cleaning, cleansing; refin-ing, clearing; paying off, correcting.
संशोधित: सं-शोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, completely cleansed or purified.
संशोध्य: 1. सं-शोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be purified, to be cleared or acquitted; to be paid off; to be corrected or rectified.
2. सं-शोध्य, ind. having cleansed; having cleared (a road).
संशुभ्: संशुभ् सं-शुभ्, Caus. -शोभयति, -यितुम्, to decorate, adorn.
संशुष्: संशुष् सं-शुष्, cl. 4. P. -शुष्यति, -शोष्-टुम्, to be completely dried or dried up: Caus. -शोषयति, -यितुम्, to make dry, dry up.
संशुष्क: सं-शुष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, completely dried, dry; withered, sere.
संशोषित: सं-शोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, made thoroughly dry, dried up.
संशून: सं-शून, अस्, आ, अम्, much swelled, swollen.
संशो: संशो सं-शो (closely connected with सं-शि), cl. 3. P. -शिशाति, -शातुम्, Ved. to sharpen thoroughly, sharpen up, excite, raise, produce; to finish off, effect, complete, supply, (Sāy. सं-शिशातु = सम्यक् तीक्ष्णी-करोतु = प्रयच्छतु, Ṛg-veda I. 111, 5.)
संश्चत्: संश्चत् संश्-चत्, त्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 85. fr. rt. 1. चि with सम्; more probably fr. rt. चत्; cf. सञ्चत्, सं-श्वत्), deceit, trick, illusion, juggling; (त्), m. a juggler.
संश्चाय: संश्चाय, Nom. A. संश्चायते, -यितुम्, to con-jure, juggle; to be cheated or deceived.
संश्यान: संश्यान सं-श्यान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्यै with सम्), contracted, drawn together, shrunk up, congealed, frozen; collapsed; rolled up, gathered up.
संश्राव: संश्राव सं-श्राव, अस्, m. (for सं-स्राव), flowing or pouring out, sprinkling, aspersion.
संश्रि: संश्रि सं-श्रि, cl. 1. P. A. -श्रयति, -ते, -श्रयितुम्, to go towards or have recourse to, betake one's self or flee for refuge or succour, seek protec-tion with, seek; to lean on, rest on, depend on; to attain, obtain; to unite with; to approach for sexual intercourse; to serve.
संश्रय: सं-श्रय, अस्, m. the having recourse to, betak-ing one's self to [cf. कलि-श्°], fleeing for refuge or protection, seeking shelter or succour; refuge, shelter, asylum, protection, patronage, favour; a resting-place, dwelling-place; seeking alliance, leaguing to-gether for mutual protection (one of the six Guṇas of a military prince mentioned in Manu VII. 160), league; an aim, object; N. of a Prajā-pati. —सं-श्रय-कारित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused by alliance (Manu VII. 176).
संश्रयिन्: सं-श्रयिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having recourse to, seeking refuge.
संश्रित: सं-श्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone or fled to for refuge; come for protection or an asylum; taken under protection, sheltered, secured, protected, supported; united, joined; (अस्), m. a dependant, servant, fol-lower. —संश्रितानुराग (°त-अन्°), अस्, m. the affection of dependants.
संश्रित्य: सं-श्रित्य, ind. having fled to for refuge.
संश्रु: संश्रु सं-श्रु, cl. 5. P. A. -शृणोति, -शृ-णुते, -श्रोतुम्, to hear well (P.); to listen well or attentively, be attentive (A. without acc. c. follow-ing); to promise: Caus. -श्रावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to hear, cause to be heard; to narrate, report, recite, tell, proclaim.
संश्रव: सं-श्रव, अस्, m. hearing or listening atten-tively; promise, assent, agreement.
संश्रवण: सं-श्रवण, अम्, n. the act of hearing; the ear.
संश्रुत: सं-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, well heard; promised, agreed, assented.
संश्रुत्य: सं-श्रुत्य, ind. having heard or listened atten-tively, having promised.
संश्लिष्: संश्लिष् सं-श्लिष्, cl. 4. P. -श्लिष्यति, -श्लेष्-टुम्, to clasp or press together, join together, em-brace: Caus. -श्लेषयति, -यितुम्, to join or connect together, unite.
संश्लिष्ट: सं-श्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, clasped or pressed toge-ther, embraced, joined, united; adjoining, touching, close together; endowed; possessed of.
संश्लिष्य: सं-श्लिष्य, ind. having clasped or embraced, having joined together.
संश्लेष: सं-श्लेष, अस्, m. embrace, embracing; union, connection, junction, association, contact. —सं-श्लेष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing union or contact, joined, united.
संश्लेषण: सं-श्लेषण, अम्, n. the act of clasping or pressing together; means of binding together.
संश्लेषित: सं-श्लेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, joined together, united, attached.
संश्लेषिन्: सं-श्लेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, clasping, embracing, joining together.
संश्वत्: संश्वत् सं-श्वत्, त्, n. = संश्-चत्, deceit, illusion, &c.
संश्वि: संश्वि सं-श्वि, cl. 1. P. -श्वयति, -श्वयितुम्, to swell up, swell greatly.
संसञ्ज्: संसञ्ज् सं-सञ्ज्, Pass. -सज्यते, -सज्जते (see rt. 2. सञ्ज्), to adhere or cling together, stick close, be attached or connected together, adhere or cling to; to be entwined.
संसक्त: सं-सक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, adhered or stuck together, joined or attached or linked together, sticking close to, adhering to, attached or tied to; fastened; re-strained; closely connected; close, near, adjoining, contiguous; intent on; possessing, endowed with, affected by. —संसक्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the mind attached or fastened. —संसक्त-युग, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to a yoke, harnessed, yoked. —संसक्त-वदनाश्वास (°न-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, with breath adhering to the mouth, with suppressed breath.
संसक्ति: सं-सक्ति, इस्, f. close adherence, sticking close together, intimate union or junction; close connec-tion or contact, proximity; tying or fastening toge-ther; intercourse, intimacy, acquaintance; addiction or devotion to.
संसज्जमान: सं-सज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, adhering or sticking close together; being prepared or ready.
संसद्: संसद् 1. सं-सद्, cl. 1. 6. P. -सीदति (Ved. and ep. also A. -ते), -सत्तुम्, to sit down together, sit along with, sit down; to sink down, be afflicted, be in distress; to pine away.
2. सं-सद्, त्, त्, त्, one who sits together, one who sits at or takes part in a sacrifice; (त्), f. an as-sembly, meeting, congress, session; a court of justice.
संसाद: सं-साद, अस्, m. a sitting down together, meet-ing, assembly.
संसीदत्: सं-सीदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sitting down together, sinking down.
संसरण: सं-सरण, अम्, n. going, proceeding, moving or going round in a circuit, revolving, revolution, passing through a succession of states, birth and re-birth of living beings, the world; going well or unobstructedly, the unresisted march of troops; the commencement of war or battle; a highway, prin-cipal road; a resting-place for passengers near the gates of a city.
संसर्ग: संसर्ग सं-सर्ग, सं-सर्जन, &c. See under 1. सं-सृज्।

सं-सर्ग, अस्, m. mixture or union together, commixture, conjunction, close or intimate union, close contact, touch, proximity, approximation, asso-ciation, society, (पापिष्ठ-स्°, the society of very low people); intercourse, sexual attachment or con-nection, copulation, coition; acquaintance, familiarity; intimate relation (= सम्-अवाय), co-existence. —संसर्ग-तस्, ind. through union or connection, in consequence of intercourse or familiarity. —सं-सर्ग-दोष, अस्, m. the fault or evil consequences of society (with bad people). —संसर्ग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, = सं-सृष्ट, mixed, joined with. —सं-सर्गाभव (°ग-अभ्°), अस्, m. (in the Nyāya phil.) a particular form of the category of non-existence (said to be of three kinds, prior, incidental and final, or absence of birth, destruction of present being and necessary cessation of existence).
संसर्प: सं-सर्प, अस्, m. creeping along, gliding, flow-ing gently; any equable or gentle motion; the intercalary month occurring in a year in which there falls a Kṣaya-māsa.
संसव: संसव सं-सव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 3. सु with सम्), a confusion of libations, an irregular or sinful sacrifice (so regarded when two Brāhmans perform the Soma sacrifice on the same spot and at the same time).
संसाध्: संसाध् सं-साध्, Caus. -साधयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to be completely finished; to ac-complish or perform thoroughly, complete; to finish off; to settle; to destroy, kill, extinguish; to cause to be settled or paid; to regain; to obtain; to be successful (A.): Pass. of Caus. -साध्यते, to be com-pletely accomplished; to be thoroughly provided or furnished with.
संसाधयत्: सं-साधयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, accomplishing, &c.; obtaining, receiving, taking.
संसाध्य: सं-साध्य, ind. having accomplished or per-formed thoroughly; having destroyed or killed, &c.
संसार: सं-सार, अस्, m. course, passage, passing through a succession of states, course or circuit of mundane existence, transmigration, metempsychosis, the world, secular life, worldly illusion. —संसार-गमन, अम्, n. passing from one state of existence to another or from one body to another, transmigration, metem-psychosis. —संसार-गुरु, उस्, m. ‘the Guru of the world,’ epithet of Kāma (god of love). —सं-सार-मण्डल, अम्, n. the circle of the world. —संसार-मार्ग, अस्, m. the road of the world, the course or stage of mundane affairs, the world; the vulva. —संसार-मोक्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, libe-rating or emancipating from worldly existence; (अम्), n. emancipation from the world. —सं-सार-समुद्र or संसार-सागर, अस्, m. the ocean-like world.
संसिच्: संसिच् 1. सं-सिच्, cl. 6. P. A. -सिञ्चति, -ते, -सेक्तुम्, to sprinkle over, sprinkle thoroughly, water.
2. सं-सिच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. one who sprinkles, sprinkling.
संसिक्त: सं-सिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well sprinkled or moistened, watered. —संसिक्त-रेणु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the dust laid or well watered.
संसेक: सं-सेक, अस्, m. sprinkling over, moistening, watering.
संसिध्: संसिध् सं-सिध्, cl. 4. P. -सिध्यति, -सेद्-धुम्, to be accomplished or performed thoroughly, to be made perfect; to be made happy, attain beatitude.
संसिद्ध: सं-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, fully done or accom-plished, made perfect, perfected; one who has at-tained beatitude.
संसिद्धि: सं-सिद्धि, इस्, f. complete accomplishment, per-fection, completion, complete attainment, beati-tude, final emancipation; nature, natural disposition, natural state or quality; a passionate or intoxicated woman.
संसुदा: संसुदा सं-सुदा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. altogether munificent, one who gives very liberally, (Sāy. = सम्यक् सुष्ठु दातृ।)
संसुप्त: सं-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, soundly asleep, fast asleep, asleep, sleeping.
संसूच्: संसूच् सं-सूच्, cl. 10. P. -सूचयति, -यितुम्, to indicate or show plainly, prove, imply, argue; to inform, tell.
संसूचन: सं-सूचन, अम्, n. the act of indicating or show-ing plainly, proving; telling, informing; reproving, reproaching.
संसूचित: सं-सूचित, अस्, आ, अम्, plainly indicated; in-formed, told, apprised; reproved.
संसृ: संसृ सं-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्, to go towards, approach, attain, obtain; to go round, revolve, pass through a succession of states: Caus. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go round or revolve or pass through.
संसारिन्: संसारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, passing through (successive existences), transmigratory, worldly, mundane, secu-lar, mixing with society, engaged in worldly or secular occupations; (ई), m. a living or sentient being, human being, animal, creature, embodied spirit. —संसार्य्-आत्मन्, आ, m. (perhaps rather two separate words), the transmigratory soul, the soul passing through various mundane states, (opposed to परमात्मन्।)
संसृति: सं-सृति, इस्, f. course, current, flow, stream, revolution; course of mundane existence, transmi-gration; the world.
संसृत्य: सं-सृत्य, ind. having gone to or approached, having obtained; having passed onwards or through.

P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, to strike together, join or unite closely, put together, close (the hands &c.), shut; to contract, diminish; to bring together, heap, accumulate, collect; to fight together, clash; to strike, kill, destroy completely: Caus. -घातयति, -यितुम्, to strike together, kill, destroy utterly.
संहत: सं-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck together, closely joined or united, closed, shut; well knit or com-pacted together, firmly united, compact, close, firm, solid; closely allied; combined, joined, connected, acting or making effort together, keeping together; collected, assembled, accumulated; struck, hurt, wounded, killed. —संहत-जानु, उस्, उस्, उ, or संहत-जानुक, अस्, ई, अम्, knock-kneed. —सं-हत-तल, अस्, m. the two hands joined with the open palms brought together. —संहत-ता, f. or संहत-त्व, अम्, n. compactness, close combina-tion; close contact or approximation, conjunction; union, agreement. —संहत-भ्रू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, knitting the brows. —संहत-स्तनी, f. (a woman) whose breasts are very close to each other. —सं-हताश्व (°त-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a king.
संहति: सं-हति, इस्, f. the state of being brought into close contact, firm or close combination, firm union or alliance, junction, joint effort, agreement, com-pactness, firmness, solidity, bulk, mass, assemblage, collection, heap, number, host, multitude.
संहत्य: सं-हत्य, ind. having struck together, having closed or joined.
संहनन: सं-हनन, अस्, ई, अम्, striking together; kill-ing, destroying, a destroyer, conqueror; (अम्), n. the act of striking together, compactness, inflexi-bility; strength, muscularity; rubbing the limbs; the body (as having the limbs well compacted).
संहनु: सं-हनु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. destructive, deadly.
सङ्घ: सङ्-घ, अस्, m. close contact or combination; any collection or assemblage, heap, multitude, quantity, crowd, host, band, number, group, flock, shoal; any number of people or inhabitants living together. —सङ्घ-गुप्त, अस्, m. a proper N., (also read सिंह-गुप्त।) —सङ्घ-चारिन्, ई, m. ‘going in shoals,’ a fish. —सङ्घ-जीविन्, ई, m. ‘living by multitudes of people,’ a hired labourer, porter, cooly. —सङ्घ-तल, अस्, m. the two hands joined with the open palms brought together. —सङ्घ-पुष्पी, f. a particular plant (= धातकी). —सङ्घ-वृत्ति, इस्, f. a state of close combination. —सङ्घवृत्ति-ता, f. combined action. —सङ्घ-शस्, ind. collec-tively, all together; by troops, in flocks, in shoals, in companies.
सङ्घात: सङ्-घात, अस्, m. close combination, union, association, connection, confederacy; a collection, quantity, assemblage, multitude, heap, cluster, band; a collection of mucus, phlegm [cf. सङ्-घाणक]; composition of words, formation of compounds; striking, killing, hurting; a particular gait or mode of walking (in the drama); N. of a division of the infernal regions; [cf. सं-हात।] —सङ्घात-क-ठिन, अस्, आ, अम्, compactly or solidly hard, hard from solidity or compactness. —सङ्घात-पत्त्रिका, f. a sort of fennel (= शत-पुष्पा). —सङ्घात-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having close union, possessing a heap or multitude, closely compacted or combined.
संहरण: सं-हरण, अम्, n. the act of drawing or bring-ing together; contracting; crumpling together, de-stroying, destruction, ruin; collecting, accumulating; withdrawing; restraining, checking; seizing, taking.
संहर्ष: संहर्ष 1. सं-हर्ष, अस्, m. (for सङ्-घर्-ष, q. v.; for 2. see under सं-हृष्), rubbing, grinding, trituration; envy, emulation; air, wind.

2. सं-हर्ष, अस्, m. bristling or erection of the hair of the body (either from rapture or terror), thrill of delight, joy, pleasure; ardour, emulation, (perhaps for सङ्-घर्ष); air, wind; trituration, rubbing together, (for सङ्-घर्ष।) —संहर्ष-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing joy, enraptured.
संहवन: संहवन सं-हवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. हु with सम्), the act of sacrificing or offering oblations toge-ther; sacrificing in a proper manner; a quadrangle, group of four houses; [cf. सञ्-जवन।]
संहा: संहा सं-हा, cl. 3. A. -जिहीते, &c., to go together, proceed; to obtain.
सञ्जिहान: सञ्-जिहान, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving.
संहात: संहात संहात, अस्, m. (probably for सङ्-घात, q. v.), one of the twenty-one hells (mentioned in Manu IV. 89).
संहार: सं-हार, अस्, m. drawing together, contraction, abridgement, comprehensive description, abbrevia-tion, compression; a fault in pronunciation, (opposed to वि-हार); close, end, conclusion, (काव्य-सं-हार, अस्, m. ‘the close of a poem,’ epithet of the benediction at the conclusion of a drama); destruc-tion, loss; the periodical destruction of the universe at the end of a Kalpa; collection, assemblage, accu-mulation; withdrawing, withholding, restraining, suppressing; a charm or spell for restraining magical weapons or bringing them back after discharging them; seizing, laying hold of, taking [cf. वेणी-स्°]; a division of the infernal regions; practice, skill. —संहार-भैरव, अस्, m. one of the eight forms of Bhairava, q. v. —संहार-मुद्रा, f., N. of a particular posture in the Tantra worship (= विसर्जन-मुद्रा).
संहि: संहि सं-हि, cl. 5. P. -हिनोति, &c., to send forth, utter.
संहित: सं-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. 1. धा with सम्), put together, placed together, conjoined, combined, joined, connected, united, attached, agreed, agreeing with, conformable to, in accordance with, (धर्म-स्°, in accordance with justice); referring to, relating to; collected, assembled; compiled; placed, fixed; endowed with, provided, furnished, equipped, pos-sessed of, accompanied by, abounding in; caused by; (आ), f. conjunction, combination, connection, union; a collection, compilation, compendium; any metho-dical or arranged collection of texts or verses; the real continuous hymnical text of the Veda as formed out of the Padas or separate words (see पद) by proper phonetic changes according to various schools, (the Prātiśākhyas teaching how these Padas must change in order to become the Saṃhitā; hence the term Saṃhitā is applied to that portion of the Veda which contains the collection of Mantras or hymns thus formed, collected, and arranged according to particular Śākhās or schools [cf. शाखा]; the number of Vedas being four, and the Yajur-veda having two branches, it follows that there must be at least five Saṃhitās of the Veda, viz. the Ṛk-s°, Taittirīya-s°, Vājasaneyi-s°, Sāma-s°, Atharva-s°; for the division of the Saṃhitā of the Śākala school of the Ṛg-veda, which is the only Śākhā of this Veda preserved, see मण्डल; Vyāsa is said to have compiled a Saṃ-hitā of the Purāṇas, the substance of which is sup-posed to be represented by the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa); a compilation or compendium of laws, code, digest; (in grammar) the junction or combination of letters according to euphonic rules (= सन्धि, but some-times considered rather as the state preparatory to the actual junction than the junction itself); the Being who holds together and supports the universe, (a term applied to the Supreme Being, according to some); N. of an astrological work; [cf. वृहत्-स्°।] —संहित-पुष्पिका, f. a particular plant (= मि-श्रेया). —संहिता-पाठ, अस्, m. the continuous text of the Veda (as formed out of the Pada-pāṭha). —संहिता-प्रदीप, अस्, m. ‘light of the Saṃhitā,’ N. of a work. —संहिता-वत्, ind. as in the Saṃ-hitā text. —संहितेषु (°त-इषु), उस्, उस्, उ, one who has fitted or placed an arrow on a bow-string. —संहितोपनिषद (°ता-उप्°) or संहितोपनि-षद्-ब्राह्मण, अम्, n., N. of a Brāhmaṇa (of the Sāma-veda). —संहितोरु (°त-ऊरु), उस्, उस् or ऊस्, उ, having the thighs joined (through obesity).
संहूति: सं-हूति, इस्, f. shouting or calling out together, general shout or clamour, exclamation, tumultuous exultation.
संहृ: संहृ सं-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्-तुम्, to bring or draw together; to contract, abridge, compress; to close, clench (the fists &c.); to crush together, crumple up, destroy, annihilate, (opposed to सृज्); to bring together, collect, accumulate; to draw together, unite, bind by obligations; to draw aside (a curtain &c.), withdraw, withhold, hold back, take back; to restrain, suppress, curb; to lay hold of, seize, subtract, take: Pass. -ह्रियते, to be drawn together, be contracted or abridged; to be destroyed; to be finished or concluded; to be restrained, &c.: Desid. -जिहीर्षति, to wish to draw together or destroy or annihilate.
संहर: सं-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, drawing together, bringing together; contracting; destroying, &c. —संह-राख्य (°र-आख्°), अस्, m. ‘called Saṃhara,’ the fire Pāvaka.
संहर्तृ: सं-हर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who draws together or contracts, &c.; destroying, a destroyer.
संहारक: सं-हारक, अस्, इका, अम्, drawing together, compressing, closing; destructive, ruinous; a de-stroyer.
संहार्य: सं-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be drawn together or contracted, to be abridged; to be destroyed, &c.; to be restrained or curbed or suppressed.
संहृत: सं-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn together; contracted, compressed, abridged; closed; destroyed, scattered; collected, assembled; withdrawn, withheld; restrained, curbed; seized, laid hold of.
संहृति: सं-हृति, इस्, f. contraction, compression, abridge-ment; destruction, loss, disappearance; collection; restraint; taking, seizure.
संहृत्य: सं-हृत्य, ind. having drawn together or con-tracted, having abridged; having closed or clenched (the fist); having destroyed.
संहृष्: संहृष् सं-हृष्, cl. 4. P. -हृष्यति, -हर्-षितुम्, to bristle, stand erect (as the hair of the body from joy or fright); to thrill with delight, be glad, rejoice.
संहृष्ट: सं-हृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, thrilled, enraptured, rejoiced, delighted, glad; bristling, shuddering; fired with ardour or emulation. —संहृष्ट-रोमन्, आ, आ, अ, or संहृष्ट-रोमाङ्ग (°म-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the hair of the body bristling (with joy or fright), thrilling with joy.
संहोत्र: संहोत्र सं-होत्र, Ved. = समीचीन-यज्ञ, Ṛg-veda X. 86, 10.
संह्राद: संह्राद सं-ह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ह्रद् with सम्), a loud noise, uproar, sound, noise.
संह्रादिन्: सं-ह्रादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding together, making a noise, tumultuous, noisy. —संह्रादि-कण्ठ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a sounding throat.
संह्री: संह्री सं-ह्री, cl. 3. P. -जिह्रेति, &c., to be quite ashamed.
संह्रीण: सं-ह्रीण, अस्, आ, अम्, altogether ashamed; bash-ful, modest.
संह्लाद: संह्लाद सं-ह्लाद, अस्, m., N. of a son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu (and brother of Pra-hlāda, q. v.).
संह्वे: संह्वे सं-ह्वे, cl. 1. A. -ह्वयते, -ह्वातुम् (Ved. Inf. -ह्वयितवै), to call out loudly, shout together; to call out, tell, relate, make known.
सक: सक सक, अस्, m. (a diminutive fr. स, the base of nom. sing. of तद्), he, that man; (आ), f. she, (Ṛg-veda I. 191, 11.)
सकट: सकट स-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, bad, vile; (अस्), m. the small tree Trophis Aspera (= शाखोट)। —सकटान्न (°ट-अन्°), अम्, n. impure food (ac-cording to some).
सकण्टक: सकण्टक स-कण्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, having thorns, thorny, prickly; troublesome, perilous; (अस्), m. the aquatic plant Vallisneria (= शैवाल); a kind of Karañja.
सकपटम्: सकपटम् स-कपटम्, ind. with fraud or dissimulation, fraudulently.
सकमल: सकमल स-कमल, अस्, आ, अम्, having lotuses, abounding in lotuses.
सकम्प: सकम्प स-कम्प, अस्, आ, अम्, having tremor, tremulous.
सकम्पन: स-कम्पन, अस्, आ, अम्, having tremor, trem-bling; accompanied with earthquakes; (according to Nīla-kaṇṭha) = स-विद्युत्।
सकर: सकर 1. स-कर, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कर), having hands; possessing a trunk (as an elephant).
सकर 2. स-कर, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. कर), having rays, full of rays; having or bearing tax, bringing in toll, liable to pay taxes.
सकरुण: सकरुण स-करुण, अस्, आ, अम्, having pity, tender, compassionate; (अम्), ind. compassionately, tenderly.
सकर्ण: सकर्ण स-कर्ण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having ears; hearing, listening; accompanied by Karṇa.
सकर्तृक: सकर्तृक स-कर्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्, having an agent.
सकर्मक: स-कर्मक, अस्, m. having or performing any act; (in grammar) ‘having an object,’ the transitive or active verb.
सकर्मन्: स-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, performing any act or rite; following similar business.
सकारण: स-कारण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a cause, originating from a cause.
सकल: सकल 1. स-कल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. स and कला), together with parts or portions; all, whole, entire; (अम्), n. everything; the whole; [cf. Lith. cźiela-s; Russ. zielyï; Slav. ziel; Pol. saly, salki; perhaps Goth. hail-s; Old Norse heil; Angl. Sax. hal.] —सकल-सिद्धि-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving all perfection. —१। सकल-हंस-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing entire or unbroken flocks of geese. —सकलार्-थ-शास्त्र-सार (°ल-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, containing the essence of precepts about all things. —सकलेन्दु (°ल-इन्°), उस्, m. the full moon. —सकलेन्दु-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having a face like the full moon.
सकल 2. स-कल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a soft or low sound.
सकलङ्क: सकलङ्क स-कलङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having spots or stains, stained, contaminated.
सकलत्र: सकलत्र स-कलत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied by a wife.
सकलह: सकलह स-कलह, अस्, आ, अम्, having quar-rels, quarrelsome, quarrelling.
सकलहंसगण: सकलहंसगण 2. स-कलहंस-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, having flocks of Kala-haṃsas.
सकल्प: सकल्प स-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, having the ritual or ceremonial part of the Veda, along with the ritual, (Manu II. 140); having rites or ceremonies; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva.
सकवच: सकवच स-कवच, अस्, आ, अम्, having armour or mail, clad in armour, mailed.
सकाकोल: सकाकोल स-काकोल, अस्, m. one of the twenty-one hells (mentioned in Manu IV. 89).
सकातर: सकातर स-कातर, अस्, आ, अम्, cowardly, dastardly; (अम्), ind. with cowardice, in a cowardly manner.
सकाम: सकाम स-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, having love or affection, full of love, loving, a lover; one who has obtained his wish, contented, satisfied, humoured, gratified; (अम्), ind. with pleasure; contentedly, assuredly, indeed. —सकामारि (°म-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of lovers,’ epithet of Śiva.
सकार्मुक: सकार्मुक स-कार्मुक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bow, armed with a bow.
सकाल: सकाल स-काल, अस्, आ, अम्, seasonable; (अम्), ind. seasonably, betimes, early in the morning.
सकाली: सकाली सकाली, f., N. of a place. —सकाली-समुद्र, N. of a place.
सकाश: सकाश स-काश, अस्, आ, अम्, having appear-ance or visibility, visible, present, near; (अस्), m. presence, propinquity, vicinity, nearness; (अम्, ए), ind. in the presence of, near; (आत्), ind. from the presence of, from.
सकिरीटकौस्तुभ: सकिरीटकौस्तुभ स-किरीट-कौस्तुभ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a diadem and breast-jewel.
सकुक्षि: सकुक्षि स-कुक्षि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the same womb, born from the same mother (as a brother or other relation of whole blood).
सकुण्डल: सकुण्डल स-कुण्डल, अस्, आ, अम्, having ear-rings, decorated with ear-rings.
सकुरुण्ड: सकुरुण्ड सकुरुण्ड, अस्, m. yellow Ama-ranth or Barleria (= साकुरुण्ड, कुरुण्ट).
सकुल: सकुल स-कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a family; belonging to a noble family, &c.; belonging to the same family; (अस्), m. a kinsman; (अस्, ई), m. f. a sort of fish (= शकुल).
सकुल्य: सकुल्य, अस्, m. one of the same family and name (= स-गोत्र); a distant relation, remote kins-man (said to be one who shares a divided oblation, e. g. the grandson's grandson or even other descendants as far as three degrees or more from him; sometimes extended to the tenth descendant).
सकृच्छ्र: सकृच्छ्र स-कृच्छ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having trouble or distress, attended with pain, painful, dis-tressing.
सकृत्: सकृत् 1. स-कृत्, ind. (connected with rt. 1. कृ), once, on one occasion only [cf. अ-स्°]; at one time; at once, together; together with, with; always; [with the former part of this word cf.
