सकृपण: स-कृपण, अस्, आ, अम्, pitiable, miserable, wretched.
सकेश: सकेश स-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, having hair, hairy.
सकैतव: सकैतव स-कैतव, अस्, आ, अम्, having fraud, fraudulent; (अस्), m. a deceiver, cheat, impostor; (अम्), ind. fraudulently.
सकोप: सकोप स-कोप, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, full of anger, angry, displeased; (अम्), ind. with anger, angrily.

सक्त: सक्त सक्त, सक्ति। See under rt. सञ्ज्।

सक्तुल: सक्तुल, अस्, आ, अम्, containing flour.
सक्थि: सक्थि सक्थि, इ, n. (according to Uṇādi-s. III. 154. fr. rt. सञ्ज्, because the body ‘is attached to’ or ‘rests on’ the thigh; according to Yāska fr. rt. सच्; the base of some cases is सक्थन्, see below; in Ṛg-veda X. 86, 16. सक्थ्या = सक्थिनी, n. du., occurs), the thigh; a bone; the pole or shafts of a cart; a part of the frame of a cart.
सक्थ: सक्थ at the end of a comp. = सक्थि।
सक्थन्: सक्थन्, a form of base substituted for सक्थि above, in the weakest cases (e. g. inst. sing. सक्थ्ना, dat. सक्थ्ने, abl. gen. सक्थ्नस्, loc. सक्थ्नि or सक्थनि, gen. pl. सक्थ्नाम्, Ved. acc. pl. सक्-थानि).
सक्म: सक्म सक्म, सक्म्य। See under rt. सच्।
सक्रिय: सक्रिय स-क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, having action, active, mutable, movable, migratory; one who ob-serves his religious duties.
सक्रोध: सक्रोध स-क्रोध, अस्, आ, अम्, full of anger, angry; (अम्), ind. with anger, angrily.
सक्षण: सक्षण स-क्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a leisure moment, being at leisure.
सक्षणि: सक्षणि सक्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (according to some fr. rt. क्षन्, perhaps fr. rt. 1. सह्; according to Sāy. fr. rt. सच्), Ved. overpowering, destroying; honouring, obeying; to be honoured; (Sāy. = स-चमान, Ṛg-veda VIII. 70, 8; = सचनीय-शील, VIII. 22, 15.)
सक्षत्रम्: सक्षत्रम् स-क्षत्रम्, ind. suitably to the state of a Kṣatriya.
सक्षित्: सक्षित् स-क्षित्, त्, त्, त् (see 2. क्षित्), Ved. dwelling along with, associated together, going to-gether.
सखड्ग: सखड्ग स-खड्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, armed with a sword, sword in hand.
सखि: सखि सखि, आ, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 136. fr. स for समान + rt. ख्या; according to others fr. 4. स and rt. 2. क्षि, and meaning ‘living together’), a friend, (किं-स्°, a bad friend); an associate, companion; [cf. Lat. socius.] —सखि-ता, f. or सखि-त्व, अम्, n. friendship, intimacy. —सखि-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has been formerly a friend; (अम्), n. the being formerly a friend. —सखि-वत्, ind. like a friend, as a friend. —सखि-विग्रह, अस्, m. war of friends, civil war.
सख: सख, अस्, m. a friend, (frequently used at the end of comps. for सखि above; cf. नर-स्°, व-सन्त-स्°); the tree Mimosa Catechu.
सखी: सखी, f. a female friend or companion, a woman's confidante, (कु-सखी, a bad female friend.) —स-खी-कदम्बक, अम्, n. a number of female friends. —सखी-गण, अस्, m. a number of female friends. —सखीगण-समावृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded by a company of female friends. —सखी-जन, अस्, m. a female friend, confidante. —सखी-सहित, अस्, आ, अम्, attended by female friends.
सखीय: सखीय, Nom. P. सखीयति, &c., to wish for a friend.
सखीयत्: सखीयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desiring friends, desirous of friendship.
सख्य: सख्य, अम्, n. friendship, intimacy; equality; (अस्), m. a friend.
सखेद: सखेद स-खेद, अस्, आ, अम्, having grief or sorrow; (अम्), ind. with grief, sorrowfully.
सखेलम्: सखेलम् स-खेलम्, ind. with a gentle motion, moving gently.
सग्: सग् सग्, cl. 1. P. सगति, ससाग, असगीत्, सगितुम्, to cover: Caus. सगयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to cover.
सगजारोह: सगजारोह स-गजारोह, अस्, आ, अम्, accom-panied by an elephant-rider, attended by men riding on elephants.
सगण: सगण स-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, having troops or flocks, accompanied by a troop, attended by a body of followers; attended or accompanied by (with inst.); (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva.
सगद्गदम्: सगद्गदम् स-गद्गदम्, ind. with stammer-ing, in a faltering voice.
सगन्ध: सगन्ध स-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, having a smell, odoriferous, fragrant, sweet-smelling; (अस्), m. a relation, kinsman, co-heir.
सगन्धर्व: सगन्धर्व स-गन्धर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, together with the Gandharvas.
सगर: सगर स-गर, अस्, आ, अम्, having poison, poisonous; (अस्), m. the ocean, sea (Ved., enumerated among the अन्तरिक्ष-नामानि in Naigh. I. 3; also अम्, n.); N. of a king of the solar race, sovereign of Ayodhyā (son of Bāhu; he is said to have been called Sagara, as born together with a poison given to his mother by the other wife of his father; he was father of Asamañja by Keśinī and of sixty thousand sons by Sumati; the latter were turned into a heap of ashes by the sage Kapila, see भगीरथ, and their funeral ceremonies could only be performed by the waters of Gaṅgā to be brought from heaven for the purpose of purifying their remains; this was finally accomplished by the devotion of Bhagīratha, q. v., who having led the river to the sea, called it Sāgara in honour of his ancestor: Sagara is described as having subdued the Śakas, Yavanas, and other barbarous tribes, and de-prived them of their social and religious position); N. of a particular Arhat. —सगरोपाख्यान (°र-उप्°), अम्, n. ‘the story of Sagara,’ N. of the fifteenth chapter of the Svarga-khaṇḍa of the Padma-Purāṇa.
सगर्भ: सगर्भ स-गर्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, pregnant; (अस्), m. ‘having the same womb,’ a brother by the same father and mother, a brother of whole blood (= स-होदर; cf. Gr. ἀδελφός (आ), f. a pregnant woman.
सगर्भ्य: सगर्भ्य, अस्, m. a brother of whole blood, one by the same father and mother.
सगर्व: सगर्व स-गर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, proud; joyful, glad, elated; (अम्), ind. haughtily.
सगुडशृङ्गक: सगुडशृङ्गक स-गुडशृङ्गक, अस्, इका, अम्, furnished with cupolas.
सगुण: सगुण स-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, having properties or qualities, &c.; possessing good qualities or attri-butes, virtuous; worldly.
सगूढम्: सगूढम् स-गूढम्, ind. secretly, privately, privily.
सगोत्र: सगोत्र स-गोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, being of the same family or kin, related; (अस्), m. a kinsman of the same family; one sprung from a common an-cestor; one connected by funeral oblations of food and water; a distant kinsman; (अम्), n. a family, race, lineage.
सग्धि: सग्धि स-ग्धि, इस्, f. (contracted fr. सह-जग्धि, see जग्धि), eating together; (इस्, इस्, इ,), Ved. eating together.
सग्मन्: सग्मन् सग्मन्, enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि in Naigh. II. 17.
सघ्: सघ् सघ्, cl. 5. P. सघ्नोति, ससाघ, सघिष्यति, असघीत् or असाघीत्, सघि-तुम्, to strike, hurt, injure, kill; to receive, accept; to support, bear [cf. rt. 1. सह्]: Caus. साघयति, -यितुम्, Aor. असीषघत् or असीसघत्: Desid. सिसघिषति: Intens. सासघ्यते, सासग्धि।
सघन: सघन स-घन, अस्, आ, अम्, having density or solidity, dense, solid.
सङ्क: सङ्क सङ्-क, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Sāy. fr. rt. कै with सम्; but according to Yāska, Nir. IX. 14, either fr. rt. सच् or fr. सङ्-कॄ), sounding together, shouting; having assembled warriors; (in Naigh. II. 17. सङ्काः is enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि।)
सङ्कट: सङ्कट सङ्-कट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सम् + कट, q. v.), ‘having the hips close together,’ contracted, narrow, strait; impassable, impervious; crowded; (अस्), m. a proper N.; (आ), f. a particular goddess worshipped at Benares; a particular Yoginī, (seven others are named, viz. Maṅgalā, Piṅgalā, Dhanyā, Bhrāmarī, Bhadrikā, Ulkā, Siddhi); (अम्), n. a narrow passage, strait, defile, pass; a strait, difficulty, trouble, (प्राण-सङ्कट, risk of life.) —सङ्क-टाक्ष (°ट-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, ‘having contracted eyes,’ winking, leering; (अस्), m. the tree Grislea Tomentosa (= धव). —सङ्कटापन्न (°ट-आप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, beset with difficulties.
सङ्कथ्: सङ्कथ् सङ्-कथ् (सम्-कथ्), cl. 10. P. -क-थयति, -यितुम्, to relate or narrate fully, tell, com-municate, inform; to explain; to speak about or of (with acc.); to converse.
सङ्कथन: सङ्-कथन, अम्, n. the act of narrating fully, narration, relation.
सङ्कथा: सङ्-कथा, f. conversation, discourse, talking to-gether.
सङ्कथित: सङ्-कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, related, narrated, com-municated.
सङ्कथ्यमान: सङ्-कथ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being told or related.
सङ्कन्: सङ्कन् सङ्-कन् (सम्-कन्, cf. 2. का, rt. कै), cl. 1. P. -कनति, &c. (apparently only used in the participle below), Ved. to be satisfied or pleased, &c.; [cf. rt. चक्।]
सञ्चकान: सञ्-चकान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. satisfied with, pleased; praised, glorified, (Sāy. = स्तूयमान, as if fr. rt. कै with सम्।)
सङ्कम्प्: सङ्कम्प् सङ्-कम्प् (सम्-कम्प्), cl. 1. A. -कम्पते, -कम्पितुम्, to shake about, quake, tremble: Caus. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shake or tremble.
सङ्कर: सङ्-कर, अस्, m. mixing together, intermixture, blending, confusing, confounding, confusion, irregular mixture, unlawful intermarriage, mixture of caste, a mixed caste or race (proceeding from the union of a man with a woman of a higher caste or from the promiscuous intercourse of the four tribes, and again from the indiscriminate cohabitation of their descend-ants amongst each other; cf. योनि-सङ्कर); the union or mixing together of two figures in the same passage (in rhetoric); dust, sweepings [cf. अव-कर, p. 88]; the crackling of flame. —सङ्कर-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born from a mixed marriage. —सङ्करी-करण, अम्, n. the act of mixing together, con-fusing; confusion; causing mixture or loss of caste. —सङ्करी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to mix together confusedly, cause confusion. —सङ्करी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, confused, blended or mixed confusedly; outcast.
सङ्कर; add — contamination, pollution; any contaminated object.
सङ्कर्षण: सङ्-कर्षण, अम्, n. the act of drawing together, contracting; shortening; attracting, drawing; mak-ing rows, ploughing, &c.; (अस्), m., N. of the first-born offspring of Viṣṇu, (Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 7527); epithet of Bala-deva or Bala-rāma (elder brother of Kṛṣṇa, and so called because withdrawn from the womb of Devakī and transferred to that of Rohiṇī); a proper N. —सङ्कर्षण-काण्ड, N. of a work ascribed to Jaimini. —सङ्कर्षणेश्वर-तीर्थ (°ण-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
सङ्कल्: सङ्कल् 1. सङ्-कल् (सम्-कल्, see rt. 2. कल्), cl. 10. P. -कालयति, -यितुम्, to drive together, drive to; to drive away, put to flight.
सङ्कल् 2. सङ्-कल् (सम्-कल्, see rt. 3. कल्), cl. 10. P. -कलयति, -यितुम्, to heap together, pile up, accumulate; to grasp, lay hold of; to consider, deem, regard as.
सङ्कल: सङ्-कल, अस्, m. collection, accumulation, quan-tity; addition.
सङ्कलन: सङ्-कलन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of heaping toge-ther; contact, junction, collision, intermixture; blend-ing, twining; (अम्), n. addition (in arithmetic).
सङ्कलित: सङ्-कलित, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped together, piled up, collected, brought together, blended, intermixed, arranged; added; laid hold of, grasped; (आ), f. (in arithmetical progression) the first sum; (अम्), n. addition (in arithmetic). —सङ्-कलितैक्य (°ता-ऐक्°), अम्, n. the sum of the sums or terms (of an arithmetical progression).
सङ्कल्प: सङ्-कल्प, अस्, m. will, volition, strength of will, purpose, mental resolve or determination, resolution, vow; power of will; wish, desire; idea formed in the mind, thought, imagination, fancy, contrivance; consideration, reflection; mind, soul, heart; idea or expectation of advantage from any voluntary act; a solemn vow to perform a ritual observance, decla-ration of purpose; a declaration repeated by a widow who burns herself with her deceased husband; N. of a Prajā-pati; (आ), f., N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Dharma. —सङ्कल्प-कुल्मल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having desire for its shaft (said of an arrow). —सङ्कल्प-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced from self-determined will or desire, proceeding from idea of advantage; (अस्), m. ‘mind-born, heart-born,’ epi-thet of Kāma (god of love). —सङ्कल्प-जन्मन्, आ, or सङ्कल्प-भव, अस्, or सङ्कल्प-योनि, इस्, m. epithet of Kāma (god of love). —सङ्कल्प-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, formed or consisting of will, of the nature of mental resolve, conformable to the will or purpose. —सङ्कल्प-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्, produced from will or desire, arising out of an idea or desire of advantage; (अस्), m. ‘mind-born,’ epi-thet of Kāma. —सङ्कल्प-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, perfected by mental resolve or will, having super-natural powers by the exercise of a strong will. —सङ्कल्पात्मक (°प-आत्°), अस्, इका, अम्, con-sisting of will or volition, of the nature of mental resolve; willing, resolving.
सङ्कसुक: सङ्कसुक सङ्-कसुक, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 29. fr. rt. कस् with सम्), going or moving about unsteadily, unsteady, inconstant, fickle, changeable; uncertain, doubtful; weak, feeble; bad, wicked; (अस्), m., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 18 (having the patronymic Yāmāyana).
सङ्काश्: सङ्काश् सङ्-काश् (सम्-काश्), cl. 1. A. -काशते, काशितुम्, to appear together, appear in sight, become visible: Caus. -काशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to ap-pear; to look at, see, contemplate, behold.
सङ्काश: सङ्-काश, अस्, m. appearance; presence; vicinity, (गृह-सङ्काशे, in the neighbourhood of the house, near the house); (अस्, आ, अम्), like, similar (at the end of comps., e. g. मृत्यु-सङ्काश, death-like; गज-स्°, resembling elephants); near, close at hand.
सङ्किल: सङ्किल सङ्किल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. किल् with सम्), a burning torch, fire-brand.
सङ्कीर्ण: सङ्-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, poured together, mixed together, intermingled, confused, miscellaneous, crowded, closely packed; indistinct; scattered, strewed, spread, diffused; sprinkled (with exuding juice, as a rutting elephant); of mixed caste, of impure origin, born from a mixed marriage, impure, polluted, adul-terated; contracted, narrow; (अस्), m. a man of mixed caste, an outcast; a mixed note or mode (in music); an elephant possessing certain characteristic marks or one in rut; (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma. —सङ्कीर्ण-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wandering about confusedly, going to various places. —सङ्-कीर्ण-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, or सङ्कीर्ण-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, of mixed birth or caste, impure through illegal intermarriage, of a mongrel breed, mule. —सङ्-कीर्ण-युद्ध, अम्, n. a mixed or confused fight, mêlée.
सङ्कीर्तन: सङ्-कीर्तन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of reciting or proclaiming at full; greatly praising or celebrating, extolling, lauding, honouring, glorification.
सङ्कु: सङ्कु सङ्कु, उस्, m. (doubtful), a hole.
सङ्कुच्: सङ्कुच् सङ्-कुच् (सम्-कुच्), cl. 6. 1. P. -कु-चति, -कोचति, -कोचितुम्, to shrink, become con-tracted, contract, shrivel up; to close, shut (as a flower); to contract, compress: Pass. -कुच्यते, to be con-tracted, be closed: Caus. -कोचयति, -यितुम्, to con-tract, narrow, make smaller, lessen; to close up.
सङ्कुचित: सङ्-कुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, contracted, narrowed, shriveled up, shrunk, wrinkled, (अ-सङ्कुचित, not wrinkled); closed, shut, unblown (as a flower); crouching, cowering.
सङ्कोच: सङ्-कोच, अस्, m. contracting, shriveling up, con-traction, shrinking; terror, fear; compression, abridge-ment, narrowness, diminution; shutting up, closing; binding, tying; a sort of skate fish; (अम्), n. saffron. —सङ्कोच-पिशुन, अम्, n. ‘manifesting contrac-tion,’ saffron.
सङ्कोचन: सङ्-कोचन, अम्, n. the act of contracting or shrinking, contraction, causing to shrink or close; astringing; (अस्, ई, अम्), contracting, shrinking; astringent; (ई), f. the sensitive plant (= लज्जालु).
सङ्कोचयत्: सङ्-कोचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, contracting, causing to shrink or close, narrowing.
सङ्कोचिन्: सङ्-कोचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shrinking, contracting, shrivel-ing up; closing; astringent.
सङ्कोच्य: सङ्-कोच्य, ind. having contracted or compressed, &c.
सङ्कुप्: सङ्कुप् सङ्-कुप् (सम्-कुप्), cl. 4. P. A. -कुप्-यति, -ते, -कोपितुम्, to become angry or enraged; to be agitated or excited: Caus. -कोपयति, -यितुम्, to make angry, enrage, provoke, excite; to become agitated or excited.
सङ्कुपित: सङ्-कुपित, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, aroused, excited.
सङ्कोपयत्: सङ्-कोपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making angry, en-raging, exciting.
सङ्कुल: सङ्कुल सङ्कुल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. कुल् with सम्; probably connected with सङ्-कर fr. सङ्-कॄ), crowded together, thronged, mixed together, commingled, confused, perplexed, disordered, incon-sistent; filled with, full of; (अस्), m., N. of a poet; (अम्), n. a crowd, throng, mob; a flock, collection; a confused fight, battle, war, mêlée; inconsistent or contradictory speech.
सङ्कूज्: सङ्कूज् सङ्-कूज् (सम्-कूज्), cl. 1. P. -कूजति, &c., to cry aloud, utter inarticulate sounds.
सङ्कूजित: सङ्-कूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, cried aloud; (अम्), n. the cry of the Cakra-vāka.
सङ्कृ: सङ्कृ सङ्-कृ (सम्-कृ), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, = सं-स्-कृ, q. v.
सङ्कृति: सङ्-कृति, इस्, f. a kind of metre (consisting of four lines of twenty-four syllables each); (इस्), m. a proper N.; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a class of ancient Ṛṣis.
सङ्कृत्: सङ्कृत् सङ्-कृत् (सम्-कृत्), cl. 6. P. -कृन्-तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut to pieces, cut up; to cut through, cut, pierce.
सङ्कृत् सङ्-कृत् (सम्-कॄत्), cl. 10. P. -कीर्त-यति, -यितुम्, to mention or relate fully, recite; to proclaim, announce; to celebrate or praise or com-mend greatly.

1. सङ्-ग, अस्, m. (for 2. सङ्ग see under rt. 1. सञ्ज्), coming together, concurrence, meeting, encountering, conflict, war, battle, (in Naigh. II. 17. सङ्गे is enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामा-नि); uniting, union, association, contact, touch, co-herence; intercourse, keeping company, intimacy, friendship, love; the confluence of rivers. —१। सङ्ग-विच्युति, इस्, f. dissolution of union, disunion.

2. सङ्ग, अस्, m. (for 1. सङ्-ग see under सङ्-गम्), clinging to, adhering to, attachment, addiction or devotion to, fondness, propensity for, worldly or selfish attachment, affection, desire, wish, cupidity. —सङ्ग-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from attachment, indifferent, unworldly, stoical. —सङ्ग-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from worldly attachments or affections, unwordly. —२। सङ्ग-विच्युति, इस्, f. separation from wordly affection, dissolution of wordly attachments.
सङ्गणिका: सङ्गणिका सङ्गणिका, f. (fr. rt. गण् with सम्), incomparable or unequalled discourse (= अप्रतिरूप-कथा).
सङ्गम्: सङ्गम् सङ्-गम् (सम्-गम्), cl. 1. A. -गच्-छते (Pāṇ. I. 3, 29; but with an object P. -गच्छति; in Hari-vaṃśa 14, 787. सम-गच्छतु occurs for सङ्-गच्छतु, Perf. -जग्मे; Ved. forms &c. -गमेमहि, -गमामहै, -अजग्मिरन्, -अगत, -अगन्महि, -अगस्महि or -अगंस्महि, -ग्मि-षीय, -गसीष्ट or -गंसीष्ट, -गंस्यते, &c., see rt. 1. गम्, cf. Pāṇ. I. 2, 13, VII. 2. 58), -गन्-तुम्, to go together, come together, assemble, meet, encounter (either in a friendly or hostile manner), come into collision; to meet with, to ally or connect one's self with; to have sexual intercourse with; to meet harmoniously, harmonize, agree, be suitable or fit, correspond; to become contracted, shrink up; to go away, depart, die; to go to, attain (with acc.); to go to, visit (P.): Caus. -गमयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go together, bring together, connect or unite with, endow or present with (with inst. of person and acc. of thing); to connect, combine; to lead any one to anything (with two acc.); to deliver or hand over to another (with loc.), transfer, bestow, give.
सङ्गत: सङ्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, convened, met, encountered; joined, conjoined, united, associ-ated; united in wedlock; sexually united; assembled, collected, accumulated, mixed; fitted together, ap-posite, proper, seasonable, appropriate, applicable, adapted to, fitted for; in conjunction (as planets); contracted, shrunk up; (अस्), m., N. of a king (belonging to the Maurya dynasty); (अम्), n. com-ing together, union, meeting; alliance, association, intercourse, connection; friendship, acquaintance. —सङ्गत-गात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having contracted or shriveled limbs. —सङ्गत-सन्धि, इस्, m. a peace concluded after friendship.
सङ्गति: सङ्-गति, इस्, f. coming together, meeting, inter-view, union, junction, conjunction, mixture; associa-tion, intercourse, society; sexual intercourse; adapta-tion, fitness, appropriateness, applicability; going to, visiting, frequenting; meeting or coming to pass accidentally, chance, accident, (सङ्गत्या, by chance, haply); going to, visiting, frequenting; becoming acquainted, knowledge, questioning for further in-formation.
सङ्गत्वा: सङ्-गत्वा (anom. ind. part.), having come toge-ther, having met, &c.
सङ्गथ: सङ्-गथ, Ved. coming together, encountering, conflict, (in Naigh. II. 17. enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि); flowing together, confluence, (Sāy. = सङ्-गमन); (आ), f. confluence.
सङ्गम: सङ्-गम, अस्, m. coming together, meeting, en-counter, conflict, (in Naigh. II. 17. enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि); union, congress, junction, conjunction, contact, touch; association, society, company; sexual intercourse; flowing toge-ther, confluence (of rivers); fitness, adaptation; mix-ture; meeting with, acquiring, &c.; (in astronomy) planetary conjunction. —सङ्गमेश्वर (°म-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of Viśva-nātha; (अम्), n., N. of a Liṅga.
सङ्गमन: सङ्-गमन, अम्, n. the act of coming together, meeting; going with; intercourse, union; (अस्, ई, अम्), uniting, bestowing; any person or thing form-ing a point of union; (अस्), m., N. of Yama.
सङ्गमनीय: सङ्गमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be met or brought together, relating to union or congress, causing re-union.
सङ्गमय्य: सङ्-गमय्य, ind. having united, having joined, having delivered over.
सङ्गमित: सङ्-गमित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought together, con-nected, united, delivered over. —सङ्गमित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has brought together or united.
सङ्गम्य: सङ्-गम्य, ind. having met, having come toge-ther, having become united, having had sexual inter-course with.
सङ्गिन्: 1. सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going with or to, uniting with, meeting.

2. सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 1. see under सङ्-गम्), full of attachment or devotion, attached, devoted, addicted to, fond of, intent on, connected with; full of affection or desire, desirous; libidinous, lustful; continuous, uninterrupted, (Kirāt. XIV. 59.)
सञ्जग्मान: सञ्-जग्मान, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has come together, going alone with, uniting, having inter-course with.
सङ्गमनेर: सङ्गमनेर सङ्गमनेर, N. of a place.
सङ्गर: सङ्गर सङ्-गर। See under 1. and 2. सङ्-गॄ, p. 1048, col. 1.
1. सङ्-गर, अस्, m. agreeing together, agree-ment, assent; promise; a bargain, transaction of sale; knowledge.
2. सङ्-गर, अस्, m. swallowing up, devouring, misfortune, calamity; conflict, war, battle; poison; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Śamī tree.
सङ्गर्ज्: सङ्गर्ज् सङ्-गर्ज् (सम्-गर्ज्), cl. 1. P. -गर्-जति, -गर्जितुम्, to roar together, roar at, shout out against, cry out defiantly.
सङ्गव: सङ्गव सङ्-गव, Ved. the time when cows are collected for milking, i. e. early morning or at the end of night, (Sāy. सङ्गवे = रात्र्य्-अपरकाले, see Ṛg-veda V. 76, 3, where सङ्गव is enumerated among the five divisions of the day; according to some, it is the second of these divisions coming three Muhūrtas after Prātastana or the first dawn, cf. प्रातस्तन; the other three are मध्याह्न, पराह्ण, and सायाह्न।) —सङ्गव-काल, अस्, m. the time when cows are brought together for milking.
सङ्गा: सङ्गा सङ्-गा (सम्-गा), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गा-तुम्, to come together; to go to, approach.
सङ्गाद: सङ्गाद सङ्-गाद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. गद् with सम्), conversation.
सङ्गाह्: सङ्गाह् सङ्-गाह् (सम्-गाह्), cl. 1. A. -गाहते, गाहितुम्, -गाढुम्, to plunge into, enter, go into.
सङ्गिर्: सङ्-गिर्, ईर्, f., Ved. a song of praise, hymn.
सङ्गीत: सङ्-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung together, sung in chorus or harmony; (अम्), n. a song sung by many voices, chorus; singing accompanied by music and dancing, symphony; a concert; the art of singing with music and dancing. —सङ्गीत-कौमुदी, f., N. of a work on harmony. —सङ्गीत-गीति, इस्, इस्, इ, one who sings a song, a singer. —सङ्गीत-दर्पण, ‘mirror of harmony,’ N. of a work on music by Dāmodara. —सङ्गीत-नारायण, अस्, m., N. of a work on symphony by Nārāyaṇa. —सङ्गीत-रत्न-माला, f., N. of a work on harmony by Mammaṭa. —सङ्गीत-रत्नाकर (°न-आक्°), अस्, m. ‘jewel-mine of singing,’ N. of a musical work by Śārṅga-deva. —सङ्गीतरत्नाकर-कला-निधि, इस्, m., N. of a commentary on the Saṅgīta-ratnākara. —सङ्-गीत-व्यापृत, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged in singing and music. —सङ्गीत-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the science of singing combined with music and dancing; any work on the above subject. —सङ्गीत-सार and सङ्गीतार्णव (°त-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of two works. —सङ्गीतार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. the apparatus or materials for a concert; the subject of a musical performance. —सङ्-गीतावसान (°त-अव्°), अम्, n. the close of a concert.
सङ्गुप्: सङ्गुप् सङ्-गुप् (सम्-गुप्)। See rt. 2. गुप्, p. 292.
सङ्गुप्त: सङ्-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well guarded or protected, preserved; well hidden, concealed, covered over, kept secret; (अस्), m. a particular Buddha or Buddhist saint. —सङ्गुप्तार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. a secret matter, hidden meaning; (अस्, आ, अम्), having a secret or hidden meaning.
सङ्गोपन: सङ्-गोपन, अम्, n. the act of hiding or conceal-ing well, complete concealment.
सङ्गोपनीय: सङ्-गोपनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be completely hidden or concealed.
सङ्गुह्: सङ्गुह् सङ्-गुह् (सम्-गुह्), cl. 1. P. A. -गू-हति, -ते, &c. (see rt. 1. गुह्), to cover or conceal completely.
सङ्गूढ: सङ्-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, completely concealed or hidden from view; contracted, abridged; brought into contact, united, joined, heaped together, piled, arranged.
सञ्जुघुक्षा: सञ्-जुघुक्षा, f. the wish to conceal or cover, desire of hiding.
सञ्जुघुक्षु: सञ्-जुघुक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to conceal, desirous of hiding.
सङ्गृभित: सङ्गृभित सङ्-गृभित, सङ्-गृहीत, &c. See under सङ्-ग्रह्।
सङ्-गृभित, अस्, आ, अम्, grasped, griped, con-centrated.
सङ्गॄ: सङ्गॄ 1. सङ्-गॄ (सम्-गॄ, see rt. 1. गॄ), cl. 9. P. A., 6. A. -गृणाति, -गृणीते, -गिरते, &c., to speak about or praise together; to agree together, agree with (with inst.), assent, promise; to recognise, acknowledge; to agree in calling or naming (A.).
सङ्गिरमाण: सङ्-गिरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, agreeing, assenting to; promising.
सङ्गीर्ण: सङ्-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, agreed, assented to, pro-mised.
सङ्गृ: सङ्गृ 2. सङ्-गॄ, (सम्-गॄ, see rt. 2. गॄ), cl. 6. 9. P. -गिरति, -गृणाति, &c., to swallow up, de-vour.
सङ्गीर्य: सङ्-गीर्य, ind. having swallowed up or devoured.
सङ्गै: सङ्गै सङ्-गै (सम्-गै), cl. 1. P. -गायति, गातुम्, to sing together, sing in chorus, chant; to celebrate by singing together.
सङ्गीतक: सङ्गीतक, अम्, n. a concert, symphony, public entertainment consisting of songs combined with dancing and music.
सङ्गीति: सङ्-गीति, इस्, f. singing together, a concert, sym-phony, harmony, the art of singing combined with music and dancing; conversation, discourse; a species of metre.
सङ्गीयमान: सङ्-गीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being sung together, being chanted.
सङ्ग्रथित: सङ्-ग्रथित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. strung or tied together, knotted together.
सङ्ग्रस्: सङ्ग्रस् सङ्-ग्रस् (सम्-ग्रस्), cl. 1. P. A. -ग्रसति, -ते, -ग्रसितुम्, to swallow up, devour, consume: Pass. -ग्रस्यते, &c., to be devoured, consumed, &c.
सङ्ग्रह्: सङ्ग्रह् सङ्-ग्रह् or सङ्-ग्रभ् (सम्-ग्°, see rt. ग्रह्, p. 302), cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते (Ved. generally -गृभ्णाति, -गृभ्णीते), -ग्रहीतुम्, to seize or hold together, grasp, gripe, clench, take or lay hold of, snatch; to apprehend, conceive, un-derstand; to take, receive, accept, receive kindly or hospitably, attend to, listen to, encourage, support, favour, protect; to carry off; to seize on, attack (as an illness); to gather together, assemble, collect, compile; to include, comprehend, contain; to draw together, contract, make narrow or smaller, abridge; to draw together a bow (in order to unstring it); to hold in, restrain, check, govern; to keep together, close, shut (as the mouth); to concentrate (the mind); to constrain, force; to take in marriage, marry; to mention, name: Caus. -ग्राहयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to take hold of or receive, cause any one to accept (with two acc.): Desid. -जिघृक्षति, to wish to take hold of, &c., to desire to collect; to wish to take in marriage, desire to marry.
सङ्गृभ्या: सङ्-गृभ्या, ind., Ved. (for सङ्-गृभ्य) = सङ्-गृह्य below.
सङ्गृहीत: सङ्-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, grasped, seized, caught; taken, received, accepted, admitted, received kindly; collected, gathered, comprised, contracted, abridged; held in, restrained, governed. —सङ्गृहीत-राष्ट्र, अस्, m. (a king) who has a well governed kingdom.
सङ्गृह्णत्: सङ्-गृह्णत्, अन्, अती, अत्, seizing, laying hold of.
सङ्गृह्य: सङ्-गृह्य, ind. having seized, having carried off, having restrained; having constrained.
सङ्ग्रह: सङ्-ग्रह, अस्, m. seizing, grasping, clench-ing (the fist), grasp, grip, taking hold of, taking; reception, admission, assent; guarding, protecting, protection, favouring, supporting, encouraging, pro-pitiating, receiving kindly, entertaining, entertain-ment; bringing together, conjunction, collection, conglomeration, compilation; agglomeration (a par-ticular kind of संयोग or conjunction in phil.); comprehension; sum, amount, totality; abridge-ment, epitome, summary; a catalogue, list; restrain-ing, confining, controlling, governing; effort, exertion; a store-room, place where anything is kept; mention, mentioning; greatness, elevation, loftiness; velocity; epithet of Śiva; N. of several works; [cf. धनञ्-जय-स्°, स्मृति-स्°।] —सङ्ग्रह-कार, अस्, m. the composer or author of the Saṅgraha. —सङ्ग्रह-श्लोक, अस्, m. a verse recapitulating what has been explained before (in prose intermixed with Sūtras).
सङ्ग्रह, N. of a grammatical work by Vyāḍi.
सङ्ग्रहण: सङ्-ग्रहण, अम्, n. the act of taking hold of, seizing, grasping, accepting, receiving, admitting, supporting, encouraging, hoping; embracing car-nally, intercourse with a female, (see स्त्री-स्°); adultery; bringing or gathering together, compiling, collecting, mixing, blending; inlaying, enchasing; (ई), f. diarrhœa, dysentery.
सङ्ग्रहणीय: सङ्-ग्रहणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seized, &c.; to be collected; to be drawn together or contracted; to be restrained, &c.
सङ्ग्रहीतृ: सङ्-ग्रहीतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who restrains, &c.; (ता), m. a driver, charioteer.
सङ्ग्राह: सङ्-ग्राह, अस्, m. forcible seizure or grasp, laying hold of; clenching the fist; the fist; the handle of a shield.
सङ्ग्राहक: सङ्-ग्राहक, अस्, m. a gatherer, collector, com-piler.
सङ्ग्राहित: सङ्-ग्राहित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be taken hold of or received, imparted, bestowed.
सङ्ग्राहिन्: सङ्-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, seizing, grasping, holding; collecting, contracting, &c.; (ई), m. the Kuṭa-ja tree.
सङ्ग्राह्य: सङ्-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be laid hold of or seized; to be collected; to be received.
सङ्ग्राम्: सङ्ग्राम् सङ्ग्राम् (rather to be regarded as a Nom. fr. सङ्ग्राम below), cl. 10. A. सङ्ग्रामयते (also P. -ति), -यितुम्, Aor. अससङ्ग्रामत, to make war, fight.
सङ्ग्राम: सङ्ग्राम, अस्, m. war, battle, fighting; a proper N. —सङ्ग्राम-जित्, त्, त्, त्, conquering in battle; (त्), m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa. —सङ्ग्राम-प-टह, अस्, m. a large military drum.
सङ्घट्: सङ्घट् सङ्-घट् (सम्-घट्), cl. 1. A. -घ-टते, -घटितुम्, to assemble together, meet: Caus. -घटयति, -घाटयति, -यितुम्, to cause to assem-ble, collect; to join together, fasten together; to strike (a musical instrument), sound [cf. सङ्-घट्ट्]: In-tens. -जाघटीति, to be well fitted or adapted for anything.
सङ्घटित: सङ्-घटित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected, assembled; struck, sounded.
सङ्घट्य: सङ्-घट्य, ind. having joined or united toge-ther, having assembled.
सङ्घाटिका: सङ्घाटिका, f. a pair, couple; a bawd, procuress; the aquatic plant Trapa Bispinosa (= जल-कण्टक); smell (= घ्राण).
सङ्घाटी: सङ्घाटी, f. in भिक्षु-सङ्घाटी, q. v.
सङ्घट्ट्: सङ्घट्ट् सङ्-घट्ट् (सम्-घट्ट्), cl. 1. A. -घट्टते, -घट्टितुम्, to rub together, crush to pieces, bruise: Caus. -घट्टयति, -यितुम्, to cause to rub against (with inst.); to strike against, touch; to bring together, collect, assemble.
सङ्घट्ट: सङ्-घट्ट, अस्, m. rubbing together, friction; clashing together, collision, shock, clash, encounter, conflict; meeting, joining together, cohesion, rivalry, (अ-सङ्घट्ट-सुखम्, without any rival to one's happiness, Raghu-v. XIV. 86); embracing; (आ), f. a large creeper (= लता). —सङ्घट्ट-चक्र, अम्, n. a particular astrological diagram intended as a guide for determining the proper season for war.
सङ्घट्टन: सङ्-घट्टन, अम्, आ, n. f. rubbing together, friction; collision; close contact, cleaving or adhering to; the intertwining of wrestlers; the embrace of lovers; contact, cohesion, union, junction; collecting, meeting, encountering, occurrence.
सङ्घट्टयत्: सङ्-घट्टयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to rub against, rubbing together.
सङ्घट्टय्य: सङ्-घट्टय्य, ind. having brought together, having collected.
सङ्घट्टित: सङ्-घट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, struck against, touched; assembled, collected.
सङ्घाणक: सङ्घाणक सङ्घाणक, अस्, अम्, m. n. = सिं-हाणक, the mucus of the nose; [cf. सङ्-घात।]
सङ्घात्य: सङ्घात्य, a kind of dramatic performance.
सङ्घुष्: सङ्घुष् सङ्-घुष् (सम्-घुष्), cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -घोषितुम्, to sound together, resound, sound; to proclaim aloud, cry (in offering for sale); to fill with cries, make resonant.
सङ्घुषित: सङ्-घुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, proclaimed aloud; resonant, resounding.
सङ्घुष्ट: सङ्-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, proclaimed; resonant, resounding; offered for sale; (अस्), m. sound, noise, cry.
सङ्घृष्: सङ्घृष् सङ्-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, -घर्षितुम्, to rub together, grind together, tritu-rate; to rub against another (with सह and inst.), contend with, vie with: Pass. -घृष्यते (ep. also P. -ति), to rub against each other (sometimes with परस्परम्), come into collision, contend for superiority, vie with each other.
सङ्घर्ष: सङ्-घर्ष, अस्, m. rubbing together, grinding, trituration, friction; collision, mutual attrition, rivalry, emulation, vying or contending for superiority (= परस्पर-स्पर्धा); envy; going gently, gliding, flowing (= सं-सर्प).
सङ्घर्षिन्: सङ्-घर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, rubbing together, vying with one another, emulating.
सङ्घृष्ट: सङ्-घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed with, rubbed together.
सङ्घृष्यत्: सङ्-घृष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, rubbing together, coming into collision.
सङ्घ्रा: सङ्घ्रा सङ्-घ्रा (सम्-घ्रा), cl. 1. P. A. Ved. -जिघ्रति, -ते, -घ्रातुम्, Ved. to smell at one another (as animals), be on intimate or familiar terms, be closely connected: Caus. -घ्रापयति, -यितुम्, to bring into close connection or intimacy, make intimate.
सच्: सच् सच् (closely connected and by some identified with rt. सश्च्, q. v., cf. rt. सप्), cl. 1. A., 3. P. सचते (sometimes also P. सचति), सिषक्ति (Ved., Pot. 1st pl. सक्षीमहि = सङ्गच्-छेमहि, Impv. 2nd sing. सक्ष्वा for सक्ष्व), सक्तुम् (Ved. Inf. सचध्यै), Ved. to follow, pursue, seek after, attend on, become attached to (sometimes with inst.); to love, like; to celebrate, honour, worship, serve, obey, be obedient to (with acc. or gen.); to favour, assist, aid; to be associated with, (त्वं सचसे पुरन्ध्या, thou art associated with devotion, Ṛg-veda II. 1, 3); to go towards, go to, (in Naigh. II. 14. सचति and सक्षति are enume-rated among the गति-कर्माणः); to attain, obtain, acquire, gain, accomplish; [cf. Gr. ἕπ-ω, ἕ-σπ-ο-ν, ἕπ-ο-μαι, ἑ-σπ-ό-μην, ἑπ-έ-της, ὅπ-λο-ν, ὁπλότερος, ἑκάς: Lat. sequ-o-r, sec-u-ndu-s, ad-sec-la, sec-to-r, pedis-sequa, soc-iu-s, sec-us, sacer: Lith. sek-u, ‘I follow:’ Hib. seichim, ‘I follow, pursue;’ seicin, ‘pursuit.’]
सक्म्य: सक्म्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be followed; to be liked, agreeable; to be honoured, (Sāy. = सम्भ-जनार्ह); (अम्), n. (according to some) the agree-able produce (of the cow, i. e. milk).
सचथ: सचथ, Ved. companionship, assistance, (Sāy. सचथाय = सचनाय, i. e. याग-सहाय-कर-णाय, for giving assistance at the sacrifice.)
सचथ्य: सचथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = सचनीय, to be fol-lowed or served, to be honoured, worthy of honour, (Sāy. = सेवार्ह; in Ṛg-veda V. 50, 2. सचथ्य is made a substantive and interpreted by काम, i. e. any desirable thing.)
सचन: सचन, अम्, आ, n. f., Ved. the act of honouring, favouring, assisting; honour, service; (अस्, आ, अम्), to be honoured or served (= सेव्य). —सचनस्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be excessively followed or honoured. —सचना-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing honour, honoured.
सचनस्यमान: सचनस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desiring attach-ment or union, (Sāy. = सम्पर्कम् इच्छत्, Ṛg-veda X. 4, 3.)
सचनीय: सचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be followed, to be honoured or served.
सचमान: सचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. following, pursuing, seeking after, &c.
सचा: सचा (thought by some to be fr. साञ्च्, i. e. स + अञ्च्, ‘going with,’ cf. साचि; but more probably an inst. of a form सच्), ind., Ved. along with, at the same time with, together with, with (= 2. सह, but some-times used with loc. and even with gen. and dat.; Sāy. often interprets this word by सहाय, ‘an associate, helper,’ evidently connecting it with rt. सच्); with the assistance of. —सचा-भू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. being along with, united with, associated with, an associate, (Sāy. = सह वर्तमान।)
सचान: सचान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. following, pursuing, &c.; being associated with.
सचि: सचि, इस्, m. an associate, friend [cf. सखि]; con-nection, intimacy, friendship; (इस्), f. the wife of Indra, (also written शचि।) —सचि-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. knowing or appreciating friendship.
सचिव: सचिव, अस्, m. an associate, companion, friend; a counsellor, minister; the dark thorn-apple; (आ), f., see Vopa-deva VI. 13. —सचिव-ता, f. the position or rank of a minister. —सचिवामय (°व-आम्°), अस्, m. the disease Vi-sarpa.
सची: सची, f. the wife of Indra, (also written शची, q. v.) —सची-नन्दन, अस्, m. ‘Sacī's delight,’ epi-thet of Jayanta (son of Sacī and Indra).
सचकित: सचकित स-चकित, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, timorous, timid, startled; (अम्), ind. tremblingly, with alarm, timidly, timorously, in a startled manner.
सचक्र: सचक्र स-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having a circle or discus; (अम्), ind. together with a wheel or discus.
सचक्षुस्: सचक्षुस् स-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, having eyes, seeing.
सचक्षुष: स-चक्षुष, अस्, आ, अम्, having eyes, seeing.
सचनस्: सचनस् स-चनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having the same food, (Sāy. = समानान्न, Ṛg-veda I. 127, 11); (according to some) being in company with, accompanied by; [cf. सचन।]
सचरणलाक्षाराग: सचरणलाक्षाराग स-चरण-लाक्षा-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, having the colour of feet-lac, i. e. lac used for (dyeing) the feet.
सचराचर: सचराचर स-चराचर (°र-अच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, comprehending all moving and motionless creatures, comprising animate and inanimate, having all things, universal; (अम्), n. the universe.
सचल: सचल स-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, having moving things; moving.
सचारु: सचारु स-चारु, उस्, -र्वी, उ, very beautiful.
सचित्र: सचित्र स-चित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having pictures, painted, variegated.
सचिल्लक: सचिल्लक स-चिल्लक, अस्, आ, अम्, having sore eyes, blear-eyed.
सचेतन: सचेतन स-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, having con-sciousness, conscious, sentient, sensible, animate, rational; having feeling; recovering sense or con-sciousness.
सचेतस्: स-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, conscious, reflective, intelli-gent; having the same mind, unanimous.
सचेल: सचेल स-चेल, अस्, आ, अम्, having clothes, clothed, dressed.
सचेष्ट: सचेष्ट स-चेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, making effort or exertion, active; (अस्), m. the mango tree, Man-gifera Indica.
सच्चिदंश: सच्चिदंश सच्-चिद्-अंश, सच्-चिद्-आनन्द, &c. See under सत्, p. 1052.
सच्छिद्र: सच्छिद्र स-च्छिद्र (स-छ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having defects, faulty.
सच्छेद: सच्छेद स-च्छेद (स-छ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having cuttings or divisions, having interruptions, interrupted.
सजन: सजन स-जन, अस्, आ, अम्, having men or living beings; (अस्), m. a man of the same family, kinsman.
सजनपद: स-जनपद, अस्, आ, अम्, having the same country; a fellow-countryman.
सजनामात्य: स-जनामात्य (°न-अम्°), अस्, आ, अम्, accompa-nied by men and ministers.
सजनीय: सजनीय, अम्, n., N. of an ancient hymn.
सजन्य: सजन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to kinsmen or relations.
सजम्बाल: सजम्बाल स-जम्बाल, अस्, आ, अम्, having mud, muddy, clayey.
सजल: सजल स-जल, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing or containing water, watery, wet, humid. —सजल-त्व, अम्, n. wateriness. —सजल-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, watery-eyed.
सजात: सजात स-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born together, born at the same time; (अस्), m., Ved. a brother. —सजात-वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. loving one's brethren, attached to relations or kindred.
सजाति: स-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, of the same sort or kind or species, of the same class or tribe or caste; (इस्), m. the son of a man and woman of the same caste.
सजातीय: स-जातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, of the same kind or species; like, similar; of the same class or tribe, descended from parents of the same caste.
सजात्य: सजात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being of the same race or family, a kinsman, relation; (अम्), n., Ved. brotherhood, relationship; kinsfolk.
सजार: सजार स-जार, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied by a lover, together with a paramour.
सजित्वन्: सजित्वन् स-जित्वन्, आ, &c., Ved. conquer-ing common enemies (Sāy. = समान-शत्रु-जय-शील, समान-जेतृ), conquering together, victorious.
सजिष्णु: सजिष्णु स-जिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, accompanied by Arjuna.

P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to equip, make ready, prepare, array; to decorate, arm. —सज्जी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, arrayed; prepared; decorated, armed. —सज्जी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become equipped or accoutred or decorated; to be prepared or made ready. —सज्जी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, equipped; prepared, made ready; decorated. —सज्जी-भूय, ind. having become pre-pared or decorated, in full decoration.
सज्जन: 1. सज्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, fastening on clothes, dress-ing, preparing, putting on armour, arming; (अम्), n. the act of preparing or making ready; a guard, sentry, picket; a ferry, Ghāt; (आ), f. the act of dressing; dress, decoration, equipment, accoutre-ment, caparisoning an elephant, arming.
सज्जन 2. सज्-जन। See under सत्, p. 1052.
सज्जमान: सज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, dressing, making ready, preparing, arming; hesitating (in speech).
सज्जित: सज्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, dressed; decorated, orna-mented; made ready, equipped, accoutred, armed.
सज्य: सज्य स-ज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bow-string, strung (as a bow). —सज्य-सायक, अस्, आ, अम्, having arrows on the string (said of a bow).
सज्योतिस्: सज्योतिस् स-ज्योतिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, having the same light, having a common light; (इस्), n. the time during which the sun or the stars give light.
सज्योत्स्ना: स-ज्योत्स्ना, f. ‘having moonlight,’ scil. रात्रि, a moonlight night.
सञ्च्: सञ्च् सञ्च्, cl. 1. P. सञ्चति, &c. = rts. 1. सञ्ज्, 1. सज्ज्, to go, &c.
सञ्च: सञ्च सञ्च, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. सञ्-चय), a collection of leaves for writing, (according to Śab-da-k. पुस्तक-लेखनार्थ-पत्त्र-चय = साञ्च् in Bengālī.)
सञ्चकित: सञ्-चकित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly startled, trembling, fearful, afraid; [cf. प्र-चकित।]
सञ्चक: सञ्चक सञ्चक (?), a stamp; a disc.
सञ्चक्ष्: सञ्चक्ष् 1. सञ्-चक्ष् (सम्-च्°; cf. rt. ख्या), cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -चष्टुम्, to look at, observe, notice, consider, contemplate, survey, examine, re-flect upon; to enumerate; to report or relate fully; to avoid, shun.
2. सञ्-चक्ष्, f., Ved. appearance, sight, (Sāy. सञ्-चक्षि = सन्दर्शने सति, Ṛg-veda VI. 14, 4.)
सञ्चक्षाण: सञ्-चक्षाण, अस्, आ, अम्, beholding at the same time, observing, surveying, examining.
सञ्चक्ष्य: सञ्-चक्ष्य, ind. having observed, having re-flected on, &c.
सञ्चत्: सञ्चत् सञ्-चत्, त्, m. (in Uṇādi-s. II. 85. said to be fr. rt. 1. चि, the final of the rt. being dropped, and स् being generally inserted after सम्, see सञ्श्-चत्), cheating, deceit, juggling; a cheat.
सञ्चय: सञ्-चय, अस्, m. collection, gathering, heaping up, accumulation, construction, heap, hoard, store, multitude, number, quantity.
सञ्चर्: सञ्चर् सञ्-चर् (सम्-च्°; cf. सङ्-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to go or come toge-ther, meet, join; to go or walk about, move about, roam, wander, graze; to go through, pass through, pervade, roam through; to go towards, come to, arrive at, reach, attain; to go over to, pass over to, enter; to stay, remain, live in the practice of (with loc.); to practise (with acc.): Caus. -चारयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to come together, make to meet, bring into contact; to cause to go or put in motion, move, lead about; to cause to pass through; to cause to go towards, convey, deliver over to, transmit, communicate; to turn out to graze.
सञ्चर: सञ्-चर, अस्, m. [cf. सङ्-क्रम], going or passing through, passage, transit; a way, road, route, course, entrance, gate, doorway; difficult passage or progress, travelling by inaccessible routes, any narrow road or difficult pass, a defile, a bridge over a torrent, &c.; emanation, development (in phil.); the body; killing.
सञ्चरण: सञ्-चरण, अस्, ई, अम्, going together, meeting, converging; (अम्), n. the act of going together; passing through, travelling, going, motion, setting in motion, use.
सञ्चरत्: सञ्-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, walking or wandering about; passing through.
सञ्चरमाण: सञ्-चरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, going about, roaming; passing.

सञ्चारक: सञ्-चारक, अस्, इका, अम्, conveying, transmitting, communicating, leading; (अस्), m. a leader, guide, messenger; an instigator; an orator; (इका), f. a female messenger, go-between; a procuress; a pair, brace; odour, smell.
सञ्चारण: सञ्-चारण, अम्, n. the act of setting in motion, moving; impelling, instigating; conveying, leading, guiding, transmission.
सञ्चारित: सञ्-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to come together, made to meet, brought into contact; caused to go, set in motion, moved, impelled, driven, worked; led, conducted, conveyed, guided; transmitted, com-municated (as disease).

सञ्चार्य: सञ्-चार्य, ind. having caused to go or move, having conducted or conveyed or led.
सञ्चल्: सञ्चल् सञ्-चल् (सम्-च्°), cl. 1. सञ्चल: सञ्-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving about, trembling, quivering. —सञ्चल-नाडि, इस्, f. ‘quivering tube,’ an artery, vein, pulse.

सञ्चयित्वा: सञ्-चयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having collected or accumulated.
सञ्चयिन्: सञ्-चयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, who or what collects, col-lecting, accumulating, gathering.

सञ्चित्: सञ्चित् सञ्-चित् (सम्-च्°; see rt. 4. चित्), cl. 1. 3. P. -चेतति, -चिकेत्ति, -चेतितुम्, Ved. to observe together, survey, view, notice; to be of the same mind or opinion, agree together, be unanimous: Caus. -चेतयति, -यितुम्, to observe, be aware of, perceive.
सञ्चिकित्वस्: सञ्-चिकित्वस्, आन्, उषी, अत्, one who has observed, one who knows thoroughly.
सञ्चेतयमान: सञ्-चेतयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, observing, being aware of, perceiving.
सञ्चित्रा: सञ्चित्रा सञ्-चित्रा (सम्-च्°), f. the plant Salvinia Cucullata (= मूषा-कर्णी).
सञ्चिन्त्: सञ्चिन्त् सञ्-चिन्त् (सम्-च्°), cl. 10. P. -चिन्त-यति, -यितुम्, to think about, meditate on, think over, think of, reflect about (with acc.); to reflect, consider; to design, intend, destine.

सञ्चिन्तित: सञ्-चिन्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, thought about, delibe-rated, weighed; designed, intended (for an office); appointed.
सञ्चिन्तितवत्: सञ्चिन्तित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has reflected, &c.
सञ्चिन्त्य: सञ्-चिन्त्य, ind. having reflected or considered, being thoughtful, musing, pondering.
सञ्चीवरय: सञ्चीवरय सञ्-चीवरय, Nom. -चीवरयते, -यितुम्, to assume the dress of an ascetic.
सञ्चुद्: सञ्चुद् सञ्-चुद् (सम्-च्°), Caus. -चोदयति, -यितुम्, to impel, push on, incite, drive, shoot off; to excite, inflame, arouse, animate, instigate, further; to brandish, wield; to summon, challenge; to pro-cure quickly, assist to obtain (Ved.).
सञ्चोदित: सञ्-चोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, urged on, incited, driven; ordered, commanded.
सञ्चूर्णय: सञ्चूर्णय सञ्-चूर्णय (सम्-च्°), Nom. P. -चूर्णयति, -यितुम्, to grind to powder, commi-nute, pulverize.

सञ्छन्द्यमान: सञ्-छन्द्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being presented or offered.
सञ्छिद्: सञ्छिद् सञ्-छिद् (सम्-छ्°), cl. 7. P. सञ्छिन्न: सञ्-छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut to pieces, cut off; dissipated, removed.
सञ्ज्: सञ्ज् 1. सञ्ज् (= rts. सञ्च्, 1. सज्ज्), cl. 1. P. सञ्जति, &c., to go, move.

सञ्जर्भुराण: सञ्-जर्भुराण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens.), moving about rapidly; seizing, taking, (Sāy. = गृह्णत्, Ṛg-veda V. 44, 5.)
सञ्जल्प्: सञ्जल्प् सञ्-जल्प् (सम्-ज्°), cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -जल्पितुम्, to speak or talk together, converse, speak, chatter, chat.
सञ्जल्प: सञ्-जल्प, अस्, m. talking together, conversation; confused discourse, chattering, uproar, confusion.

सञ्जल्पमान: सञ्-जल्पमान, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking together, conversing.

सञ्जि: सञ्जि सञ्-जि (सम्-जि), cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जे-तुम्, to conquer together; to gain or acquire (by conquest &c.), conquer entirely; to obtain or acquire together, win.
सञ्जयत्: सञ्-जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, conquering, victorious.
सञ्जिगीवस्: सञ्-जिगीवस्, आन्, m., Ved. one who has com-pletely conquered, victorious.
सञ्जित्: सञ्-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. completely conquering, win-ning.
सञ्जित: सञ्-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely conquered, com-pletely overcome, vanquished.

सञ्जिजीवयिषु: सञ्-जिजीवयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to bring to life or enliven.
सञ्जीव: सञ्-जीव, अस्, आ, अम्, living together, living.
सञ्जीवक: सञ्-जीवक, अस्, इका, अम्, living together; animat-ing; (अस्), m., N. of a bull (in the Hitopadeśa).
सञ्जीवत्: सञ्-जीवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, living together, living.

सञ्जीवमान: सञ्-जीवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, coming to life, recover-ing, reviving.

सञ्ज्ञ: सञ्ज्ञ 1. सञ्-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, उम् (see 1. ज्ञ; cf. 1. प्र-ज्ञ), knock-kneed.

2. सञ्-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, named, called, designated (fr. the fem. सञ्-ज्ञा below, used at the end of adj. comps., cf. समास-स्°); being conscious; (आ), f. sense, consciousness, becoming aware of anything, knowledge, understanding, intellect, thought, mind, right mind; sign, token, symbol, gesture, gesticula-tion; name, appellation, title, designation, term; (in grammar) the name of anything thought of as standing by itself, any name or noun having a special meaning, (the expression सञ्ज्ञायाम् therefore de-notes the use of a word in some peculiar sense rather than in its strictly etymological meaning; for example, as a proper name; and a derived or com-pounded word can only be called Sañjñā when the idea it expresses is not clearly rendered by analysis); the technical name of any affix, &c. (e. g. the tech-nical expressions घ, घु); N. of the Gāyatrī or most sacred verse of the Veda, (see गायत्री); N. of a daughter of Viśva-karman and wife of the Sun; (अम्), n. a yellow fragrant wood, yellow sanders (= पीत-काष्ठ). —सञ्ज्ञा-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of an astronomical work by Nīla-kaṇṭha. —सञ्ज्ञाधि-कार (°ञा-अध्°), अस्, m. (in Pāṇini) a heading or presiding rule which gives a particular name to the rules which fall under it and influences them all. —सञ्ज्ञा-प्रकरण, अम्, n. explanation of the grammatical Sañjñās. —सञ्ज्ञार्थम् (°ञा-अर्°), ind. for a sign. —सञ्ज्ञा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having consciousness, become sensible, revived, recovered; having a name or denomination. —सञ्ज्ञा-विषय, अस्, m. ‘having a name for subject,’ an epithet, attributive. —सञ्ज्ञा-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Sañjñā,’ Saturn.
सञ्ज्ञु: सञ्-ज्ञु, उस्, उस्, उ, = संहात-जानु, knock-kneed.
सञ्ज्ञु सञ्-ज्ञु। See 1. सञ्-ज्ञ, p. 1051, col. 2.
सञ्ज्ञा: सञ्ज्ञा सञ्-ज्ञा (सम्-ज्°), cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to be of the same mind, agree together, come to a mutual understanding, live in harmony with (with inst. or acc., Pāṇ. II. 3, 22), understand one another (A.); to be conscious, be aware, know, understand, comprehend; to acknow-ledge, recognise, own (generally A.); to acknowledge or claim as one's own, take possession of (P.); to direct, appoint, assign, intend (for any purpose), destine (usually A.); to think of, recollect sorrow-fully (P., with acc. or gen., Pāṇ. 1. 3, 46, cf. Pāṇ. II. 3, 52); to watch for: Caus. -ज्ञपयति, -ज्ञा-पयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to be of one mind or agree together; to appease, gratify, console, satisfy; to cause to acquiesce or agree in, pacify, quiet (espe-cially any animal destined for sacrifice which ought not to be led forcibly but made to resign itself); to cause to be conscious, animate; to make intelligible, cause to be understood or known, cause to under-stand, apprise, cause to recognise; to make a sign to any one, to communicate or make anything known by signs; to command, enjoin, instruct.
सञ्-ज्ञा, f. See above under 2. सञ्-ज्ञ।

सञ्ज्ञप्त: सञ्-ज्ञप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, apprised; killed, suffocated, sacrificed.
सञ्ज्ञप्ति: सञ्-ज्ञप्ति, इस्, f. apprising, informing; killing, slaying.
सञ्ज्ञात: सञ्-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, known, understood, des-tined or intended for.
सञ्ज्ञान: सञ्-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowing, understanding, knowledge.
सञ्ज्ञापन: सञ्-ज्ञापन, अम्, n. apprising, informing; teach-ing; killing, slaughter.
सञ्ज्ञापित: सञ्-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, killed, suffocated (as a victim).
सञ्ज्ञाप्य: सञ्-ज्ञाप्य, ind. having made known by signs; having killed.
सञ्ज्ञित: सञ्ज्ञित, अस्, आ, अम्, named, called, designated, denominated, termed.

सती सती, सती-त्व। See p. 1053, col. 2.
सतीक: सतीक, अम्, n., Ved. water (= उदक, Naigh. I. 12).
सतीन: सतीन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. real, essential, mighty, powerful; (अस्), m. a bamboo; pease, pulse or a particular kind of it, (see सतील); (अम्), n., Ved. water (= उदक, Naigh. 1. 12; Sāy. सतीन = वृष्ट्य्-उदक, cf. सत्). —सतीन-कङ्कत, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of venomous aquatic animal. —स-तीन-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved., (Sāy.) eager to (shed) rain-water. —सतीन-सत्वन्, आ, m., Ved. ‘having real or mighty power,’ epithet of Indra; (Sāy.) a sender of water (= उदकस्य सादयितृ, गम-यितृ, Ṛg-veda I. 100, 1).
सतीनक: सतीनक, अस्, m. pease or pulse, (see above.)
सतील: सतील, अस्, m. a bamboo; air, wind; (अस्, आ), m. f. pease, pulse or a particular kind (called Teorā).
सत्य: सत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, true, real, genuine, sincere, honest, truthful, faithful, pure, virtuous, good, (सत्-यं कृ, to make true, make good, ratify, fulfil); fulfilled, realized; (अस्), m. the uppermost of the seven Lokas or worlds (the abode of Brahmā and heaven of truth, see लोक); the Aśvattha tree; epithet of Rāma-candra; of Viṣṇu; of a deity presiding over the Nāndī-mukha Śrāddha; N. of the author of the Horā-śāstra; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of deities; (आ), f. truth, sincerity, veracity; epithet of Sītā (wife of Rāma); of Satya-vatī (mother of Vyāsa); = सत्य-भामा, col. 3; N. of the goddess Durgā; (अम्), n. truth; sincerity, reality, goodness, the quality of goodness or purity, knowledge; demon-strated truth or conclusion, dogma; a solemn asseve-ration, promise, oath; water (= उदक, Naigh. 1. 12); the first of the four Yugas or ages (i. e. the best or golden age as the age of general virtue and purity, comprising 1,728,000 years of men; it is also called कृत, q. v.); (अम्), ind. truly, indeed, verily, necessarily, (Sāy. = अवश्यम्); yes; a par-ticle of asseveration and interrogation; [cf. Gr. ἐτεός.] —सत्य-कर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a king. —सत्य-काम, अस्, m. a lover of truth; a proper N. —सत्य-कारुण्य-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing truth and tenderness and the Veda. —सत्य-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a king. —सत्यङ्-कार, अस्, m. making true or good, ratification of a contract or bargain; something given in advance as an earnest or security for the performance of a contract, earnest-money, pledge. —सत्यङ्कार-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, given or deposited in order to ratify a bargain. —सत्य-जित्, त्, m. ‘truth-conqueror’ or ‘truly conquering,’ N. of a king. —सत्य-तपस्, आस्, m. ‘practising true penance,’ N. of a Muni (who was once a hunter, but after performing severe austerities obtained as a boon from Durvāsas that he should become a great sage and saint). —सत्य-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most true, quite true. —सत्य-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more true, very true. —सत्य-ता, f. or सत्य-त्व, अम्, n. trueness, truth, sincerity, veracity. —सत्य-दर्-शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, truth-seeing, foreseeing truth, truth-discerning. —सत्य-देव, अस्, आ, अम्, shining through truth. —सत्य-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, rich in truth, virtuous, sincere. —सत्य-धर्म, अस्, m. a proper N. —सत्य-धर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. practising the duty of truth; ruling by fixed ordinances. —सत्य-धर्म-परायण, अस्, आ, अम्, devoted to truth and virtue. —सत्य-धृत, अस्, m., N. of a son of Puṣpa-vat. —सत्य-धृति, इस्, इस्, इ, holding fast to truth, strictly truthful; (इस्), m., N. of a Ṛṣi (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 185; he has the patro-nymic Vāruṇi); of a son of Śatānanda; of several other persons. —सत्य-ध्वज, अस्, m. ‘truth-ban-nered,’ N. of a king. —सत्य-ध्वृत्, त्, त्, त्, destroy-ing or perverting truth. —सत्य-नामन्, आ, आ, अ, having a true name. —सत्य-नारायण, अस्, m., N. of a particular divinity (called सत्य-पीर् in Bengālī). —सत्य-नेत्र, अस्, m. ‘true-eyed,’ N. of a son of Atri. —सत्य-पराक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having real valour, truly brave. —सत्य-पुर, अम्, n. the world of Viṣṇu. —सत्य-पूत, अस्, आ, अम्, purified by truth (as a speech &c.). —सत्य-प्रतिज्ञ or सत्य-प्रतिश्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, true or faithful to a promise. —सत्य-प्रतिष्ठान, अस्, आ, अम्, having truth for a foundation, grounded in truth. —सत्य-फल, अस्, m. ‘having good fruit,’ the Vilva tree. —सत्य-बन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound by truth, adhering to the truth, truthful. —सत्य-भामा, f. ‘having true lustre,’ N. of the daughter of Satrā-jit and one of the eight wives of Kṛṣṇa, (she is described as having promoted the quarrels of the Yādavas.) —सत्य-भारत, अस्, m., N. of the poet Vyāsa. —सत्य-भेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, a truth-breaker, breaking a promise. —सत्य-मन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having or repeating true prayers, praying effectually. —सत्-यम्-उग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having very invigorating or exciting qualities, (Ṛg-veda IX. 113, 5.) —सत्य-यज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, sincerely worshipping, sacrificing in truth. —सत्य-यज्ञ, अस्, m., N. of a king. —सत्य-युग, अम्, n. the first of the four Yugas or ages. —सत्य-युगाद्या (°ग-आद्°), f. the third day of the light half of Vaiśākha (on which the commence-ment of the Kṛta-yuga is celebrated). —सत्य-यौ-वन, अस्, m., N. of a particular Vidyā-dhara. —सत्-य-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, devoted to truth, honest, sincere; (अस्), m., N. of a prince (son of Satya-vrata); epithet of Vyāsa. —सत्य-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a king of Vidarbha. —सत्य-रथि, इस्, m., N. of a king. —सत्य-राधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. one who grants real or true gifts. —सत्य-लोक, अस्, m., N. of one of the seven worlds, (see सत्य above.) —सत्य-वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a speaker of truth. —सत्य-वचन, अम्, n. truth-speaking, veracity, admitting the truth. —सत्यवचनार्थम् (°न-अर्°), ind. for the sake of speaking the truth. —सत्य-वचस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, truth-speaking, veracious; (आस्), m. a Ṛṣi, saint, seer; (अस्), n. veracity, truth. —सत्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing or practising truth, veracious, true; con-taining the word सत्य (said of a hymn); (आन्), m., N. of a king (husband of Sāvitrī); (अती), f., N. of the wife of Parāśara and mother of Vyāsa; of a daughter of Gādhi and wife of Ṛcīka (fabled to have become the Kauśikī river); N. of the wife of Nā-rada; epithet of Acchodā. —सत्यवती-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Satyavatī,’ epithet of the poet Vyāsa. —सत्य-वद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, true-speaking, veracious; (अम्), n. truth. —सत्य-वाक्य, अम्, n. true-speak-ing, veracity, truth. —सत्य-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, truth-speaking, veracious, sincere; (क्), m. a Ṛṣi, saint; N. of a son of Cākṣuṣa; a crow. —सत्यवादि-त्व, अम्, n. veracity, truthfulness. —सत्य-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking truth, veracious; (इनी), f., N. of a goddess. —सत्य-वाह, अस्, m., N. of a descendant of Bharad-vāja. —सत्य-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing real valour, truly valiant. —सत्य-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, practising truth, honest or upright in conduct. —सत्य-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, true to a vow or promise, adhering to truth, veracious, honest, sincere; (अस्), m., N. of a king, (the twenty-fifth of the solar dynasty in the second age); N. of Manu Vaivasvata; of the author of a Dharma-śāstra; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a race inhabiting Śāka-dvīpa. —सत्य-व्रत-परायण, अस्, आ, अम्, devoted to truth and religious observances. —सत्य-शवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having real strength, possessing true vigour, truly vigorous. —सत्य-श्रवस्, आस्, m., N. of the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda V. 79, 80 (having the patronymic Ātreya); of a teacher of the Ṛg-veda; of a son of Mārkaṇḍeya. —सत्य-श्रवसी, f., Ved. ‘possessed of real wealth or renown,’ epithet of Uṣas. —सत्य-श्रावण, अम्, n. the speaking or taking of an oath. —सत्य-श्री, ईस्, m., N. of a teacher of the Ṛg-veda. —सत्य-सङ्काश, अस्, आ, अम्, like the truth, likely, probable, plausible. —सत्य-सङ्गर, अस्, आ, अम्, true to an agreement or promise, veracious, faithful; (अस्), m., N. of Kuvera (god of wealth). —सत्य-सन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, true to an agreement or com-pact, faithful to an engagement; faithful, veracious; (अस्), m. epithet of Bharata (younger brother of Rāma); of Rāma-candra; of king Janam-ejaya; (आ), f. epithet of Draupadī (wife of the Pāṇḍu princes). —सत्य-सन्निभ, अस्, आ, अम्, like the truth, likely, probable, plausible. —सत्य-सव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. really generating; possessing true energy (epithet of Savitṛ); observing truth, (Sāy. = सत्या-नुज्ञ, Ṛg-veda V. 82, 7.) —सत्य-साक्षिन्, ई, m. a genuine or trustworthy witness. —सत्य-हित, अस्, m., N. of a teacher of the Ṛg-veda. —सत्या-कृति, इस्, f. ratification of a bargain. —सत्याग्नि (°य-अग्°), इस्, m., N. of the Muni Agastya. —सत्याङ्ग (°य-अङ्°), आस्, m. pl., N. of a mythical race inha-biting Plaksha-dvīpa. —सत्यात्मन् (°य-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, having a true soul, true-hearted, true; (आ), m. a virtuous and upright man. —सत्यानुरक्त (°य-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, attached to truth, upright, true. —सत्यानृत (°य-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, true and false, containing truth and falsehood; (अम्), n. practice of truth and falsehood, commerce, trade, traffic. —सत्याभिधान (°य-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, truth-speaking. —सत्याभिध्यायिन् (°य-अभ्°), ई, इनी, इ, truth-meditating, meditating upon truth. —सत्या-भिसन्ध or सत्याभिसन्धान, अस्, आ, अम्, or सत्याभिसन्धिन् (°य-अभ्°), ई, इनी, इ, faithful to a promise or agreement. —सत्योत्कर्ष (°य-उत्°), अस्, m. eminence or excellence in truth; true excel-lence. —सत्योदक (°य-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having truth for water, flowing with truth. —सत्योद्य (°य-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, speaking the truth. —सत्योपया-चन (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, true to a request, granting or fulfilling a prayer or petition.
सत्यक: सत्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, = सत्य, true, real, veracious, &c.; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Śini; (अम्), n. rati-fication (of a contract or bargain &c.).
सत्यापन: सत्यापन, अम्, आ, n. f. (fr. सत्यापय below), speaking or observing the truth; ratification (of a bargain &c.).
सत्यापय: सत्यापय, Nom. P. सत्यापयति, -यितुम्, to speak the truth; to ratify (a bargain or contract).
सत्वन्: सत्वन्, आ, m. (according to Sāy. to be connected in some senses with rts. सद्, सन्), Ved. = सत्-त्व, entity, existence, being; a living being; reality, power, strength; a strong or valiant man, hero, warrior, (Sāy. = शत्रूणं सादयितृ धनानां वा सनितृ, Ṛg-veda VI. 45, 22); (आनस्), m. pl. a class of spirits attendant on Parameśvara, (Sāy. = परमेश्वरस्य भूत-गणा अतिशयेन बल-पराक्रमाः, Ṛg-veda I. 64, 2.)
सत: सत सत, a kind of sacrificial vessel.
सतत: सतत स-तत, अस्, आ, अम् (= सन्-तत, see सन्-तन्), constant, lasting, incessant, perpetual, eternal, continual, uninterrupted; (अम्), n. incessantly, eternally, perpetually, uninterruptedly, continually, always. —सतत-ग, अस्, m. or सतत-गति, इस्, m. ‘continually moving,’ the wind. —सतत-ज्वर, अस्, m. a constant fever, one not intermitting. —स-तत-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, continually moving or going, always tending to decay, (Manu I. 50.)
सतत्त्व: सतत्त्व स-तत्त्व, अम्, n. natural property, nature; (अस्, आ, अम्), having or knowing the real truth; containing the words तद्, ‘this,’ and त्व, ‘thou.’
सतर्क: सतर्क स-तर्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having argument or reasoning, skilled in speculation; cautious, con-siderate.
सतर्ष: सतर्ष स-तर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, having thirst, thirsty; (अम्), ind. with thirst, thirstily.
सतल: सतल स-तल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bottom; [cf. अ-तल।]
सतलत्र: सतलत्र स-तलत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having leather guards (used in archery).
सतस्: सतस् सतस्, ind. (according to some fr. सत्; according to others fr. स = सह, सम; usually occurring at the beginning of comps.), = तिरस् (ac-cording to Naigh. III. 29; cf. Nirukta III. 20). —सतः-पङ्क्ति, इस्, f. a kind of metre consisting of two Pādas of eight syllables and two Pādas of twelve syllables. —सतो-बृहती, f. a kind of metre the even Pādas of which consist of eight syllables and the uneven of twelve. —सतो-महत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. truly great, greater than everything that exists, (Sāy. सतो-महान्तः = सर्वस्माद् विद्यमानात् पृथिव्याम् अपि ये महान्तस्, Ṛg-veda VIII. 30, 1.) —सतो-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. thoroughly brave or valiant, (Sāy. = प्राप्त-वीर्य, Ṛg-veda VI. 75, 9.)
सतानन्द: सतानन्द सतानन्द, अस्, m. (for शतानन्द, p. 990, col. 3), N. of the sage Gautama; of the son of Gautama.
सताह: सताह सताह, N. of a place.
सति: सति 1. सति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. सो; for 2. सति see under rt. सन्), end, destruction.
2. सति, इस्, f. (for 1. सति see s. v.), giving, a gift.
सतीर्थ: सतीर्थ स-तीर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, having sacred bathing-places; having the same bathing-place; (अस्), m. a pupil of the same spiritual preceptor, fellow religious student.
सतीर्थ्य: सतीर्थ्य, अस्, m. a fellow religious student, &c.
सतुष: सतुष स-तुष, अस्, आ, अम्, having husk or chaff; (अम्), n. grain with the husk remaining on it.
सतृणम्: सतृणम् स-तृणम्, ind. with grass, grass and all.
सतृष्: सतृष् स-तृष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, or स-तृष, अस्, आ, अम्, having thirst, thirsty, desirous, greedy, longing after, cupidinous.
सतृष्ण: स-तृष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, thirsty; (अम्), ind. with thirst, thirstily; with desire.
सतेर: सतेर सतेर, अस्, m. husk, chaff (= तुष).
सत्र्: सत्र् सत्र्, cl. 10. A. सत्रयते, सत्राप-यते, -यितुम्, to fulfil, accomplish; (ac-cording to others) to extend; to connect, fasten together.
सत्र: सत्र सत्र or सत्त्र। See under rt. 1. सद्।
सत्रप: सत्रप स-त्रप, अस्, आ, अम्, having shame or modesty, ashamed, modest.
सत्रा: सत्रा सत्रा, ind. (fr. स + त्रा; cf. 2. स-ध्रि), with, together with, (Sāy. = सह); all toge-ther, all at once; always, ever, continually, (Sāy. = सन्ततम्, सर्वदा); truly, (in Naigh. III. 10. सत्रा is enumerated among the सत्य-नामानि); great, many, abundant, (Sāy. = महत्, बहु, प्र-भूतम्।) —सत्रा-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. always conquer-ing; conqueror of the great; (त्), m., N. of a son of Nighna and father of Satya-bhāmā, (he was father-in-law of Kṛṣṇa and was killed by Śata-dhanvan); N. of Pratardana. —सत्राञ्च् (°रा-अञ्च्), आङ्, आची, आक् [cf. सध्र्य्-अञ्च्], going with, associated, united; perfect. —सत्रा-दावन्, आ, m., Ved. always granting, giving all at once, (Sāy. = सह प्रदातृ); epithet of Indra. —सत्रा-सह् or सत्रा-साह्, साट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. always overcoming or conquering; conquering the great; conquering many. —सत्रा-हन्, आ, m. always destroying, destroyer of mighty foes, (Sāy. = मह-तां शत्रूणाम् हन्तृ); epithet of Indra.
सत्रासम्: सत्रासम् स-त्रासम्, ind. with terror or fear, in a fright.
सत्रिजातक: सत्रिजातक स-त्रि-जातक, अम्, n. a kind of dish consisting of meat fried with three sorts of spices, (it is then soaked and dried and again dressed with ghee and condiments.)
सत्व: सत्व सत्व, अम्, n. See सत्-त्व under सत्।
सत्वच: सत्वच स-त्वच, अस्, आ, अम्, having skin or bark.
सत्वत्: सत्वत् सत्वत्, N. of a people inhabiting the south of India; [cf. सात्वत।]
सत्वर: सत्वर स-त्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, having haste or speed, expeditious, quick; (अम्), ind. quickly, swiftly, hastily, suddenly. —सत्वर-ता, f. or सत्वर-त्व, अम्, n. quickness, hastiness, speed.
सथूत्कार: सथूत्कार स-थूत्-कार, अस्, आ, अम्, accom-panied with the sound थूत् or the sound made in spitting or sputtering, sputtered; (अम्), n. sputtering (in speech), speech accompanied with sputtering; [cf. अम्बू-कृत।]
सद्: सद् 1. सद् [cf. rt. शद्], cl. 1. P. (or ac-cording to some cl. 6. P.) सीदति (ep. also A. -ते), ससाद (2nd sing. सेदिथ or ससत्थ, 3rd pl. सेदुस्), सत्स्यति, असदत् (Vedic forms, cl. 2. सत्सि, cl. 1. सदतु, सदताम्), सत्तुम् (Ved. Inf. सदे), to sink down, lie down, lie, recline; to sit, sit down, settle down, rest, settle; to be seated, reside, remain, live, be; to sink into despondency, be dejected or low-spirited; to become wearied, faint away, pine away; to sink into distress; to waste away, perish, decay, be destroyed; to be impeded; to go: Pass. सद्यते, Aor. असादि: Caus. सादयति, यितुम्, Aor. असीषदत्, to cause to sink or sit down, throw down, cast down, place down, place, put; to weary out, wear out, exhaust, harass, afflict; to cause to perish, destroy: Desid. सिषत्सति: Intens. सा-सद्यते, सासत्ति, to sit or lie down in an indecent posture; [cf. Gr. ὁδός, οὐδός, ἔδεθλον, ἕδ-ος, ἕζομαι, ἱδρόω: Lat. solum, sedeo, sido, probably also de-sidero, sella (for sed-la): Goth. sat, ‘to sit;’ satja, ‘to place;’ sinths, sitan, sitls: Old Germ. saz, ‘to sit;’ sezin, ‘to place;’ senal, satul: Angl. Sax. in-sidhian, on-settan, sittan, sadl, sadel: Lith. se†d-mi, ‘to place;’ sodiun, ‘to plant:’ Slav. sjadū, sad-i-ti: Hib. suidhim, suidhinghaim, ‘I set, I plant;’ saidhe, saidhiste, ‘a seat.’]
2. सद्, त्, त्, त्, one who sits or settles down, sitting, dwelling, residing (often at the end of comps., see नाक-स्°).
सत्त: सत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = सन्न, (नि-षत्त = नि-षण्ण, Ṛg-veda 1. 68, 4.)
सत्ति: सत्ति, इस्, f. sitting down, sitting; [cf. नि-षत्ति।]
सत्तृ: सत्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, sitting down, sitting; one who sits or resides.
सत्त्र: सत्त्र, अम्, n. a long sacrifice or sacrificial session (lasting, according to some, from 13 to 100 days); a sacrifice (in general); an oblation, offering, gift; giving alms or charity, liberality, munificence; wealth; a residence, house; a place of refuge, asylum, hiding-place, covert; covering, clothing, concealing; fraud, roguery, cheating; a wood, forest; a tank, pond. —सत्त्र-परिवेषण, अम्, n. a distribution of food or other gifts at a sacrifice. —सत्त्र-वर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, increasing or promoting sacrifice. —सत्-त्र-शाला, f. a large hall or room where food and alms are given away to Brāhmans or mendicants, &c., an alms-house. —सत्त्रापश्रय (°र-अप्°), अस्, m. a place of refuge, asylum. —सत्त्रायण (°र-अय्°), अम्, n. a long course of sacrifices.
सत्त्राय: सत्त्राय, Nom. A. सत्त्रायते, &c., to perform a sacrifice.
सत्त्रि: सत्त्रि, इस्, इस्, इ, conquering, a conqueror; (इस्), m. a cloud; an elephant; [cf. शद्रि।]
सत्त्रिन्: सत्त्रिन्, ई, m. a liberal householder who constantly performs sacrifices and distributes gifts or alms; a priest superintending or performing a sacrifice; an ambassador or agent residing in a foreign country.
सत्त्वा: सत्त्वा, ind. having sunk down, sitting, resting, &c.
सद: सद, अस्, m. [cf. शद], the fruit of trees; N. of one of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra's sons.
सदन: सदन, अम्, n. sinking or settling down, sitting, a seat; a dwelling, residence, house, palace; the abode of sacrifice, sacrificial hall; the abode of Yama; perishing, decaying; exhaustion; water (= उदक, Naigh. 1. 12). —सदना-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting on a seat.
सदन्य: सदन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of or belonging to a house, &c.
सदस्: सदस्, अस्, n. a seat, residence, abode, dwelling; an assembly, meeting, (also आस्, f. according to some, and आस्, m. according to others; सदसः पतिः, ‘lord of the assembly,’ epithet of Agni); (असी), n. du, Ved. heaven and earth (= द्यावा-पृथिवी, Naigh. III. 30); [cf. Gr. ἕδος.] —सदस्-पती, m. du., Ved. ‘lords of the assembly,’ epithet of Indra and Agni. —सदो-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone to the assembly, being in the assembly. —सदो-गृह, अम्, n. ‘assembly-house,’ the court of a prince.
सदस्य: सदस्य, अस्, m. any person present at or belong-ing to an assembly, an assessor, spectator, member of an assembly, councillor; any one present or assist-ing at a sacrifice, a superintending priest or Ṛtvij, (his duties, according to the Kauṣītakins, are to superintend the whole sacrifice and correct mistakes; cf. विधि-दर्शिन्।)
सद्मन्: सद्मन्, आ, m. an abode, dwelling (Ved.); (अ), n. a seat; a house, dwelling, palace; a temple; an altar; a place, station; conflict, (in Naigh. II. 17. enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि); water (= उदक, Naigh. I. 12); (अनी), n. du., Ved. heaven and earth (= द्यावा-पृथिवी, Naigh. III. 30); (आ, आ, अ), Ved. sitting, seated, (in Ṛg-veda I. 173, 1. according to Sāy. सद्मानम् = सीदन्तम्।) —सद्-म-चिति, इस्, f. a collection of houses. —सद्म-बर्-हिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, Ved. having sacred grass for its abode or place of sprinkling. —सद्म-मखस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. (according to Sāy. मखस् = महस्), hav-ing light for a seat or abode, radiant, (Sāy. = प्राप्त-तेजस्क, Ṛg-veda 1. 18, 9.)
सद्रु: सद्रु, उस्, उस्, उ [cf. शद्रु], resting, staying; going, moving; [cf. probably Gr. ἱδρυ in ἱδρύνω..]
सन्न: सन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sunk down; lying down; seated, resting; settled down; still, motionless; sunk, low (in tone, accent, &c.); depressed, low (in spirits), desponding, dispirited, spiritless, weak, feeble, diminished; wasted away, exhausted, decayed, perished, destroyed, spoiled, lost; stunted, shrunk, contracted; oppressed; lying near, adjacent; gone, departed; (अस्), m. the Piyāla tree; (अम्), n. little, a small quantity. —सन्न-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a contracted throat, having a feeble or broken utter-ance, with a choking voice, scarcely able to articulate, choking, choked. —सन्न-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more depressed, very weak or feeble; (in grammar) lower (in tone or accent), more depressed than the ordinary accentless tone (= अनुदात्त-तर). —सन्-न-मुसल, अम्, n. a motionless pestle; (ए), ind. at the time when the pestle lies motionless, (Manu VI. 56.) —सन्न-हर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose joy has departed, depressed in spirits, desponding.
सन्न सन्न, सन्नक। See under rt. 1. सद्।
सन्नक: सन्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, low, dwarfish; (अस्), m. the Piyāla tree. —सन्नक-द्रु, उस्, m. the Piyāla tree.
साद: साद, अस्, m. sinking or settling down, sinking, exhaustion, weariness, lassitude; perishing, decay; suffering, pain; purity, clearness, cleanness [cf. प्र-सन्न, प्र-साद]; going, motion.

सादक: सादक, अस्, इका, अम्, exhausting, wearying, de-stroying.
सादत्: सादत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. sitting down (= सीदत्)। —सादद्-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. sitting in the interior, sitting on the hearth.
सादन: सादन, अम्, n. causing to sink, wearying, ex-hausting; destroying, dispelling; sinking, sitting, settling; a seat, house, dwelling, palace; (ई), f. the plant Helleborus Niger; exhaustion, decay. —सा-दन-स्पृश् = गृहादि-प्रद, Ṛg-veda IX. 72, 8.
सादन्य: सादन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = सदन्य, belonging to a house, &c., skilful in domestic affairs, (Sāy. = गृह-कार्य-कुशल, Ṛg-veda I. 91, 20.)
सादयत्: सादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to sink down, wearying, wearing out, exhausting; destroying; expelling, removing; extracting.
सादयितव्य: सादयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be destroyed, de-structible.
सादयित्वा: सादयित्वा, ind. having caused to sink or sit down; having put or placed down; having destroyed; hav-ing removed.
सादयिष्यत्: सादयिष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, about to destroy.
सादि: सादि, इस्, m. a charioteer; a warrior; a dispirited or melancholy person; air, wind.

सादित: सादित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), made to sink down, depressed, exhausted, harassed; dispirited, wearied, distressed; wasted, decayed; destroyed, ex-terminated; broken; made to go, drawn, dragged.
सादिन्: सादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sitting down, settling down; (fr. the Caus.) exhausting, wearying, destroying; (ई), m. a horseman, cavalier; any one seated or riding on an elephant; any one seated or mounted on a car or chariot; a charioteer.
सासद्यमान: सासद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting or lying down in an indecent posture.
सीदत्: सीदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sinking, desponding, pining, grieving, sorrowing; decaying, perishing; distressed, pained; going.

सीदमान: सीदमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sinking down, &c.
सेदिवस्: सेदिवस्, वान्, -दुषी, वत्, one who has sat down or sunk down.
सदंशक: सदंशक स-दंशक, अस्, आ, अम्, having teeth; having a sharp sting; (अस्), m. ‘having nippers,’ a crab.
सदंशवदन: स-दंश-वदन, अस्, m. ‘having a face with a sharp bill,’ a heron.
सदक्षिण: सदक्षिण स-दक्षिण, अस्, आ, अम्, having presents, accompanied by gifts.

(fr. 5. स + दा), always, at all times, continually, perpetually, ever. —सदा-कल-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing at all seasons, (opposed to प्रावृट्-काल-वह). —सदा-कान्ता, f., N. of a river; [cf. सदा-नीरा।] —सदा-गति, इस्, m. ‘ever-going,’ air, wind; the Universal Spirit; the sun; everlasting happiness, final emancipation. —सदा-तोया, f. ‘always (wanting) water,’ the plant Mimosa Octandra; the Karatoyā river (= सदा-नीरा). —१। स-दा-दान, अम्, n. ‘always giving,’ liberality, munifi-cence. —२। सदा-दान, अस्, m. सदृक्ष: स-दृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, like, resembling, similar.
सदृश: स-दृश, अस्, ई, अम्, like, resembling, same, similar, of the same rank; conformable, fit, proper, right, suitable; worthy. —सदृश-ता, f. or सदृश-त्व, अम्, n. likeness, similarity, sameness. —सदृश-स्पन्दन, अम्, n. any regular or even throbbing motion (= नि-स्पन्द).

(fr. 4. स + द्यस् for दि-वस्, fr. 3. दिव्, q. v.), to-day, this very day, now, instantly, at the moment, in an instant, momenta-rily; presently, forthwith, immediately, on a sudden; quickly, promptly; recently. —सद्य-ऊति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. quickly aiding or assisting; quickly going, (Sāy. = सद्यो-गमन।) —सद्यः-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done at the moment, done promptly or quickly; (अम्), n. a name, appellation. —सद्यः-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, quickly falling or dropping, frail. —सद्यः-प्रक्षा-लक, अस्, m. one who cleans corn immediately for use (without storing it). —सद्यः-प्राणकर, अस्, ई, अम्, quickly inspiriting or invigorating. —सद्यः-प्राणहर, अस्, आ, अम्, quickly destroying vigour, debilitating. —सद्यः-शुद्धि, इस्, f. = सद्यः-शौच. —सद्यः-शोथा, f. ‘quickly swelling,’ cowach, Carpopogon Pruriens. —सद्यः-शौच, अम्, n. present or immediate purity or purification. —सद्यस्-काल, अस्, m. present time. —सद्यस्-कालीन, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the present time, recent, modern, new. —सद्यस्-तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, just heated. —सद्यो-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. quickly going, swift-moving. —सद्यो-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, newly born, born in a moment; (अस्), m. a calf; epithet of Śiva. —सद्यो-भाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, existing or becoming born in a moment, newly born; (ई), m. a calf.
