सधिस्: सधिस् सधिस्, इस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 114. fr. rt. 1. सह्), an ox, bull.
सधूम्र: सधूम्र स-धूम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, dusky, dark.
सधे: सधे स-धे, a various reading for स्वधे, enumerated among the द्यावा-पृथिवी-नामधे-यानि in Naigh. III. 30.
सधैर्यम्: सधैर्यम् स-धैर्यम्, ind. with firmness, with gravity; firmly, gravely.
सध्रि: सध्रि 1. सध्रि, इस्, m., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 114 (having the patro-nymic Vairūpa).
सध्रि 2. सध्रि [cf. स-त्रा], a form sub-stituted for 2. सह, with, together with, (Pāṇ. VI. 3, 95.)
सध्री: सध्री, scil. नद्यः, Ved. the rivers going or flow-ing together, (Sāy. = सध्रीचीनाः, Ṛg-veda II. 13, 2, the अञ्च् of सध्र्य्-अञ्च् being dropped.)
सध्रीचीन: सध्रीचीन, अस्, आ, अम्, going or coming with, accompanying, associated; [cf. प्रतीचीन।]
सध्र्यञ्च्: सध्र्य्-अञ्च्, अङ्, -रीची, अक् [cf. सत्राञ्च्], going with, accompanying, associated; a companion; (ईची), f. a woman's companion or female friend, a confi-dante; (अक्), ind. together with.
सध्वंस: सध्वंस स-ध्वंस, अस्, m., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 8 (having the patro-nymic Kāṇva).
सध्वज: सध्वज स-ध्वज, अस्, आ, अम्, having a banner, bannered, with a flag.
सन्: सन् 1. सन्, cl. 1. P., 8. P. A. सनति, सनोति, सनुते (Ved. सनिष्णत = सम्-भजन्ते, Ṛg-veda 1. 131, 5), ससान, सनितुम्, to love, like, worship, honour; to obtain through love or worship, obtain, acquire, gain; to receive graciously; to honour with gifts, give, bestow, dis-pense, distribute: Pass. सन्यते or सायते (Pāṇ. VI. 4, 43), to be loved, &c.: Caus. सानयति, -यितुम्, Aor. असीषणत्: Desid. सिसनिषति, सिषासति, to be eager to worship or honour; to wish to obtain, desire, strive for; to wish to bestow or give: Intens. संसन्यते, सासायते, संसन्ति।
सन् 2. सन्, (in grammar) a technical term for the syllable स or sign of the desiderative.
सन: 1. सन, अस्, m. the flapping of an elephant's ears; the plant Ghaṇṭā-pāṭali; the tree Pentaptera To-mentosa; (अम्), n., Ved. food, (Sāy. सनानि = अन्-नानि, Ṛg-veda I. 95, 10.) —सन-पर्णी, f. the plant Marsilea Quadrifolia, (also written असन-पर्णी।)

सन 2. सन, a Vedic word meaning ‘old,’ ‘ancient,’ occurring in the form सना, neut. pl. = सनानि = सनातनानि, सदातनानि, Ṛg-veda III. 1, 20, 1. 174, 8; see also सना, सनात्, &c.; (अस्), m., N. of one of the seven sons of Brahmā; [cf. Lat. senex; Goth. sins, sineigs.] —सन-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, or सन-जा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. born or pro-duced of old, ancient. —सन-वित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. long since obtained. —सन-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. famous of old; always celebrated; (अस्), m. a proper N.
सनत्: 1. सनत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. bestowing, granting. —सनत्-कुमार, see under 2. सनत्. —सनद्-रयि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. granting wealth. —सनद्-वाज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. granting food.

2. सनत्, त्, m. (according to some properly neut. of 2. सन above), N. of Brahmā; (त्), ind. always, ever, perpetually. —सनत्-कुमार, अस्, m. ‘son of Brahmā,’ or, according to some, ‘always a youth,’ N. of one of the four sons of Brahmā and oldest of the progenitors of mankind (= वैधात्र; other lists give seven sons); N. of one of the twelve Sār-vabhaumas or emperors of India according to the Jainas; N. for any sanctified person who retains throughout life the purity of youth. —सनत्कु-मार-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work. —स-नत्कुमार-संहिता, f., N. of a part of the Skanda-Purāṇa; of a Tantra work (regarded as one of the Śubhāgamas). —सनत्कुमरीय, N. of a Tantra work. —सनत्कुमारोपपुराण (°र-उप्°), अम्, n., N. of an Upa-Purāṇa. —सनत्-सुजात, अस्, m., N. of the second of the seven mind-born sons of Brahmā. —सनत्सुजातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to Sanat-sujāta.
सनस्: 1. सनस्, अस्, n. (doubtful), excrement, ordure; Śiva's trident (?); crystal (?).
2. सनस् = 2. सन, p. 1056. —सनो-जा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. = सन-ज, q. v.
सनि: सनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. giving, a giver, (Sāy. सनि = धनस्य दातृ; cf. सहस्र-स्°); (इस्), m., Ved. obtaining, acquisition, pursuit; giving, dona-tion; service, worship; (इस्), m. f. request, solicitation, respectful entreaty (addressed to a spiritual preceptor, &c.); quarter, region, point of the compass.
सनित: सनित, अस्, आ, अम्, granted; gained, obtained.
सनितृ: सनितृ, ता, m., Ved. one who grants anything (with acc. or gen.; Sāy. = सम्भजन-शील); a benefactor; a husband, (Sāy. = भर्तृ, Ṛg-veda III. 31, 2; see Nirukta III. 6.)
सनित्र: सनित्र, अम्, n., Ved. an instrument or means of honouring, (Ṛg-veda IX. 97, 29.)
सनित्व: सनित्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be honoured or loved, (Sāy. = सम्भजनीय, Ṛg-veda VIII. 81, 8.)
सनिष्ठ: सनिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most liberal or boun-tiful, very munificent.
सनिष्य: सनिष्य, Nom. P. सनिष्यति, Ved. to wish to give; to wish for or desire gifts.
सनिष्यत्: सनिष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desiring to bestow; wishing for riches, desirous of wealth, (Sāy. = धनम् इच्छत् or लप्स्यमान, Ṛg-veda VII. 100, 1.)
सनिष्यु: सनिष्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. wishing to give, de-sirous of giving; desirous to honour.
सनी: सनी, f. a respectful request (= सनि above); a quarter or point of the compass; the flapping of an elephant's ears (= 1. सन); light, lustre; epithet of Gaurī.
सनुत्री: सनुत्री, f. (probably fem. of a form सनुतृ), Ved. a giver or dispenser (of light to the whole world), epithet of Uṣas, (Sāy. सनुत्री = सर्वं जगत् सम्भजन्ती or दात्री प्रकाशस्य, Ṛg-veda 1. 123, 2.)
सनेरु: सनेरु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. honouring, worshipping, &c., (Sāy. = सम्भक्तृ।)
सन्ति: 1. सन्ति, इस्, f. (for 2. सन्ति see s. v.), giving, a gift.
सन्ति 2. सन्ति, इस्, f. (probably connected with rt. सो; for 1. सन्ति see under rt. 1. सन्), end, destruction; [cf. 1. सति, 2. साति।]
सन्त्य: सन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be honoured or wor-shipped, adorable; to be possessed, (Sāy. = भजन-शील, सम्भजनीय); giving, a giver, a giver of rewards, (Sāy. = फलस्य दातृ, Ṛg-veda 1. 45, 9); (अस्), m. epithet of Agni.
सन्यस्: सन्यस्, apparently only used in dat. c. सन्यसे = सम्भजनाय, ‘for the honouring,’ (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 31, 19. fr. rts. 1. सन् and यस्, perhaps a kind of Ved. Inf.)
सिषासत्: सिषासत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desirous of giving, eager to bestow benefits, (Sāy. = सम्भक्तुम् इच्-छत्, Ṛg-veda I. 123, 4.)
सिषासत् सिषासत्। See rt. 1. सन्, p. 1056.
सनक: सनक, अस्, m., N. of one of the four sons of Brahmā (described as one of the councillors or com-panions of Viṣṇu and as inhabiting the Janar-loka; some accounts assign to Brahmā seven mind-born sons); N. of an inspired legislator; (आस्), m. pl., Ved. epithet of the Asuras (represented in the Ṛg-veda as slain by Indra). —सनक-संहिता, f., N. of a Tantra work, (one of the Śubhāgamas.)
सनय: सनय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. old, ancient (= पु-राण, Nirukta IV. 19).
सना: सना, ind. (properly an old inst. fr. 2. सन, p. 1056), always, eternally, perpetually; [cf. Angl. Sax. sin, especially at the beginning of comps.; Old Germ. sin; Goth. sin in sin-teins.]
सनात्: सनात्, ind. (properly abl. fr. 2. सन), Ved. ‘from ancient times,’ of old, always, eternally, per-petually, ever, (न सनात्, never.)
सनातन: सनातन, अस्, ई, अम्, eternal, continual, perpetual; firm, fixed, permanent; primeval, ancient; (अस्), m. epithet of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; of Brahmā; of one of Brahmā's sons; of one of Rudra's sons; of a teacher of the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa; a guest of the Manes, one who must always be fed whenever he attends Śrāddhas or obsequial ceremonies; (ई), f., N. of the goddess Lakṣmī; of Durgā; of Sarasvatī; [cf. Goth. sinteins, sinteino.] —सनातन-तम, अस्, m. ‘the most eternal, most ancient,’ epithet of Viṣṇu. —सनातन-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of an author of a commentary on the Megha-dūta.
सनाय: सनाय, Nom. A. सनायते, Ved. to act like an immortal being, be eternal.
सनग: सनग सनग, अस्, m., N. of a teacher of the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa.
सनन्द: सनन्द स-नन्द, अस्, m. ‘joy-possessing,’ N. of one of the four sons of Brahmā (inhabiting Janar-loka; see लोक); one of the sons of Rudra.
सनन्दन: स-नन्दन, अस्, m., N. of one of the mind-engendered sons of Brahmā (said to have preceded Kapila in teaching the Sāṅkhya phil.); of a pupil of Śaṅkarācārya and author of the Pañca-pādikā; of a commentator. —सनन्दन-संहिता, f., N. of a Tantra work, (one of the Śubhāgamas.)
सनरद्विप: सनरद्विप स-नर-द्विप, अस्, आ, अम्, accom-panied by men and elephants.
सनलदानलद: सनलदानलद स-नलदानल-द (°द-अन्°, cf. 3. द), अस्, आ, अम्, having the Nalada (i. e. An-dropogon Muricatus or Uśīra plant) and appeasing heat, (Kirāt. V. 25.)
सनसूत्र: सनसूत्र सन-सूत्र, अम्, n. (= शण-सूत्र), hempen cord or string, packthread; a net made of hemp.
सनाकवनित: सनाकवनित स-नाक-वनित, अस्, आ, अम्, having celestial women or Apsarases.
सनाथ: सनाथ स-नाथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a master or protector; having a lord or husband; occupied by, possessed by; endowed with, possessed of, pos-sessing, having; (आ), f. a woman whose husband is living. —सनाथ-ता, f. the state of having a pro-tector or husband. —सनाथी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make to possess a master or protector.
सनाभि: सनाभि स-नाभि, इस्, इस्, इ, connected by the same navel or womb, uterine, nearly related, kindred; like, resembling; affectionate; having even or evenly formed naves (Ved.); (इस्), m. a near kinsman, uterine brother, one of the same family name; a relation or kinsman as far as the seventh degree (= स-पिण्ड, q. v.); (अयस्), f. pl. ‘the sisters,’ epithet of the fingers, (enumerated among the अङ्गुलि-नामानि in Naigh. II. 5.)
सनाभ्य: स-नाभ्य, अस्, m. a relation as far as the seventh degree.
सनामक: सनामक स-नामक, अस्, इका, अम्, having the same name; (अस्), m. the tree Hyperanthera Moringa.
सनामन्: स-नामन्, आ, आ, or -म्नी, अ, having the same name.
सनारु: सनारु सनारु, उस्, m., N. of a teacher of the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa.
सनिःश्वासम्: सनिःश्वासम् स-निःश्वासम्, ind. with a sigh.
सनियम: सनियम स-नियम, अस्, आ, अम्, performing or observing religious ceremonies, engaged in religious observances.
सनिर्घात: सनिर्घात स-निर्घात, अस्, आ, अम्, accom-panied by a hurricane or whirlwind.
सनिर्घृण: सनिर्घृण स-निर्घृण, अस्, आ, अम्, merciless, cruel.
सनिर्वेदम्: सनिर्वेदम् स-निर्वेदम्, ind. in a modest manner, with humility, humbly; despairingly; with indifference.
सनिष्ठीव: सनिष्ठीव स-निष्ठीव, अम्, n. sputtered speech, speech accompanied with sputtering or emis-sion of saliva.
सनीड: सनीड स-नीड, अस्, आ, अम्, having a nest or abode; having or occupying the same nest or abode, dwelling together; near, proximate.
सनीळ: स-नीऌअ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = स-नीड above.
सनीय: सनीय सनीय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
सनुतर्: सनुतर् सनुतर्, ind. (thought by some to be fr. सानु + तः), Ved. from behind, behind the back, in concealment, secretly, clandestinely, (enume-rated in Naigh. III. 25. among the निर्णीतान्तर्-हित-नामधेयानि); far away, far off.
सनुत्य: सनुत्य, अस्, m., Ved. one who lies in ambush (as a thief; Sāy. अन्तर्हिते देशे भवश् चोरः).
सनेमि: सनेमि स-नेमि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. ‘having the halves,’ complete, entire, whole, (see नेम); having equal or even fellies, i. e. revolving with even motion, (Sāy. समान-नेम्य् एकप्रकार-वहिर्-वलयम् अक्षीण-नेमि, Ṛg-veda I. 164, 14); (इ), ind. wholly, entirely; enumerated among the पुराण-नामानि in Naigh. III. 27; = क्षिप्रम्, (Nirukta XII. 44.)
सनोजा: सनोजा सनो-जा। See under 2. सनस्, col. 1.
सन्त: सन्त सन्त, अस्, m. the two hands opened and the palms joined (= संहत-तल).
सन्तक्ष्: सन्तक्ष् सन्-तक्ष् (सम्-त्°), cl. 1. P. -तक्-षति, -तक्षितुम्, -तष्टुम्, to cut out, form, fashion by cutting; to construct, compose (hymns &c., Ved.); to cut through, cut to pieces, wound; to hurt by words.
सन्तक्षण: सन्-तक्षण, अम्, n. cutting language, sarcasm, scoff, reproach.
सन्तष्ट: सन्-तष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, cut out, formed, cut through, &c.
सन्तड्: सन्तड् सन्-तड् (सम्-त्°), cl. 10. P. -ताड-यति, -यितुम्, to strike effectually, strike or hit hard, hit (with an arrow &c.); to beat or play a musical instrument.
सन्ताड्य: सन्-ताड्य, ind. having struck or hit.
सन्तन्: सन्तन् सन्-तन् (सम्-त्°), cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -तनुते, -तनितुम्, to stretch or extend along, stretch over, cover with, cover over; to join or connect together, make continuous; to effect, accom-plish; to exhibit, display, evince; to be connected or combined with (Ved.); Caus. -तानयति, -यितुम्, to cause to extend, cause to accomplish, cause to be finished.
सन्तत: सन्-तत, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. स-तत], stretched along, extended along, stretched or spread over, covered over, connected together, sewn or woven together, extended; continued, continuous, uninter-rupted, regular, continual, lasting, eternal; much, many; (अम्), ind. constantly, continually, eternally, always. —सन्तत-ज्वर, अस्, m. continuous fever. —सन्तत-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raining continuously. —सन्तत-वेपथु, उस्, उस्, उ, trembling all over. —सन्ततापद् (°त-आप्°), त्, त्, त्, one whose mis-fortunes are continuous. —सन्तताभ्यास (°त-अभ्°), अस्, m. habitual practice, regular study or repetition (of the Vedas &c.).
सन्तति: सन्-तति, इस्, f. stretching or extending along, stretching or spreading over, extent, expanse, con-tinuity; a continuous line, row, range; uninterrupted succession, descent; lineage, race, progeny, offspring; a son; a daughter; a number of people, multitude; (इस्), m., N. of a son of Alarka.
सन्ततेयु: सन्ततेयु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Raudrāśva.
सन्तनि: सन्-तनि, इस्, m., Ved. extension; continuous stream.
सन्तन्वत्: सन्-तन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, extending along, covering over, covering with.
सन्तान: सन्-तान, अस्, अम्, m. n. extending, extension, expansion, spreading; the being spread or increased, continuance, continuous succession, lineage, race, family; progeny, offspring; a son or daughter; one of the five trees of Indra's paradise. —सन्तान-सन्धि, इस्, m. peace cemented by family alliance (by giving a daughter in marriage, &c.).
सन्तानक: सन्तानक, अस्, इका, अम्, stretching, spreading, who or what spreads; (अस्), m. one of the trees of Indra's heaven, the Kalpa tree or its flower; (इका), f. froth, foam; cream, coagulated milk, custard; a cob-web; the blade of a knife or sword. —सन्तानका-कीर्ण (°क-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, strewn with celestial flowers, &c. (from the Kalpa tree).
सन्तप्: सन्तप् सन्-तप् (सम्-तप्), cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्, to heat thoroughly, make red hot, cause to glow, inflame; to scorch, parch, dry up; to pain by heat, torture: Pass. -तप्यते (ep. P. -ति), to be well heated, to become hot, suffer great pain or torment; to undergo penance; to be penitent, repent: Caus. -तापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be heated, to make very hot, heat, scorch, burn, inflame, set on fire; to foment; to burn up, consume; to pain by heat, torment, torture, distress, harass; (with आत्मानम्) to torture or torment one's self, harass the body by penance: Pass. of Caus. -ताप्यते, to be made very hot, &c.
सन्तपन: सन्-तपन, अम्, n. the act of inflaming or tor-menting.
सन्तप्त: सन्-तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly heated or inflamed, red hot, glowing; melted, burnt up, scorched, dried up, inflamed with passion, &c.; suffering great pain or anguish, tormented, distressed, afflicted, wearied, fatigued. —सन्तप्त-चामीकर, अम्, n. glowing or molten gold. —सन्तप्त-रजत, अम्, n. molten silver. —सन्तप्त-वक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, oppressed in the chest or breathing, short-breathed. —सन्-तप्त-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, feeling great anguish of heart. —सन्तप्तायस् (°त-अय्°), अस्, n. heated iron, red hot iron.
सन्तप्यमान: सन्-तप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being inflamed, being tormented or distressed. —सन्तप्यमान-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one whose mind is in a state of torture.
सन्ताप: सन्-ताप, अस्, m. great heat, burning heat; in-flammation, fire; affliction, pain, anguish, distress; passion; remorse, resentment, penance, penitence, repentance. —सन्ताप-हर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, re-moving heat, cooling; consolatory, consoling.
सन्तापन: सन्-तापन, अस्, ई, अम्, burning up, scorching, inflaming; (अम्), n. the act of burning, scorching; paining, affliction; exciting passion; (अस्), m., N. of one of the arrows of Kāma-deva.
सन्तापयित्वा: सन्-तापयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having burnt up or inflamed.
सन्तापित: सन्-तापित, अस्, आ, अम्, made very hot, burnt up, scorched; inflamed, consumed; tormented, pained, harassed, distressed, afflicted, wearied.
सन्ताप्य: सन्-ताप्य, ind. having caused to be heated.

सन्तृण्ण: सन्-तृण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. connected or fastened together.

सन्तारित: सन्-तारित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to pass over, saved, rescued, delivered.
सन्तीर्ण: सन्-तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, crossed, passed through; rescued, saved.

सन्त्वरयत्: सन्-त्वरयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to hurry, hastening, urging on.
सन्त्वरित: सन्-त्वरित, अस्, आ, अम्, hurried, hastening; (अम्), ind. in a hurry, in great haste, quickly.

सन्दा 3. सन्-दा (सम्-दा, see rt. 4. दा), cl. 4. P. -द्यति, -दातुम्, Ved. to bind together, fasten together, tie.

सन्दानित: सन्दानित, अस्, आ, अम्, bound together, tied.

सन्दी: सन्दी 1. सन्-दी (सम्-दी, see rt. 2. दी), cl. 3. P. (Ved. Impv. 2nd sing. -दीदिहि or -दिदीहि), to shine together; to make very bright or manifest, (Sāy. = सम्यक् प्रकाशयति।)
सन्दी 2. सन्-दी f. (perhaps connected with 3. सन्-दा), a small bedstead or cot (= खट्टा).
सन्दीक्ष्: सन्दीक्ष् सन्-दीक्ष् (सम्-द्°), cl. 1. A. -दीक्-षते, -दीक्षितुम्, to consecrate one's self together or along with, be initiated with others.
सन्दीक्षित: सन्-दीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, consecrated together, initiated along with others.
सन्दीप्: सन्दीप् सन्-दीप् (सम्-दीप्), cl. 4. A. (ep. also P.) -दीप्यते (-ति), -दीपितुम्, to blaze up, flame; burn or shine very brightly, glow: Caus. -दीपयति, -यितुम्, to set on fire, light up, kindle, inflame, illumine; to inflame with anger; to fire, animate, excite, inspirit, encourage.
सन्दीपन: सन्-दीपन, अस्, ई, अम्, lighting up, kindling, inflaming, inspiriting, encouraging, (कामाग्नि-स्°, kindling the fire of love, exciting sexual desire); (अम्), n. the act of lighting up, inflaming, inflam-mation, kindling (of wrath &c.), encouragement; (अस्), m., N. of one of the arrows of Kāma-deva (god of love).
सन्दीपित: सन्-दीपित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted up, kindled, in-flamed, excited.
सन्दीप्त: सन्-दीप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, inflamed, flaming, burning, being on fire. —सन्दीप्त-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing inflamed or flashing eyes.
सन्दीप्य: सन्-दीप्य, अस्, m. the plant Celosia Cristata (= मयूर-शिखा).
सन्दीप्यत्: सन्-दीप्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flaming up, burning, shining.
सन्दुष्: सन्दुष् सन्-दुष् (सम्-द्°), cl. 4. P. -दुष्-यति, -दोष्टुम्, to be or become utterly corrupt, be defiled or polluted, become unclean: Caus. -दू-षयति, -यितुम्, to corrupt, defile, pollute, stain, spoil; to revile, abuse, censure, libel, expose to shame or infamy.
सन्दुष्ट: सन्-दुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, polluted, defiled, unclean; very depraved, wicked, bad; ill-disposed, ill-affected towards (with gen.).
सन्दूषण: सन्-दूषण, अम्, n. the act of vitiating or cor-rupting, defiling, any vice which causes infamy.
सन्दूषित: सन्-दूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, utterly corrupted, vitiated, defiled, stained, made unclean; made or grown worse (as a disease); exposed to shame, reviled, abused.
सन्दूष्य: सन्-दूष्य, ind. having entirely spoiled or cor-rupted, having vitiated.
सन्दुह्: सन्दुह् सन्-दुह् (सम्-दुह्), cl. 2. P. A. -दोग्-धि, -दुग्धे, &c. (see rt. 2. दुह्), to milk at the same time, milk together; to milk out, suck: Caus. -दोहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to milk, &c.
सन्दुग्ध: सन्-दुग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, milked at the same time, milked together.
सन्दोह: सन्-दोह, अस्, m. ‘the whole of a quantity of drawn milk,’ any quantity, multitude, mass, assem-blage.
सन्दोह्य: सन्-दोह्य, ind. having caused to milk.
सन्दृभ्: सन्दृभ् सन्-दृभ् (सम्-द्°), cl. 6. P. -दृ-भति, -दर्भितुम्, to string or bind together; to connect, arrange, compose; to collect or bind into a bunch or tuft, weave into a garland, interweave.
सन्दृब्ध: सन्-दृब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, strung together, inter-woven, bound or collected into a tuft or bunch; arranged, composed.
सन्दृश्: सन्दृश् 1. सन्-दृश् (सम्-द्°), cl. 1. P. सम्पश्-यति (ep. also A. -ते), सन्द्रष्टुम्, to see together or at the same time; to look at steadfastly, see well, gaze at, see, behold, view, perceive, become aware of, recognise; to review; to regard, consider, reflect upon; to calculate, enumerate; to overlook, wink at, allow to happen; to look about (A. if without an object, Pāṇ. 1. 3, 29, Vārtt. 2): Pass. -दृश्यते, to be seen at the same time, appear together; to look like, resemble, be similar, be equal; to be observed, become visible, appear: Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्, to cause to see well, make manifest, show, display; to represent; to show one's self to any one (acc.).
2. सन्-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. one who sees well or thoroughly, (Sāy. सम्यक् पश्यति यः); (क्), f. sight, vision; a glance, look.
सन्दर्शयत्: सन्-दर्शयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to see, show-ing, pointing out.
सन्दर्शित: सन्-दर्शित, अस्, आ, अम्, shown, pointed out; displayed, manifested.
सन्दर्श्य: सन्-दर्श्य, ind. having made to appear, having shown, &c.
सन्दिदर्शयिषु: सन्-दिदर्शयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to show, &c.
सन्दृश्य: सन्-दृश्य, ind. having looked at, having beheld, &c.; having considered.
सन्दृश्यमान: सन्-दृश्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being seen well or thoroughly, being looked at, being foreseen.
सन्दृष्ट: सन्-दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, beheld, (पाप-सन्दृष्ट, having an evil aspect); foreseen, antici-pated.
सन्दृष्टि: सन्-दृष्टि, इस्, f. complete sight, full view; a sight, glance, look, aspect.
सम्पश्यत्: सम्-पश्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking at.
सम्पश्यमान: सम्पश्यमान सम्-पश्यमान। See under 1. सन्-दृश्, p. 1059, col. 3.
सन्द्युत्: सन्द्युत् सन्-द्युत् (सम्-द्°), cl. 1. A. -द्योतते, -द्योतितुम्, to shine together with, shine along with, rival in shining; to shine forth.
सन्द्रु: सन्द्रु सन्-द्रु (सम्-द्रु), cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्, to run together; to run away.
सन्द्राव: सन्-द्राव, अस्, m. running together, running away, flight, retreat.
सन्धन्व्: सन्धन्व् सन्-धन्व् (सम्-ध्°), cl. 1. A. -धन्वते, &c., to flow towards, be directed towards, (in Ṛg-veda III. 31, 1. according to Sāy. सन्-द-धन्वे = आत्मानं सन्धत्ते।)
सन्धा: सन्धा सन्-धा (सम्-धा), cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते (ep. -दधामहे = -दध्महे), -धातुम् (ep. -धितुम्), to place or hold together, join together, unite, combine, connect, fasten toge-ther; to repair, restore, mend, heal; to make good, atone for, redress; to put together, compose, com-pound, make, construct, prepare, mix; to draw toge-ther, contract, close up, close; to bring together, collect; to bring together or unite in friendship, reconcile; to make a compact or agreement, con-clude a league or alliance, come to terms, make peace with (with inst. or sometimes with acc.); to be associated or allied with (A.); to come near, approach; to fix or compose the mind or thoughts, (see under rt. 1. धा); to put or lay down by the side of, put or lay on, fix on (e. g. शरं धनुषि सन्-दधाति or सन्-धत्ते, he fixes an arrow on a bow; sometimes धनुर् शरेण सन्-धा, to con-nect a bow with an arrow); to aim at, direct towards; to take hold of, grasp, support, sustain; to render aid, assist; to take hold of with the mind, compre-hend, conceive; to hold, possess, have; to perform, do; to grant, yield; to inflict; to be a match for, hold out against (A.); to employ, make use of (with inst.): Pass. -धीयते, to be joined together, be connected, unite one's self with, become recon-ciled, &c.; to become possessed of (with inst.): Desid. -धित्सति, to wish to place or join together, desire to unite or repair.
सन्ध: सन्-ध, अस्, आ, अम्, holding together; joined, united, closely blended; placing in or on; possessing; (आ), f. junction, intimate union, association, identi-fication; alliance, compact, stipulation, agreement, assent, promise; twilight (as joining night and morning or day and evening; cf. सन्ध्या); fixation, steadiness, fixedness; steady continuance in any state; state, condition; a boundary, limit.
सन्धय: सन्धय, Nom. P. -धयति, -यितुम्, to join together, reconcile; to fasten on, (see सन्-धित।)
सन्धातव्य: सन्-धातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed or held together, to be united or connected, to be allied with, to be reconciled.
सन्धातृ: सन्-धातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who puts together or joins, a joiner, uniter.
सन्धान: 1. सन्-धान, अम्, n. the act of placing or holding together, joining, junction, uniting, tying or binding together, intimate union, combining, combination, repairing, restoration; composing, compounding, mixing, preparation; drawing together, contraction (as of the skin by astringents &c.); bringing toge-ther, alliance, league, association, companionship, peace; the act of fixing an arrow on a bow-string; directing, taking aim; direction; advertence, atten-tion; sustaining, supporting, reception, receiving; spirituous liquor; a preparation of pickles &c. (made from the Vilva and other fruits); mixed or bell-metal (= सौराष्ट्र); a kind of relish eaten to excite thirst; sour rice-gruel; (अम्, ई), n. f. distil-lation, distilling; the manufacture of fermented or spirituous liquors; (ई), f. a braziery, foundery, place where metals are wrought or stored. —सन्धान-करण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing union or combination, who or what re-unites or heals or reconciles; uniting, connecting; (अम्), n. the act of combining or unit-ing; healing; allying, making peace. —सन्धान-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, = सन्धान-करण above.
2. सन्-धान, अस्, आ, अम् (ep. for सन्-दधान), placing together, &c.
सन्धानिका: सन्धानिका, f. a kind of pickle or sauce.
सन्धानित: सन्धानित, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. 1. सन्-धान), joined, united, strung together; bound, tied.
सन्धानिन्: सन्धानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, tying or binding together; clever in taking aim, shrewd; (इनी), f. a cow-house (= गो-गृह).
सन्धानी: सन्-धानी, f. See under 1. सन्-धान above.
सन्धाय: सन्-धाय, ind. having placed together, having joined or united; having repaired; having formed an alliance or made peace; having fixed an arrow on a bow-string, having taken aim, shooting at.
सन्धि: सन्-धि, इस्, m. placing or holding together, con-junction, junction, connection, combination, union, contact; composition, construction, structure; distil-lation; compact, agreement, alliance, league, reconcili-ation, peace, making a treaty of peace, negotiating alli-ances, (one of the six Guṇas or courses of action recommended to kings, see गुण; many kinds of treaty are enumerated, e. g. अदृष्ट-पुरुषः सन्धिः, an alliance concluded without the inter-vention of an agent; उच्छिन्नः सन्धिः, a treaty purchased by the cession of fertile territories; काञ्-चनः सन्धिः, ‘golden alliance,’ an alliance which lasts throughout the lifetime of the parties, each of whom pursues the same object, see also कपाल-स्°, सन्तान-स्°); euphonic junction of final and initial letters in grammar, (every sentence in Sanskrit being regarded as a euphonic chain, the links being syl-lables rather than words, and a break in the chain denoting the end of a sentence, commonly called ‘a Virāma or stop;’ this Sandhi or euphonic coa-lition is applied both to the final and initial letters of separate Padas or finished words in a sentence and to the final letters of Dhātus or roots, and Prāti-padikas or nominal bases when combined with ter-minations and affixes to form such words); a con-necting link (as of a perpendicular in mensuration); a joint, articulation (of the body &c.); juncture, critical juncture, opportune moment; division, sepa-ration; breaking, dividing; a breach, chasm, mine, hole, opening or cavity made in a wall or underneath a building by a housebreaker or enemy &c.; the vagina or vulva (in anatomy); a division in a drama (e. g. critical junctures, changes of situa-tion &c. considered as breaks though contributing to the connection of the whole); a fold; an interval, pause, rest; a period at the expiration of each Yuga or age (equivalent to one sixth of its duration and intervening before the commencement of the next; occurring also at the end of each Manv-antara and Kalpa). —सन्धि-कुशल, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in the art of making treaties or forming alliances. —सन्-धि-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘joint-knot,’ a synovial gland connecting and lubricating a joint. —सन्धि-चौर, अस्, m. ‘hole-thief,’ one who enters a house by undermining it, a housebreaker. —सन्धि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by Sandhi; (अम्), n. spirituous liquor. —सन्धि-जीवक, अस्, m. one who lives by dishonest means (especially by making matches or as a go-between). —सन्धि-तस्, ind. from an alli-ance. —सन्धि-दूषण, अम्, n. the violation of a treaty or alliance. —सन्धि-पूजा, f., N. of the third period in the great autumnal Durgā-pūjā. —सन्धि-प्रबन्धन, अम्, n. (in anatomy) the ligament of a joint. —सन्धि-बन्ध, अस्, m. the plant Kæmpferia Rotunda. —सन्धि-बन्धन, अम्, n. ‘joint-binding,’ a ligament, tendon, nerve. —सन्धि-भङ्ग, अस्, m. joint-fracture, dislocation of a joint. —सन्धि-मति, इस्, m., N. of the minister of Jayendra, king of Kaśmīra. —सन्धि-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘joint-loosened,’ dislocated. —सन्धि-मुक्ति, इस्, f. ‘joint-loosening,’ dislocation of a joint. —सन्-धि-रन्ध्रका, f. a hole or breach in a wall. —सन्धि-विग्रह, औ, m. du. peace and war. —सन्धि-विग्रहक, अस्, m. one who has the charge of peace and war, a chief minister. —सन्धि-विग्रहाधिकार (°ह-अध्°), अस्, m. superintend-ence of peace and war, war-ministry. —सन्धि-विग्रहाधिकारिन्, ई, m. superintendent of peace and war, a chief political minister. —सन्धि-विचक्षण, अस्, m. one skilled in peace-making, an able nego-tiator of treaties. —सन्धि-विद्, त्, त्, त्, skilled in alliances; (त्), m. a negotiator of treaties, a minister. —सन्धि-वेला, f. ‘a connecting period, time of junction,’ any period or time which connects parts of the day or night or fortnight (e. g. morning, noon, evening, new moon, the first or thirteenth day of the fortnight, full moon, &c.). —सन्धि-सितासित-रोग (°त-अस्°), अस्, m. a kind of disease. —सन्धि-स्तोत्र, अम्, n., N. of a particular hymn. —सन्धि-हारक, अस्, m. a housebreaker, (see सन्धि-चौर।) —सन्ध्य्-अक्षर, अम्, n. a compound vowel, diphthong, N. of the diphthongs ए, ऐ, ओ, औ; [cf. समानाक्षर।] —सन्ध्य्-अध्याय, अस्, m. an Adhyāya or chapter on Sandhi.
सन्धिक: सन्धिक, अस्, m. a kind of fever (said to be caused by a vitiated state of the three humors of the body); (आ), f. distillation.
सन्धिग: सन्धिग, a kind of disease, (probably for सन्-धिक।) —सन्धिग-चिकित्सा, f. the treatment or cure of Sandhiga.
सन्धित: सन्धित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सन्धय), joined or fastened together, united, strung, bound, tied; recon-ciled, allied; fixed, fitted, prepared, mixed together; pickled; (अम्), n. pickles, acid preparations, spirituous liquor. —सन्धितेषु (°त-इषु), उस्, उस्, उ, having an arrow fitted on a bow-string; [cf. संहितेषु।]
सन्धितव्य: सन्धितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = सन्-धेय below.
सन्धित्सु: सन्-धित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to make peace or form an alliance with.
सन्धिनी: सन्धिनी, f. a cow with calf, one which has just taken the bull; a cow milked unseasonably. —सन्-धिनी-क्षीर, अम्, n. the milk of a cow in heat, (prohibited as an article of food.)
सन्धिला: सन्धिला, f. a breach or hole made in a wall; a chasm, mine, pit; spirituous liquor; a river.
सन्धीयमान: सन्-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being joined toge-ther by the rules of Sandhi, (as words in the Saṃhitā text of the Vedas, &c.)
सन्धेय: सन्-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be joined or united, &c.; to be connected or allied, &c.; to be reconciled; to be made peace with; to be aimed at.
सन्ध्य: सन्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of or belonging to Sandhi, relating to euphonic conjunction, joined together by Sandhi.
सन्ध्या: 1. सन्ध्या, f. (for 2. see under सन्-ध्यै), hold-ing or joining together, union, conjunction, connec-tion; joint, division; boundary, limit; twilight (a period consisting of two Daṇḍas connecting day and night), morning or evening twilight, evening, dusk; early morning, day-break; Twilight personified as daughter of Brahmā and wife of Śiva; the period which precedes a Yuga or age of the world (see युग); any one of the three divisions of the day, (forenoon, noon, and afternoon); morning or evening or mid-day prayer (or any religious exercise, such as abstrac-tion, meditation, repetition of Mantras, sipping water, &c., performed at the three divisions of the day); promise, agreement, assent; a kind of jasmine (according to some); N. of a river. —सन्ध्यांश (°या-अं°), अस्, m. ‘portion of twilight,’ the period at the end of each Yuga, (see युग।) —सन्ध्यांशु (°या-अं°), उस्, m. ‘twilight-ray,’ twilight. —सन्ध्या-काल, अस्, m. twilight-period, (a term applied to the intervals of a Yuga, see युग); evening. —सन्ध्या-चल (°या-अच्°), अस्, m. ‘twilight-mountain,’ N. of a mountain. —सन्ध्या-त्रय, अम्, n. the three divisions or periods of the day (i. e. forenoon, noon, and afternoon). —सन्ध्या-त्व, अम्, n. the state of twilight; the time of twilight (period for devotional exercises). —सन्ध्या-नाटिन्, ई, m. ‘dancing at evening twilight,’ epithet of Śiva. —सन्ध्या-पा-त्र, अम्, n. a vessel used for pouring out water in performing the Sandhyā ceremonies. —सन्ध्या-पुष्पी, f. a kind of jasmine; nutmeg (= जाति or जाती). —सन्ध्या-बल, अस्, m. ‘strong in twilight,’ a demon, imp, Rākṣasa. —सन्ध्या-बलि, इस्, m. ‘receiving twilight-oblations,’ a clay or stone image of the bull of Śiva (usually standing in the temples of that deity). —सन्ध्याभ्र (°या-अभ्°), अम्, n. an evening cloud; a sort of red chalk (= सुवर्ण-गैरिक). —सन्ध्या-मङ्गल, अम्, n. an evening solemnity or religious service. —सन्ध्या-राग, अम्, n. ‘having the colour of twilight,’ red-lead. —सन्-ध्याराम (°या-आर्°), अस्, m. ‘delighting in San-dhyā,’ epithet of Brahmā. —सन्ध्या-वन्दन, अम्, n. morning and evening adoration or prayer. —सन्ध्या-विधि, इस्, m. a Sandhyā rite, (see above.) —सन्ध्या-शङ्ख, अस्, m. the evening conch, the conch which sounds the evening hour. —सन्ध्या-समय, अस्, m. twilight-period, even-ing; a portion of each Yuga, (see युग।) —सन्-ध्योपनिषद् (°य-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad belonging to the Atharva-veda. —सन्ध्योपासन (°या-उप्°), अम्, n. worship performed at the Sandhyās, (see above.)
2. सन्-ध्या, f. (for 1. see col. 1), reflection, medi-tation.
सन्धारण: सन्धारण सन्-धारण, &c. See under सन्-धृ, col. 2.
सन्-धारण, अम्, आ, n. f. holding together, holding in, restraining, observing, practising.
सन्धाव्: सन्धाव् 1. सन्-धाव् (सम्-ध्°), cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run together; to run up to violently, assail, attack; to run to.
सन्धाव् 2. सन्-धाव् (सम्-ध्°), cl. 1. A. -धावते, -धावितुम्, Ved. to rub one's self, wash one's self.

(said to be fr. rt. 1. भा with स, because people, सह भान्ति, ‘appear together’ at a place of meeting), an assembly, con-gregation, meeting, company, society, good society; Society (personified as a daughter of Prajā-pati); a council, council-chamber, hall; a court of justice; a court, palace [cf. राज-स्°]; a public audience, levee; a gaming room, gambling house; any house or large room or frequented place. —सभा-चातुर्य, अम्, n. politeness in society. —सभाचार (°भा-आच्°), अस्, m. the customs or usages of society, court-manners. —सभा-धैर्य, अम्, n. boldness in company. —सभा-नर, अस्, m. a proper N. —स-भा-नायक, अस्, or सभा-पति, इस्, m. the president of an assembly, chairman; the keeper of a gaming house. —सभा-पर्वन्, अ, n., N. of the second book of the Mahā-bhārata (which describes the holding of a great assembly at Hastināpura and the gambling between Yudhi-ṣṭhira and Śakuni, in which the former staked and lost all his possessions, including his territory and his wife Draupadī). —सभा-पूजा, f. respect or reverence paid to the audience (in the prelude of a drama). —सभा-मण्डन, अम्, n. the adorning or arranging of an assembly-room. —सभा-वशकर, अस्, ई, अम्, controlling or influencing an assembly. —सभा-सद्, त्, m. one who sits at an assembly, a member of any society or company, an assistant at an assembly or meeting; (in law) an assessor, one who sits in a court of justice, a judge. —सभा-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who restrains or rules an assembly. —सभा-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a king. —सभास्तार (°भा-आस्°), अस्, m. an assistant at an assembly, one of a society or company. —सभा-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being at an assembly or court; (अस्), m. one who sits in an assembly; a courtier. —स-भोचित (°भा-उच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, fit for an assembly, fit for good society; (अस्), m. a learned Brāhman, any learned or educated person. —सभोद्देश (°भा-उद्°), the neighbourhood of any place of meeting; the precincts of a house, &c.

सभेय: सभेय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to an assembly, skilled in council, shining in society.
सभ्य: सभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to an assembly, fit for an assembly; suitable to good society; fit for a court; polite; refined, civilized, (अ-सभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not met with in good society, not used in the best society, unrefined, indecorous); trusted, confidential, faithful; (अस्), m. an assistant at an assembly; an assessor; a person of honourable parentage; N. of one of the five sacred fires; the keeper of a gaming house; the servant of a keeper of a gaming house; [cf. सम् 2. सम् [cf. 5. स, सम; by some con-nected with 4. स], ind. (as a preposition or prefix to verbs and verbal derivatives opposed to 1. वि, q. v., and like Gr. σύν, Lat. con, expressing) with, together with, along with, together (e. g. सं-युज्, to join together; सञ्-चि, to gather together; सन्-धा, to place together; सन्-धि, placing together); when prefixed to some roots and verbal derivatives सम् intensifies the idea contained in the simple rt., and may often be translated by ‘much,’ ‘greatly,’ ‘thoroughly,’ ‘quite,’ ‘very,’ ‘well,’ (see सन्-तप्, सन्-तुष्, &c.); it may also express ‘completeness,’ ‘perfection,’ ‘beauty,’ &c., (see सम्-उच्छेद, सन्-तमस्, &c.); it is not unfrequently prefixed to nouns in the sense of सम, ‘same,’ ‘like,’ ‘similar,’ (see सम, cf. सम्-अर्थ); in the Veda it may be used as a separable preposition with inst. (e. g. असृ-जद् मधुना सम् मधूनि, Ṛg-veda X. 54, 6); [cf. according to some, Gr. σύν, ξύν; perhaps Lat. cum; Old Russ. sen; Slav. sū, su.]
सम: सम 1. सम, अस्, आ, अम् (probably connected with 5. स and 2. सम्; declined like the prono-minal सर्व except in meanings like ‘even,’ ‘equal,’ &c., e. g. समस्मै, to all, to every one, Ṛg-veda VI. 51, 6), even, level, flat, plain; same, equal, (समं कृ, to make equal, balance; to pay); like, similar, like to (with inst., e. g. मया सम, like to me); a match for, acting in the same way or with equal justice towards every one; indifferent, impartial, fair; free from emotion, unaffected by passion, unmoved; straight; upright, honest, just, temperate, good, virtuous; fit, convenient, suitable; not eminent, ordinary, common, low, mean, equally distant from extremes; all, every one (= सर्व and so declined, see above); full, complete; whole, entire; (अस्), m., N. of certain zodiacal signs (espe-cially Vṛṣa, Karkaṭa, Kanyā, Vṛścika, Makara, Mīna); a mode of measuring time in music (de-scribed as a simultaneous movement of the hands or feet of a singer with the time of the music); a kind of straight line placed over a numerical figure to mark the process of extracting the square root; (आ), f. a year; see p. 1067, col. 1; (अम्), n. anything even or level, a level plain; (in rhetoric) a particular figure, sameness of objects compared to one another; (in geometry) a mean proportional segment (de-scribed as a fourth proportional to the two perpen-diculars and the link or segment, and used for solving certain problems in a trapezium); (अम्), ind. equally; similarly; like; ceteris paribus; on a level with, in the same way; conformably to; entirely; with, along with, together with (used as a preposition governing the inst.); sometimes used for the pre-position सम्, cf. सम-चोदित, सम-रञ्जित, and सम-गच्छतु under सङ्-गम्); [cf. Zend hama: Gr. ἅμα, ὁμό-ς, ὁμοῦ, ὁμό-θεν, ὁμό-σε, ὁμο-ῖο-ς, ὁμοί-ι-ος, ὁμαλό-ς, μία, μέν: Lat. sim-ia (?), si-mili-s, simul, simul-tas, simul-ā-re, semel, sem-per, singuli: Old Lat. simītu: Goth. sama, sama-frathjis, sam-ana, samath, sums, sum: Old Germ. sama, saman, zi-samane (= Mod. Germ. zusammen), samet: Angl. Sax. same (sam in comp.), somne, samne, sum: Slav. samu: Hib. samhuil, ‘like;’ samhladh, ‘resemblance;’ sam-hlain, ‘I compare, resemble.’] —सम-कन्या, f. a suitable maiden, a girl fit to be married. —सम-कर्ण, अस्, अम्, m. n. an equi-diagonal tetragon. —सम-काल, अस्, m. the same time, the same moment; (अम्), ind. simultaneously. —सम-कोल, अस्, m. ‘having an even breast,’ a serpent, snake. —सम-कोष्ठ-मिति, इस्, f. the measure of like compartments, area or superficial contents of any figure. —सम-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. (अम्), n. the fragrant root of the Uśīra. —सम-चतुरश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, equally quadrangular, square; (अस्, अम्), m. n. an equilateral tetragon. —सम-चतुर्भुज, अस्, आ, अम्, equally four-sided; (अस्, अम्), m. n. an equilateral tetragon or rhombus. —सम-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, even-minded, even-tem-pered, equanimous, equable; P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, &c., to make even or equal, equalise. —समी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, equalised; levelled, equipoised, balanced; done in the same manner, imitated; summed up, added. —समी-क्रिया, f. the act of equalising; (in arith-metic) equation. —समी-भू, cl. 1. सम 2. स-म, अस्, आ, अम् (i. e. स + मा), ‘together with Lakṣmī,’ happy, prosperous.
समया: समया, ind. at a fixed or appointed time; duly, seasonably, in due time or season; (in the following senses probably an old inst. of सम), within, in the middle, in the midst, betwixt, between, within; near (with acc.); [cf. Gr. ὁμῇ, ὁμοῦ, ὁμῶς; Lat. simul.]
समा: 1. समा, f. (sometimes आस्, pl.; for 2. समा see s. v.), a year; a day (according to some). —समां-समीना, f. a cow bearing a calf every year. —समा-निचय, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has a store (of pro-visions) sufficient for a year. —समान्त (°मा-अन्°), अस्, m. the end of a year.
समा 2. समा (for 1. see p. 1067, col. 1), ind. (apparently an old inst. and connected with 2. सम्, see समि; cf. अमा, p. 74, सचा, p. 1049), with, together with.
समीय: 1. समीय, Nom. A. समीयते, &c., to be treated equally or in the same manner as (with inst.).
2. समीय, अस्, आ, अम्, similar, like, of like origin.
समीयमान: 1. समीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being treated in the same manner as. (For 2. see under 1. सम्-इ।)
2. सम्-ईयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being come together, being united with; being treated equally, (in this sense probably for 1. समीयमान, see p. 1067.
समक्त: सम्-अक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, joined together; put toge-ther, composed, combined, (also referrible to सम्-अच् above.)
