समक्ष: समक्ष सम्-अक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, being before the eyes or in sight, visible, being in presence of; (अम्), ind. before the eyes, in sight of, visibly, in presence of. —समक्ष-ता, f. visibility. —सम्-अक्ष-दर्शन, अम्, n. the act of seeing with the eyes, ocular evidence.
समग्र: समग्र सम्-अग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, all, entire, whole, full, complete. —समग्र-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, pos-sessing the whole of one's property. —समग्र-सम्पद्, त्, त्, त्, having complete happiness, blessed with every happiness. —समग्रेन्दु (°र-इन्°), उस्, m. the full moon. —समग्रेन्दु-निभानन (°भ-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a face like the full moon.
समङ्ग: समङ्ग सम्-अङ्ग, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
समङ्गल: समङ्गल स-मङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, endowed with happiness, auspicious.
समङ्गा: समङ्गा सम्-अङ्गा, f. Bengal madder (= मञ्जिष्ठा); a sort of fern, Lycopodium Imbri-catum; the sensitive plant (= लज्जालु); other plants (= वराह-क्रान्ता; = बाला).
समच्: समच् सम्-अच् or सम्-अञ्च् (see rts. अच्, 1. अञ्च्, cf. सम्-अञ्ज् below), cl. 1. P. A. -अचति, -अञ्चति, -ते, -अञ्चितुम्, to bend together; to go together: Pass. -अच्यते, to be combined or united.
समज्: समज् सम्-अज्, cl. 1. P. -अजति, -अजितुम्, to bring or collect together, (Sāy. = सं-योजयति); to bring into conflict; to meet (for battle; Sāy. = सङ्-गच्छते, Ṛg-veda 1. 100, 11); to subdue, over-come; to animate, incite, (Sāy. = सम्-प्रेरयति।)
समज: समज, अस्, m. a multitude of beasts or animals; a number of fools; (अम्), n. a forest, wood.
समज्या: सम्-अज्या, f. a meeting, assembly; fame, celebrity.
समाज: सम्-आज, अस्, m. a meeting [cf. द्यूत-स्°, प्रेक्-षा-स्°], assembly, congregation, congress; a society, company, association, club; a convivial meeting, party; a collection, quantity, multitude, number (applied to any collection of articles except of beasts); an elephant. —समाज-सन्निवेश, अस्, m. a building or place suitable for an assembly, assembly-room, meeting-house.
समाजिक: समाजिक, अस्, m. a member of an assembly or congregation; a spectator.
समञ्ज्: समञ्ज् सम्-अञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. A. -अनक्ति, -अङ्क्ते, अञ्जितुम् or -अङ्क्तुम्, to smear over, anoint, be-sprinkle; to beautify, decorate, adorn (Ved.); to honour (Ved.); to join together (Sāy. = एकी-कृ), connect, unite; to put together, compose; to utter forth, (Sāy. = सम्यग् व्यक्तं कृ); to consume, devour (Ved.).
समञ्जस: सम्-अञ्जस, अस्, आ, अम्, proper, right, fit; correct, accurate, true, consistent; virtuous, just, good; sound, healthy; exercised, practised, experienced; (अम्), n. propriety, fitness, truth, accuracy, consistency, correct evidence.
समण्ठ: समण्ठ समण्ठ, अस्, m. a kind of pot-herb (described as a sort of cucumber, = गण्डीर).
समत्: समत् सम्-अत्, cl. 1. P. -अतति, -अतितुम्, to resort to, approach, visit.
समतिक्रम्: समतिक्रम् सम्-अति-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रा-मति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go or pass by en-tirely, go completely beyond, go or pass completely through, cross over, step over, step out of; to trans-gress, neglect, disregard, lose; to surpass, excel, exceed; to pass by, elapse (as time); to let pass by.
समतिक्रम: सम्-अतिक्रम, अस्, m. going entirely over or beyond; deviating from, transgressing, omission.
समतिक्रम्य: सम्-अतिक्रम्य, ind. having entirely gone by, having wholly passed over, (द्वौ मासौ समति-क्रम्य, having allowed two months to elapse, after two months); having neglected or omitted.
समतिक्रान्त: सम्-अतिक्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone entirely over or beyond; transgressed; surpassed, exceeded; passed by, elapsed.
समतिया: समतिया सम्-अति-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go completely beyond, pass by or away, elapse.
समतिरिक्त: समतिरिक्त सम्-अतिरिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. रिच् with अति and सम्), excessively redundant or abundant, exceeding, excessive, much.
समतिवह्: समतिवह् सम्-अति-वह्, Caus. -वाहयति, &c., to cause to be spent, to pass, spend.
समतिवृत्: समतिवृत् सम्-अति-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, &c. (see rt. 1. वृत्), to pass by; to escape from, avoid.
समती: समती सम्-अती (-अति-इ), cl. 2. P. -अत्येति, &c., to go or pass by entirely, pass completely be-yond; to go through, cross over; to go by, avoid; to surpass, excel.
समतीत: सम्-अतीत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone or passed by.
समतीत्य: सम्-अतीत्य, ind. having completely gone or passed by, having passed through; having avoided.
समत्सर: समत्सर स-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, having envy or jealousy, envious, jealous.
समद्: समद् 1. सम्-अद्, cl. 2. P. -अत्ति, -अत्तुम्, to eat completely up, entirely devour.

समद् 2. समद्, त्, f. (in the Pada स-मद्; according to Yāska either fr. 1. सम्-अद् above or सम्-मद्), Ved. a battle, contest, fight, (in Naigh. II. 17. समत्सु is enumerated among the सङ्-ग्राम-नामानि।)
समद: समद स-मद, अस्, आ, अम्, intoxicated; ex-hilarated, delighted; furious, mad with rut.
समधिक: समधिक सम्-अधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly abundant, very abundant, exceeding, excessive, plen-tiful; (अम्), ind. exceedingly, excessively. —सम्-अधिक-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more abundant, exceed-ing, excessive.
समधिकृत्: समधिकृत् सम्-अधि-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut up in addition, cut up completely.
समधिकृत्य: सम्-अधिकृत्य, ind. having completely cut up, having cut in pieces, having cut off.
समधिगम्: समधिगम् सम्-अधि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go towards together, go well up to, come quite near, approach; to come into possession of, acquire, obtain; to go completely over, surpass; to go over, study, read.
समधिगत: सम्-अधिगत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone quite near to, approached.
समधिगमन: सम्-अधिगमन, अम्, n. the act of going quite near to; surpassing, overcoming.
समधिगम्य: सम्-अधिगम्य, ind. having completely attained to; having obtained.
समधिरुह्: समधिरुह् सम्-अधि-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, &c., to rise up, mount, ascend; to rise up to, be convinced of.
समधिश्रि: समधिश्रि सम्-अधि-श्रि, cl. 1. P. A. -श्र-यति, -ते, -श्रयितुम्, to proceed or advance towards, approach, go up to; to attack.
समधिश्रित्य: सम्-अधिश्रित्य, ind. having proceeded or ad-vanced towards; having approached.
समधिष्ठा: समधिष्ठा सम्-अधि-ष्ठा (-स्था), cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -ष्ठातुम्, to stand over, preside over, superintend, administer, protect; to mount upon, ascend.
समधिष्ठाय: सम्-अधिष्ठाय, ind. having presided over; having mounted upon.
समधी: समधी सम्-अधी (-अधि-इ), cl. 2. A. -अधीते, to go over, read through, study thoroughly, peruse, investigate.
समधीत: सम्-अधीत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone over, read through, studied.
समध्यास्: समध्यास् सम्-अध्य्-आस् (-अधि-आस्), cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to sit on together, occupy (a seat) along with; to dwell in, inhabit: Desid. -आसिसिषते, to wish to occupy.
समध्व: समध्व सम्-अध्व, अस्, आ, अम्, being on the same road, travelling in company.
समन्: समन् सम्-अन्, cl. 2. P. -अनिति, -अनितुम्, Ved. to breathe again, come to life.
समान: 1. सम्-आन (for 2. समान see s. v.), one of the five vital airs (that which circulates about the navel and is considered essential to digestion).

समान 2. समान, अस्, आ (Ved. also ई), अम् (according to some fr. स + मान, as if the original meaning were ‘having the same measure,’ according to others connected with 1. सम; in Ṛg-veda V. 87, 4. समानस्मात्, abl. c. = समस्मात् = सर्-वेषाम् साधारणात्, see 1. सम; for 1. सम्-आन see under सम्-अन्), same, alike, similar, equal (with inst., e. g. तेन समान, equal to him), uniform, one; common to all, common, general; good, virtuous; honoured; (अम्), ind. equally with (with inst.); (अस्), m. an equal, friend; any letter which corresponds to another (e. g. a long to its short vowel, a hard guttural to its soft), a letter having the same place or organ of utterance; (ई), f. a kind of metre. —समान-काल or समान-कालीन, अस्, आ, अम्, synchronous, occur-ring or produced at the same time. —समान-गोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, being of the same family (= स-गोत्र, q. v.). —समान-जन, अस्, m. a person of the same family or race. —समान-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having a common birth or origin, of equal age. —समान-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, or समान-जातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, be-longing to the same kind or species, of a common tribe or caste, of the same sort. —समान-ता, f. or समान-त्व, अम्, n. sameness, equality, likeness; community of kind or quality. —समान-तेजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, of equal splendor, equal in glory. —समान-दुःख, अस्, आ, अम्, having the same griefs, sympa-thising. —समान-बन्धु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. of the same family. —समान-मान, अस्, आ, अम्, receiving equal honour, equally respected. —समान-यम, अस्, m. the same pitch of voice. —समान-योग-क्षेम, अस्, आ, अम्, having the same value. —स-मान-योजन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the same yoking, harnessed for both alike (said of the chariot of the Aśvins). —समान-रुचि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the same tastes, taking pleasure in similar objects. —स-मानरुचि-ता, f. the having similar tastes. —समान-रूपा, f. a kind of riddle or enigma. —समान-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or समान-वयस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, of the same age. —समान-वर्चस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. of equal splendor. —समान-शब्दा, f. a kind of riddle or enigma. —समान-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, of a similar disposition or temper. —समानाक्षर (°न-अक्°), ‘a monophthong,’ N. of the vowels अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ऋ, ॠ, ऌ (as opposed to the सन्ध्य्-अक्षर or diphthongs). —समानाधिकरण (°न-अध्°), अम्, n. common or same government; same location, same predicament; a predicament including several things or persons, common or generic property, common substratum; (अस्, आ, अम्), being in the same subject or category, being in the same predicament, having the same location or sphere; having a common substratum (in the Vaiśe-shika phil.); agreeing together in the same case, &c., being in the same government, (see अधि-करण।) —समानाधिकार (°न-अध्°), अस्, m. similar office, like rule or government; generic character. —समानार्थ or समानार्थक (°न-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the same meaning, syno-nymous. —समानार्थ-प्रयोजन (°न-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a common object and purpose, caused by common interests. —समानालङ्कार (°न-अल्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wearing the same ornaments. —समानोदक (°न-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘having com-mon water-oblations,’ a kinsman connected by the offering of water to the departed spirits of common ancestors, (this relationship is said to extend to the fourteenth degree, the first seven being both Sapiṇḍas and Samānodakas, while the remaining seven are Samānodakas only.) —समानोदर्य (°न-उद्°), अस्, m. born from the same womb, a brother of whole blood.
समन: समन समन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. सम् or connected with 2. सम्), Ved. a battle, fighting, (in Naigh. II. 17. enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि, cf. सम्-अर), rivalry; coming or going together, meeting, union, collection; a marriage, marriage ceremony; a sacrifice, (Sāy. = यज्ञ); (अस्), m. zeal; a diligent man (Ved.).
समना: समना, ind. Ved. in battle, (Sāy. = समने); (according to others समना is an old inst. = सम्-आनया fr. 2. समान, see Nirukta X. 5. and Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 41, 2.)
समन्य: समन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. warlike, martial, military.
समनस्: समनस् स-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, of the same mind, unanimous.
समनीक: समनीक सम्-अनीक, अम्, n., Ved. war, battle.
समनुकम्प्: समनुकम्प् सम्-अनु-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्-पते, -कम्पितुम्, to sympathise with, have pity on, pity.
समनुकम्प्य: सम्-अनुकम्प्य, ind. having sympathised with, having pitied.
समनुकॢप्: समनुकॢप् सम्-अनु-कॢप्, Caus. -कल्पयति, -यितुम्, to make any one (acc.) attain any state or condition (loc.), convert into, cause to become.
समनुक्रम्: समनुक्रम् सम्-अनु-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रा-मति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go or pass through completely, to go through.
समनुक्रम्य: सम्-अनुक्रम्य, ind. having passed or gone through.
समनुगम्: समनुगम् सम्-अनु-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go after, follow, pursue; to penetrate, pervade.
समनुगत: सम्-अनुगत, अस्, आ, अम्, followed, pursued; penetrated, pervaded.
समनुगा: समनुगा सम्-अनु-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to go after together; to go well after, follow quite closely, follow.
समनुग्रह्: समनुग्रह् सम्-अनु-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्-णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to collect or gather together, arrange or put in order.
समनुगृह्य: सम्-अनुगृह्य, ind. having arranged in order.
समनुचिन्त्: समनुचिन्त् सम्-अनु-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्त-यति, -यितुम्, to reflect deeply about, meditate on, think upon, remember.
समनुजन्: समनुजन् सम्-अनु-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be born similar to or resembling (with acc.).
समनुज्ञा: समनुज्ञा सम्-अनु-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to permit or allow or consent to fully, wholly acquiesce in; to approve, admit, grant, authorize, empower; to pardon, forgive, excuse; to grant leave of absence, allow to go away, dismiss; to favour: Caus. -ज्ञापयति, -यितुम्, to ask leave, beg permission; to ask for, request; to take leave of (with acc.), bid adieu; to greet, salute.
समनुज्ञात: सम्-अनुज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely assented or agreed to, permitted, allowed; authorized; allowed to go away, dismissed; favoured.
समनुज्ञान: सम्-अनुज्ञान, अम्, n. entire assent, concurrence, permission; (अस्, आ, अम्), entirely acquiesced in, permitted, allowed.
समनुज्ञाप्य: सम्-अनुज्ञाप्य, ind. having granted full permis-sion, having fully allowed, having asked leave, having requested permission; having taken leave of; having saluted respectfully.
समनुज्ञाय: सम्-अनुज्ञाय, ind. having entirely approved or consented to; having acquiesced in.
समनुतप्: समनुतप् सम्-अनु-तप्, Pass. -तप्यते, to suffer great subsequent pain, be very penitent, repent.
समनुदिश्: समनुदिश् सम्-अनु-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to assign, apportion.
समनुदृश्: समनुदृश् सम्-अनु-दृश्, cl. 1. P. -पश्यति, -द्रष्टुम्, to look well after; to look on, regard as, consider, observe.
समनुद्रु: समनुद्रु सम्-अनु-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति (ep. also A. -ते), -द्रोतुम्, to run after together; to run well after, follow, pursue.
समनुधाव्: समनुधाव् सम्-अनु-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धा-वति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run after together; to run well after, pursue.
समनुध्यै: समनुध्यै सम्-अनु-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्या-यति, -ध्यातुम्, to reflect upon, think of.
समनुपद्: समनुपद् सम्-अनु-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to enter into, enter upon, attain to.
समनुप्रछ्: समनुप्रछ् सम्-अनु-प्रछ्, cl. 6. P. -पृच्-छति, -प्रष्टुम्, to ask about, ask after, inquire about.
समनुप्राप्: समनुप्राप् सम्-अनु-प्राप् (-प्र-आप्), cl. 5. P. -प्राप्नोति, -प्राप्तुम्, to attain, reach, arrive at; to obtain.
समनुप्राप्त: सम्-अनुप्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, arrived at, reached, attained; obtained, assumed; entirely covered or overspread.
समनुप्राप्य: सम्-अनुप्राप्य, ind. having reached or arrived at.
समनुभू: समनुभू सम्-अनु-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to enjoy together, feel, perceive.
समनुमन्: समनुमन् सम्-अनु-मन्, cl. 4. A. -मन्यते, &c., to assent, allow, consent; to recognise as.
समनुमत: सम्-अनुमत, अस्, आ, अम्, assented to, agreed upon; (अम्), n. consent.
समनुया: समनुया सम्-अनु-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go after, follow.
समनुयात: सम्-अनुयात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone after, followed.
समनुयुज्: समनुयुज् सम्-अनु-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to inquire after, ask about; to appoint, order, enjoin.
समनुवर्ण्: समनुवर्ण् सम्-अनु-वर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -वर्ण-यति, -यितुम्, to depict, describe.
समनुवर्णित: सम्-अनुवर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, described, delineated.
समनुवस्: समनुवस् सम्-अनु-वस् (see rt. 6. वस्), cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to abide by, follow, conform to.
समनुविद्: समनुविद् सम्-अनु-विद्, Caus. -वेदयति, -ते, &c., to cause to know or remember, remind.
समनुवृत्: समनुवृत् सम्-अनु-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, &c., to follow after, pursue; to obey; to ensue: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to take place or happen.
समनुव्रज्: समनुव्रज् सम्-अनु-व्रज्, cl. 1. P. -व्रजति, -व्रजितुम्, to go after, follow, pursue.
समनुव्रत: समनुव्रत सम्-अनुव्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely devoted to, ardently attached to.
समनुशास्: समनुशास् सम्-अनु-शास्, cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्, to rule or regulate well, govern, direct.
समन्त: समन्त सम्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, being on every side or part, universal, complete, whole, entire, all; (अस्), m. limit, boundary, term, end; (अम्), ind. to the very end, on all sides, wholly, altogether; (आत्), ind. from every side, on every side, from every part, all round, completely. —समन्त-तस्, ind. all round, on every side, altogether, wholly. —समन्त-दुग्-धा, f. the milk hedge-plant (= स्नुही). —समन्त-पञ्चक, अम्, n. the district Kuru-kṣetra, q. v. (said to have been once bordered by five lakes filled by Paraśu-rāma with the blood of the slaughtered Kṣatri-yas). —समन्त-भद्र, अस्, m. ‘wholly auspicious,’ a Buddha or Jina. —समन्त-भुज्, क्, m. ‘all-devouring,’ epithet of Agni or fire.
समन्त्रक: समन्त्रक स-मन्त्रक, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing charms or spells.
समन्त्रिक: समन्त्रिक स-मन्त्रिक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. मन्-त्रिन् with 5. स, q. v.), together with or accompanied by counsellors (said of a king).
समन्त्रित्व: समन्त्रि-त्व, अम्, n. counsel on the same side, assent.
समन्धकार: समन्धकार सम्-अन्धकार, अस्, अम्, m. n. great or universal darkness; [cf. सन्-तमस्।]
समन्धकारीकृत: समन्धकारी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made dark on all sides, (Kirāt. XIV. 39.)
समन्मथ: समन्मथ स-मन्मथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having love, filled with love.
समन्यु: समन्यु स-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the same splendor (Ved.); feeling the same energy or anger, (Sāy. = समान-वयस्क or समान-क्रोध, Ṛg-veda II. 34, 3); feeling anger or resentment, angry, fierce, enraged; filled with sorrow, sorrowful; (उस्), m. epithet of Śiva.
समन्वागम्: समन्वागम् सम्-अन्व्-आ-गम् (-अनु-आ-), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go together after, follow.
समन्वागत: सम्-अन्वागत, अस्, आ, अम्, attended by, accom-panied by, furnished with.
समन्वारभ्: समन्वारभ् सम्-अन्व्-आ-रभ्, cl. 1. A. -र-भते, &c., to take hold of or clasp together.
समन्वारब्ध: सम्-अन्वारब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, taken hold of together, grasping together.
समन्वारुह्: समन्वारुह् सम्-अन्व्-आ-रुह् (-अनु-आ-), cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्, to ascend after (as a wife ascends the funeral pile after her husband).
समन्वि: समन्वि सम्-अन्व्-इ (-अनु-इ), cl. 2. P. -एति, -एतुम्, to go together after, follow; to infer or ensue as a consequence.
समन्वय: सम्-अन्वय, अस्, m. regular succession or order, connected sequence or consequence, conjunction, mutual connection; [cf. अन्व्-अय।]
समन्वित: सम्-अन्वित, अस्, आ, अम्, connected or associated with; completely possessed of, fully endowed with, possessing, full of, affected by; [cf. अन्व्-इत।]
समन्विष्: समन्विष् सम्-अन्व्-इष् (-अनु-इष्), cl. 6. P. -इच्छति, &c., to search through, seek about every-where.
समन्वीक्ष्: समन्वीक्ष् सम्-अन्व्-ईक्ष् (-अनु-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to look towards, look or gaze after; to keep looking at, keep in view.
समन्वीक्ष्य: सम्-अन्वीक्ष्य, ind. having looked towards or kept in view.
समपध्यै: समपध्यै सम्-अप-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्यायति, -ध्यातुम्, to think ill or badly of, meditate evil or injury against, injure.
समपवृज्: समपवृज् सम्-अप-वृज्, Caus. -वर्जयति, &c., to deliver over, present with.
समपवर्जित: सम्-अपवर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, given up; delivered over, given, presented.
समपवृत्: समपवृत् सम्-अप-वृत्, Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to roll away, drive away.
समपिधा: समपिधा सम्-अपि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to cover completely.
समपिरुह्: समपिरुह् सम्-अपि-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, &c., to grow together, grow over.
समपोह्: समपोह् सम्-अपोह् (-अप-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P. -अपोहति, -अपोहितुम्, to dispel completely, entirely exclude.
समभिकॄत्: समभिकॄत् सम्-अभि-कॄत्, cl. 10. P. -कीर्त-यति, -यितुम्, to relate, tell, narrate.
समभिकीर्त्य: सम्-अभिकीर्त्य, ind. having related, having nar-rated.
समभिक्रम्: समभिक्रम् सम्-अभि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रा-मति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go near to, approach.
समभिक्रुद्ध: समभिक्रुद्ध सम्-अभिक्रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly enraged, angry.
समभिगम्: समभिगम् सम्-अभि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go towards together, go up to, approach.
समभिगच्छत्: सम्-अभिगच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going up to together, approaching.
समभिगर्ज्: समभिगर्ज् सम्-अभि-गर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -गर्जति, -गर्जितुम्, to shout or cry at defiantly, roar at, chal-lenge with a shout.
समभिगुह्: समभिगुह् सम्-अभि-गुह्, cl. 1. A. -गूहते, गूहितुम्, -गोढुम्, to crouch down, cower.
समभिच्छद्: समभिच्छद् सम्-अभि-च्छद् (-छद्), cl. 10. P. -च्छादयति, -यितुम्, to cover all over, com-pletely envelop.
समभिच्छन्न: सम्-अभिच्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, completely covered over.
समभिजन्: समभिजन् सम्-अभि-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be produced or spring up together, spring up, arise.
समभिज्ञा: समभिज्ञा सम्-अभि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to recognise fully, entirely acknow-ledge or perceive.
समभिज्ञाय: सम्-अभिज्ञाय, ind. having fully recognised or acknowledged.
समभितर्ज्: समभितर्ज् सम्-अभि-तर्ज्, cl. 1. 10. P. -तर्-जति, -तर्जयति, &c., to threaten or menace greatly, abuse, blame, scold.
समभित्यज्: समभित्यज् सम्-अभि-त्यज्, cl. 1. P. -त्यजति, -त्यक्तुम्, to give up entirely, abandon or renounce completely, wholly resign.
समभित्यक्त: सम्-अभित्यक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, wholly given up, completely abandoned, renounced; risked. —सम्-अभित्यक्त-जीवित, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has quite renounced his life.
समभिद्रु: समभिद्रु सम्-अभि-द्रु, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -द्रवति (-ते), -द्रोतुम्, to run or hasten toge-ther towards, to run hastily up to or towards (with acc.), rush full upon, assail, attack; to infest.
समभिद्रुत: सम्-अभिद्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, rushed upon, attacked, resorted to, infested; (अम्), ind. hurriedly, quickly.
समभिद्रुत्य: सम्-अभिद्रुत्य, ind. having hastened towards, having rushed full upon, having assailed.
समभिधा: समभिधा सम्-अभि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to speak to (with acc.), to address; to direct all one's thoughts to; to proclaim, announce, (Kirāt. VII. 1.)
समभिहित: सम्-अभिहित, अस्, आ, अम्, addressed, spoken to.
समभिधाव्: समभिधाव् सम्-अभि-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धा-वति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run hastily up to or towards, rush full upon; assail; to fly towards, dart at.
समभिध्यै: समभिध्यै सम्-अभि-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्या-यति, -ध्यातुम्, to reflect deeply on, meditate on; to direct all the thoughts upon, long for.
समभिनन्द्: समभिनन्द् सम्-अभि-नन्द्, cl. 1. P. -नन्-दति, -नन्दितुम्, to rejoice together with, congra-tulate; to greet, salute.
समभिनन्दित: सम्-अभिनन्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, rejoiced with, con-gratulated.
समभिपत्: समभिपत् सम्-अभि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्, to fall full upon, assail, attack (with acc.).
समभिपद्: समभिपद् सम्-अभि-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to come to, arrive at, attain; to come on; to reply to, answer.
समभिपॄ: समभिपॄ सम्-अभि-पॄ, Caus. -पूरयति, -यि-तुम्, to fill up, fill.
समभिप्रेक्ष्: समभिप्रेक्ष् सम्-अभि-प्रेक्ष् (-प्र-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -प्रेक्षते, -प्रेक्षितुम्, to look at, perceive, view.
समभिप्लु: समभिप्लु सम्-अभि-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्, to inundate, flood over; to overwhelm, cover.
समभिप्लुत: सम्-अभिप्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, inundated, flooded, overwhelmed; eclipsed (as the moon).
समभिभाष्: समभिभाष् सम्-अभि-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भा-षते, -भाषितुम्, to speak with, converse with; to speak to, address.
समभिया: समभिया सम्-अभि-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -या-तुम्, to approach together (with acc.); to go towards or near, advance.
समभियाच्: समभियाच् सम्-अभि-याच्, cl. 1. P. A. -या-चति, -ते, &c., to ask earnestly, implore.
समभिरुह्: समभिरुह् सम्-अभि-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, &c., to grow up together, ascend: Caus. -रोहयति, &c., to cause to grow up, cause to ascend, place or impose on (as a burden &c.): Pass. of Caus. -रोप्-यते, to be placed or imposed on.
समभिलष्: समभिलष् सम्-अभि-लष्, cl. 1. P. A. -ल-षति, -ते, &c., to long for, be eager for.
समभिलषत्: सम्-अभिलषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, longing for.
समभिवद्: समभिवद् सम्-अभि-वद्, Caus. -वादयति, -यितुम्, to address or salute respectfully.
समभिवध्: समभिवध् सम्-अभि-वध् (defective, see rt. वध्), to strike at.
समभिवाञ्च्: समभिवाञ्च् सम्-अभि-वाञ्छ्, cl. 1. P. -वाञ्-छति, &c., to long for, be eager for.
समभिवीक्ष्: समभिवीक्ष् सम्-अभि-वीक्ष् (-वि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -वीक्षते, -वीक्षितुम्, to perceive, become aware of.
समभिवृत्: समभिवृत् सम्-अभि-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to go towards, approach, advance towards, come on; to attack, assail; to turn back, return, recur; to remain, continue; to pass by, pass away, pass over; to depart.
समभिवृध्: समभिवृध् सम्-अभि-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्-धते, &c., to grow up, increase: Caus. -वर्ध-यति, -यितुम्, to make larger, enlarge, increase, augment.
समभिवृष्: समभिवृष् सम्-अभि-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, &c., to rain down upon.
समभिव्याहृ: समभिव्याहृ सम्-अभि-व्य्-आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to mention together; to bring together, associate together.
समभिव्याहार: सम्-अभिव्याहार, अस्, m. (in rhetoric) mention-ing together; proximity to or association with a word whose meaning is well understood (= प्रसिद्-धार्थकस्य शब्दस्य सन्निधिः); bringing to-gether, association, company.
समभिव्याहारिन्: सम्-अभिव्याहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, mentioning toge-ther; accompanying.
समभिव्याहृत: सम्-अभिव्याहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, mentioned or spoken of together; associated (= सहित), accom-panied by.
समभिष्टु: समभिष्टु सम्-अभि-ष्टु (-अभि-स्तु), cl. 2. P. A. -ष्टौति, -ष्टुते, &c., to praise, extol.
समभिसंवृत: सम्-अभिसंवृत, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely sur-rounded, encompassed.
समभिसन्धा: समभिसन्धा सम्-अभि-सन्-धा (-सम्-धा), cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place or put into; to aim at, strive after, determine on.
समभिसन्धाय: सम्-अभिसन्धाय, ind. having aimed at or resolved on.
समभिसृ: समभिसृ सम्-अभि-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, &c., to go towards, approach.
समभिसरण: सम्-अभिसरण, अम्, n. the act of going towards or against, approaching, seeking, wishing or endeavour-ing to gain.
समभिसृत्य: सम्-अभि-सृत्य, ind. having gone towards, hav-ing advanced, having attacked.
समभिहृ: समभिहृ सम्-अभि-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, &c., to seize upon or take together; to seize, take, take out.
समभिहरण: सम्-अभिहरण, अम्, n. the act of seizing upon, taking, &c.
समभिहार: सम्-अभिहार, अस्, m. seizing or taking together; repetition, reiteration, (क्रिया-समभिहारेण, by a repetition of acts, by repeated acts); excess, surplus.
समभिहृत्य: सम्-अभिहृत्य, ind. having taken out, having picked out or selected.
समभी: समभी सम्-अभी (-अभि-इ), cl. 2. P. -अभ्येति, &c., to go towards, come near, approach; to follow, attend, wait upon.
समभ्यतिक्रम्: समभ्यतिक्रम् सम्-अभ्य्-अति-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. -क्रामति, -क्रमितुम्, to come upon.
समभ्यर्च्: समभ्यर्च् सम्-अभ्य्-अर्च् (-अभि-), cl. 1. P. -अर्चति, &c., to pay great honour to, worship, greet, salute.
समभ्यर्चन: सम्-अभ्यर्चन, अम्, n. the act of paying great honour to, worshipping, reverencing.
समभ्यर्चित: सम्-अभ्यर्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly honoured, worshipped, saluted.
समभ्यर्च्य: सम्-अभ्यर्च्य, ind. having paid honour to, &c.
समभ्यर्थ्: समभ्यर्थ् सम्-अभ्य्-अर्थ्, cl. 10. A. -अर्थ-यते, &c., to petition, solicit, request.
समभ्यर्थयितृ: सम्-अभ्यर्थयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a petitioner; seeking, petitioning.
समभ्यवे: समभ्यवे सम्-अभ्य्-अवे (-अभि-अव-इ), cl. 2. P. -अवैति, &c., to go together, meet, assemble; to come to an agreement with (with inst.).
समभ्यागम्: समभ्यागम् सम्-अभ्य्-आ-गम् (-अभि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to come to, approach, arrive; to return.
समभ्यागत: सम्-अभ्यागत, अस्, आ, अम्, come to, approached; come back, returned.
समभ्यागा: समभ्यागा सम्-अभ्य्-आ-गा (-अभि-आ-), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to come to, come near, approach; to come upon, assail, attack.
समभ्यादा: समभ्यादा सम्-अभ्य्-आ-दा, cl. 3. A. -दत्ते, दातुम्, to comprehend, perceive.
समभ्याददान: सम्-अभ्याददान, अस्, आ, अम्, comprehending, perceiving.
समभ्यानी: समभ्यानी सम्-अभ्य्-आ-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -न-यति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to lead near to or towards; to introduce.
समभ्याहार: समभ्याहार सम्-अभ्याहार, अस्, m. bringing together, association, accompaniment.
समभ्युन्नम्: समभ्युन्नम् सम्-अभ्य्-उन्-नम् (-अभि-उद्-), cl. 1. P. -नमति, -नन्तुम्, to ascend, rise up.
समभ्युन्नत: सम्-अभ्युन्नत, अस्, आ, अम्, ascended, risen, rising up.
समभ्युपगमन: समभ्युपगमन सम्-अभ्युपगमन, अम्, n. the act of approaching or going near; following.
समभ्युपे: समभ्युपे सम्-अभ्य्-उपे (-उप-इ), cl. 2. P. -उपैति, &c., to go very near, approach.
समभ्युपेय: सम्-अभ्युपेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone to or approached; to be followed; (अम्), n. the being followed by.
समभ्ये: समभ्ये सम्-अभ्य्-ए (-अभि-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. -अभ्यैति, &c., to come up to, approach, go near to (with acc.).
समभ्येत्य: सम्-अभ्येत्य, ind. having come up, having approached.
समम्: समम् 1. समम्, ind. with, together with. (See under सम।)
समम् 2. सम्-अम्, cl. 1. A. -अमते, &c., Ved. to go earnestly towards, solicit eagerly; to go together, ally or connect one's self; to fix or settle firmly.
समममान: सम्-अममान, अस्, आ, अम्, connecting or allying one's self.
समय: समय सम्-अय, सम्-आय, &c. See under 1. सम्-इ, p. 1076.

सम्-अय, अस्, m. coming together, convention, coming to a mutual understanding, agreement, com-pact, covenant, treaty, contract, bargain, engage-ment, appointment; stipulation, condition; oath; concurrence of circumstances, juncture, fit or proper time, right moment, opportunity, occasion, season, time, emergency, exigency; leisure; conventional rule or usage, established custom, law, rule, regulation, regu-lar observance, religious obligation; order, direction, precept, instruction, affirmation, declaration; sign, hint, indication; coming to an end, conclusion, ter-mination; limit, boundary; demonstrated conclusion; end of trouble or distress; success, prosperity; poetī-cal idiom or conventionality (in rhetoric); (एन), ind. according to agreement, on condition, con-ditionally. —समय-कार, अस्, m. making an agreement or appointment or engagement, fixing a time. —समय-क्रिया, f. making an agreement or compact. —समय-परिरक्षण, अम्, n. the observance of a compact or agreement. —समय-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a work. —समय-प्र-दीप, अस्, m., N. of a work by Śrī-datta. —समय-भेद, अस्, m. breaking an agreement. —समय-भेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, a promise-breaker, breaking an agreement, violating an engagement. —समय-व्यभिचार, अस्, m. transgression or violation of a compact, breaking an agreement. —समय-व्य-भिचारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, transgressing a compact, violating an engagement. —समय-सेतु-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, restrained by the barrier of the rules of decorum. —समयाचार (°य-आच्°), अस्, m. conventional practice or usage; [cf. सामयाचारिक।] —समया-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work. —समया-ध्युषित (°य-अध्°), अम्, n. a time at which neither stars nor sun are visible. —समयानुवर्तिन् (°य-अन्°), ई, इनी, इ, following established rules, ob-servant of duties. —समयानुसारेण (°य-अन्°), ind. according to the occasion, suitably to the time or season. —समयोचित (°य-उच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, suited to the occasion or time, suitable to an emer-gency, seasonable, timely, opportune; (अम्), ind. suitably to the occasion, as the occasion demands. —समयोद्द्योत (°य-उद्°), N. of a work by Hemādri. —समयोल्लङ्घित-त्व (°य-उल्°), अम्, n. the overleaping or violating of contracts or agree-ments.
समर: समर सम्-अर, सम्-अराण, &c. See under सम्-ऋ।

सम्-अर, अस्, अम्, m. n. coming together in a hostile manner, conflict, combat, struggle, strife, war, battle [cf. समर्य]; (अस्), m. a proper N. —सम्-अर-कन्द, N. of a district. —समरञ्-जय, अस्, m. a proper N. —समर-मर्दन, अस्, m. ‘de-stroying in battle,’ epithet of Śiva. —समर-मूर्-धन्, आ, m. the front or van of battle. —समर-वर्मन्, आ, m. a proper N. —समर-विजयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, victorious in battle. —समर-सिंह, अस्, m. a proper N. —समर-स्वामिन्, ई, m. a particular statue or idol erected by Samara-varman. —सम-रार्णव (°र-अर्°), अस्, m. the ocean of war. —स-मरोचित (°र-उच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, fit for war. —स-मरोद्देश (°र-उद्°), अस्, m. a battle-field, place of combat. —समरोद्यत (°र-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, prepared for conflict, ready for combat.
समर्च्: समर्च् सम्-अर्च् [cf. सम्-ऋच्], cl. 1. P. or Caus. -अर्चति, &c., or -अर्चयति, &c., to honour, worship, adore; to adorn, decorate (Ved.).
समर्चन: सम्-अर्चन, अम्, n. the act of honouring, wor-shipping, adoration.
समर्चित: सम्-अर्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured, worshipped, adored.
समर्ण: सम्-अर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, asked, solicited; pained, wounded, plagued.
समर्थ्: समर्थ् सम्-अर्थ् (in some senses to be re-garded as a Nom. fr. सम्-अर्थ below), cl. 10. P. A. -अर्थयति, -ते (more usually A.), -यितुम्, to make fit or ready, prepare; to make capable, main-tain, enforce, exert (e. g. यत्नं समर्थय, make great exertions, exert effort); to establish, sup-port, provide, bestow (Ved., Sāy. समर्थयस्व = सङ्गमय = देहि); to judge of the fitness or propriety of anything, deliberate upon, take into consideration, reflect or think upon, decide on, deter-mine, resolve; to judge, consider, regard, think, imagine, suppose, hold; to suppose, imply, suggest (a possibility &c.); to approve; to expect.
समर्थ: सम्-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a similar or suitable aim or object, having proper aim or force, very forcible or adequate, well adapted (to any purpose), well suited, fit, suitable, proper, regular; capable, compe-tent, adequate; very strong or powerful, able; having the same sense or meaning, having one sense (= तुल्यार्थ, एकार्थ); having the same construction, being in apposition (said of words); having meaning or significance, full of meaning, coherent, significant, intelligible; made fit or proper, prepared, allowed; (अस्), m. a word which has force or meaning, signi-ficant word; the construction or coherence of words together in a significant sentence. —समर्थ-ता, f. or समर्थ-त्व, अम्, n. forcibleness, adequacy, capability, ability, strength, force, power; sameness of meaning, oneness of meaning or sense, force or signification (of words), sense, meaning.
समर्थक: समर्थक, अम्, n. aloe wood, Amyris Agallocha.
समर्थन: सम्-अर्थन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of making capable, giving force or strength, establishing, main-taining, supporting, corroborating, corroboration; de-liberation, determination, determining or deciding on the propriety of anything, judging, considering, supposing, imagining, inferring; adequacy, capability, energy, force, potency, efficacy, ability, perseverance; attempting difficulties or impossibilities; reconciling differences, reconciliation, allaying disputes; object-ing, objection.
समर्थनीय: सम्-अर्थनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be maintained or established; to be determined or considered.
समर्थयत्: सम्-अर्थयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, maintaining, regard-ing, considering, reflecting on.
समर्थित: सम्-अर्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, maintained, established; taken into consideration, considered, judged, regarded, held; resolved, determined.
समर्थितवत्: समर्थित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has judged or considered, &c.
समर्थ्य: सम्-अर्थ्य, ind. having deliberated, having con-sidered, having determined.
समर्द्: समर्द् सम्-अर्द्, Caus. P. -अर्दयति, -यितुम्, to pain greatly, distress, wound.
समर्धक: सम्-अर्धक, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to prosper, &c., granting a blessing or boon.
समर्पण: सम्-अर्पण, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.), the act of delivering or handing completely over, consigning, presenting.
समर्य: 1. समर्य, अस्, अम्, m. n. [cf. सम्-अर; the Pada text, however, divides into स-मर्य], Ved. conflict, battle, war, (in Naigh. II. 17. enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि); sacrifice, (Sāy. = यज्ञ, Ṛg-veda VII. 23, 1.) —समर्य-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. conquering in war, victorious in battle. —सम्-अर्य-राज्य, अम्, n. the dominion of fighting, war, battle.
2. समर्य, Nom. P. समर्यति, &c., to desire battle.
समर्याद: समर्याद स-मर्याद, अस्, आ, अम्, bounded, limited; near, proximate; keeping within bounds or in the right course, correct in conduct; respectful.
समर्ह्: समर्ह् सम्-अर्ह्, Caus. -अर्हयति, -यितुम्, to show honour to, honour, pay respect to.
समल: समल स-मल, अस्, आ, अम्, having dirt, dirty, foul, filthy, muddy, impure; sinful; (अम्), n. excrement, feculent matter, ordure.
समलङ्कृत: समलङ्कृत सम्-अलङ्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, highly decorated, well adorned.
समव्: समव् सम्-अव्, cl. 1. P. -अवति, -अवितुम्, to satisfy, satiate; to protect, maintain, (Sāy. सम्-आवतम् = सम्यग् अरक्षतम्, Ṛg-veda I. 112, 18.)
समवकार: समवकार सम्-अवकार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. कृ with अव and सम्), a species of Rūpaka or drama (described as a representation of mutual combats and heroic action in three acts).
समवकॄ: समवकॄ सम्-अव-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -क-रितुम्, -करीतुम्, to scatter completely over, cover entirely, overwhelm with.
समवक्षिप्: समवक्षिप् सम्-अव-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to cast or thrust away, repel.
समवगम्: समवगम् सम्-अव-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to perceive or understand thoroughly, become thoroughly acquainted with.
समवगुह्: समवगुह् सम्-अव-गुह्, cl. 1. A. -गूहते, गूहितुम्, -गोढुम्, to crouch down, cower; (ac-cording to a Scholiast = देहं सङ्-कुच्।)
समवच्छद्: समवच्छद् सम्-अव-च्छद् (-छद्), cl. 10. P. -च्छादयति, -यितुम्, to cover completely over, con-ceal, obscure: Pass. -च्छाद्यते, to be covered over.
समवच्छन्न: सम्-अवच्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered all over.
समवच्छाद्य: सम्-अवच्छाद्य, ind. having covered completely over.
समवतॄ: समवतॄ सम्-अव-तॄ, cl. 1. P. -तरति, &c., to descend: Caus. -तारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to descend.
समवतार: सम्-अवतार, अस्, m. descent; a descent into a river or sacred bathing-place, a Tīrtha or place of pilgrimage, (Kirāt. V. 7.)
समवदा: समवदा सम्-अव-दा or सम्-अव-दो (see rts. 3. दा, दो), cl. 2. P. -दाति, -दातुम्, to cut up in pieces, divide, distribute; to gather together, collect the pieces, to put together piece by piece.
समवत्त: सम्-अवत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut up, divided into pieces.
समवदाय: सम्-अवदाय, ind. having cut up or distributed.
समवदिश्: समवदिश् सम्-अव-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to point or refer to, to explain with refer-ence to (anything).
समवद्रु: समवद्रु सम्-अव-द्रु, cl. 1. P. A. -द्रवति, -ते, -द्रोतुम्, to run away together.
समवधान: समवधान सम्-अवधान, अम्, n. great attention; preparation.
समवनत: समवनत सम्-अवनत, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. नम् with अव and सम्), completely bent down, bowed, bending down, stooping (to drink water &c.).
समवनी: समवनी सम्-अव-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to lead together, unite; to pour in together.
समवप्लु: समवप्लु सम्-अव-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्, to leap or jump down from.
समवप्लुत: सम्-अवप्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, lept down, jumped off.
समवबुध्: समवबुध् सम्-अव-बुध्, cl. 4. A. -बुध्यते, -बोधितुम्, to perceive clearly, understand fully, know.
समवमृश्: समवमृश् सम्-अव-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति, &c., to lay hold of.
समवरुध्: समवरुध् सम्-अव-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रु-णद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, &c. (ep. also -रुन्धति, &c.), -रोद्धुम्, to shut up, enclose, confine: Pass. -रु-ध्यते, to be enclosed or contained in; to be shut out of, be deprived of.
समवरुद्ध: सम्-अवरुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, shut up, enclosed; obtained.
समवलम्ब्: समवलम्ब् सम्-अव-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते, &c., to lay hold of; to support.
समवलम्ब्य: सम्-अवलम्ब्य, ind. having taken hold of, hav-ing supported.
समवली: समवली सम्-अव-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, &c., to be dissolved.
समवलोक्: समवलोक् सम्-अव-लोक्, cl. 10. P. -लोक-यति, -यितुम्, to look at, observe; to look into, inspect; to look about; to behold, perceive.
समवलोकयत्: सम्-अवलोकयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking at, in-specting, &c.
समववृत्: समववृत् सम्-अव-वृत्, Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to turn towards.
समवशिष्: समवशिष् सम्-अव-शिष्, Pass. of Caus. -शेष्यते, to be left, to remain.
समवशेषित: सम्-अवशेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, left, spared, remaining.
समवश्यान: समवश्यान सम्-अवश्यान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्यै with अव and सम्), gone away, wasted, de-stroyed.
समवसद्: समवसद् सम्-अव-सद्, cl. 1. 6. P. -सीदति, -सत्तुम्, to sink down, pine or waste away, perish.
समवसन्न: सम्-अवसन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sunk down, de-pressed, dispirited, sorrowful.
समवसृज्: समवसृज् सम्-अव-सृज्, cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्, to let go, cast or hurl down upon; to abandon.
समवसर्ग्य: सम्-अवसर्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be let go, to be abandoned, &c.
समवस्कन्द्: समवस्कन्द् सम्-अव-स्कन्द्, Caus. -स्कन्द-यति, -यितुम्, to assail, attack.
समवस्तम्भ्: समवस्तम्भ् सम्-अव-स्तम्भ्, cl. 5. 9. P. -स्तभ्नोति, -स्तभ्नाति, -स्तम्भितुम्, to support, confirm, encourage.
समवस्था: समवस्था 1. सम्-अव-स्था, cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to stand firmly, stand still, stand ready: Caus. -स्थापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to stand firm or still, stop; to establish, found.
2. सम्-अवस्था, f. firm or fixed state or condition; similar condition or state; state or condition (in general).
समवस्थापित: सम्-अवस्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to stand firmly, set up; fully established, founded.
समवस्थित: सम्-अवस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, standing or remaining firm, remaining fixed; staunch, steady; standing ready or prepared, ready; being in any place or position.
समवहित: समवहित सम्-अवहित, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. धा with अव and सम्), closely connected with.
समवाकार: समवाकार सम्-अवाकार, अस्, m. probably incorrect for सम्-अवकार, q. v.
समवाप्: समवाप् सम्-अवाप् (-अव-आप्), cl. 5. P. A. -आप्नोति, -आप्नुते, &c., to meet with, attain, reach, gain, obtain, incur.
समवाप्त: सम्-अवाप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained, attained. —समवाप्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has obtained his desires.
समवाप्ति: सम्-अवाप्ति, इस्, f. attainment, obtaining, getting.
समवाप्य: सम्-अवाप्य, ind. having attained, having gained.
समवार्ज्: समवार्ज् सम्-अवार्ज् (-अव-अर्ज्), cl. 1. P. -अवार्जति, &c., Ved. to leave together.
समवे: समवे सम्-अवे (-अव-इ), cl. 2. P. -अवैति, -अवैतुम्, to come together, meet together, blend or mix together, assemble together, be connected or united.
समवाय: सम्-अवाय, अस्, m. coming or meeting together, conjunction, close combination or union, mixing together, cohesion, connection; a collection, aggre-gate, meeting, concourse, congress, assemblage, mul-titude, quantity; complete or intimate union, con-stant and inseparable connection or cohesion, inse-parable existence or inherence of one thing in another, intimate or material relation (e. g. the relation which exists between a whole and its parts; between cloth and the yarn composing it; between a genus or species and its individuals; between an action or quality and its subject; between particularity and the eternal substances of ether, time, space, soul, &c.; this is one of the seven categories or Padārthas of the Vaiśeṣika system or school of Nyāya philosophy founded by Kaṇāda). —समवाय-तस्, ind. in con-sequence of constant and intimate connection or rela-tion. —समवाय-सम्बन्ध, अस्, m. intimate and constant connection, inseparable relation (as described above), connection by inseparable inherence or co-hesion.
समवायिन्: समवायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, closely and intimately con-nected or united, aggregated; multitudinous; (इ), n. intimate and inseparable cause (as clay of pottery, thread of cloth, &c.). —समवायि-कारण, अम्, n. inseparable cause or connection, cause of constant inherence or cohesion, material cause, substantial cause, (in the Vedānta phil. उपादान-कारण is more commonly used.) —समवायि-त्व, अम्, n. intimate connection or relation.
समवेत: सम्-अवेत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, met toge-ther, met, closely united, mixed, mingled, blended, collected, assembled, intimately connected with or related to, intimately united or inherent; con-tained or comprised or included in a larger number, contained or comprised in anything. —समवेत-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being intimately related or connected. —समवेतार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, containing a meaning, significant, instructive.
समवेत्य: सम्-अवेत्य, ind. having come together, having assembled.
समवेक्ष्: समवेक्ष् सम्-अवेक्ष् (-अव-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -अवेक्षते, &c., to look at, behold, observe, view, look about, look round; to perceive; to consider, regard, notice; to concern one's self about; to reflect or ponder on; to acknowledge: Caus. -अवेक्ष-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to look at or consider.
समवेक्षित: सम्-अवेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, observed, considered.
समवेक्ष्य: सम्-अवेक्ष्य, ind. having viewed, having con-sidered, &c.
समश्: समश् 1. सम्-अश् (see rt. 1. अश्), cl. 5. P. A. -अश्नोति, -अश्नुते, &c., to pervade or penetrate thoroughly, extend through; to obtain, gain, attain; to meet.
समश् 2. सम्-अश्, cl. 9. P. -अश्नाति, -अशितुम्, to eat together, consume; to taste, enjoy.
समश्नुवान: सम्-अश्नुवान, अस्, आ, अम्, completely pervading, extending throughout, spreading over; obtaining, experiencing.
समष्टि: सम्-अष्टि, इस्, f. (in the Vedānta phil.) collective pervasion, a collective aggregate or one which is viewed as consisting of one thing or as constituted of parts of which each is consubstantially the same with the whole, totality; [cf. व्य्-अष्टि।] —सम्-अष्ट्य्-अभिप्राय, अस्, m. the regarding a group of objects collectively.
समशन: सम्-अशन, अम्, n. the act of eating together.
समशनीय: सम्-अशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten together.
समष्ठिल: समष्ठिल सम्-अष्ठिल, अस्, m. (see अष्ठि), a kind of shrub (= कोकाग्र, आम्र-गन्धक).
समष्ठिला: सम्-अष्ठिला, f. a kind of pot-herb or cucumber (= गण्डीर).
समस्: समस् 1. सम्-अस्, cl. 2. P. -अस्ति, to be, exist.

समस् 2. सम्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम् (Ved. Inf. सम्-आसम्), to throw or bring together, join together, combine, compound, mix, mingle, connect: Pass. -अस्यते, to be thrown together or combined, to be compounded; (in grammar) to be compounded, form a compound.
समसन: सम्-असन, अम्, n. the act of throwing together, aggregation, combination, conjunction, compound-ing, composition, formation of compound words; contracting, contraction.

समाधि: सम्-आधि, इस्, m. putting together; collecting or composing the mind, fixing the thoughts, intentness, attentiveness, intent contemplation, profound or ab-stract meditation (especially on the true nature of spirit &c.), perfect absorption of thought into the one object of meditation (i. e. the Supreme Spirit; this is the eighth and last stage of Yoga); intense absorption or contemplation (in general); silence; devotion; a religious vow or self-imposed restraint; composing differences, making up quarrels, recon-cilement; agreement, assent, promise, engagement; making good; requital, retaliation; support, uphold-ing; continuance; completion, accomplishment, con-clusion, demonstrated conclusion; attempting impos-sibilities; perseverance in extreme difficulties; col-lecting or laying up grain in times of dearth; the joint of the neck; a tomb, grave; a Jaina saint of the future age; a particular figure of rhetoric (de-scribed as the coincidence of two events accidentally connected and expressed by a common verb, e. g. सा जगाम अस्तं च भानुमान्, she went away and the sun to its setting). —समाधि-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the breaking or interruption of meditation. —स-माधि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, engaged in meditation, absorbed in contemplation; making a promise, an-nouncing assent or permission. —समाधि-योग, अस्, m. application or employment of religious medita-tion, the efficacy of contemplation. —समाधि-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, abiding in contemplation, absorbed in devout meditation.
समाधिन्: समाधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, absorbed in contemplation, meditating.
समाहित: सम्-आहित, अस्, आ, अम्, placed together, put or fixed together, held together, composed, collected, compiled, accumulated, assembled; comprehended; united, joined, reconciled, adjusted, made up (as a quarrel), set right, put in order, settled, disposed, arranged, repaired; concluded, inferred, demonstrated; agreed upon, assented to; promised; placed or put on, imposed, applied; deposited, entrusted, delivered over; composed or collected (as the thoughts), fixed (in abstract meditation), intently absorbed, very intent on or attentive, abstracted; steadfast, firm, cool, calm; made, effected, accomplished, finished, completed; (अस्), m. a pure or holy man; (अम्), n. great attention or intentness, description of great intentness (as a figure of rhetoric). —समाहित-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the mind fixed in con-templation, absorbed in mind.

समाधूत: सम्-आधूत, अस्, आ, अम्, driven away, dispersed, scattered.

समाबन्ध्: समाबन्ध् सम्-आ-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, -बन्द्धुम्, to bind on, fasten on firmly.

समालम्बन: सम्-आलम्बन, अम्, n. the act of clinging to, laying hold of, leaning or resting on, support.
समालम्बित: सम्-आलम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, suspended; clung to; rested on, supported, upheld, maintained.
समालम्बिन्: सम्-आलम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, clinging to, laying hold, &c.; (ई), m. a particular grass (= भूतृण).
समालम्ब्य: सम्-आलम्ब्य, ind. having suspended; having clung to; having maintained.
समालिख्: समालिख् सम्-आ-लिख्, cl. 6. P. -लिखति, &c., to scratch down, mark down, mark out, write down, delineate.
समालिङ्ग्: समालिङ्ग् सम्-आ-लिङ्ग्, cl. 1. P. A. -लिङ्गति, -ते, &c., to embrace closely, clasp or hold in a firm embrace.
समालिङ्ग्य: सम्-आलिङ्ग्य, ind. having embraced closely; hav-ing clasped firmly.
समालिप्: समालिप् सम्-आ-लिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लिम्पति, -ते, -लेप्तुम्, to anoint all over; to anoint one's self (A.): Caus. -लेपयति, -यितुम्, to anoint or smear over, anoint well.
समालिप्त: सम्-आलिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well anointed or smeared.
समाली: समाली स-माली, f. (fr. 5. स + माला, q. v.), a collection of flowers, nosegay.
समालुड्: समालुड् सम्-आ-लुड्, Caus. -लोडयति, &c., to stir or mix together, stir up, agitate, disturb, confuse; to rummage, investigate.
समालोड्य: सम्-आलोड्य, ind. having stirred or mixed toge-ther; having rummaged.
समालोक्: समालोक् सम्-आ-लोक्, cl. 1. A., 10. P. -लो-कते, -लोकयति, &c., to look at attentively, inspect, view, observe, regard, perceive, consider; to look about, look around; to acknowledge.
समालोक: सम्-आलोक, अस्, m. looking at or considering well.
समालोक्य: सम्-आलोक्य, ind. having looked at or observed thoroughly.
समालोच्: समालोच् सम्-आ-लोच्, cl. 1. A. -लोचते, &c., to look at attentively, consider well or thoroughly.
समालोच्य: सम्-आलोच्य, ind. having looked at or considered well.
समावद्: समावद् सम्-आ-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, &c., to speak with certainty, tell fully; to speak to, tell, say.
समावप्: समावप् सम्-आ-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, &c., to sow or scatter together, mix up together, throw in together: Caus. -वापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be sown or scattered in together or at once.
समावाप्य: सम्-आवाप्य, ind. (fr. the Caus.), having caused to be sown or scattered in together.
समावर्तन: सम्-आवर्तन, अम्, n. the act of turning back, returning; a pupil's return home after finishing his religious studies; the ceremony performed on the above occasion, (see संस्-कार।)
समावलोक्य: समावलोक्य सम्-आवलोक्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लोक् with अव, आ, and सम्), to be perceived or observed.
समावस्: समावस् सम्-आ-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्-तुम्, to dwell in, inhabit, settle in (with acc.); to encamp, lodge, halt; to resort to: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dwell or settle or halt; to pitch a camp, encamp.
समावास: सम्-आवास, अस्, m. a dwelling-place, residence, abode, halting-place, encampment.
समावासित: सम्-आवासित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to dwell or settle, lodged, encamped; sojourned. —समावासित-क-टक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has pitched a camp.
समावह्: समावह् सम्-आ-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, &c., to bear or bring together, bring or convey towards; to procure means of subsistence.
समावाय: समावाय सम्-आवाय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 5. इ with अव, आ, and सम्), association; integral or inseparable connection, (see सम्-अवाय); aggregation, totality; a multitude, number, heap, quantity.
समाविग्न: समाविग्न सम्-आविग्न, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. विज् with आ and सम्), agitated, terrified, trembling greatly.
समाविद्: समाविद् सम्-आ-विद्, Caus. -वेदयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to know thoroughly, inform; to tell, announce, report fully.
समावेद्य: 1. सम्-आवेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be told or commu-nicated fully.
2. सम्-आवेद्य, ind. having announced or reported fully.
समाविश्: समाविश् सम्-आ-विश्, cl. 6. P. -विशति, -वेष्-टुम्, to enter together or at once, enter into, go towards, approach, betake one's self to; to enter thoroughly, take possession of, occupy, penetrate, pervade, engross, fill; to overcome, seize upon; to sit down, settle down, sit down in or on, take up an abode; to go or fall into any state or condition; to apply one's self to, undertake: Caus. -वेशयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to enter together or thoroughly; to cause to enter in, insert; to conduct, lead or bring into; to contain; to place or fix in or on, direct towards; to impose; to deliver over or consign to (with acc. and loc.); to cause to sit down, cause to settle down.
समाविश्य: सम्-आविश्य, ind. having entered together, having entered thoroughly or entirely, having penetrated, &c.
समाविष्ट: सम्-आविष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, entered together, entered entirely or thoroughly, completely occupied or pos-sessed, penetrated, pervaded, filled, seized, overcome, absorbed, engrossed (as by any feeling, passion, &c.); possessed by (an evil spirit), possessed of, endowed with, well instructed in; seated, settled.
समावेश: सम्-आवेश, अस्, m. entering together, coming together, abiding together, meeting, association, co-inherence; entrance, penetration, complete possession; possession by evil spirits, &c.; affection, passion, emotion; (in grammar) applying together, employ-ing a term with a common applicability, common applicability of a term.
समावेशित: सम्-आवेशित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to enter together, brought together, caused to enter, inserted, made to penetrate, brought in or into; placed, fixed, absorbed, engrossed.
समावेश्य: सम्-आवेश्य, ind. having made to enter, having fixed or placed (in any place), having made to settle.
समावृ: समावृ सम्-आ-वृ, cl. 5. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृ-णुते, &c., to cover all over, cover completely, en-velop, encompass, enclose, surround; to conceal, hide; to shut out, shut, close; to obstruct, impede, hinder, stop.
समावृत: सम्-आवृत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered all over, com-pletely covered, enveloped, encompassed, surrounded, enclosed, beset, filled up; overspread; screened, veiled, concealed, hidden; protected, guarded; shut out, excluded, shut, closed, stopped.
समावृत्य: सम्-आवृत्य, ind. having completely covered over, having enclosed or surrounded.
समावृज्: समावृज् सम्-आ-वृज्, cl. 1. P. -वर्जति, cl. 7. P. A. -वृणक्ति, -वृङ्क्ते, &c., to bend or turn down; to bend or turn to one's own use, appropriate (Ved., A.): Caus. -वर्जयति, -यितुम्, to bend down, incline, lower.
समावर्जित: सम्-आवर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, bent down, inclined, turned down, lowered. —समावर्जित-केतु, उस्, उस्, उ, one who has lowered his standard. —समावर्-जित-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the eyes bent down.
समावृत्: समावृत् सम्-आ-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -वर्-तितुम्, to turn or advance towards, approach, come; to come together, assemble; to turn back, come back, return (said especially of a Brahma-cārin or religious student who returns home after completing his studies with a preceptor); to turn out well, suc-ceed; to come to an end, be concluded or completed: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to turn back, cause to return home, dismiss; to put an end to, annihilate, (Sāy. सम्-आवर्तयन्ति = नाशयन्ति, Ṛg-veda VII. 79, 2.)
समावृत्त: सम्-आवृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, assem-bled, returned; completed, ended, concluded; (अस्), m. a pupil who has returned home after completing his studies. —समावृत्त-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has completed a religious vow.
समावृत्तक: सम्-आवृत्तक, अस्, m. a pupil who has returned home.
समावृत्ति: सम्-आवृत्ति, इस्, f. turning back, returning, return; completion.
समावे: समावे सम्-आ-वे, cl. 1. P. A. -वयति, -ते, &c., Ved. to weave together, interweave; to string together (Ved., A.)
समाव्यध्: समाव्यध् सम्-आ-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to move or shake about, agitate.
समाविद्ध: सम्-आविद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken about, agitated.
समाशंस्: समाशंस् सम्-आ-शंस्, cl. 1. A. -शंसते, &c., to wish for, long for, hope for, desire.
समाशङ्कित: समाशङ्कित सम्-आशङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. आ-शङ्क्], very fearful or apprehensive; doubted, doubtful.
समाश्रि: समाश्रि सम्-आ-श्रि, cl. 1. P. A. -श्रयति, -ते, -श्रयितुम्, to go to or have recourse to together (especially for protection), fly to for refuge, seek refuge with, resort to, approach, enter, occupy; to attain to, obtain, assume; to seek, follow, practise; to rest on, depend on, lean on, trust to, confide in.
समाश्रय: सम्-आश्रय, अस्, m. going together to any one for support or shelter, seeking protection; support, protection; a refuge, place of refuge, place of resort or shelter, resting-place, dwelling-place, asylum.
समाश्रित: सम्-आश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, fled to for refuge, resorted to, protected, defended, cherished; going to for protection, resorting to; rested on; depending on, supported by; assuming.
समाश्रित्य: सम्-आश्रित्य, ind. having resorted to for protection or support; having followed or practised or engaged in; resting on, depending upon, trusting to.
समाश्रु: समाश्रु सम्-आ-श्रु, cl. 5. P. A. -शृणोति, -शृणुते, &c., to promise.
समाश्लिष्: समाश्लिष् सम्-आ-श्लिष्, cl. 4. P. -श्लिष्यति, -श्लेष्टुम्, to embrace closely or firmly, to join together, bring near.
समाश्लिष्ट: सम्-आश्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, closely embraced, closely or firmly attached.
समाश्लिष्य: सम्-आश्लिष्य, ind. having closely embraced, hav-ing intwined together.
समाश्लेष: सम्-आश्लेष, अस्, m. a close or firm embrace.
समाश्वस्: समाश्वस् सम्-आ-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति (also cl. 1. P. -श्वसति, see rt. 1. श्वस्), &c., to breathe again, take or recover breath, revive, recover, take courage, (समाश्वसिहि, 2nd sing. Impv. take courage), regain confidence; to trust or confide in (with loc.): Caus. -श्वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to revive, re-animate, encourage, refresh, cheer, comfort, console, calm, make confident.
समाश्वस्त: सम्-आश्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, recovered, revived, re-animated, encouraged, comforted, consoled; trusting, confiding, full of confidence.
समाश्वस्य: सम्-आश्वस्य, ind. having taken confidence, gain-ing courage.
समाश्वास: सम्-आश्वास, अस्, m. recovering breath, relief, comfort, consolation, encouragement; trust, belief, confidence.
समाश्वासन: सम्-आश्वासन, अम्, n. the act of causing to take breath, encouraging, reviving, cheering, comforting, consolation.
समाश्वासित: सम्-आश्वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, reanimated, revived, refreshed, &c.
समाश्वास्य: सम्-आश्वास्य, ind. having reanimated or encou-raged or refreshed, having cheered or comforted.
समास्: समास् 1. समास्, m. (doubtful, except as nom. pl. of 1. समा, q. v.), a year.

समास् 2. सम्-आस्, cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, &c. (see rt. 4. आस्), to sit together; to sit along with, assemble or meet around (with acc. or with inst.); to sit toge-ther in council, hold a council; to be a match for, cope with (with acc.); to sit down, be seated; to join in adhering to or following; to adhere to, observe.
समासीन: सम्-आसीन, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting together, seated together, sitting down.
समास्या: सम्-आस्या, f. (doubtful), sitting together, colloquy, interview.
समासञ्ज्: समासञ्ज् सम्-आ-सञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. -सजति, -सज्-जति, &c. (see rt. 2. सञ्ज्), to fasten or stick toge-ther, to join or attach or fix to; to fix or place on, impose, place down on, resign or deliver over to (with loc.): Pass. -सज्यते, -सज्जते, to cling or adhere closely together, to cling or stick to, become attached to.
समासक्त: सम्-आसक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened or joined toge-ther, attached, united, combined, comprehended; attached to, fixed on (with loc.); reached, attained; affected by.
समासक्ति: सम्-आसक्ति, इस्, f. sticking or adhering closely together, union; attachment, affection; compre-hension, inclusion.
समासङ्ग: सम्-आसङ्ग, अस्, m. adhering together, attach-ment, &c.
समासजत्: सम्-आसजत् or (according to some) सम्-आसज्जत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, joining or connecting with; attaching, adhering to.
समासज्य: सम्-आसज्य, ind. having attached together, having fixed or placed on, having delivered over or con-signed to (with loc.).
समासञ्जन: सम्-आसञ्जन, अम्, n. (according to some also written सम्-आसज्जन), the act of attaching or unit-ing together, joining, union; connection, combina-tion, contact.
समासद्: समासद् सम्-आ-सद्, cl. 1. 10. P. -सीदति, सादयति, &c. (see rt. 1. सद्), to go to or approach together, go towards; to go against, encounter, assail, attack; to attain, obtain, meet with, find, recover.
समासन्न: सम्-आसन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, approached, attained, obtained; met with, found; near, proximate.
समासादन: सम्-आसादन, अम्, n. the act of approaching, meeting with, attaining, obtaining, finding; effecting, accomplishing.
समासादित: सम्-आसादित, अस्, आ, अम्, approached; assailed, encountered; met with, attained, obtained; accom-plished, effected, finished, performed, done.
समासाद्य: 1. सम्-आसाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, attainable, obtainable, procurable, to be effected.
2. सम्-आसाद्य, ind. having encountered; having met with or obtained.
समासृज्: समासृज् सम्-आ-सृज्, cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्, to let go or abandon completely, resign, deliver over, consign; to place or put down upon.
समासर्जन: सम्-आसर्जन, अम्, n. the act of resigning or abandoning completely, delivering over, abandon-ment, consignment.
समासृज्य: सम्-आसृज्य, ind. having resigned or consigned.
समासृष्ट: सम्-आसृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, delivered over, made over, consigned, given.
समासेव्: समासेव् सम्-आ-सेव्, cl. 1. A. -सेवते, &c., to practise or perform assiduously; to pursue, follow, addict one's self to; to enjoy; to employ; to serve, honour, gratify.
समासेवन: सम्-आसेवन, अम्, n. the act of practising, follow-ing, addicting one's self to, employing, serving.
समासेवित: सम्-आसेवित, अस्, आ, अम्, practised, followed, em-ployed, served.
समासेव्य: सम्-आसेव्य, ind. having practised, having em-ployed, &c.
समास्कन्द्: समास्कन्द् सम्-आ-स्कन्द्, cl. 1. P. -स्कन्दति, -स्कन्तुम्, to assail, attack.
समास्तृ: समास्तृ सम्-आ-स्तृ, cl. 5. or सम्-आ-स्तॄ, cl. 9. P. A. -स्तृणोति, -स्तृणुते, -स्तृणाति, -स्तृणीते, &c., to spread entirely over, cover over; to extinguish.
समास्था: समास्था सम्-आ-स्था, cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to undergo, undertake, practise, per-form, engage in; to employ, use, apply, exert: Caus. -स्थापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be performed or practised.
समास्थ: सम्-आस्थ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सम् + आस्था), being in a prosperous condition.
समास्थाप्य: सम्-आस्थाप्य, ind. having caused to be performed; having duly observed, paying proper regard to; having placed one's self on a seat, having sat down.
समास्थाय: सम्-आस्थाय, ind. having practised or engaged in.
समास्थित: सम्-आस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, undergone, engaged in, practised; having recourse to; seated together, seated.
समाहन्: समाहन् सम्-आ-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्-तुम्, to strike together; to unite, join; to strike violently, strike down completely, strike, beat, slay, kill.
समाहत: सम्-आहत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck together; com-pletely struck down, well beaten, wounded, killed.
समाहत्य: सम्-आहत्य, ind. having struck down; having struck or killed.
समाहूत: समाहूत सम्-आहूत, सम्-आहूय। See below under सम्-आ-ह्वे।
सम्-आहूत, अस्, आ, अम्, collected together, con-voked, invited.
समाहृ: समाहृ सम्-आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to bring together, combine, collect, accu-mulate, assemble, compile; to draw together, con-tract, abridge; to crush together, destroy, annihilate; to bring back, restore; to offer up, offer.
समाहरण: सम्-आहरण, अम्, n. the act of bringing toge-ther, collecting, collection, accumulation, uniting, combination, composition.
समाहरत्: सम्-आहरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing together, collecting, contracting, &c.
समाहर्तृ: सम्-आहर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who collects toge-ther or accumulates, a collector.
समाहार: सम्-आहार, अस्, m. collection, accumulation, ag-gregation, assemblage, union by association; con-traction, abridgement; composition of words (in grammar); conjunction of words or sentences (as by the particle ‘and’); epithet of a particular subdivision of Dvandva and Dvigu compounds, (applied to the former when the last part of the compound is in the neuter gender, e. g. अहि-नकुलम्, the snake and the ichneumon; to the latter when the com-pound expresses an aggregate, e. g. त्रि-लोकी, the aggregate of three worlds); a combination of two letters of the alphabet into a syllable (= प्रत्य्-आहार, q. v.).
समाहृत: सम्-आहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought together, col-lected, accumulated, assembled, combined, compiled; abundant, much; contracted, abridged; accepted, received, taken.
समाहृति: सम्-आहृति, इस्, f. collection, compilation, abridge-ment.
समाह्वे: समाह्वे सम्-आ-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते, -ह्वातुम्, to call together, convoke; to call upon, invoke, summon, challenge, provoke to battle; to invite; to call, name.
समाहूय: सम्-आहूय, ind. having called together, having summoned.
समाह्व: सम्-आह्व, अस्, ई, m. f. calling out, mutual calling, challenge; defiance; (आ), f. appellation, name; a kind of plant (= गो-जिह्वा).
समाह्वय: सम्-आह्वय, अस्, m. calling out, challenging; single combat, war, battle; setting animals to fight for sport, a match with fighting-cocks, &c., betting or gambling with living creatures (as distinguished from gaming with dice or other inanimate objects, see द्यूत); an appellation, name.
समाह्वान: सम्-आह्वान, अम्, n. calling together, calling, convoking, summoning, provocation, challenge.
समि: समि 1. सम्-इ (see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. -एति, -एतुम्, to go or come together, meet together, assemble; to meet or be united with (with acc. or inst. or dat.); to meet any one (inst.) in hostile encounter; to come together or be united sexually; to be joined or united together (generally); to go or come to, arrive at, approach, visit, enter, reach, attain; to enter upon, commence; to lead to; to agree with, harmonize with (with inst.): Pass. -ईयते, to be united; to be resorted to or frequented by; to be agreed upon: Intens., Ved. -ईयते, to go repeat-edly, traverse frequently; to present one's self, be manifested.
समि 2. समि, apparently an old loc. con-nected with 2. सम्। See सम्य्-अञ्च्।
समित्: सम्-इत्, त्, f. conflict, war, battle. —समित्-पाणि, इस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śaṅkarācārya.
समित: सम्-इत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, met; col-lected, assembled; united with, conjoined, connected; coming into contact, contiguous, parallel; promised, agreed, assented to; finished, completed.
समिति: 1. सम्-इति, इस्, f. coming together, meeting, assem-bling, union, association; Association or Society (per-sonified as a daughter of Prajā-pati); an assembly, company; encounter, hostile meeting, war, battle, (enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि in Naigh. II. 17); sameness, likeness, equality, (in this and the following sense probably to be con-nected with 1. सम); moderation, (एषण-स-मिति, moderation in desires); one of the five Jaina rules of life, irreproachable conduct as an ascetic [cf. भाषा-स्°]. —समितिञ्-जय, अस्, आ, अम्, conquering or eminent in an assembly. —समिति-शोभन, अस्, आ, अम्, conspicuous in fight or battle.
समिति 2. सम्-इति, ind. a sacred verse be-ginning with सम्।
समिथ: सम्-इथ, अस्, अम्, m. n. war, battle (= सङ्-ग्राम, Naigh. II. 17); fire; offering oblations with fire.
समीयिवस्: सम्-ईयिवस्, आन्, -युषी, अत्, one who has met or encountered; one who has gone to or arrived at or resorted to; one who has attained.
समिक: समिक समिक, अम्, n. (see समीक), a pike, javelin, dart.
समिङ्ग्: समिङ्ग् सम्-इङ्ग्, Caus. -इङ्गयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to move or throb, agitate, shake about.
समिता: समिता समिता, f. [cf. समीद], wheat-flour; [cf. Gr. σεμίδαλις; Lat. simila, similago.]
समित्र: समित्र स-मित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, attended by a friend, along with a friend.
समिनक्ष्: समिनक्ष् सम्-इनक्ष् (see इनक्ष्), -इनक्-षति, Ved. to wish to obtain, strive to reach, be desirous of.
समिन्ध्: समिन्ध् सम्-इन्ध्, cl. 7. A. -इन्द्धे or -इन्धे, &c., to light up, kindle, ignite; to glorify; to kindle (figuratively), inflame, excite; to take fire: Pass. -इध्यते, to be kindled, take fire, break out into flame.

समिध्: सम्-इध्, त्, f. fuel, wood, a log of wood, fire-wood, grass &c. employed as fuel, (seven Samidhs, or sometimes three times seven, are mentioned, as well as seven Yonis, seven flames, &c.); a division of a stanza, (Ved., Sāy. = पाद।) —समिद्-आधान, अम्, n. the placing on of wood or fuel (for the obla-tion to fire). —समिद्-धोम, अस्, m. (i. e. समिध्-होम), an oblation of fuel (to fire). —समिद्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having fuel, supplied with fuel.
समिधान: सम्-इधान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. kindled, lighted (= सम्-इध्यमान).
समिध्य: 2. समिध्य, Nom. P. समिध्यति, &c., to wish for fuel.
समिध्यमान: सम्-इध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being kindled or ignited.
समिन्धन: सम्-इन्धन, अम्, n. the act of kindling; fuel, fire-wood; (अस्), m. a proper N.
समिन्धान: सम्-इन्धान, अस्, आ, अम्, kindling, inflaming; augmenting, prospering.
समेद्धृ: सम्-एद्धृ, धा, m., Ved. one who kindles, kindling.
समिन्व्: समिन्व् सम्-इन्व्, cl. 6. P. -इन्वति, -इन्वितुम्, Ved. to impart, bestow; to spread through, (Sāy. समिन्वतु = व्याप्नोतु = प्रापयतु, Ṛg-veda IV. 53, 7); to restore.
समिर: समिर सम्-इर, अस्, m. = सम्-ईर, wind, air, (see सम्-ईर्।)
समीक: समीक समीक, अम्, n. (perhaps connected with सम्य्-अञ्च्), war, battle, (in Naigh. II. 17. स-मीके is enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि); a pike, dart; (अस्), m. a proper N.
समीकरण: समीकरण समी-करण, समी-कृ, &c. See p. 1067, col. 1.
समीक्ष्: समीक्ष् सम्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षि-तुम्, to look at or inspect thoroughly, investigate closely, view, perceive, see; to look about for, look around; search for; to look towards, look to; to consider well, inquire into, investigate, examine, contemplate, reflect upon: Caus. P. A. -ईक्षयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to look at or perceive.
समीक्ष: सम्-ईक्ष, अम्, n. complete investigation; the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy; (आ), f. thorough or close inspection; looking well at, consideration, (अ-समीक्षम्, inconsiderately); investigation, search; the Mīmāṃsā system of philosophy or any work examining Vedic ritual and explaining the modes of sacrifice; understanding, intellect; effort; essential nature or truth (= तत्त्व, q. v.); any essential princi-ple (according to the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy).
समीक्षण: सम्-ईक्षण, अम्, n. the act of looking at or inspecting thoroughly; looking about for, search, close investigation.
समीक्षमाण: सम्-ईक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at or con-sidering attentively.
समीक्षित: सम्-ईक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, well looked at; per-ceived, considered, investigated.
समीक्ष्य: 1. सम्-ईक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at or considered; to be investigated (in phil.).

समीक्ष्यमाण: सम्-ईक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being looked at or well considered.
समीच: समीच समीच, अस्, m. (fr. सम्य्-अञ्च्), the ocean; (ई), f. a female deer, doe; praise, eulogium.
समीचक: समीचक, अस्, m. sexual union, copulation.
समीचीन: समीचीन, अस्, आ, अम्, tending in a common direction, going with or in company with, agreeing with, concordant, consistent, convenient, fit, proper, correct, true, just, right; (अम्), n. propriety, fitness, truth.
समीद: समीद समीद, अस्, m. fine wheat-flour; [cf. समिता।]
समीन: समीन समीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. समा), yearly, annual, relating to a year; hired for a year; after a year, a year hence.
समीनिका: समीनिका, f. a cow calving every year.
समीप: समीप समीप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सम्-आप्), near, contiguous, proximate, adjacent, close by, at hand; (अम्), n. proximity, vicinity; (ए), ind. in the vicinity, in the presence of, towards. —समीप-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going near. —समीप-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced near, growing near. —समीप-तस्, ind. in the vicinity of, in the presence of, near, before. —समीप-ता, f. or समीप-त्व, अम्, n. nearness, contiguity, proximity. —समीप-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or समीप-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being or situated near, living near, adjoining, neighbouring. —समीपोप-गत (°प-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, approached near.
समीर्: समीर् सम्-ईर्, Caus. P. A. -ईरयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to move about, agitate; to move, stir up, excite, rouse; to lift up, raise up, revive; to send forth, emit, utter (a sound &c.); to throw, cast; to bring about, accomplish; to confer, bestow, endow with.
समीर: सम्-ईर, अस्, m. air, wind; the Samī tree; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.

समीरित: सम्-ईरित, अस्, आ, अम्, stirred, moved, roused, sent forth, emitted, uttered; cast, tossed, thrown.
समीर्ण: सम्-ईर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, moved about, moved, &c.; [cf. सम्-ऋ।]
सम्-ईर्ण, referred to सम्-ॠ by Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 1, 102.
समीष्: समीष् सम्-ईष्, cl. 1. A. -ईषते, Ved. to become extended or lengthened out.
समीषित: सम्-ईषित, अस्, आ, अम्, extended, stretched out, lengthened.
समीह्: समीह् सम्-ईह्, cl. 1. A. -ईहते, -ईहितुम्, to strive after (with acc.), endeavour to gain, long after, desire to accomplish, wish for, desire, hope for.
समीहा: सम्-ईहा, f. striving after, longing for, desire.
समीहित: सम्-ईहित, अस्, आ, अम्, longed or wished for, desired; undertaken; (अम्), n. great effort to obtain anything, desire, longing, wish.
समुक्ष्: समुक्ष् 1. सम्-उक्ष् (see rt. 1. उक्ष्), cl. 6. P. -उक्षति, -उक्षितुम्, to sprinkle well or thoroughly, wet; to besprinkle, strew, scatter or pour over, pour out; to confer, endow.
समुक्षण: सम्-उक्षण, अम्, n. the act of sprinkling or pouring over, shedding, effusion.
समुक्षित: 1. सम्-उक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, besprinkled, scattered, strewed, covered; poured out, effused.

समुख: समुख स-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्, talkative, lo-quacious, eloquent.
समुच्: समुच् सम्-उच्, cl. 4. P. -उच्यति (Perf. -उवोच), -उचितुम्, Ved. to delight in (with inst.); to like to combine or blend with, (Sāy. = सम्-उच्यसि = सङ्गच्छसि, Ṛg-veda V. 81, 4.)
समुचित: सम्-उचित, अस्, आ, अम्, liked; well suited, suit-able, fit, right, proper; appropriate, worthy; accus-tomed, used.
समुच्चर्: समुच्चर् सम्-उच्-चर् (-उद्-चर्), cl. 1. P. -च-रति, -चरितुम्, to go out together; to go up, be borne upwards, ascend.
समुच्चर: सम्-उच्चर, अस्, आ, अम्, going or coming forth together; going upwards, ascending, flying upwards; traversing.
समुच्चरत्: सम्-उच्चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going or coming out together; rising upwards together, ascending.

समुच्चीयमान: सम्-उच्चीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being aggregated or conjoined.

समुच्छेद: सम्-उच्छेद, अस्, m. cutting off completely, destroying, utter destruction or extermination.
समुच्छुष्: समुच्छुष् सम्-उच्-छुष् (-उद्-शुष्), cl. 4. P. -छुष्यति, -छोष्टुम्, to be or become completely dried up.

समुज्ज्वलत्: सम्-उज्ज्वलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining very brightly.

समुत्कृत्: समुत्कृत् सम्-उत्-कृत् (-उद्-क्°), cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut off or cut away entirely, cut in pieces.
