समुत्खन्: समुत्खन् सम्-उत्-खन् (-उद्-ख्°), cl. 1. P. A. -खनति, -ते, &c., to dig up by the roots, eradi-cate, exterminate or destroy utterly.
समुत्तेजन: सम्-उत्तेजन, अम्, n. the act of exciting or in-flaming greatly, inciting, irritating.
समुत्तेजित: सम्-उत्तेजित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly excited or in-flamed, incited, excited, irritated.
समुत्तॄ: समुत्तॄ सम्-उत्-तॄ (-उद्-तॄ), cl. 1. P. -तरति, &c., to pass out of, come out of (with abl., e. g. जलात्, out of the water); to rise or come forth from; to pass safely out of, escape; to pass through, go through, break through, pass over or beyond, cross over, cross.
समुत्तरत्: सम्-उत्तरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, passing out of, com-ing forth from, passing over or beyond, crossing.
समुत्तीर्ण: सम्-उत्तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, come forth from; escaped from; passed through, crossed, landed, &c.
समुत्तीर्य: सम्-उत्तीर्य, ind. having passed out of or come forth from, having passed through, &c.
समुत्त्रस्त: सम्-उत्त्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly frightened, greatly alarmed or terrified.
समुत्था: समुत्था सम्-उत्-था (-उद्-स्था), cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -थातुम्, to rise up together, rise up, arise; to return to life: Caus. -थापयति, -यि-तुम्, to raise up together, raise up, elevate, erect; to re-animate, revive, restore to life.
समुत्थ: सम्-उत्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, rising up, risen; arising, arisen or produced from; occurring, occasioned.
समुत्थान: सम्-उत्थान, अम्, n. the act of rising up toge-ther, rising up, rising; recovering from sickness or injury, perfect cure, healing of a wound or sore; increase, increment, advance, growth; performance of work, active occupation, effort, industry, (सम्-भूय समुत्थान, the performance of work or engaging in business after uniting with others, co-operation, partnership); indication or symptom of disease. —समुत्थान-व्यय, अस्, m. the ex-pense of recovery or cure.
समुत्थाप्य: सम्-उत्थाप्य, ind. having raised up, having made or helped to stand up.
समुत्थाय: सम्-उत्थाय, ind. having risen up, having arisen.
समुत्थित: सम्-उत्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, risen up together, started up, risen, raised; recovered, cured, healed; swollen up; increased; arisen, produced; derived, obtained.
समुत्पट्: समुत्पट् सम्-उत्-पट् (-उद्-प्°), cl. 10. P. -पाटयति, -यितुम्, to tear completely out, tear out by the roots, root up, tear off; to draw out; to tear away, detach, sever; to expel, dethrone.
समुत्पाट: सम्-उत्पाट, अस्, m. tearing completely out or away, rooting up, eradication; tearing away from, severing, detaching.
समुत्पाटित: सम्-उत्पाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn up by the roots; torn completely away, severed, detached.
समुत्पाट्य: सम्-उत्पाट्य, ind. having torn completely out or away.
समुत्पत्: समुत्पत् सम्-उत्-पत् (-उद्-प्°), cl. 1. P. -प-तति, -पतितुम्, to fly up together, fly upwards, jump up, start up, spring up, rise, ascend, arise, be produced; to rush out of, gush out; rush forth, break forth; to fly away, depart, disappear; to rush upon, attack, assail.
समुत्पतत्: सम्-उत्पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying up together, flying upwards, ascending.
समुत्पतन: सम्-उत्पतन, अम्, n. the act of flying up toge-ther, flying upwards, going upwards, ascending; making effort, energy, exertion.
समुत्पतित: सम्-उत्पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, flown up together, flown upwards, ascended, sprung up, springing up-wards; flown away, gone, departed, disappeared; exerted.
समुत्पत्य: सम्-उत्पत्य, ind. having flown upwards; having flown away; having gushed out.
समुत्पिपतिषु: सम्-उत्पिपतिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), about to start up or spring up.
समुत्पद्: समुत्पद् सम्-उत्-पद् (-उद्-प्°), cl. 4. A. -पद्-यते, -पत्तुम्, to spring up together; to spring up, arise, come forth; to be brought forth or born or produced, happen, come to pass, occur, take place; to present one's self: Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to arise, produce, effect, cause.
समुत्पत्ति: सम्-उत्पत्ति, इस्, f. arising together, arising, pro-duction, birth, orgin; formation, occurrence, inci-dence.
समुत्पन्न: सम्-उत्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung up together, arisen, produced, born, effected, excited; occurred, happened, occurring, taking place.
समुत्पादन: सम्-उत्पादन, अम्, n. the act of bringing forth, producing; effecting, fabricating.
समुत्पादित: सम्-उत्पादित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought forth, pro-duced, effected, caused, formed.
समुत्पिञ्ज: समुत्पिञ्ज सम्-उत्पिञ्ज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. पिञ्ज् with उद् and सम्), excessively confused or con-founded, bewildered, disturbed, overcome; (अस्), m. an army in great disorder; complete confusion.
समुत्पिञ्जलक: सम्-उत्पिञ्जलक, अस्, m. excessive confusion or disorder.
समुत्पिष्: समुत्पिष् सम्-उत्पिष्, cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि, &c., to crush or squeeze together; to grind to pieces.
समुत्पिष्ट: सम्-उत्पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed or squeezed together; greatly crushed.
समुत्पीडन: समुत्पीडन सम्-उत्पीडन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. पीड् with उद् and सम्), the act of pressing together, com-pression, pressing; great pressure or distress.
समुत्पॄ: समुत्पॄ सम्-उत्-पॄ, Caus. -पारयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to spread out, stretch out, stretch forth.
समुत्प्लु: समुत्प्लु सम्-उत्-प्लु (-उद्-प्°), cl. 1. A. -प्ल-वते, -प्लोतुम्, to jump or leap up together, spring up.
समुत्प्लुत्य: सम्-उत्प्लुत्य, ind. having jumped or leaped up.
समुत्सद्: समुत्सद् सम्-उत्-सद्, Caus. P. -सादयति, -यितुम्, to destroy utterly, overturn, overthrow.
समुत्सव: समुत्सव सम्-उत्सव, अस्, m. a great festival or festivity.
समुत्सह्: समुत्सह् सम्-उत्-सह्, Caus. P. -साहयति, -यितुम्, to encourage or exhort together, animate, incite.
समुत्साह्य: सम्-उत्साह्य, ind. having encouraged or exhorted.
समुत्सुक: समुत्सुक सम्-उत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम्, very un-easy or anxious, very agitated, anxiously desirous, longing for (an absent person), eager for, fond of, attached to; regretting, missing, grieving for, sor-rowful. —समुत्सुक-त्व, अम्, n. sorrow, regret, longing desire.
समुत्सुकय: सम्-उत्सुकय, Nom. P. -उत्सुकयति, -यितुम्, to cause to long for, cause to be fond of, make attached to.
समुत्सृ: समुत्सृ सम्-उत्-सृ (-उद्-सृ), Caus. P. -सार-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to move away, drive away; to give away.
समुत्सारण: सम्-उत्सारण, अम्, n. the act of expelling or driving to a distance, driving away; pursuing, hunt-ing.
समुत्सृज्: समुत्सृज् सम्-उत्-सृज् (-उद्-स्°), cl. 6. P. -सृ-जति, -स्रष्टुम्, to pour out or shed forth together, pour out, shed; to send forth, give forth, cast forth, let go, let loose, dismiss; to leave or abandon or lay aside completely; to put off; to lose; to place or put down, throw forth or away.
समुत्सर्ग: सम्-उत्सर्ग, अस्, m. pouring out or shedding forth together, casting or giving forth, giving away; leaving, abandoning; evacuation (of the bowels or bladder), feculent discharge.
समुत्सृजत्: सम्-उत्सृजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, letting loose, letting go.
समुत्सृज्य: सम्-उत्सृज्य, ind. having wholly abandoned or given up, having cast away.
समुत्सृष्ट: सम्-उत्सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, altogether poured or shed forth, cast forth, given away; let loose, wholly given up or abandoned.
समुत्सृप्: समुत्सृप् सम्-उत्-सृप् (-उद्-स्°), cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, &c., to glide or soar upwards together; to go upwards, ascend, rise.
समुत्सेध: समुत्सेध सम्-उत्सेध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. सिध् with उद् and सम्), elevation, height; swelling up, intumescence, fatness, thickness.
समुद्: समुद् सम्-उद् or सम्-उन्द्, cl. 7. P. -उनत्ति, -उन्दितुम्, to moisten thoroughly, sprinkle all over, water, wet.
समुद्र: 1. सम्-उद्र, अस्, m. [cf. उद्र, अन्-उद्र], the waters above the firmament, the aerial ocean or sky (Ved.; in Naigh. 1. 3. enumerated among the अन्-तरिक्ष-नामानि); a collection of water, sea, ocean, (seven seas are enumerated in Viṣṇu-Purāṇa II. 4, viz. the sea of Lavaṇa, ‘salt-water;’ Ikṣu, ‘sugar-cane juice or syrup;’ Surā, ‘wine;’ Ghṛta, ‘clarified butter;’ Dadhi, ‘curds;’ Dugdha, ‘milk;’ Jala, ‘fresh water’); a symbolical expression for the num-ber four (the number of oceans being only four, according to one reckoning); the Ocean (personified and represented as the king of rivers); epithet of Śiva; a kind of metre; N. of a place; of a work; (अस्, आ, अम्), Ved. having a collection of water, watery, flowing; (आ), f. the plant called zedoary (= सटी); the Śamī tree. —समुद्र-कफ, अस्, m. ‘sea-foam,’ cuttle-fish bone. —समुद्र-कान्ता, f. ‘sea-beloved,’ a river. —समुद्र-कुक्षि, इस्, f. the shore of the ocean. —समुद्र-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, ocean-going, sea-faring; flowing towards the ocean; (अस्), m. a sea-farer, seaman; sea-trader; (आ), f. a river. —समुद्र-गमन, अम्, n. going or voyag-ing by sea; sea-roving. —समुद्र-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sea-going, sea-faring. —समुद्र-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Gupta dynasty. —समुद्र-गृह, अम्, n. a sort of summer-house built in the midst of water (= जल-यन्त्र-गृह, q. v.). —स-मुद्र-चुलुक, अस्, m. ‘holding a mouthful of the ocean,’ epithet of the sage Agastya (fabled to have drunk up the ocean). —समुद्र-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, sea-born, produced in the sea. —समुद्र-तट, अम्, n. the sea-coast. —समुद्र-तीर, अम्, n. the sea-shore. —समुद्र-दयिता, f. ‘sea-beloved,’ a river. —समुद्र-नवनीत, अम्, n. ‘ocean-butter,’ nectar or ambrosia (= अ-मृत); the moon (as produced or recovered at the churning of the ocean). —स-मुद्र-नेमि, इस्, इस्, इ, encircled or surrounded by the ocean. —समुद्र-फल, अम्, n. ‘sea-fruit,’ a particular drug or medicament. —समुद्र-फेन, अस्, m. ‘sea-foam,’ cuttle-fish bone; [cf. फेन।] —समुद्र-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the ocean, produced from or in the sea. —समुद्र-मेखला, f. ‘sea-girdled,’ the earth. —समुद्र-यात्रा, f. a sea-voyage. —समुद्र-यान, अम्, n. a sea-voyage; a vessel, ship, boat. —समुद्र-यायिन्, ई, m. a sea-farer, mariner, sailor, navigator, sea-trader. —समुद्र-योषित्, त्, f. ‘sea-wife,’ a river. —समुद्र-रशना or समुद्र-रसना, f. ‘sea-girdled,’ the earth. —समुद्र-लवण, अम्, n. sea-salt. —समुद्र-वर्णन, अम्, n. ‘description of the ocean,’ N. of the sixty-eighth chapter of the Sundara-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa. —समुद्र-वसना, f. ‘sea-clothed,’ the earth. —समुद्र-वह्नि, इस्, m. submarine fire. —समुद्र-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. ‘sea-clothed,’ enveloped by the ocean, surrounded by the sea. —समुद्र-विजय, अस्, m., N. of the father of the twenty-second Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī. —समुद्र-वेला, f. the ocean-tide; an ocean-wave, wave of the sea. —समुद्र-व्यचस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. extensive or expanded as the ocean. —समु-द्र-शोष, अस्, m. the creeping-plant Convolvulus Argenteus. —समुद्र-सुभगा, f. ‘ocean-favourite,’ the Ganges. —समुद्र-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a king. —समुद्र-स्नान, अम्, n. ablution in the sea. —समुद्रान्त (°र-अन्°), अम्, n. the sea-shore; nutmeg; (आ), f. the shrub Alhagi Maurorum (= दुर्-आलभा); the cotton plant; the plant Trigo-nella Corniculata; another plant (= यवास). —स-मुद्राम्बरा (°र-अम्°), f. ‘sea-clothed,’ the earth. —समुद्राम्भस् (°र-अम्°), अस्, n. sea-water. —समुद्रारु (°र-अरु or -आरु), उस्, m. a croco-dile, shark; a large fabulous fish (= तिमिङ्-गिल); Rāma's bridge or the ridge of rocks between India and Ceylon. —समुद्रार्थ (°र-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. tending to the sea. —समुद्रोपप्लुत (°र-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, inundated or submerged by the ocean.
समुद्र 1. समुद्र, अस्, m. the ocean, &c. See under सम्-उद्, p. 1079, col. 1.
समुद्र 2. स-मुद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having a stamp or seal, stamped, sealed; having marks.
समुद्रिय: समुद्रिय or समुद्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or generated in the firmament, aerial, (in Ṛg-veda X. 65, 13. the form समुद्रियः, acc. pl. fem., occurs); marine, oceanic, maritime, living in the ocean.
समुद्र्य: समुद्र्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = समुद्रिय above.
समुन्दन: सम्-उन्दन, अम्, n. the act of thoroughly moist-ening or sprinkling; moisture, damp, wetness.
समुन्न: सम्-उन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, well moistened or sprin-kled, thoroughly wetted or watered, very wet or moist, moistened.
समुदक्त: समुदक्त सम्-उदक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अञ्च् with उद् and सम्), lifted up, raised up, thrown up, drawn up.
समुदागम्: समुदागम् सम्-उद्-आ-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्-छति, -गन्तुम्, to arrive at full or complete know-ledge, understand perfectly.
समुदागत: सम्-उदागत, अस्, आ, अम्, completely known or understood.
समुदागम: सम्-उदागम, अस्, m. full or complete knowledge.
समुदाचर्: समुदाचर् सम्-उद्-आ-चर्, cl. 1. P. A. -च-रति, -ते, &c., to move or travel about (e. g. रथेन, in a chariot); to practise, perform, accomplish, do; to act towards, treat.
समुदाचरत्: सम्-उदाचरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, practising; acting towards, treating.
समुदाचार: सम्-उदाचार, अस्, m. proper or right practice or usage; intention, purpose, design, motive.
समुदावह्: समुदावह् सम्-उद्-आ-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -व-हति, -ते, &c., to lead or conduct out, draw out, carry out; to carry away, carry off; to conduct home, marry.
समुदाहृ: समुदाहृ सम्-उद्-आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, &c., to utter together; to pronounce, declare.
समुदाहरण: सम्-उदाहरण, अम्, n. the act of uttering, de-claring, pronouncing; illustrating, illustration.
समुदाहृत: सम्-उदाहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, declared, uttered; pro-nounced, said, spoken, mentioned, recorded; illus-trated.
समुदि: समुदि सम्-उद्-इ, cl. 2. P. -एति, -एतुम्, to go upwards or rise together; to go up, ascend, rise; to rise up together or prepare for battle; to come toge-ther, collect together in great numbers; to come into the possession (of any one).
समुदय: सम्-उदय, अस्, m. going upwards, rise, ascent, rising (of the sun &c.); coming together, collection, multitude, number, heap, quantity; totality, the whole; revenue; combination, mixture, blending together; effort, exertion, perseverance; war, battle; the rear or reserve of an army; a day; (अम्), n. the rising of a planet, &c.; an auspicious moment (= लग्न).
समुदाय: सम्-उदाय, अस्, m. rise, ascent; a collection, mul-titude, quantity, number, heap, mass, aggregate, whole, totality; a word of more than one syllable; war, battle; the rear or reserve of an army.
समुद्यत्: सम्-उद्यत्, अन्, अती, अत्, ascending, rising.
समुदीक्ष्: समुदीक्ष् सम्-उद्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to look up at; to look at attentively, perceive, observe; to look well up to, confide in, trust in; to respect, honour.
समुदीक्ष्य: सम्-उदीक्ष्य, ind. having looked up at, having looked at or observed.
समुदीर्: समुदीर् सम्-उद्-ईर्, cl. 2. A. ईर्ते, &c., to move upwards; to move about, be agitated, be greatly moved or excited: Caus. -ईरयति, -यितुम्, to cause to move upwards, raise; to cause to move about, agitate, excite, incite, stimulate; to throw; to raise the voice, speak, utter, declare.
समुदीरण: सम्-उदीरण, अम्, n. the act of raising the voice, uttering, declaring, speaking, pronouncing; repeat-ing, reciting.
समुदीरित: सम्-उदीरित, अस्, आ, अम्, set in motion, caused to move, agitated, excited; uttered, said, spoken, declared, recited.
समुदीर्ण: सम्-उदीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly moved or agi-tated, excited. —समुदीर्ण-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated or excited in mind.
समुदीष्: समुदीष् सम्-उद्-ईष्, cl. 1. P. A. -ईषति, -ते, &c., Ved. to rise well upwards, mount quite upwards.
समुद्ग: समुद्ग 1. स-मुद्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having a cover or lid; having beans, filled with beans; (अस्), m. a covered box or casket.

2. सम्-उद्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going up or rising toge-ther, rising, ascending; entirely pervading; (अस्), m. a kind of artificial stanza, (see below.) —समुद्ग-यमक, अम्, n. (in rhetoric) artificially combining words so as to make different parts of a stanza cor-respond in sound but with different senses, (see यमक।)
समुद्गक: 1. स-मुद्गक, अस्, m. a covered box, casket.

2. समुद्गक, अस्, m. a kind of artificial stanza (each half of which corresponds exactly in sound, though the meanings of the words are different, those of one half being respectively adjectives to those of the other; an example occurs in Kirātārjunīya XV. 16).
समुद्गम्: समुद्गम् सम्-उद्-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go up or rise together; to rise up, ascend; to come forth, break forth, issue, exude.
समुद्गत: सम्-उद्गत, अस्, आ, अम्, risen up together, risen, ascended, arisen; rising; breaking forth, issuing, exuding.
समुद्गम: सम्-उद्गम, अस्, m. rising, ascent, arising; issuing; birth, production.

समुपयुक्तवत्: सम्-उपयुक्तवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has consumed.
समुपरुज्: समुपरुज् सम्-उप-रुज्, cl. 6. P. -रुजति, &c., to break or cut up; to press hardly upon.
समुपरुध्: समुपरुध् सम्-उप-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रु-णद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, &c., to hinder greatly, disturb, obstruct: Pass. -रुध्यते, to be hindered or inter-rupted.
समुपलक्ष्: समुपलक्ष् सम्-उप-लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. A. -लक्षयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to look at attentively, observe carefully; to see fully, perceive.
समुपलभ्: समुपलभ् सम्-उप-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते (ep. also P. -लभति), -लब्धुम्, to take or receive fully, obtain, acquire; to acquire by experience, learn, perceive.
समुपवस्: समुपवस् सम्-उप-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to abide wholly in, engage in, devote one's self to; to abide in a state of abstinence, fast.
समुपोषित: सम्-उपोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged in, devoted to; fasting, abstaining.
समुपवह्: समुपवह् सम्-उप-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वोढुम्, to bear or carry along with; to flow with, stream: Pass. -उपोह्यते, to be borne near, approach.
समुपोढ: 1. सम्-उपोढ, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see under सम्-उपोह्), borne or carried along; borne upwards, gone upwards, risen.
2. सम्-उपोढ, अस्, आ, अम् (equally referrible to सम्-उप-वह्), brought near, presented, close at hand; suppressed, restrained; begun.
समुपविश्: समुपविश् सम्-उप-विश्, cl. 6. P. -विशति, -वेष्टुम्, to sit down together, sit down on, take a seat; to sit down near; to lie down upon (with acc.), rest upon; to encamp: Caus. -वेशयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to sit down, ask to be seated; to cause to encamp.
समुपविश्य: सम्-उपविश्य, ind. having sat down together.
समुपविष्ट: सम्-उपविष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, seated together, seated, sat down.
समुपवेश: सम्-उपवेश, अस्, m. sitting down together; asking to sit down or rest, entertaining.
समुपवेशन: सम्-उपवेशन, अम्, n. the act of causing to sit down; a habitation, building.
समुपवेशित: सम्-उपवेशित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to sit down, made to lie down, asked to sit down or rest, received hospitably.
समुपवृंह्: समुपवृंह् सम्-उप-वृंह्, Caus. -वृंहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to increase, augment, strengthen; to complete.
समुपवृत्: समुपवृत् सम्-उप-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, &c., to go together towards, proceed together; to behave.
समुपश्रु: समुपश्रु सम्-उप-श्रु, cl. 5. P. -शृणोति, -श्रोतुम्, to listen to attentively, hear.
समुपसंहृ: समुपसंहृ सम्-उप-सं-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, &c., to withhold entirely, restrain, stop.
समुपसृप्: समुपसृप् सम्-उप-सृप्, cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to creep up together towards, creep up to, go to, go towards, approach; to attack.
समुपसर्पत्: सम्-उपसर्पत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, creeping or crawl-ing near, approaching.
समुपसेव्: समुपसेव् सम्-उप-सेव्, cl. 1. A. -सेवते, -सेवितुम्, to make use of together; to use, enjoy.
समुपस्था: समुपस्था 1. सम्-उप-स्था, cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to stand together in close proximity, come near, go to or towards, approach, attack (with acc.); to occur, arise, befall.
2. सम्-उपस्था, f. standing near, approximation, proximity; happening, befalling.
समुपस्थान: सम्-उपस्थान, अम्, n. approximation, approach; nearness; happening, occurring.
समुपस्थित: सम्-उपस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, standing near, brought near to, approximated, impending; imminent; attained, acquired.
समुपस्पृश्: समुपस्पृश् सम्-उप-स्पृश्, cl. 6. P. -स्पृ-शति, &c., to touch (water) for ablution, use for ablution; to sip water; to bathe.
समुपहृ: समुपहृ सम्-उप-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to bring towards, offer; to perform (a sacrifice).
समुपाकृ: समुपाकृ सम्-उपा-कृ (-उप-आ-), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to satisfy, pay off.
समुपाक्रम्: समुपाक्रम् सम्-उपा-क्रम् (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go up to together, to approach, attain to.
समुपाक्रान्त: सम्-उपाक्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, approached, attained to.
समुपागम्: समुपागम् सम्-उपा-गम् (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go up to together, go near to, go towards, approach, meet; to come upon, incur; to occur, befall; to undergo, go to any state or condition, (see rt. गम्।)
समुपागत: सम्-उपागत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone near to, approached, come together, assembled, met; come upon, incurred; occurred, happening.
समुपाघ्रा: समुपाघ्रा सम्-उपा-घ्रा (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -जिघ्रति, -घ्रातुम्, to smell at; to kiss.
समुपाचर्: समुपाचर् सम्-उपा-चर् (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -चरति, -चरितुम्, to attend, wait on, treat (medi-cally); to practise; to be intent upon anything.
समुपादा: समुपादा सम्-उपा-दा (-उप-आ-), cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, -दातुम्, to give or deliver over (P.); to gain, receive, acquire (A.); to take away from, deprive of (A.); to collect, heap together (A.); to assume, put on (A.).
समुपात्त: सम्-उपात्त, अस्, आ, अम्, acquired; taken away; collected.
समुपादाय: सम्-उपादाय, ind. having delivered over; having acquired; having assumed.
समुपानी: समुपानी सम्-उपा-नी (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to conduct or lead together towards, bring together, gather together, assemble.
समुपानीत: सम्-उपानीत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought together, gathered together.
समुपाया: समुपाया सम्-उपा-या (-उप-आ-), cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go up to together, go towards, come up to, approach, arrive at.
समुपायात: सम्-उपायात, अस्, आ, अम्, come near, approached, arrived.
समुपायुक्त: सम्-उपायुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with, pos-sessed of, surrounded by, full of.
समुपारभ्: समुपारभ् सम्-उपा-रभ् (-उप-आ-, see आ-रभ्), cl. 1. A. -रभते, &c., to begin together, commence.
समुपारब्ध: सम्-उपारब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, begun, commenced, undertaken.
समुपारुह्: समुपारुह् सम्-उपा-रुह् (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -रोहति, &c., to mount up, ascend.
समुपारूढ: सम्-उपारूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, mounted upon, ascended.
समुपार्ज्: समुपार्ज् सम्-उपार्ज् (-उप-अर्ज्), cl. 1. 10. P. -उपार्जति, -उपार्जयति, &c., to bring together, cause to be brought together or prepared; to gain or acquire together.
समुपार्जन: सम्-उपार्जन, अम्, n. the act of gaining or acquiring together, simultaneous acquisition.
समुपार्जित: सम्-उपार्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought together, prepared; acquired, gained; stored up.
समुपाविश्: समुपाविश् सम्-उपा-विश् (-उप-आ-), cl. 6. P. -विशति, -वेष्टुम्, to enter upon together, under-take, begin, commence.
समुपाश्: समुपाश् सम्-उपाश् (-उप-अश्), cl. 9. P. -उपाश्नाति, &c., to taste fully or completely, enjoy.
समुपाश्रि: समुपाश्रि सम्-उपा-श्रि (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -श्रयति, -ते, -श्रयितुम्, to have recourse to together, resort to.
समुपाश्रित: सम्-उपाश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, resorted to, having recourse to.
समुपास्: समुपास् सम्-उपास् (-उप-आस्), cl. 2. A. -उपास्ते, &c., to sit near together or near each other; to engage in or devote one's self to anything toge-ther, practise in common; to serve or honour to-gether.
समुपासीन: सम्-उपासीन, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting near together.
समुपास्था: समुपास्था सम्-उपा-स्था (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, &c., to stand near to; to practise, observe.
समुपे: समुपे सम्-उपे (-उप-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. -उपैति, &c., to come together, assemble, meet; to go towards, go near to, approach, assail, attack; to reach; to fall to the share, come into the possession of; to go to any state or condition, undergo.
समुपेत: सम्-उपेत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, assembled, gone near to, approached, resorted to, visited; arrived at; furnished with, possessed of, endowed with; in-habited by.
समुपेत्य: सम्-उपेत्य, ind. having gone near to, having approached.
समुपेयिवस्: सम्-उपेयिवस्, आन्, -युषी, अत्, one who has gone near or approached; going, proceeding.
समुपेक्ष्: समुपेक्ष् सम्-उपेक्ष् (-उप-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -उपेक्षते (sometimes also P. -ति), -उपेक्षितुम्, to look completely over or beyond, take no notice of, overlook, disregard, neglect, abandon.
समुपोपविष्ट: सम्-उपोपविष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, seated together, sitting down.
समुपोष्: समुपोष् सम्-उपोष् (-उप-उष्), cl. 1. P. -उपोषति, &c., to burn together, consume together, to burn up completely.
समुपोह्: समुपोह् सम्-उपोह् (-उप-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P. A. -उपोहति, -ते, &c., to bring near to, draw towards; to bring into contact with.
समुब्ज्: समुब्ज् सम्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, -उब्जितुम्, to cover over, close up; to press together.
समुब्जित: सम्-उब्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered over, closed up.
समुभ्: समुभ् सम्-उभ्, cl. 9. 7. P. -उभ्नाति, -उनप्ति (Impf. -उनप्), &c., Ved. to confine, shut up, cover up, close up; to strike down, injure, mutilate.
समुब्ध: सम्-उब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, confined, covered up; injured; contracted, shrunk together, (Sāy. = सङ्-कुचित।)
समुल्लङ्घ्: समुल्लङ्घ् सम्-उल्-लङ्घ्, cl. 10. P. -लङ्घ-यति, &c., to leap beyond, violate, transgress, neglect.
समुल्लम्बित: सम्-उल्लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, quite erect, upright; (according to some) hanging.
समुल्लस्: समुल्लस् सम्-उल्-लस् (-उद्-लस्), cl. 1. P. -ल-सति, -लसितुम्, to shine forth brightly, gleam, glitter; to break forth, appear; to jump or dance about, sport, be wanton: Caus. -लासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to jump or sport, exhilarate, make glad.
समुल्लसत्: सम्-उल्लसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining very brightly, brilliant; dancing about, sporting, playing, wan-toning.
समुल्लसित: सम्-उल्लसित, अस्, आ, अम्, shining forth, gleaming, brilliant, beautiful; sportive, sporting.
समुल्लास: सम्-उल्लास, अस्, m. excessive brilliance; sporting, exhilaration.
समुल्लिख्: समुल्लिख् सम्-उल्-लिख् (-उद्-लिख्), cl. 6. P. -लिखति, &c., to scratch up, tear up, dig up, furrow, scarify; to rub against, graze; to write down.
समुल्लिखत्: सम्-उल्लिखत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, scratching up, tearing up.
समुल्लुप्: समुल्लुप् सम्-उल्-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्पति, -ते, &c., Ved. to seize upon, lay hold of, pick up.
समुल्लुप्य: सम्-उल्लुप्य, ind. having seized upon, having caught hold of.
समुष्: समुष् सम्-उष्, cl. 1. P. -ओषति, &c., to burn up or consume by fire.
समूर: समूर समूर, अस्, m. a kind of deer, (see below.)
समूरु: समूरु, उस्, m. a kind of deer (the skin of which may be used as a student's seat, &c.; accord-ing to some it has a white mane).
समूल: समूल स-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a root, along with the root; (अम्), ind. by the roots, with the roots, completely. —समूल-काषम्, ind. strik-ing or shaking (the ground) to its very foundations. —समूल-घातम्, ind. having destroyed by the roots, having utterly exterminated.
समूह्: समूह् सम्-ऊह् (see rt. 1. ऊह्; cf. सं-वह्), cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, -ऊहितुम्, to bring together, gather together, collect, unite; to bring or place back in right order: Caus. -ऊहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be brought together, bring together.
समूह: सम्-ऊह, अस्, m. a collection, assemblage, aggre-gation, aggregate, accumulation, heap, number, mul-titude, quantity. —समूह-कार्य, अम्, n. the business or affairs of a community.
समूहत्: सम्-ऊहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing together, col-lecting, gathering; contracting.
समूहन: सम्-ऊहन, अम्, n. the act of bringing together, collection; plenty; (ई), f. a broom.
समूह्य: 1. सम्-ऊह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought together or assembled or collected; (अस्), m., scil. अग्नि, a kind of sacrificial fire (to be brought or carried by the priest); a place prepared for the reception of a sacrificial fire.
2. सम्-ऊह्य, ind. having brought together or collected or assembled.
समृ: समृ सम्-ऋ or सम्-ॠ, cl. 1. 9. P. -ऋच्छति, ऋणाति (Ved. also cl. 3. 5. P. -इयर्ति, -ऋणोति, -ऋण्-वति, in some forms also A.), &c., to go or come together, meet together, meet, be united, run toge-ther; to come into collision or conflict; to bring together, construct: Caus. -अर्पयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to throw at, hurl at (with acc.), strike, hit; to fix or place in or on, put on, put down, deposit; to deliver completely over, hand over, consign, commit; to place back, give back, restore.
समरण: सम्-अरण, अम्, n., Ved. coming together, ap-proach; conflict, fighting, combat; (in Naigh. II. 17. enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि।)
समराण: सम्-अराण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. coming together.
समर्पणीय: सम्-अर्पणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be delivered or presented, to be made over.
समर्पयत्: सम्-अर्पयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, placing in or on; depositing, delivering over, consigning.
समर्पित: सम्-अर्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, placed or fixed in or on, deposited, resting on, delivered, made over, con-signed, committed; appointed; put together. —सम्-अर्पित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has consigned or delivered over.
समर्यत्: समर्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desiring battle, intent on conflict.
समृत: सम्-ऋत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, met; come into collision, clashing together.
समृति: सम्-ऋति, इस्, f., Ved. coming together, meeting to-gether, contact, (Sāy. = सङ्गम); conflict, fighting.
समृच्: समृच् सम्-ऋच् [cf. सम्-अर्च्], cl. 6. P. -ऋ-चति, &c., to praise, extol, adore, honour, (सम्-आनृचे, he has been lauded; but according to Sāy. = सम्यक् पूजितवान्, he has well honoured, or स्था-पितवान्, he has established, Ṛg-veda 1. 160, 4.)
समृञ्ज्: समृञ्ज् सम्-ऋञ्ज्, cl. 6. P. A. -ऋञ्जति, -ते, &c., to strive together or unite together for any object (with loc.); to promote well or together, (Sāy. = सम्यक् प्रसाधयति, Ṛg-veda 1. 6, 9.)
समृध्: समृध् 1. सम्-ऋध्, cl. 4. 5. P. -ऋध्यति, -ऋध्नोति, &c., to succeed well, be very successful, prosper, flourish, increase or grow greatly: Pass. -ऋध्यते, to be completely successful, be fulfilled or accomplished, succeed, prosper; to share in abun-dantly, be fully furnished with (with inst.): Caus. -अर्धयति, -यितुम्, to cause to succeed or prosper; to cause to be fulfilled; to cause to be abundantly furnished with.
2. सम्-ऋध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. very prosperous, (Sāy. = सम्-ऋद्ध, Ṛg-veda VI. 2, 10.)
समृद्ध: सम्-ऋद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, very prosperous, thriv-ing, flourishing, happy, fortunate; full-grown, in-creased, grown, accelerated; fully furnished with, abundantly endowed with, rich in, rich, wealthy; completed, full, complete, entire. —समृद्ध-यशस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, rich in fame, renowned, famous. —समृद्ध-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, increasing in speed, excessively swift. —समृद्धार्थ (°ध-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having increased substance or wealth, increas-ing in resources. —समृद्धी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -क-रोति, &c., to make prosperous or wealthy.
समृद्धि: सम्-ऋद्धि, इस्, f. great prosperity or success, exuberance, profusion; thriving increase, gain, hap-piness, good fortune, well-being, wealth; power, supremacy, sway. —समृद्धि-समय, अस्, m. a season of great prosperity.
समृद्धिन्: समृद्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, prosperous, happy, blessed; possessing abundance of (at the end of a comp.).
समृष्: समृष् सम्-ऋष्, cl. 1. P. -अर्षति, &c. (see rt. 1. ऋष्), Ved. to come together, unite with.
समे: समे सम्-ए (-आ-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. -ऐति, &c., to come together, approach together, meet or assemble together, unite together, meet at or in (with acc. or loc.); to come together with (with inst.); to go to, enter, go through, march across (with acc.); to come into competition or rivalry with, cope with; to join or lead together (with acc.).
समेत: सम्-एत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, met together, assembled, joined or united together, collected, asso-ciated, agreed, covenanted; encountered, come to close quarters, come into collision; conjoined, con-comitant, connected or united with, furnished with, possessed of, having; come near, approached, ap-proximated, near. —समेत-माय, अस्, आ, अम्, fur-nished with or possessing illusions.
समेत्य: सम्-एत्य, ind. having come together, having assembled or met together, having held a meeting.
समेयिवस्: सम्-एयिवस्, आन्, -युषी, अत्, one who has come together.
समेघलेख: समेघलेख स-मेघ-लेख, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing streaks of cloud.
समेज्: समेज् सम्-एज् cl. 1. P. -एजति, &c., to rise or move upwards.
समेडी: समेडी समेडी, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; [cf. भेडि।]
समेध्: समेध् सम्-एध्, cl. 1. A. -एधते, -एधितुम्, to prosper greatly, thrive, increase: Caus. -एधयति, -यितुम्, to cause to prosper or succeed, cause to increase or swell; to strengthen, make happy or fortunate.
समेधित: सम्-एधित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly increased or augmented, made to prosper or thrive, strengthened, strong; united.
समेध: समेध स-मेध, अस्, आ, अम्, along with the sacrifice, having the essence of sacrifice.
समोकस्: समोकस् सम्-ओकस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, living or dwelling together, furnished or surrounded with (with inst., Sāy. = समान-निवास or सम्-अवेत, Ṛg-veda 1. 64, 10.)
समोपेत: सम्-ओपेत, अस्, आ, अम्, fully furnished or endowed with, possessed of.
समोह: समोह समोह [cf. सम्-मोह under सम्-मुह्], enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि in Naigh. II. 17.
समौलिरत्न: समौलिरत्न स-मौलि-रत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, with a crown-jewel, having a crest-jewel.
सम्प: सम्प सम्प, अस्, m. (probably fr. सम्-पत्), descending, falling, alighting; (आ), f. lightning; [cf. शम्पा।]
सम्पच्: सम्पच् सम्-पच्, Caus. -पाचयति, -यितुम्, to cook or mature together; to ripen thoroughly, bake or cook thoroughly, burn.
सम्पक्व: सम्-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly matured or ripened.
सम्पाक: सम्-पाक, अस्, m. cooking or ripening thoroughly, maturing; the tree Cassia Fistula [cf. शम्-पाक]; (अस्, आ, अम्), reasoning well, a reasoner, logician; subtle, cunning, impudent; lustful, lewd; small, little, low.
सम्पठ्: सम्पठ् सम्-पठ्, cl. 1. P. -पठति, &c., to read through, peruse.
सम्पाठ्य: सम्-पाठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to be read, (अ-सम्पाठ्य, one with whom no one is allowed to read.)
सम्पत्: सम्पत् सम्-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्, to fly together, run or rush together, meet or come together, flow together; to meet at (with acc.); to unite with (with inst.); to fall together, meet together in hostile encounter; to fly to, hasten towards, flock to, go to, attain; to rush towards, assail, attack; to fall in with; to fly down, fall down, alight on; to go or roam about; to come to pass, happen: Caus. -पातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fly or fall, cause to fly down, throw down, hurl down, cast, throw.
सम्पतत्: सम्-पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying together, hasten-ing together; falling or flying down, alighting, arriving; going backwards and forwards.
सम्पतित: सम्-पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, flying or falling together, coming to pass, happening, fallen or met together; come to pass.
सम्पात: सम्-पात, अस्, m. falling together, concurrence, falling against each other, meeting together, en-countering; butting together; general fall; falling down, descending, coming down, alighting (as a bird); a peculiar mode of flight (of birds); the flight of an arrow; that which falls or settles to the bottom, the residue (of an offering); anything thrown in or added as an ingredient; going, moving, removing; N. of the son of Garuḍa; (औ), m. du., N. of two Vedic hymns. —सम्पात-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing ingredients.
सम्पाति: सम्-पाति, इस्, m., N. of a fabulous bird (the eldest son of Garuḍa and elder brother of Jaṭāyu); a proper N., (also written सं-याति।)
सम्पातिक: सम्पातिक, अस्, m. a fabulous bird.
सम्पातिन्: सम्-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling together.
सम्पत्नी: सम्पत्नी सम्-पत्नी, f. (a woman) together with her husband, (see पत्नी।)
सम्पद्: सम्पद् 1. सम्-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्-तुम्, to fall or happen well, turn out well, succeed, be prosperous, be accomplished; be completed or fulfilled, to become full or complete (as a number), amount to; to become (e. g. स्वेदोद्भेदो विभूषा सम्पेदे, the bursting out of drops of perspiration became an ornament, Kirāt. VII. 5), be produced, be born, be brought forth, arise; to fall together, come together, meet with, unite with (with inst.); to fall into any one's possession; to attain to, obtain, acquire; to enter into, be absorbed in (with loc. or acc.): Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to succeed, cause to arise, cause to become, bring about, produce, effect, accomplish complete, cause to procure, obtain, make ready, prepare; to turn or transform into; to furnish or provide with, endow with; to cause to be occupied with; to attain, obtain; to be agreed, agree upon (Ved.).

2. सम्-पद्, त्, f. success, prosperity, good fortune; luck, fate; increase of wealth or happiness, advance-ment of any kind, advantage, benefit, blessing; a treasure; a necklace of pearls; decoration, adorn-ment; accomplishment, perfection, completion; ex-cellence; correctness, right method; excess, abun-dance. —सम्पद्-वसु, उस्, m., N. of one of the seven principal rays of the sun (supposed to supply heat to the planet Mars). —सम्पद्-विनिमय, अस्, m. an interchange of benefit or advantage.
सम्पत्ति: सम्-पत्ति, इस्, f. prosperity, success, increase of wealth, &c., completion, fulfilment, perfection, excel-lence; a suitable state or condition; a sort of medi-cinal root.
सम्पद्यमान: सम्-पद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being accomplished, being brought about.
सम्पद्वर: सम्पद्वर, अस्, m. a king, prince.
सम्पन्न: सम्-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen or turned out well, successful, prosperous, fortunate, thriving, happy; accomplished, effected, completed, finished, com-plete, perfect; perfectly acquainted or conversant with; full grown, mature; right, correct; procured, acquired, obtained; possessed of, endowed with; of perfect or correct flavour; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n. a delicacy. —सम्पन्न-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most complete or perfect. —सम्पन्न-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, complete, perfect; dainty, delicate.
सम्पन्नक: सम्पन्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, = सम्-पन्न above.
सम्पाद: सम्-पाद, अस्, m. accomplishment, completion, acquisition, obtaining.
सम्पाद सम्-पाद, सम्-पादन, &c. See p. 1083, col. 3.
सम्पादक: सम्-पादक, अस्, इका, अम्, bringing about, effect-ing, effective of, accomplishing, fulfilling.
सम्पादन: सम्-पादन, अस्, ई, अम्, effective of, procuring, gaining: (अम्), n. the act of bringing about, accom-plishing, effecting, making; preparing, clearing (ground &c.); gaining, acquiring, reaching, attaining.
सम्पादनीय: सम्-पादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought about or effected.
सम्पादयत्: सम्-पादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, accomplishing, effect-ing, perfecting.
सम्पादयितृ: सम्-पादयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who accom-plishes or effects.
सम्पादित: सम्-पादित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought about, accom-plished, effected; attained, obtained, gained, gotten.
सम्पाद्य: सम्-पाद्य, ind. having procured, effected, or obtained.
सम्पद: सम्पद सम्-पद, अम्, n. standing with the feet together or even (= समम् पद-युगम्).
सम्परिकॄत्: सम्परिकॄत् सम्-परि-कॄत्, cl. 10. P. -कीर्त-यति, -यितुम्, to enumerate fully, particularise.
सम्परिकीर्तित: सम्-परिकीर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, fully enumerated, related in detail.
सम्परिक्रम्: सम्परिक्रम् सम्-परि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, &c., to go or walk round, to visit in succession, go the round of.
सम्परिख्या: सम्परिख्या सम्-परि-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, &c., to communicate completely, relate in full, de-clare at length.
सम्परिग्रह्: सम्परिग्रह् सम्-परि-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते, &c., to accept fully, receive; to receive in a friendly manner; to embrace; to accomplish, perform, complete; to take in or under-stand thoroughly.
सम्परिगृह्य: सम्-परिगृह्य, ind. having accepted; having completed, having thoroughly understood.
सम्परिचर्: सम्परिचर् सम्-परि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -चरितुम्, to wait upon, attend on, serve.
सम्परिचिन्त्: सम्परिचिन्त् सम्-परि-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्-तयति, -यितुम्, to think out, excogitate, invent.
सम्परिचिन्तित: सम्-परिचिन्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, thought out, devised.
सम्परितुष्: सम्परितुष् सम्-परि-तुष्, cl. 4. P. -तुष्-यति, -तोष्टुम्, to feel quite satisfied or content: Caus. -तोषयति, -यितुम्, to satisfy completely, appease.
सम्परितोषित: सम्-परितोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, fully satisfied, quite appeased.
सम्परित्यज्: सम्परित्यज् सम्-परि-त्यज्, cl. 1. P. -त्य-जति, -त्यक्तुम्, to abandon completely, desert, leave.
सम्परित्यक्त: सम्-परित्यक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, given up. —सम्परित्यक्त-जीवित, अस्, आ, अम्, (a battle &c.) in which life is risked.
सम्परित्यज्य: सम्-परित्यज्य, ind. having completely aban-doned, having abandoned everything.
सम्परिदह्: सम्परिदह् सम्-परि-दह्, Pass. -दह्यते (also P. -ति), to be entirely burnt or consumed by fire, be consumed.
सम्परिपॄ: सम्परिपॄ सम्-परि-पॄ। See rt. पॄ, p. 596.
सम्परिपूर्ण: सम्-परिपूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, quite filled, fully satisfied; completely accomplished, perfected. —सम्-परिपूर्ण-विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, well filled with knowledge, perfect in knowledge.
सम्परिप्लु: सम्परिप्लु सम्-परि-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, &c., to flow quite over, overflow completely.
सम्परिप्लुत: सम्-परिप्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, completely overflowed, deluged; overwhelmed (with misfortune &c.), greatly distressed.
सम्परिभू: सम्परिभू सम्-परि-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to despise or contemn utterly: Pass. -भूयते, to be despised, &c.: Caus. -भावयति, -यितुम्, to fix firmly, hold well together, control.
सम्परिभ्रष्ट: सम्-परिभ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen away from, entirely deprived of (with abl.).

सम्परिरभ्: सम्परिरभ् सम्-परि-रभ्, cl. 1. A. -रभते, &c., to take well hold of; to clasp or embrace mutually.

सम्परिवृत: सम्-परिवृत, अस्, आ, अम् (Ved. also सम्-परी-वृत), completely surrounded.
सम्परिवृज्: सम्परिवृज् सम्-परि-वृज्, Caus. -वर्जयति, -यितुम्, to shun or avoid utterly, forsake, abandon.

सम्परिवर्त्य: सम्-परिवर्त्य, ind. having made to turn round, having led round.
सम्परिशोषण: सम्परिशोषण सम्-परिशोषण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. शुष् with परि and सम्), becoming completely dried up, withering up, emaciation.
सम्परिष्वक्त: सम्-परिष्वक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, mutually embraced, closely embraced.
सम्परिहृष्: सम्परिहृष् सम्-परि-हृष्, Caus. -हर्ष-यति, -यितुम्, to make completely happy, delight.
सम्परे: सम्परे सम्-परे (-परा-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. -परैति, &c., to come together (in conflict); to go away, go beyond (especially to another world or future state).
सम्पराय: सम्-पराय, अस्, m. meeting together in strife or encounter, conflict, contention, war, battle; calamity, adversity; the other world, a future state, futurity, future time; a son.
सम्परायक: सम्परायक, अम्, n. conflict, encounter, war, battle.
सम्पर्क: सम्-पर्क, अस्, m. mixing together, mixture, commingling, conjunction, union; contact, touch; bodily contact, sexual union or connection.
सम्पर्याप्: सम्पर्याप् सम्-पर्य्-आप् (-परि-आप्), cl. 5. P. -आप्नोति, &c., Ved. to take hold of together.
सम्पर्याप्य: सम्-पर्याप्य, ind. having taken hold of simul-taneously.
सम्पलाय्: सम्पलाय् सम्-पलाय् (fr. rt. अय् = rt. 5. इ with पला for परा and सम्), cl. 1. A. -पलायते, -यितुम्, to run away together, escape.
सम्पा: सम्पा सम्-पा, cl. 1. P. A. -पिबति, -ते, &c. (see rt. 1. पा), to drink together: Caus. -पाययति, -यितुम्, to cause to drink together, make to drink.
सम्पीति: सम्-पीति, इस्, f. drinking in company, compo-tation.
सम्पाट: सम्पाट सम्-पाट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पट् with सम्), a spindle; the intersection of the prolonged side of a triangle by a perpendicular.
सम्पार: सम्पार सम्पार, अस्, m. a proper N.
सम्पारण: सम्-पारण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (equally referrible to सम्-पृ above), completing, filling, adequate, (Sāy. = इच्छायाः सम्यक् पूरक, Ṛg-veda III. 45, 4.)
सम्पिण्ड्: सम्पिण्ड् सम्-पिण्ड्, cl. 10. P. -पिण्डयति, &c., to heap together; to clench.
सम्पिण्डित: सम्-पिण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped together; con-tracted. —सम्पिण्डिताङ्गुलि (°त-अङ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, having the fingers clenched or closed.
सम्पिष्: सम्पिष् सम्-पिष्, cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि (Impf. सम्-अपिनट्, Ved. सम्-पिणक्), -पेष्टुम्, to grind or rub together, pound or crush to pieces, bruise, crush (Soma &c.); to shatter, destroy, kill.
सम्पिष्ट: सम्-पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed or broken to pieces, pounded, bruised, shattered, destroyed.
सम्पेषण: सम्-पेषण, अम्, n. the act of grinding toge-ther, pounding.
सम्पीड्: सम्पीड् सम्-पीड्, cl. 10. P. -पीडयति, -यि-तुम्, to compress, press or squeeze together, oppress, press, force; to pinch, pain, torture, vex, harass. disturb; to obscure, eclipse; to reckon up, calculate together, compute, sum up.
सम्पीड: सम्-पीड, अस्, m. pressing or squeezing together, pain, torture; harassing, agitating, disturbing; send-ing, directing; (आ), f. torment.
सम्पीडन: सम्-पीडन, अम्, n. compression, pressing toge-ther, squeezing; pinching, paining, castigation, punish-ment; stirring together, agitating; sending.
सम्पीडयत्: सम्-पीडयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, compressing; squeez-ing, tormenting, paining.
सम्पीडित: सम्-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed together, squeezed; pained, tortured, punished; agitated; sent.
सम्पीड्य: सम्-पीड्य, ind. having pressed together, having tormented; having restrained.
सम्पुट: सम्पुट सम्-पुट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पुट् with सम्), a covered box, casket; the Kuruvaka flower.
सम्पुटक: सम्पुटक, अस्, m. a box, casket; (इका), f. a box filled with ornaments.
सम्पुष्: सम्पुष् सम्-पुष्, cl. 9. P. -पुष्णाति, -पो-षितुम्, to become thoroughly nourished, increase, grow.
सम्पोष्य: सम्-पोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be well nourished or supported.
सम्पू: सम्पू सम्-पू, cl. 9. P. A. -पुनाति, -पुनीते, &c., to cleanse thoroughly, purify: Caus. -पावयति, -यितुम्, to make clean, cleanse, purify.
सम्पूय: सम्-पूय, ind. having cleansed, having purified.
सम्पूज्: सम्पूज् सम्-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूजयति, -यितुम्, to honour greatly, esteem or value highly.
सम्पूजन: सम्-पूजन, अम्, n. the act of treating with great respect, honouring, reverence, esteem.
सम्पूजनीय: सम्-पूजनीय or सम्-पूजयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be highly honoured or valued; to be respected.
सम्पूजित: सम्-पूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly honoured, highly respected or valued, revered.
सम्पूज्य: 1. सम्-पूज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured, &c.
2. सम्-पूज्य, ind. having honoured, honouring, worshipping, paying respect to.
सम्पृ: सम्पृ सम्-पृ, Caus. -पारयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to bring over to the further side, bring to an end, accomplish, perform.
सम्पृच्: सम्पृच् सम्-पृच्, cl. 7. P. -पृणक्ति (also apparently cl. 3. in some Vedic forms, e. g. सम्-पिपृग्धि, -पिपृक्त, &c.), cl. 2. A. -पृक्ते or -पृङ्क्ते, &c. (see rt. 1. पृच्), to mix together, commingle, bring into contact, connect, unite; to be mixed together, be united, be in contact, be connected (A.); to fill up, fill, complete; to fill or satiate with, present with; to be filled or satiated with, be presented with (A.).
