सम्प्रस्था: सम्प्रस्था सम्-प्र-स्था, cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्-ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to set out together; to set. out, depart; to proceed, advance.
सम्प्रस्थान: सम्-प्रस्थान, अम्, n. the act of setting out together, setting out on a journey, departure.
सम्प्रस्थित: सम्-प्रस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, set out together, set out on a journey, departed; standing forward.
सम्प्रस्पृश्: सम्प्रस्पृश् सम्-प्र-स्पृश्, cl. 6. P. -स्पृशति, &c., to touch or sprinkle with water, wash, bathe.
सम्प्रस्वप्: सम्प्रस्वप् सम्-प्र-स्वप्, cl. 2. P. -स्वपिति, &c., to sleep soundly.
सम्प्रसुप्त: सम्-प्रसुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fast asleep, sound asleep.
सम्प्रहस्: सम्प्रहस् सम्-प्र-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, &c., to laugh together, smile.
सम्प्रहृ: सम्प्रहृ सम्-प्र-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to strike at mutually, come to blows, fight together; to strike, wound.
सम्प्रहार: सम्-प्रहार, अस्, m. mutual striking, wounding, killing; conflict, encounter, assault, war, battle; going, motion.
सम्प्रहृष्: सम्प्रहृष् सम्-प्र-हृष्, cl. 4. P. -हृष्यति, -हर्षितुम्, to rejoice greatly, be glad, to think with pleasure; Caus. -हर्षयति, -यितुम्, to rejoice, make glad.
सम्प्रहर्ष: सम्-प्रहर्ष, अस्, m. great joy, thrill of de-light.
सम्प्रहर्षित: सम्-प्रहर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, much pleased, greatly delighted; thrilled.
सम्प्रहृष्ट: सम्-प्रहृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively rejoiced, rejoicing, joyful; erect, bristling (as the hair of the body), thrilling. —सम्प्रहृष्ट-तनूरुह, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hairs of the body bristling with delight. —सम्प्रहृष्ट-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, over-joyed in heart.
सम्प्राद्रु: सम्प्राद्रु सम्-प्रा-द्रु (-प्र-आ-), cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, &c., to run away together.
सम्प्राद्रवत्: सम्-प्राद्रवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, running away together.
सम्प्राप्: सम्प्राप् सम्-प्राप् (-प्र-आप्), cl. 5. P. -प्रा-प्नोति, -प्राप्तुम्, to reach or attain fully to, reach, arrive at; to meet with, light upon, come to; to obtain or acquire thoroughly, gain; Caus. -प्राप-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to attain or obtain.
सम्प्राप्त: सम्-प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well reached or attained, arrived, found, met with; completely obtained, got, caught hold of; effected, accomplished; become. —सम्प्राप्त-यौवन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has fully attained youth or manhood, come of age. —सम्प्राप्त-विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has ac-quired all knowledge.
सम्प्राप्ति: सम्-प्राप्ति, इस्, f. attainment, obtaining, getting, acquisition; gaining.
सम्प्राप्य: 1. सम्-प्राप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fully attained to, attainable, obtainable.
2. सम्-प्राप्य, ind. having attained to or ob-tained.
सम्प्रार्थ्: सम्प्रार्थ् सम्-प्रार्थ् (-प्र-अर्थ्), cl. 10. P. A. -प्रार्थयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to ask for earnestly, pray for, beg, request.
सम्प्रार्थित: सम्-प्रार्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, asked for, begged, requested.
सम्प्राव्: सम्प्राव् सम्-प्राव् (-प्र-अव्), cl. 1. P. -प्रा-वति, &c., Ved. to assist together, join in assisting, aid, help.
सम्प्री: सम्प्री सम्-प्री, cl. 4. A. -प्रीयते, &c., to be completely satisfied or contented, to be greatly pleased with, delight in (with inst.): Caus. -प्रीणयति, -यितुम्, to make completely happy or pleased.
सम्प्रिय: सम्-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, very dear or beloved; mutually dear, loving each other. —सम्प्रिय-ता, f. dearness, the being very dear.
सम्प्रीणित: सम्-प्रीणित, अस्, आ, अम्, made completely happy, thoroughly satisfied, well pleased.
सम्प्रीत: सम्-प्रीत, अस्, आ, अम्, completely satisfied or pleased, delighted, well pleased. —सम्प्रीत-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted in mind.
सम्प्रीति: सम्-प्रीति, इस्, f. attachment, affection; friendly assent; delight.
सम्प्रीयमाण: सम्प्रीयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being greatly pleased, rejoicing.
सम्प्रे: सम्प्रे सम्-प्रे (-प्र-इ), cl. 2. P. -प्रैति, &c., to go forth together, flow together.
सम्प्रेक्ष्: सम्प्रेक्ष् सम्-प्रेक्ष् (-प्र-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -प्रेक्षते, &c., to look well at, observe carefully, behold, become aware of, perceive; to look well into, consider carefully, reflect on, examine.
सम्प्रेक्षण: सम्-प्रेक्षण, अम्, n. the act of looking well at, observing, viewing, beholding, seeing; looking thoroughly into, deliberating about, considering, in-vestigating.
सम्प्रेक्षमाण: सम्-प्रेक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, fully beholding.
सम्प्रेक्षित: सम्-प्रेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, well looked at or seen, beheld; well looked into, considered, investigated.
सम्प्रेक्ष्य: सम्-प्रेक्ष्य, ind. having looked carefully at, having observed or noticed; having looked well into, having considered or examined.
सम्प्रेर्: सम्प्रेर् सम्-प्रेर् (-प्र-ईर्, see rt. ईर्), cl. 2. A. -प्रेर्ते, &c., to come forth together, rise to-gether; Caus. -प्रेरयति, -यितुम्, to drive or push forwards.
सम्प्रेर्ण: सम्-प्रेर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, risen up together.
सम्प्रेष्: सम्प्रेष् सम्-प्रेष् (-प्र-इष्, see rt. 1. इष्), cl. 4. P. -प्रेष्यति, -प्रेषितुम्, to throw, fling, cast; (in Vedic ritual) to summon, invite [cf. 2. प्रेष्]: Caus. -प्रेषयति, -यितुम्, to send forth together, send away, dispatch, send, dismiss; to send a message to.
सम्प्रेषण: सम्-प्रेषण, अम्, n. the act of sending forth together, sending away, dispatching.
सम्प्रेषित: सम्-प्रेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, sent forth, ordered; dismissed, sent away.
सम्प्रेष्य: सम्-प्रेष्य, ind. having sent away or dispatched.
सम्प्रैष: सम्-प्रैष, अस्, m. sending away, dismissing; direction, order, command, precept.
सम्प्रोक्ष्: सम्प्रोक्ष् सम्-प्रोक्ष् (-प्र-उक्ष्), cl. 6. P. A. -प्रोक्षति, -ते, &c., to sprinkle well over, sprinkle on; to consecrate by sprinkling; to be sprinkled over (A.).
सम्प्रोक्षण: सम्-प्रोक्षण, अम्, n. the act of sprinkling well over, consecration (of a temple &c.).
सम्प्रोक्षित: सम्-प्रोक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, well sprinkled or wetted (especially with holy water), consecrated.
सम्प्रोक्ष्य: सम्-प्रोक्ष्य, ind. having besprinkled; having sprinkled one's self well over.
सम्प्रोर्णु: सम्प्रोर्णु सम्-प्रोर्णु (-प्र-ऊर्°), cl. 2. P. A. -प्रोर्णोति or -प्रोर्णौति, -प्रोर्णुते, &c., to cover all over, cover completely.
सम्प्लु: सम्प्लु सम्-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्, to flow together; to float about; to fluctuate: Caus. -प्लावयति, -यितुम्, to inundate, flood over, sub-merge, overwhelm; to cause to float about.
सम्प्लव: सम्-प्लव, अस्, m. submersion, inundation; flood; surging, surge; splashing or tumbling about in water; falling into ruins, ruin; subversion.
सम्प्लवमान: सम्-प्लवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing together, floating about, &c.
सम्प्लुत: सम्-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, flooded, overspread, over-cast. —सम्प्लुतोदक (°त-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, flooded with water.
सम्फल: सम्फल सम्-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, see Vopa-deva IV. 15.
सम्फाल: सम्फाल सम्-फाल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. फल् or rt. स्फल् with सम्), a ram, sheep.
सम्फुल्ल: सम्फुल्ल सम्-फुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. फल् with सम्), full-blown, blossomed, fully opened (as a flower).
सम्फेट: सम्फेट सम्फेट, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. फेट्, q. v., with सम्), mutual encounter of persons en-raged or agitated, angry and tumultuous conflict (as a particular division of dramatic action; described in the Sāhitya-darpaṇa, and illustrated by the encounter of Mādhava and Aghora-ghaṇṭa in the Mālatī-mādhava).
सम्ब्: सम्ब् सम्ब् [cf. rts. सर्ब्, शम्ब्, साम्ब्], cl. 1. P. सम्बति, &c., to go, creep; cl. 10. P. सम्बयति, -यितुम्, to collect, accumulate, con-nect, join together.
सम्ब: सम्ब, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. सम्ब् above), water [cf. सम्बर]; twice ploughing, the second ploughing of a field [cf. शम्ब]. —सम्बा-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to plough twice. —सम्बा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, twice ploughed [cf. शम्बा-कृत].
सम्बंह्: सम्बंह् सम्-बंह्, cl. 10. P. or Caus. (or Nom. of बहुल) -बंहयति, -यितुम्, to make firm or prosperous, establish firmly, increase.
सम्बत्: सम्बत् सम्-बत्, ind. (according to Śabda-k.) = सं-वत्, q. v.
सम्बन्ध्: सम्बन्ध् सम्-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, &c., to bind together, fasten or tie together, bind or fix on, attach, connect, to construct, form: Pass. -बध्-यते, to be bound together, to be attached or con-nected, belong to; to be furnished or supplied with: Caus. -बन्धयति, -यितुम्, to cause to bind toge-ther; to make to bind on or attach or connect.
सम्बद्ध: सम्-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound or tied together, connected; connected in sense, having meaning; fastened together; closed, shut; bound on, fastened or fixed on, attached; connected with, belonging to, related, inherent, endowed with, possessing, possessed of authority, empowered. —सम्बद्ध-दर्प, अस्, आ, अम्, having feelings of pride formed (in the heart). —सम्बद्ध-सैन्यौघ (°य-ओघ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the main body of troops concentrated.
सम्बध्नत्: सम्-बध्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, binding together, at-taching, forming (fruit as a plant &c.).
सम्बध्यमान: सम्-बध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being bound toge-ther or connected.
सम्बन्ध: सम्-बन्ध, अस्, m. binding together, joining together, union, association, connection (sometimes at the end of comps. in the sense ‘connected,’ &c., cf. सु-स्°); connection by marriage [cf. स्त्री-स्°]; relationship, relation, (in phil. said to be of three kinds, 1. समवाय, ‘intimate relation,’ as between a whole and its parts; 2. संयोग, ‘con-junction,’ as between a pot and the ground; 3. स्वरूप, ‘the nature of a thing,’ as between an object and the knowledge of it, which last is also called विषयता-सम्बन्ध), inherence; a rela-tion, kinsman, relative, (कु-सम्बन्ध, अस्, m. a wicked relation); binding, restraining, restraint; (in grammar) the possessive case (but see कारक); the application of authority to prove a theological doc-trine; fitness, propriety; prosperity, success; (अस्, आ, अम्), able, capable; fit, right, proper. —सम्बन्ध-तत्त्व, अम्, n. and सम्बन्ध-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of two works.
सम्बन्धक: सम्बन्धक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to, concern-ing; fit, suitable; (अस्), m. connection by birth or marriage; a relation, friend; (scil. सन्धि), a kind of alliance proceeding from relationship.
सम्बन्धिन्: सम्बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, connected with, belong-ing to, relating or related to, referring to, adjunct, inherent; possessing good qualities; (ई), m. a rela-tion or connection (by marriage), relative, kinsman. —सम्बन्धि-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, divided or shared by relatives.
सम्बर: सम्बर सम्बर, अस्, m. (apparently mixed up and confounded with the words सं-वर, शं-वर, शम्बर, but in some senses said to be fr. rt. सम्ब्), a bridge, dam, causeway, (probably for सं-वर); a kind of deer; a sort of fish; a particular mountain; a kind of dramatic entertainment; N. of a demon or Daitya, (see शम्बर); N. of a Jaina Arhat of the future period; N. of a district and lake in Rājputāna (where the salt called गड-लवण is found; sometimes written सं-वर); (ई), f. the plant Asparagus Racemosus (= शता-वरी); the aquatic plant Salvinia Cucullata; (अम्), n. restraint, self-control; a religious observance with Buddhists; water, (in the preceding senses probably for सं-वर, but cf. शम्बर।) —सम्बरारि (°र-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of Sambara,’ epithet of Kāma-deva. —सम्बरोद्भव (°र-उद्°), अम्, n. ‘produced in Sambara,’ a kind of salt (= गड-लवण).
सम्बर्य: सम्बर्य (said to be connected with सम्बर above), Nom. P. सम्बर्यति, -यितुम्, to bring together [cf. rt. सम्ब्].
सम्बल: सम्बल, अस्, अम्, m. n. [cf. शम्बल], provender, stock of provisions for a journey; (अम्), n. water.
सम्बाध्: सम्बाध् सम्-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, &c., to press together, compress, contract; to press heavily on; to bind firmly together; to oppress, afflict, torment.
सम्बाध: सम्-बाध, अस्, m. pressing together, compres-sion, contraction, pressing on, pressure, thronging, blocking up, the being thronged; difficulty, obstruc-tion, (sometimes at the end of comps. in the senses, ‘narrow,’ ‘contracted,’ ‘confined,’ ‘blocked up,’ ‘crowded,’ ‘completely covered or strewn,’ ‘ob-structed;’ cf. हस्त्य्-अश्व-रथ-स्°, शर-स्°); the female organ of generation; the road to Naraka or hell; fear, dread.
सम्बाधक: सम्-बाधक, अस्, आ, अम्, pressing together, com-pressing, contracting; pressing upon, thronging, crowding.
सम्बाधन: सम्-बाधन, अम्, n. the act of pressing to-gether or compressing; thronging, obstructing, op-posing; a barrier, gate; the female organ, (according to Śabda-k. = मदनस्य द्वार); a door-keeper; the point of a stake or spit.
सम्बुध्: सम्बुध् सम्-बुध्, cl. 1. P. A., 4. A. -बोधति, -ते, -बुध्यते (ep. also P. -ति), &c., to perceive or understand thoroughly, have perfect knowledge of; to perceive, notice, observe, know; to wake up: Caus. -बोधयति, -यितुम्, to cause to know, inform, instruct, advise; exhort, admonish; to explain; to make attentive, cause to wake up, rouse; to call to; to cause to agree.
सम्बुद्ध: सम्-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, well perceived, perfectly known or understood; thoroughly awake; exces-sively wise, prudent, clever; (अस्), m. a Buddha or Jaina deified sage.
सम्बुद्धि: सम्-बुद्धि, इस्, f. perfect knowledge or per-ception; calling to; the vocative case (= सम्-बोधन); an epithet.
सम्बुध्यमान: सम्-बुध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being quite aware.
सम्बोध: सम्-बोध, अस्, m. explaining, instructing, in-forming; throwing, sending; loss, destruction.
सम्बोधन: सम्-बोधन, अम्, n. the act of causing to know thoroughly, informing, instructing, explanation, call-ing to, addressing; the vocative case (in gram.).
सम्बोधयित्वा: सम्-बोधयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having caused to be informed, having instructed.
सम्बोधित: सम्-बोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, fully warned, duly apprised.
सम्बोधितवत्: सम्-बोधितवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has duly warned or apprised.
सम्बोध्य: सम्-बोध्य, ind. having explained, having made an excuse or apology.
सम्बृह्: सम्बृह् सम्-बृह् or सम्-बृंह्। See सं-वृंह्, p. 1038.
सम्ब्रू: सम्ब्रू सम्-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. A. -ब्रवीति, -ब्रूते, &c. (see rt. ब्रू, p. 694), to speak with, converse with; to talk together, agree; to say anything to any one (with two acc.).
सम्भक्ष्: सम्भक्ष् सम्-भक्ष्, cl. 10. P. -भक्षयति, &c., to eat together, eat up, devour, consume.
सम्भक्ष: सम्-भक्ष, अस्, m. eating together, food in common.
सम्भक्ष्य: सम्-भक्ष्य, ind. having eaten up, having con-sumed.
सम्भक्ष्यमाण: सम्-भक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being consumed.
सम्भज्: सम्भज् सम्-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते, -भक्तुम्, to distribute completely, apportion, allot, dispense, divide, share, cause to participate in; to bestow, grant; to favour, serve, help; to share in, possess, enjoy (A.).
सम्भक्त: सम्-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, distributed, divided, shared; participating or sharing in, enjoying, pos-sessing; devoted to, faithful to, faithfully attached.
सम्भक्ति: सम्-भक्ति, इस्, f. sharing in, possessing, enjoy-ing; participating, causing to participate, distributing; favouring, honouring.
सम्भक्तृ: सम्-भक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who shares or par-ticipates, one who enjoys or possesses, sharing in, possessing, one who distributes or grants, one who favours or honours or worships.
सम्भजन: सम्-भजन, अम्, n. causing to share in, dis-tributing, favouring.
सम्भजनीय: सम्-भजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shared in or enjoyed, to be liked; to be favoured or honoured.
सम्भञ्ज्: सम्भञ्ज् सम्-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति, &c., to break to pieces, shatter, shiver.
सम्भग्न: सम्-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces, ṣat-tered; dispersed, scattered, defeated; (अस्), m., N. of Śiva (= सम्यक्-सेवित, as if fr. सम्-भज्).
सम्भर: सम्-भर, अस्, m., Ved. one who brings together, a supporter, bestower, (Sāy. = सम्भर्तृ, धारक, Ṛg-veda IV. 17, 11.)
सम्भर्त्स्: सम्भर्त्स् सम्-भर्त्स्, cl. 10. P. A. -भर्त्स-यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to censure greatly, abuse, reproach, find fault with, blame.
सम्भर्त्सित: सम्-भर्त्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, much censured, abused, reviled.
सम्भल्: सम्भल् सम्-भल्, cl. 10. P. A. -भालयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to observe well, perceive, hear, see, behold.
सम्भल: सम्भल सम्भल, अस्, m. (for सम्-भर), Ved. one who brings together, one who arranges a marriage, a match-maker; a suitor, wooer; a pro-curer, pimp; (ई), f. a procuress, bawd, (also written शम्भली।)
सम्भव: सम्-भव, अस्, m. birth, being, production, ex-istence, arising, springing up; origin, cause, motive; uniting together, combination, mixing, union; com-patibility, consistency, appropriateness, adaptation, adequacy; capacity, ability, possibility; agreement, conformity (especially of the receptacle to the thing received); equivalence (regarded as one of the Pramāṇas or means of certain knowledge in phil., it may be illustrated by the equivalence known to exist between one shilling and twelve pence); ac-quaintance, intimacy; loss, destruction; N. of the third Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī, (also read शम्-भव।)
सम्भा: सम्भा सम्-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -बभौ, -भातुम्, to shine fully or brightly, be very bright; to shine forth, be visible, be conspicuous; to ap-pear, seem.
साम्भाण्डय: साम्भाण्डय सम्-भाण्डय (fr. भाण्ड with सम्), Nom. A. -भाण्डयते, -यितुम्, to collect vessels or utensils.
सम्भाव्य: 1. सम्-भाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be adapted, to be made fit; suitable, capable; to be supposed capable, to be supposed, supposable, imaginable, probable; to be honoured, &c.; (अम्), n. adequacy, competency, fitness.
2. सम्-भाव्य, ind. having honoured or done honour to, having adorned.
सम्भाष्: सम्भाष् सम्-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, &c., to speak together, converse with; to address, speak to (with acc.); to greet, salute; to agree together, consent; to talk over, persuade (with acc.); to have sexual intercourse with; to speak, say, recite; Caus. -भाषयति, -यितुम्, to converse with (with inst.); to address (with acc.); to persuade, prevail upon.
सम्भाष: सम्-भाष, अस्, m. conversation [cf. स्नेह-स्°]; (आ), f. conversation, discourse; greeting; criminal connection; contract, agreement; war-cry, watch-word.
सम्भाषण: सम्-भाषण, अम्, n. conversation, discourse; sexual intercourse; war-cry, watch-word.
सम्भाषत्: सम्-भाषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking together.
सम्भाषमाण: सम्-भाषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking or con-versing together.
सम्भाषित: सम्-भाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken to, addressed; said, spoken; (अम्), n. conversation.
सम्भाष्य: 1. सम्भाष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be conversed with, fit to be talked in, (असम्भाष्ये देशे, in a place unfit for conversation, Manu VIII. 55.)
2. सम्-भाष्य, ind. having addressed in suitable language; addressing, accosting; having recited.
सम्भिद्: सम्भिद् सम्-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति, -भिन्त्ते, &c., to break to pieces, split or break completely asunder, pierce; to bring into contact, combine, join, mingle, associate with.
सम्भिन्न: सम्-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, completely broken or divided; shaken, agitated; brought into contact or collision, combined or united with; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva. —सम्भिन्न-मर्याद, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has broken through barriers or bounds. —सम्भिन्न-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has abandoned good conduct. —सम्भिन्न-सर्वाङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has contracted or compressed the whole body (as a tortoise).
सम्भेद: सम्-भेद, अस्, m. breaking to pieces, splitting, bursting; union, junction, mixture; the confluence of two rivers, the junction of a river with the sea.
सम्भेदन: सम्-भेदन, अम्, n. the act of breaking up; bringing into contact or collision.
सम्भीत: सम्भीत सम्-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly alarmed, afraid of (with gen.).
सम्भुज्: सम्भुज् 2. सम्-भुज्, cl. 7. P. A. -भुनक्ति, -भुङ्क्ते, -भोक्तुम्, to enjoy together, eat together; to enjoy thoroughly, eat; to enjoy carnally; to serve, be of service to (Ved.): Pass. -भुज्यते, to be en-joyed together, to be enjoyed: Caus. -भोजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to enjoy, cause to eat; to feed with (with acc. and instr.).
सम्भुग्न: सम्-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, completely bent or curved.
सम्भुक्त: सम्-भुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well enjoyed; eaten; made use of.
सम्भुज: सम्-भुज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. universally enjoyed, (Sāy. = सन्तत-भुज or सम्-भुजम् = सम्यक् भोगाय, Ṛg-veda II. 1, 4.)
सम्भुञ्जत्: सम्-भुञ्जत्, अन्, अती, अत्, enjoying, &c.; being of service to (Ved.).
सम्भोग: सम्-भोग, अस्, m. complete enjoyment, pleasure, delight; sensual enjoyment; carnal enjoyment, sexual union; a particular subdivision of the Śṛṅgāra Rasa or sentiment of love (described as successful love leading to union); employment, use; a sensualist, libertine; a Jaina or Buddhist edict (= शासन). —सम्भोग-क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, suitable for enjoyment.
सम्भोगिन्: सम्भोगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, enjoying, addicted to sensual enjoyment, sensual; employing, using; (ई), m. a sensualist, libertine.
सम्भोजक: सम्-भोजक, अस्, m. an eater, taster.
सम्भोजन: सम्-भोजन, अम्, n. the act of enjoying or eat-ing; feeding; eating together, a meal taken in company, a dinner party; (अस्, ई, अम्), eating to-gether; [cf. सह-भोजन।]
सम्भोज्य: सम्-भोज्य, ind. having caused to enjoy or eat; having fed with.
सम्भू: सम्भू सम्-भू, cl. 1. P. A. -भवति, -ते, &c., to be together, be united with, be joined with, have intercourse with (with inst. or sometimes with acc.), be united sexually with; to meet with; to be born or produced, be engendered, be formed, arise, spring up, proceed, ensue, accrue; to take place, happen, take effect; to be, become, exist, be found, occur; to be composed of, to be adequate for (with inf.), be competent to (with inf.), be able; to be fitting or compatible or consistent; to be possible; to be capable of holding; to be capable of existing in, be contained in; to be numbered among (Ved.): Caus. -भावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be together, cause to be united or meet together; to bring together; to cause to be born or produced, cause to be or exist, produce, effect, accomplish, make; to manifest, exhibit; to think about, think, imagine, fancy, suppose, consider, be-lieve; to imply, suggest a possibility, suppose anything possible in any one (with loc. or gen.), believe any one capable of; to think highly of, honour, esteem, do honour to, pay one's respects to, salute, greet; to receive or accept with honour or favour; to honour or gratify with, present with (with inst.), bestow; to regard or consider as (with two acc.); to expect: Pass. of Caus. -भाव्यते, to be produced or effected; to be possible; to be honoured or esteemed; to be received with favour; to be supposed or imagined or proved capable of, &c.; to be thought fitting or consistent: Desid. -बुभूषति, to wish to be pro-duced, &c.
सम्भवत्: सम्-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being, existing, arising, springing up.
सम्भव्य: सम्-भव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be produced together, to be capable, &c.; (अस्), m. the wood-apple, Feronia Elephantum (= कपित्थ).
सम्भावन: सम्-भावन, अम्, आ, n. f. compatibility, fitness, suitableness, adequacy, competency, ability; possi-bility; (in logic) doubt; (in grammar) the sense of the potential mood; considering, reflecting, supposi-tion, idea, fancy, imagination, thought; regard, esteem; worship, honour, affection, love; paying honour, salutation, greeting; celebrity, fame; a par-ticular Alaṅkāra or figure in rhetoric (described by some as the use of the verb in the imperative or potential mood).
सम्भावनीय: सम्-भावनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured or greeted.
सम्भावयितव्य: सम्-भावयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured, &c.
सम्भावित: सम्-भावित, अस्, आ, अम्, suited, fitted, adequate, capable, suited to, fit for, possible; perceived, thought about, thought of, considered, supposed, conjectured, imagined, reflected; thought highly of, esteemed, honoured, honourable; satisfied. —सम्भावित-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more honoured or esteemed, more con-fided in. —सम्भावितात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, noble-minded.
सम्भु: सम्-भु, उस्, m. one who is born or produced (= सम्भवति यः); a parent, progenitor; a species of the Ati-dhṛti metre.
सम्भूत: सम्-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being together, combined with; become, born, produced, arisen, accrued, pro-ceeded from, formed of, composed; capable, ade-quate, equal; (अस्), m., N. of a king. —सम्भूत-त्व, अम्, n. the being combined or united with (e. g. पञ्चसु भूतेषु, with the five elements). —सम्भूत-विजय, अस्, m. (according to some) N. of a particular Jaina Arhat (= श्रुत-केवलिन्).
सम्भूति: सम्-भूति, इस्, f. the being together, combina-tion; suitability, fitness; Fitness (personified as a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Marīci); birth, ori-gin, production; power. —सम्भूति-विजय, अस्, m., N. of one of the six Śruta-kevalins (with Jainas).
सम्भूय: सम्-भूय, ind. being together, being united or combined with, (सम्भूय समुत्थानम्, en-gaging in business after joining partnership, associa-tion in trade, partnership; sometimes written as a compound word.) —सम्भूय-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting in concert or in company, a coadjutor, co-partner, colleague. —सम्भूय-गमन or सम्-भूय-यान, अम्, n. going in company.
सम्भूयस्य: सम्भूयस्य (said to be fr. a form सम्-भूयस्), Nom. P. सम्भूयस्यति, &c., to be born again.
सम्भूष्: सम्भूष् सम्-भूष्, cl. 1. P. -भूषति, &c., Ved. to procure or provide anything (acc.) for any one (loc.); to obtain, (भूष् being regarded by Sāy. as a form of rt. 1. भू); to adorn, (Sāy. = अलङ्-कृ।)
सम्भृ: सम्भृ सम्-भृ, cl. 1. 3. P. A. -भरति, -ते, -बिभर्ति, -बिभृते, &c., to bring together, collect, unite, concentrate, place together, compose; to pre-pare, make ready, procure (materials or ingredients of any kind, especially for a sacrifice); to offer, pre-sent; to support or maintain well, nourish; to effect; accomplish: Caus. -भारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to bring together or prepare.
सम्भार: सम्-भार, अस्, m. bringing together, collecting, preparing, preparation, equipment, provision, ap-paratus, materials, necessaries, constituent part, in-gredient, requisite, assemblage of things required for any purpose; multitude, number, quantity, heap, ful-ness, completeness; wealth; maintaining or support-ing well, maintenance, support, nourishment.
सम्भार्य: सम्-भार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be maintained or nourished, a dependant.
सम्भृत: सम्-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought together, col-lected, assembled, accumulated, concentrated, com-posed, prepared, got ready, equipped, fitted out, provided, stored, laden, filled, covered, furnished, endowed, possessed of; full, complete, compact; brought, placed, deposited, offered (as an oblation); acquired, obtained, gained; produced, caused; well maintained or nourished; carried, borne. —सम्-भृत-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who has accom-plished holy acts (said of Indra; Sāy. = सम्पादित-कर्मन् or सम्पादित-प्रज्ञ, Ṛg-veda 1. 52, 8). —सम्भृत-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, one whose beauty is enhanced, richly stored. —सम्भृत-सम्भार, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has brought together all re-quisite materials or provided all requisites. —सम्-भृतार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has accumulated wealth.
सम्भृति: सम्-भृति, इस्, f. collection; equipment, prepara-tion, provision; plenitude, fulness; complete main-tenance, support, nourishment.
सम्भृत्य: 1. सम्-भृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be maintained or nourished.
2. सम्-भृत्य, ind. having brought together, having nourished.
सम्भ्रियमाण: सम्-भ्रियमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being collected; being nourished, &c.
सम्भ्रंश्: सम्भ्रंश् सम्-भ्रंश् or सम्-भ्रश्, cl. 4. P. A. -भ्रश्यति, -ते, &c., to fall quite away, glide off, slip away.
सम्भृष्ट: सम्-भृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly parched, dried, dry.
सम्भ्रम्: सम्भ्रम् सम्-भ्रम्, cl. 1. 4. P. -भ्रमति, -भ्राम्यति, &c., to roam or wander all about, go quite astray; to whirl about, be greatly confused, be perplexed or puzzled: Caus. -भ्रमयति, -भ्राम-यति, -यितुम्, to lead astray, perplex, bewilder: Pass. of Caus. -भ्राम्यते, &c., to be led astray, be bewildered, be at a loss, be perplexed about (with abl.).
सम्भ्रम: सम्-भ्रम, अस्, m. moving about, moving or going round, turning round, whirling about, re-volving, haste, hurry; flurry, confusion, agitation; uproar, tumult; fear, terror, alarm; error, mistake, ignorance; bustling activity, zeal; respect, reverence; epithet of a class of beings attending on Śiva. —सम्-भ्रम-ज्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, excited by flurry. —सम्भ्रम-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, possessing bewilder-ment, embarrassed, agitated.
सम्भ्रान्त: सम्-भ्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, whirled about; flurried, confused, perplexed, troubled, bewildered, stirred up, agitated, excited. —सम्भ्रान्त-जन, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose people are bewildered. —सम्भ्रान्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, bewildered in mind.
सम्भ्राज्: सम्भ्राज् सम्-भ्राज्, cl. 1. A. -भ्राजते, &c. (see rt. 1. भ्राज्), to shine brightly, glitter, gleam, sparkle.
सम्भ्राजत्: सम्-भ्राजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining brightly, glittering, sparkling.
सम्मज्ज्: सम्मज्ज् सम्-मज्ज्, cl. 6. P. -मज्जति, &c., to sink together, sink down, to be wholly submerged or immersed.
सम्मग्न: सम्-मग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sunk down; immersed; overwhelmed.
सम्मथ्: सम्मथ् सम्-मथ् or सम्-मन्थ्, cl. 1. 9. P. -मथति, -मन्थति, -मथ्नाति, &c., to bruise or pound together, crush to pieces.
सम्मथित: सम्-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, bruised, pounded, crushed to pieces, destroyed.
सम्मद्: सम्मद् सम्-मद्, cl. 4. P. -माद्यति (Ved. also cl. 1. P. A. -मदति, -मन्दति, -ते), -मदितुम्, to be completely drunk or intoxicated; to be very glad, be greatly pleased with, rejoice at, rejoice: Caus. -मादयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to make intoxicated; to make cheerful, put in good spirits, exhilarate; to be completely intoxicated (A.).
सम्मत्त: सम्-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, completely intoxicated, greatly exhilarated or excited, intoxicated with love, enraptured; rutting, in rut.
सम्मद: सम्-मद, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly exhilarated, happy, glad; (अस्), m. exhilaration, happiness, joy, pleasure; N. of the king of the fish (in Viṣṇu-Purāṇa IV. 2).
सम्माद: सम्-माद, अस्, m. great exhilaration, intoxica-tion, frenzy.
सम्मन्: सम्मन् सम्-मन्, cl. 4. A. (ep. also P.) -मन्यते (-ति), -मन्तुम्, to think together, be of the same mind, agree, consent to, assent to, approve, sanction, authorise, permit, allow, recognise; to think highly of, esteem, value, honour; to think, suppose, imagine; to consider or regard as, to have in the mind, intend, contemplate, resolve: Caus. -मानयति, -यितुम्, to honour, reverence, respect; to consider, regard; to assure of; to instruct, teach, (Pāṇ. 1. 3, 36.)
सम्मत: सम्-मत, अस्, आ, अम्, agreed, consented or as-sented to, concurred in, approved; conformable, corresponding, like, resembling, attached, liked, be-loved; thought highly of, esteemed, highly honoured, valued; thought, supposed, considered, regarded; (अम्), n. assent, consent, approval, acquiescence, con-currence; opinion, impression, (सम्मते सार्थ-वाहस्य, under the impression of its being a com-pany of travellers.)
सम्मति: सम्-मति, इस्, f. sameness of opinion, agreement, consent, assent, approval, approbation; wish, desire; esteem, respect, homage; regard, affection, love; self-knowledge; order, command.
सम्मतीय: सम्मतीय, N. of one of the four divisions of the Vaibhāṣika system of Buddhism (whose founder is said to have been Upāli, a disciple of the great Buddha).
सम्मान: 1. सम्-मान, अस्, m. (according to some also अम्, n.), honour, respect, homage.
2. सम्-मान, अम्, n. the act of measuring out, equalizing, comparing; measure.
सम्मान 1. and 2. सम्-मान। See above and p. 1090, col. 3.
सम्मानन: सम्-मानन, अम्, n. the act of honouring, wor-ship, homage; instruction, teaching, (Pāṇ. 1. 3, 36.)
सम्मानित: सम्-मानित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured, treated with reverence or respect.
सम्मान्य: सम्-मान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured, honour-able, respectable.
सम्मन्त्र्: सम्मन्त्र् सम्-मन्त्र्, cl. 10. A. -मन्त्रयते, -यितुम्, to consult together, take counsel with (with inst.), hold a council, deliberate, advise, express an opinion; to salute, greet, address.
सम्मन्त्रणीय: सम्-मन्त्रणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be consulted.
सम्मन्त्रयित्वा: सम्-मन्त्रयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having con-sulted together.
सम्मन्त्र्य: सम्-मन्त्र्य, ind. having consulted together; having saluted.
सम्मर्द: सम्मर्द सम्-मर्द, सम्-मर्दिन्, &c. See under सम्-मृद्।
सम्-मर्द, अस्, m. pressing or rubbing together, friction; thronging, trampling or treading on; war, battle.
सम्मर्शिन्: सम्-मर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, inquiring into, deliberating about, discriminating, judicious.
सम्मा: सम्मा 1. सम्-मा (see rt. 3. मा), cl. 2. P., 3. 4. A. -माति, -मिमीते (2nd sing. Impv. P., Ved. -मिमीहि), -मायते, -मातुम्, to measure out, mea-sure; to make of the same measure, make equal, make to correspond, equalize (in size, number, quantity, &c.); to compare; to mete out, appor-tion, distribute, grant, bestow (Ved.); to be of the same capacity with, be contained in (with loc.): Pass. -मीयते, to be of the same measure; to be contained in.
2. सम्-मा, f. a kind of Vedic metre.
सम्मित: सम्-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, measured out, measured, meted; of the same measure, of equal measure or extent, commensurate, conformable, corresponding, equal, same, like, resembling, similar, as large as, as long as (e. g. तुलया स्°, equal in weight; समरे स्°, equal in battle; पाप-स्°, equal in crime; नगर-स्°, as large as a city; योजनायुत-स्°, ten thousand Yojanas long); reaching to (e. g. ललाट-स्°, reaching to the forehead); equalized, adapted; furnished or provided with.
सम्मिति: सम्-मिति, इस्, f. measuring out, measuring, com-paring.
सम्मातुर: सम्मातुर सम्-मातुर, अस्, m. (for सन्-मातुर, q. v.), the son of a virtuous mother.
सम्मातृ: सम्मातृ सम्-मातृ, ता, &c., having the same mother, twin.
सम्मार्जक: सम्-मार्जक, अस्, m. a sweeper, purifier.
सम्मि: सम्मि सम्-मि (see rt. 1. मि), cl. 5. P. A. -मि-नोति, -मिनुते, &c., Ved. to fasten at the same time, fasten together, fix, erect.
सम्मिक्ष्: सम्मिक्ष् सम्-मिक्ष् or सम्-मिमिक्ष् (by some regarded as a Desid. form of सम्-मिह्, see मिक्ष्, p. 777), -मिमिक्षति, &c., to mix together, mingle.
सम्मिल्: सम्मिल् सम्-मिल्, cl. 6. P. A. -मिलति, -ते, &c., to meet together, assemble together, be present, associate with.
सम्मिलित: सम्-मिलित, अस्, आ, अम्, met together, assembled, collected.
सम्मिल्य: सम्-मिल्य, ind. having assembled or met toge-ther.
सम्मेलन: सम्-मेलन, अम्, n. the act of meeting together, assembling, union; mixing with, mixture, blending.
सम्मिश्र: सम्-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, commingled, mixed together, mixed, mingled, blended, joined, con-nected, furnished or endowed with.
सम्मिश्रण: सम्-मिश्रण, अम्, n. the act of commingling or mixing together.
सम्मिश्रित: सम्-मिश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed together, mingled, intermixed with (with inst.).
सम्मिश्ल: सम्-मिश्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, = सम्-मिश्र above; (अस्), m. ‘universal mingler,’ epithet of Indra.
सम्मिह्: सम्मिह् सम्-मिह्, apparently cl. 3. A. (see Ṛg-veda 1. 48, 16, where the form मिमिक्ष्व occurs), Ved. to sprinkle with, shower down upon: Desid. -मिमिक्षति, to wish to mix; to mingle, unite one's self; [cf. सम्-मिक्ष् above.]
सम्मील्: सम्मील् सम्-मील्, cl. 1. P. -मीलति, &c., to close up (as a flower &c.); to shut the eyes: Caus. -मीलयति, -यितुम्, to cause to close up, close, shut; to close the eyes; to make insensible.
सम्मीलन: सम्-मीलन, अम्, n. the closing up (of a flower &c.), covering up, enveloping.
सम्मील्य: सम्-मील्य, ind., Ved. having closed up, having covered over, having enveloped.
सम्मुख: सम्मुख सम्-मुख, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, facing, fronting, being in front of, being face to face, oppo-site; confronting, meeting, encountering; looking towards, directed towards; propitious; (अम्), ind. before the face, in front of. —सम्मुख-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being before the eyes.
सम्मुखिन्: सम्मुखिन्, ई, m. a looking-glass, mirror.
सम्मुखीन: सम्मुखीन, अस्, आ, अम्, facing, being in face of, face to face, confronting, before, in front, op-posite.
सम्मुच्: सम्मुच् सम्-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते, मोक्तुम्, to let loose together, pour out, discharge, shed: Caus. -मोचयति, -यितुम्, to release, free, set free, liberate.
सम्मोचित: सम्-मोचित, अस्, आ, अम्, set free, liberated, released,
सम्मुर्छ्: सम्मुर्छ् सम्-मुर्छ्, cl. 1. P. -मूर्छति, &c., to congeal into a fixed form, acquire density or con-sistency, become dense, thicken, coagulate; to be-come stupid or senseless, become stupefied or insen-sible; to acquire firmness or strength, grow stronger or more intense, increase, expand, become powerful: Caus. -मूर्छयति, -यितुम्, to cause to assume form or consistency, form, fashion; to stupefy, cause to faint.
सम्मूर्छ: सम्-मूर्छ, (perhaps) thickening, augmenting, increase, expansion, spreading. —सम्मूर्छ-ज, अस्, m. grass or any gramineous plant.
सम्मूर्छत्: सम्-मूर्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, becoming more intense, increasing, spreading, pervading.
सम्मूर्छन: सम्-मूर्छन, अम्, n. the act of congealing or becoming dense; stupefaction, insensibility, fainting away; increasing or spreading in all directions, universal pervasion, entire permeation, expansion, co-extension; height, elevation. —सम्मूर्छनोद्-भव (°न-उद्°), अस्, m. a fish or other aquatic animal.
सम्मूर्छित: सम्-मूर्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, coagulated, congealed, thickened; stupefied, senseless, unconscious; inten-sified, increased.
सम्मुह्: सम्मुह् सम्-मुह्, cl. 4. P. -मुह्यति, &c., to become quite stupefied or unconscious; to be bewildered or disturbed or confounded; to become unconscious: Caus. -मोहयति, -यितुम्, to stupefy, make unconscious, confound, bewilder, perplex, in-fatuate, lead astray.
सम्मुग्ध: सम्-मुग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, stupefied, astounded; bewildered, fascinated; beautiful; (अम्), ind. in a fascinating manner; furtively.
सम्मूढ: सम्-मूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, completely stupefied, astounded; unconscious, senseless; bewildered, be-guiled; infatuated, foolish, ignorant; disordered, deranged; heaped, accumulated; produced rapidly; broken; (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma. —सम्-मूढ-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or सम्मूढ-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered or infatuated in mind.
सम्मोह: सम्-मोह, अस्, m. stupefaction, bewilderment, confusion, insensibility, fainting away, swoon; in-fatuation, ignorance, folly, illusion of mind; fasci-nation, beguilement; tumult, battle, (enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि in Naigh. II. 17; cf. समोह।)
सम्मोहन: सम्-मोहन, अस्, ई, अम्, stupefying, bewitching, fascinating; (अम्), n. fascinating, fascination. —सम्-मोहन-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work.
सम्मोहयत्: सम्-मोहयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, stupefying, infatuat-ing, bewildering.
सम्मोहित: सम्-मोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, stupefied, bewildered, infatuated, beguiled, fascinated; enraptured.
सम्मोह्य: सम्-मोह्य, ind. having fascinated or stupefied, having bewildered.
सम्मृज्: सम्मृज् सम्-मृज् or सम्-मार्ज् (see rts. 1. मृज्, मार्ज्), cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि (sometimes cl. 1. -मार्जति, also cl. 10. P. -मार्जयति, -यितुम्), &c., to sweep together; to sweep clean, scour; to rub or wipe off, clean, cleanse, sweep, purify, wash, strain, filter; to take away, remove; to stroke.
सम्मार्जत्: सम्-मार्जत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, sweeping, cleansing, scouring.
सम्मार्जन: सम्-मार्जन, अम्, n. the act of sweeping or cleansing thoroughly; cleaning, scouring, purifying, brushing; the anointing (of images &c.); (ई), f. a broom, brush.
सम्मार्जित: सम्-मार्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, well swept or scoured.
सम्मार्ज्य: सम्-मार्ज्य, ind. having swept clean, having scoured, &c.
सम्मृज्यमान: सम्-मृज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being swept or cleansed.
सम्मृष्ट: सम्-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, well swept or scoured, cleaned, cleansed; strained, filtered.
सम्मृण्: सम्मृण् सम्-मृण्, cl. 6. P. -मृणति, &c., Ved. to kill, slay, destroy.
सम्मृत: सम्मृत सम्-मृत, अस्, आ, अम्, quite dead, deceased.
सम्मृद्: सम्मृद् सम्-मृद्, cl. 9. 1. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्दति, &c., to press or squeeze together, rub or grind to pieces, bruise, crush, trample upon, defeat: Caus. -मर्दयति, &c., to cause to be rubbed toge-ther, &c., crush, pound, bruise; to rub; to clean.
सम्मर्दयान: सम्-मर्दयान, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbing or dashing to pieces, shattering.
सम्मर्दित: सम्-मर्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly bruised, crushed, pounded.
सम्मर्दिन्: सम्-मर्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, pressing thoroughly, rubbing, crushing, trampling upon.
सम्मर्द्य: सम्-मर्द्य, ind. having pounded or bruised; having rubbed or cleaned.
सम्मृश्: सम्मृश् सम्-मृश्, cl. 6. P. A. -मृशति, -ते, &c., to take hold of, seize, touch.
सम्मोक्ष्: सम्मोक्ष् सम्-मोक्ष्, cl. 10. P. -मोक्षयति, -यितुम्, to set quite free, liberate, let loose, release.
सम्मोद: सम्मोद सम्-मोद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. मुद् with सम्), great rejoicing, delight, pleasure.
सम्म्यक्ष्: सम्म्यक्ष् सम्-म्यक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -म्यक्षति, &c. (see rt. म्यक्ष्), Ved. to be held together or united; to be joined with.
सम्म्रक्ष्: सम्म्रक्ष् सम्-म्रक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -म्रक्षति, &c. (see rt. म्रक्ष्), to rub on or in, anoint, em-brocate.
सम्म्रक्षित: सम्-म्रक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed in, anointed.
सम्यञ्च्: सम्यञ्च् सम्य्-अञ्च् or सम्य्-अच्, अङ्, ईची, अक् (fr. an old loc. 2. समि + अञ्च्, see समि; cf. तिरि fr. तिरस् in तिर्य्-अञ्च्), going along with or together, going with, accompanying; uniform, same, identical; all, entire, whole, complete; correct, accu-rate, proper, true, right; pleasant, agreeable; (अक्), ind. at the same time, with, together; wholly, com-pletely, entirely, comprehensively, thoroughly, fully, accurately, correctly, truly, properly, fitly, in right manner, honourably; well, duly; distinctly, clearly. —सम्यक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make true, perform well. —सम्यक्-चारित्र, अम्, n. ‘correct conduct,’ one of the three excellent things (according to the Jainas, see रत्न-त्रय). —सम्यक्-त्व, अम्, n. completeness, correctness, ac-curacy, propriety, (क्षायिक-स्°, that state of perfection in which material existence is destroyed.) —सम्यक्-पाठ, अस्, m. correct recitation or pronunciation. —सम्यक्-प्रयोग, अस्, m. fitting or proper use or employment, due practice; (एण), ind. by the use of proper means. —सम्यक्-प्रवृत्ति, इस्, f. the right or proper direction (of the organs). —सम्-यग्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, properly or accurately said, of equal weight or authority. —सम्यग्-गमन, अम्, n. the act of going with, accompanying. —सम्यग्-गोप्तृ, ता, m. a true protector or guardian. —सम्-यग्-ज्ञान, अम्, n. ‘complete knowledge,’ one of the three jewels or excellent things (according to the Jainas, see रत्न-त्रय). —सम्यग्-दण्डन, अम्, n. the act of punishing properly or justly; punishing legally. —सम्यग्-दर्शन, अम्, n. ‘com-plete vision, accurate perception,’ one of the three jewels or excellent things (according to the Jainas, see रत्न-त्रय); (with अव्रत), epithet of the fourth of the fourteen stages leading to final emanci-pation (according to the belief of the Jainas). —सम्-यग्-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, continuing in the proper discharge of duty, &c. —सम्यग्-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, properly conducted; wholly confiding in. —सम्यग्-वृत्ति, इस्, f. steady or complete practice, regular discharge of prescribed duties.
सम्राज्: सम्राज् सम्-राज्, ट्, m. (fr. सं-राज्, Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 25), a sovereign lord, paramount sovereign, one who rules over other princes and has performed the Rājasūya sacrifice; (ट्), f. a kind of Vedic metre.
सम्राजत्: सम्-राजत्, अन्, m., Ved. = सम्-राज्, (see सं-राज्।)
सम्राज्ञी: सम्राज्ञी, f., Ved. a woman who takes prece-dence, a mistress, superior.
सय्: सय् सय्, cl. 1. A. सयते, &c., to go.
सय: सय स-य, अस्, आ, अम्, with the letter य।
सयक्ष्मन्: सयक्ष्मन् स-यक्ष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having or subject to consumption, consumptive.
सयत्न: सयत्न स-यत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, making efforts, taking pains, endeavouring, persevering; active, busy; (अम्), ind. with effort, vigorously, assiduously.
सयन: सयन सयन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सि), the act of binding, fastening; [cf. प्र-स्°।]
सयन्त्र: सयन्त्र स-यन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, with machines. —स-यन्त्र-जल-शैल, अस्, आ, अम्, having engines and water and a rock.
सयावक: सयावक स-यावक, अस्, आ (according to some इका), अम्, dyed or coloured with lac.
सयावन्: सयावन् स-यावन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. going along with, attendant, attending, associated with (with inst.).
सयुज्: सयुज् स-युज्, क्, m., Ved. a companion.
सयुग्वन्: स-युग्वन्, आ, आ or अरी, अ, Ved. associated with, attending on, attendant; (आ), m. a proper N.
सयुज्य: स-युज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, closely united with. —स-युज्य-ता, f. intimate union or junction.
सयुधिष्ठिर: सयुधिष्ठिर स-युधिष्ठिर, अस्, आ, अम्, with or accompanied by Yudhiṣṭhira.
सयूथ्य: सयूथ्य स-यूथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the same herd or tribe; (अस्), m. one of the same tribe.
सयोग: सयोग स-योग, अम्, n. (scil. गुण-स्थान), epithet of the last but one of the fourteen stages leading to final emancipation (according to the belief of the Jainas).
सयोनि: सयोनि स-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the same womb, uterine; closely related to; closely united with the womb; (इस्), m. ‘being from the same womb,’ a brother; a pair of nippers for cutting betel-nut; N. of Indra (according to some).
सयोषण: सयोषण स-योषण, अस्, आ, अम्, attended by women, along with the women.
सर: सर सर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. सृ, cf. सल under rt. सल्), going, moving, proceeding (often at the end of comps., cf. पुरः-स्°); cathartic, purga-tive; (अस्), m. going, motion; an arrow [cf. शर]; the coagulum of curds or milk, cream, (in this sense cf. according to some, Gr. ὀρό-ς, ὀῤῤός, οὐρό-ς; Lat. seru-m; Lith. suri-s; Slav. syru); salt (pro-bably as coming from water, cf. सल, सरिर, स-लिल); a waterfall; (आ), f. going, motion, move-ment; a cascade, waterfall; the plant Pæderia Fetida; (ई), f. a cascade; (अम्), n. a lake, pool; water. —सर-ज, अम्, n. ‘produced from cream,’ fresh butter. —सर-पत्त्रिका, f. the new leaf of a lotus. —सर-वती, f., N. of the river Vitastā. —स-रोत्सव (°र-उत्°), अस्, m. ‘delighting in water,’ the Indian crane.
सरक: सरक, अस्, आ or इका, अम्, going, moving, pro-ceeding; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a continuous line of road, spirituous liquor (especially that distilled from sugar), rum; drinking spirits; a drinking vessel, goblet; distribution of spirituous liquor; (अम्), n. going; a lake, pond, pool; heaven, sky.
सरट्: सरट्, ट्, m. air, wind; a cloud; a bee; a lizard, chameleon.
सरट: सरट, अस्, m. wind; a kind of lizard or cha-meleon; [cf. शरट।]
सरटि: सरटि, इस्, m. air, wind; a cloud.
सरटु: सरटु, उस्, m. a lizard, chameleon.
सरण: सरण, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving, proceeding, flowing, who or what goes or moves; (अम्), n. the act of going, flowing, proceeding; iron rust or filings; (आ), f. the creeping plant Pæderia Fetida; a sort of convolvulus (= त्रि-वृता, commonly called Tëori).
सरणि: सरणि, इस्, f. a road, path, way [cf. 2. शरणि]; a straight or continuous line; the creeping plant Pæderia Fetida; a disease of the throat.
सरण्ड: सरण्ड, अस्, m. a bird; a lizard; a rogue, cheat; a dissolute man; a sort of ornament; [cf. शरण्ड।]
सरण्य: सरण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone; [cf. 2. शरण्य।]
सरण्यत्: सरण्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing to go; wishing to go everywhere, all-pervading, (Sāy. = सर्वत्र गमनम् इच्छत्।)
सरण्यु: सरण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, (probably) fleet, impetuous (Ved.); (उस्), m., N. of Yama, (Sāy. = सरण-शील); of the son of Varuṇa, (in Ṛg-veda X. 61, 24. said to have the form of a horse; the plural of this word is in other places applied to certain beings called Saraṇyus, who seem to be iden-tified in Ṛg-veda III. 32, 5. with the Maruts, and in I. 62, 4. with the Aṅgirasas, who are described by Sāy. as seven in number); air, wind; a cloud; water; spring (= वसन्त); fire (= अग्नि); [cf. Gr. ἐριννύς.]
सरण्यू: सरण्यू, ऊस्, f., Ved. ‘the fleet-running one,’ N. of a daughter of Tvaṣṭṛ, (in Ṛg-veda X. 17, 2. represented as wife of Vivasvat or the Sun and mother of the two Aśvins, and according to another legend, mother of the twins Yama and Yamī; ac-cording to Yāska XII. 10, Saraṇyū is a personifica-tion of the Night, and the first twins she bore were Madhyama and Mādhyamikā Vāc; she then made Sa-varṇā, q. v., take her place as wife of the Sun, and herself ran away in the form of a mare, but being pursued and embraced by the Sun in the form of a horse, then gave birth to the two Aśvins or ‘horsemen,’ her substitute Sa-varṇā giving birth to Manu); epithet of the Dawn (according to some).
सरत्: 1. सरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going, flowing, proceeding.
2. सरत्, त्, m. a thread; [cf. सरित्।]
सरपसस्: सरपसस्, pl., Ved. (in the Pada-pāṭha sepa-rated into सर अपसः), the flowing waters, (Sāy. = सरणम् अपः कर्म यासां ताः, those waters whose act is flowing, Ṛg-veda II. 13, 12.)
सरमा: सरमा, f. (probably fr. rt. सृ), ‘the runner,’ N. of the dog of Indra (represented in Ṛg-veda X. 14, 10. as the mother of the four-eyed brindled dogs of Yama, and called in Mahā-bhārata Ādi-p. 671. देव-शुनी; in the Ṛg-veda this dog is said to have gone in search of and recovered the cows stolen by the Paṇis; according to some modern scholars Saramā may be one of the names of उषस्, ‘Dawn,’ the cows representing the rays of the sun stolen by the night; the name Saramā is also thought to cor-respond with Helena; and Sārameya, q. v., is regarded as connected with Hermes, Saramā being by some identified with the Wind, as conductor of the souls of the departed; Saramā Deva-śunī is said to be the authoress of part of Ṛg-veda X. 108); a female dog, bitch; N. of the wife of Vibhīṣaṇa (Rāvaṇa's brother); of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Kaśyapa.
सरयु: सरयु, उस्, m. air, wind; (उस्), f., N. of a well-known river (commonly called by the various names Surjoo, Surju, Sirjoo, Seryu; it is a tributary of the Ghogra [see घर्घर] on which stands the ancient city of Ayodhyā or Oude, cf. Rāmāyaṇa I. 5, 6; in Ṛg-veda X. 64, 9, X. 75, 5. it is men-tioned along with the other well-known rivers Saras-vatī, Sindhu, Gaṅgā, Yamunā, and Śutu-dri). —स-रयु-तट, अस्, अम्, m. n. the bank of the Sarayu; N. of a place.
सरयू: सरयू, ऊस्, f., N. of a river (= सरयु above). —सरयू-वन, अम्, n. a forest on the river Sarayū.
सरल: सरल, अस्, आ, अम्, straight, not crooked, direct, right, honest, sincere, candid, artless, simple, upright [cf. शरल]; (अस्), m. a species of pine tree, Pinus Longifolia; a kind of bird, Pavo Bicalcarata; a Buddha; fire; (आ), f. a kind of convolvulus (= त्रि-पुटा); N. of a river. —सरल-काष्ठ, अम्, n. the wood of the pine. —सरल-द्रव, अस्, m. the exudation of the Sarala pine; a fragrant resin. —स-रल-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going in a straight line; upright, honest; (इनी), f. a plant with an upright stem. —सरल-स्कन्ध-सङ्घट्ट-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ, originating in the friction of the trunks of pines. —सरलाङ्ग (°ल-अङ्°), अस्, m. the exudation of the Sarala pine, resin, turpentine. —सरला-भाष्य, अम्, n., N. of a Bhāṣya.
सरव्य: सरव्य, अम्, n. (fr. सर, an arrow), a mark for shooting at, target, butt; [cf. शरव्य।]
सरस्: सरस्, अस्, n. (originally perhaps ‘flowing water’), water; a lake, large sheet of water, pond, pool; any piece of water in which the lotus grows, (in Naigh. 1. 12. enumerated among the उदक-नामानि, and in 1. 11. among the वाङ्-नामानि); [cf. Old Norse sir, sœr, sior; Angl. Sax. sirendœ.] —सरः-काक, अस्, m. ‘water-crow,’ a gander; (ई), f. a goose. —सरसि-ज, अम्, n. ‘pond-born,’ a lotus. —सरसि-रुह, अम्, n. ‘growing in a pond,’ a lotus. —सरसिरुह-जन्मन्, आ, m. ‘born from a lotus,’ epithet of Brahmā. —सरसी-रुह, अम्, n. ‘pool-growing,’ a lotus. —सरस्-तीर, अम्, n. the bank of a lake or pond. —सरस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, ‘having water,’ watery, fluid, juicy, sapid; elegant; sentimental; (आन्), m. the ocean; a male river; N. of a river-god, (in Ṛg-veda VII. 96, 4-6. assigned as a consort to Sarasvatī, see below); N. of Vāyu, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VII. 95, 3 = मध्य-स्थानो वयुः); a buffalo; (अती), f., N. of the goddess of speech and learning, (in the later mythology regarded as the wife or female energy of the god Brahmā or first deity of the Hindū triad [see ब्रह्मन्], and sometimes identified with Vāc, q. v., and invoked as a kind of muse or patroness of science and inventress of the Sanskrit language and letters; in the earliest mythology she was probably a river-deity, her name signifying ‘watery;’ according to Yāska [Nirukta II. 23] she was regarded both as a river and as a goddess; probably this river was to the earlier Hindūs what the Ganges [said to be only twice named in the Ṛg-veda] was to the later; sacrifices were doubtless performed on its banks, and its sanctity imparted a sacred character to the district lying between its waters and those of the Dṛṣad-vatī [see Manu II. 17]; hence the river Sarasvatī was not only personified as a river-goddess, but her assistance was invoked at the sacrifices performed near her flowing waters and her influence held to be necessary for inspiring the Ṛṣis who composed the sacrificial hymns with eloquence and wisdom; in Ṛg-veda II. 41, 16. she is called the best of mothers, of rivers, and of goddesses; in other places she is described as bestowing wealth, fertility, and offspring, as moving along a golden path, as destroying Vṛtra, as associated with the Aśvins, and even as the wife of Indra; in Ṛg-veda VI. 61, 10-12, VII. 36, 6. she is called the mother of rivers, and is said to be sevenfold or to have seven sisters; in Mahā-bhārata, Śalya-parvan 2189, seven Sarasvatīs are also men-tioned, viz. Su-prabhā, Kāñcanākṣī, Viśālā, Mano-ramā, Ogha-vatī, Su-reṇu, and Vimalodakā; in the Śānti-parvan 12920, Sarasvatī is called the mother of the Vedas, which is also elsewhere said of Vāc, though Vāc in the earlier mythology is regarded as a separate deity; according to later legends the goddess Sarasvatī was persuaded to descend from heaven and confer her invention of language and letters on the human race by the sage Bharata, whence one of her names is Bhāratī; she is some-times represented as assuming the form of a Haṃsa or swan, and is also called Mahā-śvetā or Mahā-śuklā from her extreme whiteness); N. of a cele-brated river (held very sacred by the Hindūs and in the earlier mythology mixed up with the goddess [see above]; it corresponds with the modern Sur-sooty, which rises in the mountains bounding the north-east part of the province of Delhi, and running in a south-westerly direction becomes lost in the sands of the great desert; this river formerly marked one of the boundaries of the region called Ārya-deśa, and of a particularly sacred district called in Manu II. 17. Brahmāvarta; in Ṛg-veda VII. 95, 2. it is represented as flowing into the sea, although later legends make it disappear underground and join the Ganges and Jumnā at Allahabad, see त्रि-वेणी, प्र-याग); a river (in general); speech, voice, eloquence, literary composition; a cow (= गो); N. of Durgā; an excellent woman; N. of the wife of a Manu; of the wife of Maṇḍana (see मण्डन-मिश्र); a female divinity peculiar to the Buddhists or Jainas; the moon-plant Asclepias Acida (= सोम-लता, ब्राह्-मी); N. of another plant (= ज्योतिष्-मती); N. of a celebrated grammarian, (in this and the follow-ing senses masc.); N. of various learned men. —सरस्वती-कण्ठाभरण (°ठ-आभ्°), N. of a work on the art of poetry by Bhoja-deva. —स-रस्वती-कुटुम्ब, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —सरस्वती-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —सरस्वती-पू-जन, अम्, n. or सरस्वती-पूजा, f. the worship of Sarasvatī (observed on the fifth of the light half of the month Māgha, on which day books and im-plements are held sacred and not allowed to be used). —सरस्वती-प्रयोग, अस्, m. a kind of mystical rite peculiar to the Tāntrikas. —सरस्वती-मन्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a hymn to Sarasvatī. —सरस्वती-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a particular religious observance. —सरस्वती-सरस्, अस्, n., N. of a sacred lake. —सरस्वती-सूक्त, अम्, n., N. of a particular hymn. —सरस्वती-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of particular grammatical aphorisms. —सरस्वती-स्तव, अस्, m. or सरस्वती-स्तोत्र, अम्, n., N. of a hymn. —सरो-ज, अम्, n. ‘lake-born,’ a lotus; (अस्), m. a prosodial foot containing six long syllables (according to some). —सरो-जन्मन्, अ, n. ‘lake-born,’ a lotus. —सरो-जल, अम्, n. the water of a pond or lake. —सरोजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having lotuses; (ई), m. epithet of Brahmā; (इनी), f. a pond abounding in lotuses; a multitude of lotuses; a lotus. —सरो-रक्ष, अस्, m. the guardian of a pool. —सरो-रुह्, ट्, or सरो-रुह, अम्, n. ‘pond-growing,’ a lotus. —सरोरुहासन (°ह-आस्°), अस्, m. ‘sitting on a lotus,’ epithet of Brahmā (as having appeared first from the interior of a lotus springing from the navel of Viṣṇu in order to create the world). —सरो-रुहिणी, f. ‘pond-growing,’ a lotus. —सरो-वर, अस्, m. a lake, large pond, any piece of water deep enough for the lotus to grow.
सरस: 1. सरस, अम्, n. (for 2. see col. 2), a tank, pond, lake, (also a substitute for सरस् at the end of a comp.); alchemy; (आ), f. a sort of white convolvulus (= श्वेत-त्रिवृता). —सरस-वाणी, f. a proper N.

सरस 2. स-रस, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see col. 1), tasty, juicy, succulent, sapid; fresh, new; beautiful, charming, excellent; agreeable; expressive of poetical sentiment, (see रस); impassioned, enrap-tured; (अम्), ind. with rapture. —सरसाङ्गयष्टि (°स-अङ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, one whose delicate body is wet with perspiration, (see under 2. यष्टि।)
सरसिक: सरसिक or सरसीक, अस्, m. the Indian crane.
सरसी: सरसी, f. a lake, large pond or sheet of water; N. of a species of metre. —सरसी-रुह, अम्, n. ‘pond-growing,’ a lotus.
सरि: सरि, इस्, m. a cascade, waterfall; [cf. सर, सरी।] —सरि-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
सरिका: सरिका, f. the act of going or proceeding; a woman going or moving [cf. सरक]; a particular drug (= हिङ्गु-पत्त्री).
सरित्: सरित्, त्, f. a stream, river; a thread, string; a particular species of metre. —सरितां-वरा, f. ‘best of rivers,’ the Ganges. —सरितान्-नाथ, अस्, or सरिताम्-पति or सरित्-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of rivers,’ the ocean. —सरित्-वत्, आन्, m. ‘possessed of rivers,’ the ocean. —सरित्-सुत, अस्, m. ‘river-son,’ epithet of Bhīṣma (son of Gaṅgā). —सरिद्-भर्तृ, ता, m. ‘river-lord,’ the ocean; a symbolical term for the number four, (see 1. सम्-उद्र, p. 1079). —सरिद्-वधू, ऊस्, f. ‘river-woman,’ a woman-like river. —सरिद्-वरा, f. ‘best of rivers,’ the Ganges. —सरिन्-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘river-lord,’ the ocean. —सरिन्-मरु-वनाश्रय (°न-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, protected by a wood, desert, and river. —सरिन्-मुख, अम्, n. the source of a river.
सरिन्: सरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. going, moving, one who goes.
सरिमन्: सरिमन् or सरीमन्, आ, m. going, moving, pro-ceeding; air, wind.
सरिर: सरिर, अम्, n., Ved. = सलिल, water, the ocean, (enumerated among the बहु-नामानि in Naigh. III. 1); the universe (= लोक, लोक-त्रय, according to Mahīdhara on Vājasaneyi-s. XV. 52, XVII. 87).
सर्म: सर्म, अस्, m. going, running; sky; heaven; [cf. Gr. ὁρμή.]
सरक्तगौर: सरक्तगौर स-रक्त-गौर, अस्, आ, अम्, being of a red and whitish colour.
सरघा: सरघा सरघा, f. (said to be fr. सर, ‘a goer,’ and rt. हन्), a bee, (apparently also अम्, n.)
सरङ्ग: सरङ्ग स-रङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having colour; having a nasal sound; (अस्), m. a quadruped; a bird; [cf. सारङ्ग।]
सरङ्गक: सरङ्गक सरङ्गक, a species of the Atiśak-varī metre.
सरजत्: सरजत् स-रजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. rt. रञ्ज् with स for सह), Ved. colouring or tinging at the same time, (Sāy. = सह-रजत्, Ṛg-veda X. 115, 3.)
सरजस्: सरजस् स-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having dust or dirt or impurity; (आस्), f. a woman during menstru-ation.
सरजस: स-रजस, अस्, आ, अम्, having dirt or impurity of any kind; (अम्), ind., see Vopa-deva VI. 60. —स-रजस-ता, f. dirtiness, dustiness.
सरजस्क: स-रजस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, = स-रजस above.
सरटक: सरटक सरटक, अस्, m., N. of a mendicant.
सरत्नि: सरत्नि सरत्नि, इस्, m. f. a kind of cubit mea-sure (= रत्नि); a short cubit (according to some).
सरथ: सरथ स-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a car or chariot, possessing a carriage; riding in the same car; (अस्), m. a warrior or Kṣatriya (as riding in a chariot). —स-रथ-पादात, अस्, आ, अम्, accom-panied by or along with chariots and infantry.
सरभ: सरभ सरभ, a species of the Atiśakvarī metre.
सरभक: सरभक, (probably) a kind of animal or insect; [cf. शरभ।]
सरभस: सरभस स-रभस, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing speed or impetuosity, impetuous, speedy, quick; agitated, passionate; delighted; (अम्), ind. im-petuously, with great speed, hurriedly, hastily, pas-sionately, delightedly.
सरशन: सरशन स-रशन, अस्, आ, अम्, having a girdle, girdled.
सरषट्ट: सरषट्ट सरषट्ट, N. of a place.
सरसम्प्रत: सरसम्प्रत सरसम्प्रत, अम्, n. a sort of Euphorbia (= त्रि-कण्ट).
सरहस्य: सरहस्य स-रहस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing anything secret or mystical, magical, mystical; having the secret or mystical doctrine (of the Upaniṣads, see Manu. II. 140); along with the Upaniṣads or esoteric part of Vedic teaching. —स-रहस्य-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing mystical spells.
सराग: सराग स-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, having colour, coloured, tinted; having passion, passionate, impas-sioned. —सराग-ता, f. the being coloured with red. —सराग-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, red-eyed.
सराजक: सराजक स-राजक, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing a king; along with the king.
सराट: सराट सराट, N. of a place.
सराति: सराति स-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. accompanied with presents or wealth.
सराव: सराव सराव, अस्, m. (for शराव, q. v.), a lid, cover; a shallow cup, saucer, &c.
सराष्ट्र: सराष्ट्र स-राष्ट्र, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing a kingdom; along with the kingdom.
सराष्ट्रक: स-राष्ट्रक, अस्, आ, अम्, = स-राष्ट्र above.
सराहु: सराहु स-राहु, उस्, उस्, उ, possessed or held by Rāhu, q. v.; eclipsed.
सरिषप: सरिषप सरिषप, अस्, m. = सर्षप, mus-tard, Sinapis Dichotoma.
सरीसृप: सरीसृप सरीसृप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens. of rt. सृप्), crawling, creeping; (अस्), m. a snake.
सरु: सरु सरु, उस्, उस्, उ (probably to be con-nected with rt. सृ, cf. rt. त्सर्), minute, thin, fine, small; (उस्), m. = त्सरु, the hilt or handle of a sword.
सरुज्: सरुज् स-रुज्, क्, क्, क्, or स-रुज, अस्, आ, अम्, suffering pain or sickness, sick, ill, diseased; [cf. per-haps Goth. saurga.]
सरोग: स-रोग, अस्, आ, अम्, affected with disease, sick, diseased. —सरोग-ता, f. or सरोग-त्व, अम्, n. sickliness.
सरोगिन्: सरोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, diseased, sick. —सरोगि-ता, f. sickliness, sickness, disease.
सरुष्: सरुष् स-रुष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, feeling anger, angry.
सरूप: सरूप स-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, of the same shape, like, similar, resembling, having shape, shaped, formed. —सरूप-ता, f. or सरूप-त्व, अम्, n. identity of form, likeness, resemblance, assimilation to the deity, (one of the four states into which मुक्ति, q. v., is distinguished.)
सरेफ: सरेफ स-रेफ, अस्, आ, अम्, together with the letter र्।
सरोध: सरोध स-रोध, अस्, आ, अम्, having hin-drance or obstruction or opposition; having destruc-tion or loss; (अस्), m. obstruction, opposition (ac-cording to some).
सरोम: सरोम स-रोम, अस्, आ, अम्, having hair, hairy. —स-रोम-कण्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, having hair bristling with ecstasy. —स-रोम-विक्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, thrilling with ecstasy.
सरोष: सरोष स-रोष, अस्, आ, अम्, full of anger, angry, wrathful; (अम्), ind. with anger, angrily. —सरोष-रागोपहत (°ग-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, suffused with a flush of anger.
सर्क: सर्क सर्क, अस्, m. (according to Śabda-k.), wind, air, (probably fr. rt. सृ); the mind; N. of Prajā-pati, (perhaps for सर्ग below.)
सर्ग: सर्ग सर्ग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. सृज्), letting go, relinquishment, abandonment; loss of conscious-ness, fainting (= मोह); voiding (as excrement &c.); letting loose; creation, the creation of the world, (in Bhāgavata-Purāṇa III. 10, 13, &c. nine different creations are enumerated, viz. 1. Mahat or intellect; 2. Aham or personality; 3. Tan-mātra, the subtile, with the five grosser elements [see तन्-मात्र]; 4. Indriya or organs; 5. Vaikārika or Deva-sarga, which also comprises Manas or mind; 6. Tamas or darkness; 7. Tasthuṣāṃ Sarga or creation of stationary creatures, such as tress, plants, &c., which are said to be उत्-स्रोतस्, having the flow or current of life upwards, cf. ऊर्ध्व-स्रोतस्; 8. Tiraścāṃ Sarga or creation of animals, cf. तिर्यक्-स्रोतस्; 9. Nṛṇāṃ Sarga or creation of men, which is said to be अर्वाक्-स्रोतस्, q. v.); nature, the universe; natural property, disposition, tendency; onset, advance, motion, rush; a troop of horses let loose (Ved.); a horse, (Sāy. = अश्व); effort, reso-lution, determination, resolve, will, perseverance; a chapter, book, section, canto; assent, agreement; ascertainment, certainty; epithet of Śiva; (आस्), m. pl., Ved. a stream of water (= उदक, Naigh. I. 12). —सर्ग-क्रम, अस्, m. the order of creation. —सर्ग-तक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. set in motion, (Sāy. = गमने प्रवृत्त।) —सर्ग-प्रतक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. urged on to impetuous motion, (Sāy. = विसर्जनेन प्रगमित।) —सर्ग-बन्ध, अस्, m. ‘chapter-composition,’ a Mahā-kāvya or great poem; any work or book comprising several sections or chapters.
सर्ज: सर्ज, अस्, m. the Śāl tree, Shorea Robusta (= शाल); another tree (= पीत-शाल); the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. —सर्ज-गन्धा, f. a particular plant (= रास्ना). —सर्ज-निर्यासक, अस्, or सर्ज-मणि, इस्, or सर्ज-रस, अस्, m. the resi-nous exudation of the Śāl tree; resin (in general).
सर्जक: सर्जक, अस्, m. the Śāl tree; another tree (= पीत-शाल).
सर्जन: सर्जन, अम्, n. the act of letting go or letting loose, abandonment, quitting; voiding (excrement &c.); the reserve or rear of an army; the act of creating, creation.
सर्जि: सर्जि, इस्, f. natron, (see below.) —सर्जि-क्षार, अस्, m. = सर्जि, (also written स्वर्जि-क्षार।)
सर्जिका: सर्जिका, f. natron, impure alkali or carbonate of soda (used in India instead of soap for cleaning linen &c.). —सर्जिका-क्षार, अस्, m. natron, (also written स्वर्जिका-क्षार।)
सर्ज्: सर्ज् सर्ज् [cf. rt. 1. अर्ज्], cl. 1. P. सर्जति, सर्जितुम्, to earn by labour, acquire, gain.
सर्जू: सर्जू, ऊस्, m. (in Uṇādi-s. I. 82. said to be fr. rt. सर्ज् above, but probably to be connected with rt. 1. सृज्, cf. सर्ज above), a merchant, trader; (ऊस्), f. lightning; a necklace; going, following.
सर्प: सर्प सर्प, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सृप्), a creeping or serpentine or tortuous motion, creeping, moving gently, gliding, sliding, twining; going, flowing; a snake, serpent; a particular tree (= नाग-केशर); a particular tribe of Mlecchas or barbarians who were formerly Kṣatriyas (mentioned in the twenty-fourth chapter of the Hari-vaṃśa, and described as wearing beards); N. of a particular Rudra; (ई), f. a female snake; N. of the wife of a Rudra; [cf. the charming of serpents. —सर्-प-विष-प्रतिषेध, अस्, m. the keeping off or expelling of snake-poison. —सर्प-वेद, N. of a work on serpents or their influence. —सर्प-व्यापा-दन, अम्, n. the killing of serpents; being killed by a snake. —सर्प-शिरस्, आस्, m. सर्पण: सर्पण, अम्, n. the act of creeping or gliding; going tortuously; the flight of an arrow nearly parallel with the ground.
सर्पत्: सर्पत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, gliding, creeping, sliding, slipping, going.
सर्पिन्: सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going gently or tortuously, creeping, gliding, winding, sliding, slipping, twin-ing, moving; (इणी), f. a female serpent; a small medicinal shrub (= भुज-गी).
सर्पिस्: सर्पिस्, इस्, n. clarified butter, ghee, (in Naigh. I. 12. enumerated among the उदक-नामानि।) —सर्-पिर्-आसुति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. sacrificed or worshipped with butter; (इस्), m. epithet of Agni. —सर्पिष्-कुण्डिका, f. a butter-jar. —सर्पिष्-टर, more com-pletely clarified butter, more or most excellent ghee. —सर्पिष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of ghee, seasoned with clarified butter. —सर्पिष्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing ghee, dressed with butter. —सर्-पिस्-समुद्र, अस्, m. the sea of clarified butter (one of the seven seas, see 1. सम्-उद्र).
सर्ब्: सर्ब् सर्ब् (also written सम्ब्), cl. 1. P. सर्बति, &c., to go, move.
सर्व्: सर्व् सर्व् (= rt. शर्व्), cl. 1. P. सर्वति, &c., to hurt, injure, kill.
सर्व: सर्व सर्व, अस्, आ, अम् (in Uṇādi-s. 1. 153. said to be fr. rt. सृ, ‘to go,’ ‘pervade,’ this rt. having also, according to some, the meaning ‘to be strong or whole,’ cf. सार; according to others fr. सत्र for सत्रा, q. v., व being affixed; dat. sing. सर्वस्मै, nom. pl. सर्वे, &c., this declension being the model for a whole series of pronominals, see Gram. 237), all, every; whole, entire, universal, complete; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; of Viṣṇu; of a Muni, (सर्वम् is enumerated among the उदक-नामानि in Naigh. 1. 12); [cf. साङ्ख्य: साङ्ख्य साङ्ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. सङ्-ख्या), relating to number or calculation, reckoning up, cal-culating, enumerating, deliberating, reasoning; ra-tional, discriminative; (अस्, अम्), m. n., N. of one of the three great divisions of Hindū philosophy, (ascribed to the sage Kapila, q. v., and so called as ‘reckoning up’ or ‘enumerating’ twenty-five Tat-tvas or true principles, its object being to effect the final liberation of the twenty-fifth Tattva [Puruṣa, the Soul] from the fetters of the phenomenal crea-tion by conveying the correct knowledge of the twenty-four other Tattvas, and rightly discriminating the Soul from them; these twenty-four principles are divided into eight Prakṛtis or Producers and six-teen Vikāras or Productions; the eight Producers start from a Mūla-prakṛti or original Producer [variously called Pradhāna, ‘chief one;’ A-vyakta, ‘unevolved;’ Brahman, ‘supreme;’ Māyā, ‘power of illusion;’ Bahu-dhānaka, ‘much-containing’], which is emphatically the Prakṛti, ‘First-producer,’ or ‘Originant,’ being a kind of primordial germ whence all the twenty-three remaining Tattvas are evolved; its first production is the 2nd Tattva, viz. Buddhi, Intellect [sometimes called महत् from its being the great source of the two other internal organs or instruments, Ahaṅkāra and Manas, which are both modifications of it]; 3rd in order comes Ahaṅ-kāra, ‘the I-making’ principle or sense of indi-viduality; 4th come the five Tan-mātras or subtile elementary particles out of which the five grosser elements are evolved; the preceding eight principles constitute the Producers, [all but the first being of course in one sense also Productions]; then follow, as proceeding from the Tan-mātras, the five Sthūla-bhūtas or grosser elements [also called Mahā-bhūta], viz. a. आकाश, space or ether, having the Guṇa or property of sound [शब्द], which is the Viṣaya or object of apprehension for the corresponding Indriya or organ, the Ear; b. वायु, air, having the Guṇa or property of tangibility or touch [स्पर्श], which is the Viṣaya for the Skin; c. तेजस् or ज्योतिस्, fire or light, having the property of form or colour [रूप], which is the Viṣaya for the Eye; d. आपस्, water, having the property of savour or taste [रस], which is the Viṣaya for the Tongue; e. पृथिवी or भूमि, earth, having the property of odour or smell [गन्ध], which is the Viṣaya for the Nose, [see गुण]; each of these elements after the first having also the Guṇa or Guṇas of the pre-ceding besides its own, and these Guṇas being some-times identified with the Tan-mātras; then follow the eleven organs, produced like the Tan-mātras from the 3rd Tattva Ahaṅkāra, forming with them a class of sixteen [षोडशकः]; these eleven organs are the five above-named Buddhīndriyāṇi or organs of sense, viz. ear, skin, eye, tongue, nose; the five Karmendriyāṇi or organs of action, viz. larynx, hand, foot, arms, and organ of generation; and an eleventh organ called Manas, commonly translated ‘mind,’ which stands between both sets of Indriyas as an in-ternal organ of perception and action, or of cogni-tion and volition, [see मनस्]: the twenty-fifth Tattva, Puruṣa or Soul, is to be wholly distinguished from the twenty-four just enumerated; it is neither a Producer nor Production; it is altogether passive, and simply a looker-on, having nothing whatever to do with the acts of creation, which it only contem-plates, uniting itself with unintelligent Prakṛti, as a lame man mounted on a blind man's shoulders, for the sake of observing and enjoying the acts of this Prakṛti, who herself cannot see or observe any-thing; without that union no creation can take place any more than can the birth of a child without the union of male and female; this view of creation implies the eternal existence of innumerable separate individual souls, each soul by its junction with Pra-kṛti causing the creation of its own phenomenal world, which world, however, has an existence of its own independent of all connection with the par-ticular Puruṣa to which it is joined; moreover, each soul is invested in the first place with a subtile body [लिङ्ग-शरीर or सूक्ष्म-शरीर] composed of Buddhi, Ahaṅkāra, the five Tan-mātras, and the eleven organs, and afterwards with a grosser body formed of the five elements; the former accompany-ing the soul through all its transmigrations, while the latter perishes; this system also teaches that Prakṛti and its products may be regarded as made up of three ingredients in a state of equipoise, viz. Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas, Goodness, Passion, and Darkness, commonly called Guṇas, but rather substances than qualities, and more correctly translated ‘fetters,’ be-cause they are like a triple-stranded rope [see गुण] which binds and confines the soul: the Sāṅ-khya system agrees with the Vedānta in being synthetical, and so differing from the Analytical Nyāya; its great point of divergence from the Vedānta is in maintaining two principles which the Vedānta denies, [see वेदान्त]; it is said to be atheistical as ignoring all notice of a Supreme Soul, whose existence is, however, established by the Yoga branch of the Sāṅkhya proper, [see योग]: the vague outlines of the system before its crystallization into a distinct school of dualism are propounded in the first Book of Manu: its more fully developed doctrines are contained in the Sāṅkhya-sūtras ascribed to Kapila, in the Tattva-samāsa, or Summary of Principles, ascribed to the same author, in the Sāṅkhya-kārikā [see below], and the numerous commentaries on these works, some of which are enumerated below: the Buddhist system and that of bishop Berkeley in Europe have many points of connection with the Sāṅkhya, but the modern phi-losophers of India pay far more attention to the Nyāya and Vedānta); a follower of the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy; a patronymic of the Vedic Ṛṣi Atri; epithet of Śiva. —साङ्ख्य-कारिका, f., N. of a collection of memorial verses or stanzas by Īśvara-kṛṣṇa in which a summary of the Sāṅkhya system is given. —साङ्ख्य-कारिका-भाष्य, अम्, n., N. of a commentary by Gauḍa-pāda on the Sāṅkhya-kārikā. —साङ्ख्य-कौमुदी, f. = साङ्-ख्य-तत्त्व-कौमुदी;
